31386.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code, Code of Criminal Procedure and several related laws to criminalise participating in or assisting terrorist training, to extend the possibility of disqualification from a profession as an additional penalty to more offences (including for company directors and tax/financial offences), to raise penalties for certain offences tied to terrorism preparation, child pornography and fraud, and to allow Royal Marechaussee officers to be given technical-tool communication interception orders. It also makes administrative costs recoverable with fines and adds a criminal offence for unlawfully entering airports.
31386.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers by pointing to the need for an integrated approach to financial-economic crime, terrorism prevention and the wish to prevent repeat offending, with judges retaining discretion and proportionality review.
q: It is for the judge to assess whether the sanction is justified in the given case.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de sanctie in het gegeven geval gerechtvaardigd is.
d: training and cooperation rules for Royal Marechaussee officers authorised to intercept communications
p: Artikel I H, I (artikel 137h Sr, artikel 194 lid 3, artikel 205 lid 2, artikel 235, artikel 349)

Extends the court's power to impose disqualification from one's profession as an additional penalty to many more offences, including for first offenders, which broadens sanctioning discretion but is decided by a judge.

Allows the public prosecutor to order Royal Marechaussee officers to intercept confidential communications, including entering homes, extending a privacy-intrusive power to another enforcement body under conditions set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks how the motion on strafrechtelijke ondercuratelestelling will be implemented and whether the expanded disqualification can be enforced in practice.
These members ask the government to address in the reply how this motion will be implemented, insofar as possible within this bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering in de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag in te gaan op de vraag hoe deze motie, voor zover mogelijk in het kader van deze wet, zal worden uitgevoerd.

Asks whether the higher maximum penalty for child pornography investigation powers is a workable way to give courts the power, and whether the terrorism training offence goes beyond the European convention.
In the view of these members, however, the proposed criminal liability in this bill goes further than that.
De voorgestelde strafbaarheid in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel gaat naar de mening van deze leden echter verder dan dat.
Questions the breadth of the terrorism training offence, the lack of an explicit intent requirement, and why the evaluation of existing counterterrorism measures is not awaited.
In the view of the SP members, the European Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism only obliges criminalising giving training for terrorism.
Naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie verplicht het Europees Verdrag ter voorkoming van terrorisme slechts het training geven voor terrorisme strafbaar te stellen.
Supports the bill as a means to tackle serious organised crime and terrorism more effectively.
These members are positive about the majority of the amendments.
Deze leden staan positief tegenover het merendeel van de wijzigingen.
Asks how disqualification from a religious or other profession fits with church-state separation, freedom of expression and property, and the effects on benefits and pensions.
What are the consequences of this disqualification possibility for the right to free choice of work and the protection of property?
Wat zijn de consequenties van deze ontzettingsmogelijkheid voor het recht op vrije keuze van arbeid, bescherming van eigendom?

31458.s: The bill harmonises administrative fine regimes across several financial supervision and pension laws by moving the fine amounts and the categories of fineable offences into general administrative orders (AMvB), with a statutory cap of EUR 2,000,000 per offence. It also adds suspension of fine payment during objection or appeal and repeals the annexes listing offences by category.
31458.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to AMvB by saying a flexible fine system with boeterichtsnoeren lets the supervisor tailor fines to the circumstances of each case within statutory bounds.
q: General administrative orders shall set rules on the exercise of the power referred to in the first paragraph.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de uitoefening van de bevoegdheid, bedoeld in het eerste lid.
d: Pensioenwet art. 176(2); Sanctiewet 1977 art. 10d(5); Wfbb art. 9b(2); Wgt art. 21(2); Wta art. 54(2); Wtt art. 21(2); Wvb art. 171(2); Wbpf 2000 art. 19(2); Wft art. 1:80(2) (as amended)
rules on exercising the power to impose administrative fines
Pensioenwet art. 179(1)-(2); Sanctiewet art. 10e; Wfbb art. 9c; Wgt art. 22; Wft art. 1:81; Wta art. 55; Wtt art. 22; Wvb art. 174; Wbpf art. 20; Wtt/Wft/Wgt amended
amount of administrative fines and offence categories, within a statutory cap of EUR 2,000,000
Wft art. 1:81 (as amended by art. V.B); Wwft art. 28(3)
boeterichtsnoeren: criteria for setting fine level within category bandwidth, incl. recidivism and gravity
p: Art. I-X, fine categories and bandwidths

Fine amounts for each offence category and the criteria for setting fine levels are moved from statute annexes to general administrative orders, reducing parliamentary control over sanction levels, though a statutory maximum of EUR 2,000,000 remains.
Art. IV.D and VII.C, VIII.C (art. 23/56/23 new)
Objection or appeal against a fine suspends payment until the appeal period ends or the appeal is decided, which protects citizens' legal position.
Offences in the highest fine category are made criminally punishable under the Economic Offences Act, linking administrative and criminal enforcement.

parties: Asks for a numerical justification of the fines and for the AMvB guidelines to be laid down in law, and insists on strict separation between investigation and sanctioning.
The said members attach great importance to a strict separation between these two powers of the supervisors.
Genoemde leden hechten groot belang aan een strikte scheiding tussen deze twee bevoegdheden van de toezichthouders.
Questions the basis of guidelines in AMvB form, whether the AMvB will be submitted to parliament, and why key elements are not in the bill.
Will this AMvB be submitted to the House?
Zal deze AMvB bij de kamer worden voorgehangen?
Supports higher fines but argues that the general principles for fines should be set at statutory level, as the Raad van State advised, and worries about more court appeals.
The said members share the view of the Council of State that the general principles should actually be regulated at statutory level.
Genoemde leden delen de mening van de Raad van State dat de algemene uitgangspunten eigenlijk op wetsniveau zouden moeten worden geregeld.

Supports the bill in principle but wants legal certainty, statutory functional separation as advised by the Raad van State, a draft AMvB, and clarity on the effect of reduced fines for pension providers.
The said members also argue for great legal certainty and therefore, like the Council of State, believe essential elements of the system should be regulated at statutory level.
Genoemde leden pleiten ook voor grote rechtszekerheid en zijn derhalve net als de Raad van State van mening dat essentiële elementen van het stelsel op wetsniveau moet worden geregeld.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill's essential elements of the fine system, including fine categories and flexibility in the top two categories, be set in statute rather than in an AMvB, and that stronger functional separation be required, while also raising points on the liability of individual directors and the discretion of supervisors. The government's reply accepted the bill would move the fine categories into the law itself, kept the circumstances rules in an AMvB, and clarified the commentary on separation of functions and director liability.
concerns: The Council considered that essential elements of the fine system, including fine categories and flexibility in the top two categories, should be laid down in statute for legal certainty, rather than left to a near-blank delegation.

The Council found the near-blanket delegation to an AMvB insufficient guarantee that fining rules would follow the announced design; the government moved fine categories into the law but kept circumstance rules in an AMvB.

The Council required stronger functional separation so that the department that conducted supervision or drafted the report is no longer involved in the fine proposal, to protect legal protection of those fined.
The Council asked that the explanatory memorandum nuance the liability of individual directors and managers in line with Supreme Court case law under article 51 of the Criminal Code.
The Council asked that the explanatory memorandum clarify that supervisors may depart from the guideline fine levels within statutory minimum and maximum bounds, consistent with the Boetenota.

31467.s: The bill lets the mayor order persons who repeatedly disturbed public order in groups to stay out of specified areas or objects, or to report at set times, for up to three months per order, extendable twice. It also lets the public prosecutor impose conduct directions on suspects pending trial, for up to 90 days, and makes violating such a direction a crime.
31467.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by persistent serious group nuisance and football hooliganism that current instruments cannot adequately address, and by the need for more specific, longer-lasting and earlier intervention.
q: The bill contains a power for the mayor to issue an order for the maintenance of public order.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat een bevoegdheid voor de burgemeester tot het geven van een bevel voor de handhaving van de openbare orde.
p: Mayor gains power to impose area bans, group bans and reporting obligations of up to nine months on persons in public-order disturbing groups, subject to appeal to the administrative court.
Public prosecutor may impose conduct directions on suspects before any court judgment, for up to 90 days extendable, with appeal to the district court.

parties: Supports effective nuisance enforcement but asks how the mayor's powers will be controlled and whether powers should be fully used with accountability.
These members find that the mayor has repeatedly had his powers expanded in recent times.
Deze leden vinden dat de burgemeester de afgelopen tijd meermalen heeft te maken gehad met uitbreiding van zijn bevoegdhedenarsenaal.
Welcomes the bill but stresses careful weighing and dossier-building because the instruments can be far-reaching for those affected, asking for protocols and evaluation.
At the same time these members ask whether it is possible to give mayors and public prosecutors more clarity on the use of the instruments in this act.
Tegelijk vragen deze leden of het niet mogelijk is om de burgemeesters en officieren van justitie meer duidelijkheid te geven over de inzet van de instrumenten in deze wet.
Questions the mayor's role as administrative sanctioner and prefers prosecutor and judicial measures; demands quick appeal procedures and warns against arbitrariness.
They explicitly prefer the prosecutor's conduct order over a group or area ban imposed by the mayor.
Zij geven uitdrukkelijk de voorkeur aan de gedragsaanwijzing van de officier van justitie, boven een groeps- of gebiedsverbod door de burgermeester.
Asks for justification of the duration of bans, legal basis for dossiers, access rights for those affected, and empirical evidence that existing powers are insufficient.
Can the government give a reasoned account of why the separate powers in the motion, such as a contact ban or curfew, are not explicitly granted to the mayor in the bill?

Kan de regering gemotiveerd aangeven waarom de in de motie opgenomen afzonderlijke bevoegdheden zoals contactverbod of avondklok niet expliciet in het wetsvoorstel aan de burgemeester worden toegekend?
Finds the bill insufficient and wants broader area bans and an unlimited period for bans at the mayor's discretion.
The PVV members want the proposed time limit (maximum three times 90 days) for area and group bans dropped, so that they are unlimited at the mayor's discretion.

De leden van de PVV-fractie willen graag dat de tijdsperiode die voorgesteld wordt (maximaal drie keer 90 dagen) voor gebieds- en groepsverboden komt te vervallen, en dat deze naar het inzicht van de burgemeester onbeperkt wordt.
Criticises the lack of individual problem analysis and of evidence that existing powers were tried, citing the Raad van State, and asks the government to withdraw the proposal pending such analysis.
These members, together with the Raad van State, consider such an analysis indispensable before new powers can even be considered.
Deze leden achten, met de Raad van State, een dergelijk analyse onmisbaar voordat überhaupt kan worden overwogen nieuwe bevoegdheden in het leven te roepen.
Supports the aim but asks about religious freedom limits on bans, the mayor's role and the handling of appeals.
An area ban may not restrict the person in the exercise of their religion or belief, unless special circumstances require it.
Een gebiedsverbod mag betrokkene niet beperken in de uitoefening van zijn godsdienst of levensovertuiging, tenzij bijzondere omstandigheden daartoe nopen.
Supports the bill but asks about the responsibility of football clubs and information exchange between police forces.
Although the bill is clearly linked to football hooliganism, the SGP members feel insufficient attention is paid to the football clubs' own responsibility.

Hoewel het wetsvoorstel duidelijk gekoppeld is aan voetbalvandalisme, wordt er naar de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie onvoldoende aandacht besteed aan de verantwoordelijkheid van de voetbalclubs zelf.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill on mayoral area bans and prosecutor conduct orders against football hooliganism and serious nuisance be reconsidered, citing insufficient problem analysis, lack of urgency for the mayor's new powers, overlap between mayor and prosecutor powers, and concerns about the prosecutor's conduct order lasting too long without court involvement. The government's nader rapport largely rejects the Raad's advice on the mayoral ban and prosecutor powers, but adopts several drafting changes, shortens the maximum duration of mayoral orders to nine months, adds a 90-day prosecution deadline and court power to amend conduct orders, and sharpens the conditions for pre-trial detention and conduct orders.
concerns: The Raad finds the problem analysis of football hooliganism and other nuisance insufficiently thorough and the urgency for new mayoral powers insufficiently motivated, advising postponement pending a vision on the mayor's public order portfolio; the government rejects postponement but adds more justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad argues that a long-lasting ban imposed by the administration rather than a judge is inappropriate and that prosecutor conduct orders should be limited to a short period with court involvement thereafter; the government maintains that administrative and prosecutorial competence is appropriate.

The Raad questions proportionality of long-duration mayoral and prosecutorial orders; the government reduces the maximum mayoral ban duration from one year to nine months but keeps the prosecutor's order framework.

The Raad asks for a 90-day deadline after which a prosecutor's conduct order lapses if no prosecution follows, and for the order to lapse upon a court judgment; the government adds the 90-day-related limit and a court power to amend orders, but not automatic lapse.

The Raad proposes merging articles 172a and 172b of the Gemeentewet and sharpening vague terms such as 'rechtstreeks in verband' and 'ernstig belastend gedrag'; the government adopts most of these redactional changes.

The Raad notes that a conduct order restricts liberty of unconvicted suspects and that the scope of 'belastend gedrag' is too vague; the government tightens the wording to require a link with the suspected offence.

The Raad flags practical problems of competence overlap between mayor and prosecutor requiring case-level consultation; the government answers that consultation already occurs in the local triangle and in safety houses.

31548.s: The bill adds a sunset (horizon) provision so that the participation-place rules in the WWB, IOAW and IOAZ expire two years after entry into force. It also drops the evaluation article of the Wet participatieplaatsen, reflecting the government's view that the instrument should not be kept in place beyond that period.
31548.j: The memorandum justifies the sunset by saying it is undesirable to keep the participation-place instrument in place if the planned amendments will not follow within two years.
q: expire two years after their entry into force.
vervallen twee jaar na hun inwerkingtreding.

parties: Questions why the bill introduces changes while leaving participants without rights to those changes, and objects to arbitrary criteria for training and for extending placements.
Is it true that until then people in a participation placement have no claim whatsoever to the rights attached to the future proposed adjustments/improvements?
Is het waar dat tot die tijd mensen in een participatieplaats op geen enkele wijze aanspraak hebben op de rechten behorende bij toekomstig voorgestelde aanpassingen/verbeteringen?

Asks whether the government considered alternatives to the Raad van State's proposals, whether mandatory training still applies when a worker secures a position, what happens if municipalities cannot offer training, and who determines extension criteria.
Who determines that, what criteria apply, and what rights do those involved have?
Wie bepaalt dat, welke criteria gelden hier en welke rechten hebben betrokkenen hierbij?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the bill introducing a two-year sunset clause for the participatieplaatsen scheme, arguing that legislation should not be used to pressure timely amendment of a pending bill and that the government should instead amend or withdraw the original bill. The government's reply rejects this, stating the sunset is needed to ensure planned tightened criteria for extension are adopted within two years, and that the parliamentary timeline is sufficient.
concerns: Enacting a sunset clause tied to a yet-to-be-adopted amendment creates a regime known to be changed or lapse soon, undermining legislative stability and implementability.
The government should pursue its aims by amending or withdrawing the pending bill or a novelle rather than using a horizon clause to pressure change.
Frequent successive changes burden municipal implementation; the government says it consults implementing bodies regularly.

31566.s: The bill amends several Dutch statutes (legal aid, study finance, childcare, primary education, housing allowance, owner-occupancy promotion) to replace their own income and wealth definitions with the single income data item from the basic income registry (BRI). It also revises legal aid rules so that income and wealth can be reassessed ex officio when new data differ from data used earlier, and allows applicants to request use of current-year figures after a decline.
31566.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to introduce the basic income registry and to align the laws with its single income concept, with the revision rules limited to cases where new data affect entitlement or contribution.
q: Revision decisions are only taken if a new deviating income (or wealth) figure becomes available and that figure affects whether legal aid is granted or the amount of the client's own contribution.

Er worden alleen herzieningsbeschikkingen genomen als een nieuw afwijkend gegeven over het inkomen (of vermogen) beschikbaar komt en dat gegeven gevolgen heeft voor het al dan niet verlenen van een toevoeging of de hoogte van de door de rechtszoekende verschuldigde eigen bijdrage.
d: Artikel I, C (Wet op de rechtsbijstand, art. 25 lid 3-4)
inspector providing wealth and income data for legal aid assessment
p: Artikel I, D and F (Wet op de rechtsbijstand, art. 34a and 34d)

The council may ex officio revise earlier legal aid decisions when new income or wealth data become available, with the revision limited so it cannot assume a higher income than applied in the reference year.

parties: Asks for a full overview of income-dependent schemes, whether they will use the BRI, and why legal aid boards and the IB-group may retrieve income data differently, including questions on automatic revision of decisions.
Revision decisions are only taken where there is cause for them, when income or assets have actually changed and affect the citizen.
Herzieningsbeschikkingen worden alleen genomen als daar aanleiding toe is, als het inkomen (of vermogen) ook daadwerkelijk is gewijzigd en gevolgen heeft voor de burger.
Asks whether legal aid boards will need extra staff and what the extra costs would be.
The PVV members ask the government whether extra staff will be added at the legal aid boards.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV vragen de regering of er bij de raden voor de rechtsbijstand extra werknemers bij komen?
Asks for agreed commencement dates for the separate sub-parts of the bill and how long technical preparation will take.

31575.s: The bill extends the collection powers of the Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen (LBIO) to court-ordered partner maintenance (partneralimentatie), allowing the LBIO to collect it for a fee and enabling municipalities to refer welfare recipients to it. It also moves the LBIO seat from Gouda to Rotterdam, allows collection to be ended after ten years, and removes a delegation clause allowing deviation from statute by lower regulation.
31575.j: The memorandum justifies the collection extension by the public interest in enforcement of maintenance duties and the relief of municipalities, and justifies removing the deviation clause by the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving and a parliamentary motion.
q: This motion asks the Minister of Justice to promote, in the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving, a clear wording that a delegation of legislative power by law to a lower regulator, authorizing it to deviate from the formal statute, is not permitted.

In deze motie wordt de minister van Justitie gevraagd te bevorderen dat op korte termijn in de Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving een duidelijke formulering wordt opgenomen dat een delegatie van wetgevende bevoegdheid bij wet aan een lagere regelgever, die die lagere regelgever machtigt om af te wijken van de wet in formele zin, niet is toegelaten.
d: ARTIKEL II B (art. 14, lid 2 Wet LBIO)
personnel legal status deviating from civil service rules
p: ARTIKEL II B (art. 14, lid 2 Wet LBIO)
The clause allowed an administrative order to depart from the statutory personnel rules; the bill removes it, which narrows executive discretion.

parties: Asks about the basis for the expected 64% and 90% payment success rates, the scale of benefit spending on unpaid alimony, and the pros and cons of using a bailiff instead of the LBIO.
On what is the expectation based that, due to LBIO mediation, the paying party will meet the obligations in 64% of cases?
Waarop is de verwachting gebaseerd dat vanwege de bemiddeling door het LBIO de betalingsplichtige in 64% van de gevallen aan de verplichtingen gaat voldoen?
Asks whether the LBIO has enough enforcement powers comparable to a bailiff, how it is coordinated across three ministers, and how the government will be accountable for collection.
Does the LBIO have sufficient coercive powers to enforce payment of the alimony?
Heeft het LBIO voldoende dwangmiddelen om de betaling van de alimentatie af te dwingen?
Worries that applicants for benefits may be worse off and delayed if LBIO mediation fails, and asks whether unlisted non-treaty countries and a partner alimony plan could protect citizens.
If LBIO mediation does not succeed, can the benefit applicant still receive assistance directly?
Mocht de bemiddeling van het LBIO niet slagen, kan de bijstandsaanvrager dan nog direct bijstand ontvangen?

Critical of the shift away from individual responsibility for enforcement, cites the Raad van State's state-aid objection, and asks for monitoring, evaluation and a possible reversal of the task allocation.
The premise that enforcement of partner alimony is the individual's own responsibility is abandoned with this.
Het uitgangspunt dat de (dwang)invordering van partneralimentatie behoort tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid wordt hiermee verlaten.
Welcomes the bill as a long-desired improvement that strengthens the alimony recipient's position, and asks about benefit-recourse interaction with municipalities and LBIO costs.
Moreover it strengthens the position of the alimony recipient, so they can retain more independence and dignity.
Bovendien versterkt het de positie van de alimentatiegerechtigde, zodat die meer zelfstandigheid en waardigheid kan behouden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises reconsidering the bill that would extend the LBIO's collection powers to partner maintenance, arguing that collection is not an overheidstaak and that the justifications, the relation to bijstandsverhaal, EU state-aid compliance and effectiveness are insufficiently motivated. The government's nader rapport rebuts most points, accepting the need to clarify cost recovery and EU-law compliance while defending the policy shift and effectiveness estimates.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether collection of partner maintenance should be treated as a government task given the existing private enforcement route via bailiffs, and asks for a sound justification of the policy shift.
The Afdeling finds the existing bijstandsverhaal powers sufficient and doubts that the LBIO's 90% effectiveness projection is supported by the evaluation data.

The Afdeling concludes the LBIO's partner-maintenance collection may be an economic activity under EU state-aid rules requiring cost recovery, separate accounts and no cross-subsidy, which the bill does not demonstrate.
The Afdeling notes the bill contains no data on the feasibility of partner-maintenance collection by the LBIO and asks for it.

31584.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the 2008 EU-Australia agreement on transfer of air passenger name record (PNR) data to Australian customs. It designates the Dutch Data Protection Authority (College bescherming persoonsgegevens) as the competent authority to suspend data flows under the agreement and to enforce suspension by administrative coercion.
31584.j: The memorandum justifies designating the Data Protection Authority because the agreement provides no statutory procedure for it, and the Wbp's existing enforcement powers cannot otherwise be used for suspension.
q: This does not alter the fact that a statutory provision must be made to give effect to the right of suspension.
Dit neemt niet weg dat een wettelijke voorziening moet worden getroffen om het opschortingsrecht te effectueren.
p: Gives the Data Protection Authority an explicit statutory basis to suspend PNR data flows and enforce this with administrative coercion, strengthening an independent oversight body rather than the executive.

parties: Supports PNR data exchange against terrorism but wants timely evaluation of safeguards on analytical information, sensitive data and third-country transfers.
Given the critical remarks of the Article 29 Working Party and the Dutch data protection college, the CDA members attach importance to this evaluation.
Mede gezien de kritische opmerkingen van de artikel 29 Werkgroep en van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens hechten de leden van de CDA-fractie aan deze evaluatie.
Doubts the necessity of systematic collection of all PNR data and asks for optimal protection of civil liberties, including on sensitive data and retention.
For them, the central aim of such a treaty should first and foremost be optimal protection of the civil liberties of EU citizens.
Wat hen betreft zou het centrale doel bij het afsluiten van zo’n verdrag echter in de eerste plaats de optimale bescherming van de burgerlijke vrijheden van de EU-burgers moeten zijn.
Questions effectiveness of PNR collection, finds the data flow disproportionate, and asks about onward transfer safeguards and the retention period.
The SP members agree with the Dutch data protection college and the Article 29 Working Party that the scale of the data flow is disproportionate.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn met het College bescherming persoonsgegevens en de artikel 29 Werkgroep van mening dat de omvang van de gegevensstroom disproportioneel is.
Supports measures against terrorism but questions the large number of largely irrelevant data fields and asks about onward transfer to third states and legal protection.
A great deal of data that is not relevant is provided in the context of combating terrorism and crime.
Er worden in het kader van terrorisme- en criminaliteitsbestrijding veel niet relevante gegevens verstrekt.
Recognises the importance of combating terrorism but insists on careful assessment of necessity and proportionality of the data flow and of retention of sensitive data.
In doing so they attach importance to a careful weighing of the necessity and proportionality of the proposed agreement.
Daarbij hechten zij aan een zorgvuldige afweging waar het gaat om noodzaak en proportionaliteit van de voorgestelde overeenkomst.

Asks the government to justify departing from advice of national and European data protection supervisors, the European Parliament resolution, and the vague purpose definition, and whether the scheme is evidence-based.
These members ask the government to substantiate with arguments why it chooses to depart from the advice of the national and European data protection supervisors.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering met argumenten te onderbouwen waarom ze ervoor kiest af te wijken van de adviezen van de nationale en Europese toezichthouders bescherming persoonsgegevens.

v.summary: The Council of State supports the bill approving the EU-Australia PNR agreement but asks for clarification on whether bank account numbers of passengers are covered by the payment/billing data transfer and that the necessity be justified in the explanatory memorandum. The government replies that bank account numbers are unusual in PNR records, that it has added a short passage to the explanatory memorandum, and it updates the memorandum regarding a planned amendment to the Dutch data protection act.
concerns: Transfer of payment/billing data may restrict the right to protection of personal data, so its necessity must be justified; the Council asks that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented.
Clarify whether passengers' bank account numbers fall under the payment/billing information to be transferred; the government adds a short passage to the explanatory memorandum.
Reciprocity of PNR exchange with third countries is noted as deserving attention, but the Council makes no remark on it and each agreement should be assessed on its own merits.

31728.s: The bill amends the Winkeltijdenwet to narrow the tourism exemption for Sunday shop opening: municipal exemptions must serve substantial tourism whose attraction lies largely outside the shopping itself, and councils must weigh employment, Sunday rest, liveability, safety and public order and justify the decision in writing. It also opens administrative appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven against such exemption decisions even where they are generally binding rules, with a transitional rule for existing decisions.
31728.j: The memorandum justifies the municipal discretion as a local matter requiring a case-specific assessment and marginal judicial review, and the appeal extension as needed because tourism exemptions affect third parties' civil and legal interests.
q: The tourism provision may first of all only be applied if there is tourism of substantial scale in the municipality or a part of it.
De toerismebepaling mag in de eerste plaats alleen nog worden toegepast als sprake is van toerisme met een substantiële omvang in de gemeente of een deel van de gemeente.
d: Artikel I, A.1 (art. 3, lid 3, onder a)
municipal council exemption from Sunday shop closing for tourism
mayor and aldermen granting shop-opening exemptions under delegated power
p: Opens appeal to the administrative court against municipal tourism exemption decisions even where they are generally binding rules, deviating from the general Awb rule.

parties: Wants a careful balancing of Sunday rest, liveability, public order and economic interests, and asks how municipal consultation and the drafting of the exemption will work.
These members attach great value to a careful weighing of the various interests surrounding the opening of shops on Sunday.
Deze leden hechten grote waarde aan een zorgvuldige afweging van de verschillende belangen die leven rond de opening van winkels op zondag.
Asks detailed questions on the evaluation, municipal decision-making, the role of courts and whether the bill fits local democratic consultation.
On the competence to designate areas in municipalities the government is clear, it is and remains decentralised.
Over de bevoegdheid om gebieden in gemeenten aan te wijzen is de regering duidelijk, die is en blijft decentraal.
Says the bill does little to clarify existing criteria or allow prior review, and argues central law should not be left unenforced by decentralised discretion.
In these members' view, a general steering philosophy, however laudable, may never be offered as an excuse for leaving compliance with a democratically adopted law to take its course.

Naar de mening van deze leden mag een algemene sturingsfilosofie, hoe lovenswaardig en nastrevenswaardig ook, nimmer als excuus worden aangedragen om de naleving van een democratisch aangenomen wet op zijn beloop te laten.

Opposes the bill as solving a non-existent problem, restricting shop and consumer freedom, and criticises the vague 'substantial tourism' criterion and limited judicial review of municipal discretion.
These members regard the bill as a solution to a non-existent problem and see in its implementation a restriction on the freedom of choice of shopkeepers and consumers.
Deze leden beschouwen het wetsvoorstel als een oplossing voor een niet bestaand probleem en zien in de uitvoering daarvan een beperking van de keuzevrijheid van winkeliers en consumenten.
Supports protecting vulnerable interests and asks whether marginal judicial review and the Council of State's concerns about the Awb are adequately addressed.
Can the government justify why there is no disruption of the balance between the decentralised legislator and the court?
Kan de regering motiveren waarom geen sprake is van een verstoring van het evenwicht tussen de decentrale wetgever en de rechter, zo vragen zij?
Objects to state interference in entrepreneurs' and consumers' freedom and says the bill ignores the local democratic weighing of interests.
These members see the bill as a meddlesome government intervention.
Deze leden zien het wetsvoorstel als een bemoeizuchtig overheidsingrijpen.
Welcomes narrowing the tourism exemption to reduce Sunday opening, but doubts the bill really reduces Sunday trading and asks for national uniformity and explicit protection of workers' interests.
For these members, curbing shop opening on Sunday is an important value, for religious and socio-societal reasons.
Voor deze leden is het terugdringen van de winkelopenstelling op zondag een belangrijke waarde, vanwege godsdienstige en sociaal-maatschappelijke redenen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on 19 May 2008, that the bill amending the Winkeltijdenwet to restrict the tourism exemption for Sunday shopping should be reconsidered: the need is insufficiently substantiated, the wording was not shown to be unclear, and the proposed sixth and seventh paragraphs and the appeal route to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven should be dropped. The minister's reply of 30 September 2008 accepted several points (adding a substantial-scale criterion, adding motivation in the explanatory memorandum) but kept the bill's core, including the new appeal route, arguing the restriction is justified and decentralisation is preserved.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the cited figures and evaluation do not show a growing or increasingly broad use of the tourism provision, so the need for amendment is not substantiated; the minister added figures from other studies showing a trend but kept the proposal.

The Afdeling says the existing tourism provision and its legislative history are sufficiently clear and a brochure could suffice; the minister acknowledges unclarity and expanded the explanatory memorandum but rejected a brochure as insufficient for material changes.

The Afdeling asks whether the new 'substantial scale' criterion is a clarification or a tightening going beyond original intent, and why the three listed interests are singled out and whether general Awb balancing (art. 3:4) is insufficient; the minister confirmed it is a tightening and kept the enumerated interests.

The Afdeling objects that allowing the administrative judge to review general binding rules by municipal councils intrudes on the decentralised legislator and the balance between administration and judiciary; the minister argues the decisions are hybrid and reviewable and rejected deleting the provision.
The Afdeling notes that affected parties may have civil rights under ECHR article 6, which the minister cites to justify judicial review by an independent court.
The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation of the reasons for the seventh paragraph's motivation duty given Awb articles 3:46 and 3:47; the minister added explanation and redactional changes.

31746.s: The bill implements EU Shareholder Rights Directive 2007/36/EC by amending Book 2 of the Civil Code and the Financial Supervision Act for companies listed on regulated markets. It sets rules on notice of meetings, electronic voting and proxies, record dates, and publication of meeting information and voting results on company websites.
31746.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the EU directive, which requires member states to allow electronic participation and specified shareholder rights.
q: To ensure that the conditions set by the company do not go beyond what the directive allows, it is proposed to limit the possibility of setting conditions in article 2:117a(3) of the Civil Code.

Om te verzekeren dat de door de vennootschap gestelde voorwaarden niet verder gaan dan de richtlijn toestaat, wordt voorgesteld de mogelijkheid tot het stellen van voorwaarden in artikel 2:117a lid 3 BW te begrenzen.
d: ARTIKEL I, B (artikel 114, lid 1 onderdeel d BW)
procedures and conditions for electronic participation and voting at shareholder meetings
conditions on use of electronic communication set in the articles of association
board authorisation, via the articles or meeting resolution, to set a record-date register for voting rights
p: ARTIKEL I, D en ARTIKEL I, E (artikelen 115 en 117 BW)
Shareholders gain rights to electronic proxy notification and no longer face mandatory deposit of proof documents, while company deposit requirements are relaxed for listed firms.
The general meeting may authorise the board for up to five years, or indefinitely in the articles, to set the record-date register, giving the board discretion over shareholder voting eligibility.

parties: Supports strengthening shareholder participation but wants balance with national business climate, reciprocity and minimal administrative burden; asks whether the Directive's Action Plan is still current.
They endorse the importance of improving shareholder participation in decision-making at the general meeting.
Zij onderschrijven het belang om de deelname van aandeelhouders aan de besluitvorming in de algemene vergadering te verbeteren.
Asks about EU lobbying outcomes, the legal status of the Commission recommendation, hedge fund stake-building via derivatives, and whether agenda requests must be reasoned and who judges sufficiency.
These members ask the government to explain why there was insufficient support among Member States for a rule on identifying the actual investor.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven waarom er onvoldoende steun was bij de lidstaten voor een regeling met betrekking tot het vaststellen van een daadwerkelijke investeerder.

Asks whether removing the company's power to refuse shareholder agenda items could allow items outside the meeting's competence, and whether a 30-day registration date and splitting dividend and registration dates should be considered.
These members ask how the government views this potential problem.
Deze leden vragen hoe de regering dit potentiële probleem ziet.

Questions replacing the 'serious company interest' refusal ground with a reasonableness and fairness test, arguing the former is more specific and better protects shareholder rights; also asks about disclosure timing and Eumedion's comments.
In the view of the Council of State, this is a more clearly defined and more specific refusal ground than the reasonableness and fairness test proposed in the explanatory memorandum.
Dit is naar de mening van de Raad van State een duidelijker omschreven en specifieker weigeringsgrond dan de in de toelichting voorgestelde toetsingsnorm van de redelijkheid en billijkheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised revising the bill implementing Directive 2007/36/EC on shareholder rights: it wanted to keep the existing refusal ground for agenda items, questioned the statutory shortening of the agenda period regarding revised agendas, and asked for electronic notification of proxies to be added to the electronic-meeting rules. The government's reply rejected the first point because the Directive does not allow a refusal ground based on the company's serious interest, accepted the second with a clarification in the explanatory memorandum, and accepted the third by adding the electronic proxy notification requirement.
concerns: The Raad proposed several technical redactional amendments to the bill and explanatory memorandum, which the government adopted.

The Raad advised keeping the existing company refusal ground for agenda items, but the government rejected this because the Directive does not permit such a ground, relying on the reasonableness and fairness standard instead.

The Raad found that the statutory option to shorten the agenda period may conflict with the Directive's requirement that revised agendas be published in time before the registration date; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum that the registration date always falls after the minimum convocation period.
The Raad advised adding a requirement that shareholders be offered an electronic means to notify proxy appointments, which the government adopted for listed public limited companies.

31755.s: The bill modernises the environmental impact assessment (mer) rules in the Environmental Management Act by simplifying chapter 7 and aligning the assessment procedures for plans and decisions. It removes several exemption and advisory provisions, reassigns procedural steps, and adjusts related statutes and transitional rules.
31755.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as reducing administrative and bestuurlijke lasten and aligning with system design, and removes unused delegation grounds rather than justifying new executive powers.
q: The power to set rules by general administrative order on provincial designation of activities, plans and decisions has never been used and is not expected to be used in the future.

Van de bevoegdheid bij algemene maatregel van bestuur regels te stellen over de provinciale aanwijzing van activiteiten, plannen en besluiten, is nooit gebruik gemaakt en in de toekomst wordt niet voorzien dat daar gebruik van zal worden gemaakt.
d: designation of activities, plans and decisions subject to mer
rules on how plan report data are determined and described
rules on how environmental report data are determined and described
p: The competent authority may grant exemption from the mer obligation for decisions where the general interest requires immediate action, a discretion that bypasses the prior impact assessment.

Plan procedures lose the competent authority's obligation to invite public comment on the proposed intention, replaced by an after-the-fact accountability duty.','directions':[],'mechanisms':[],'constraints':[],'severity':'routine','towards':'checks','description_en':'Commission advice is restructured.'}],
Ministerial role in transboundary consultation is redefined, limiting intervention to cases where contact between Dutch and foreign authorities has failed.

parties: Asks whether the removal of the as-then construction and the reduced Commissie mer role create double work, and how ex-post accountability on participation will be judged by a court.
They do ask the government to further justify why this earlier advice from the Commissie mer needs no further concretisation when a general plan designation is filled in by a specific project.
Wel vragen zij de regering nader te onderbouwen waarom dit eerdere advies van de Commissie mer geen nadere concretisering behoeft
Asks what remedy exists if ex-post accountability reveals inadequate participation by citizens and civil society.
What can still be done when the ex-post accountability shows that the way citizens and civil society organisations were involved in the process was too thin?
Wat kan er nog gedaan worden wanneer uit de verantwoording achteraf blijkt dat de wijze waarop burgers en maatschappelijke organisaties in het proces zijn betrokken te mager is?

Asks who assesses the accountability on citizen involvement, what the consequences are, and whether citizens' influence on the mer will be fixed in law; also questions dropping the most environmentally friendly alternative.
Will that influence be fixed in law?

Welcomes simplification and shorter procedures, but questions whether a legal duty of ex-post accountability on participation is needed and who judges it, and whether the bevoegd gezag's discretion for extra safeguards could lead to arbitrariness.
They also want to know to what extent this mandate could lead to arbitrariness or large differences in how the various competent authorities act.
Daarnaast willen deze leden weten in hoeverre dit mandaat kan leiden tot willekeur dan wel grote verschillen tussen de handelswijze van de verschillende bevoegde gezagen?

Objects to dropping the startnotitie, public comments, the most environmentally friendly alternative and Commissie mer advice on projects; fears ex-post participation accountability is a weak, vormvrij check and that the Commissie mer should decide itself whether to advise.
Can the government provide an overview of the advantages and disadvantages of dropping these obligations and how it reached its final judgement?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van de voor- en nadelen die er verbonden zijn aan het schrappen van deze verplichtingen
Asks whether limiting the Commissie mer role and replacing participation rules with ex-post review risks late-discovered gaps and experiments that fail in court, given strict EU requirements.
Does this new regulation not carry the risk that gaps in the quality of the environmental impact report and participation only come to light at a late stage?
Houdt deze nieuwe regeling niet het risico in dat lacunes in de kwaliteit van de milieueffectrapportage en de participatie in een laat stadium blijken?

31764.s: The bill approves the 24 April 2008 tax treaty between the Netherlands and Qatar on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes, together with its protocol. Article 2 sets entry into force the day after the Staatsblad publication date.
q: The treaty concluded at The Hague on 24 April 2008 ... is approved for the Netherlands.
Het op 24 april 2008 te ’s-Gravenhage totstandgekomen verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Asks whether the main purpose test sufficiently prevents treaty-shopping and whether a loophole for double exemption could open up, and seeks clarification of the scope of liquid assets in the three-year rule.
Does this not open the door to undesired possible schemes to avoid tax?
Wordt hiermee niet de deur opengezet voor niet gewenste mogelijke opzetjes om belasting te vermijden?

Questions the choice of a treaty with a country that levies almost no tax, asks whether zero-rate dividends and exemptions mean companies pay no dividend tax anywhere, and asks why a limitation on benefits clause is absent.
Qatar in fact levies hardly any tax.
Asks about social security consequences of source-state taxation, budgetary effects, the risk of relocation of firms, and the need for a treaty with a financially unequal state.
Is there data showing that a cooperation treaty with a financially unequal state like Qatar is necessary?
Zijn er gegevens beschikbaar waaruit blijkt dat een samenwerkingsverdrag met een financieel ongelijke staat als Qatar noodzakelijk is?

31791.s: The bill amends the Dutch Inburgering Act to add voluntary civic integration for certain non-obligated persons, including a personal integration budget and municipal offers and agreements for them, and harmonises enforcement deadlines. It also lets the municipal council set detailed rules by ordinance and allows further rules by general administrative order (AMvB) on the personal budget and the agreements.
31791.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB and ordinance powers by saying they can set practical details such as the personal budget mechanics, the agreement terms, and the procedure for offers.
q: Rules may be set by or pursuant to a general administrative order on the personal integration budget.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld omtrent het persoonlijk inburgeringsbudget.
d: municipal ordinance on offers and criteria for voluntary integrators
rules on personal integration budget for voluntary integrators
designation of social security laws for combined provisions
rules on the agreement between municipality and voluntary integrator
municipal ordinance on information, payment and identity checks
p: Voluntary integrators owe a co-payment and may be required by the municipality to follow a combined provision, with sanctions limited where benefit reduction or fines already apply.

parties: Questions whether the rule that no offer is made when it hinders labour participation is too rigid, and asks about uniform municipal rules to avoid legal inequality.

These members ask the government to explain how municipalities are supported in this, given that several municipalities have indicated or shown that they struggle with implementing the obligations and responsibilities imposed on them.

Deze leden vragen de regering uiteen te zetten hoe de gemeenten hierin worden ondersteund, mede gelet op het feit dat diverse gemeenten aangegeven hebben dan wel hebben laten zien dat zij worstelen met de uitwerkingen van de hen opgelegde verplichtingen en verantwoordelijkheden.
Questions the justification for the three-and-a-half-year period, how extensions and exemptions are safeguarded, and how misuse of the PIB will be prevented.
These members ask how the mentioned possibilities of extension and exemption are safeguarded.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe de genoemde mogelijkheden van verlenging en ontheffing gewaarborgd worden.
Asks whether standard assessment criteria and guidelines will be issued so that municipalities do not diverge on PIB contracts and sanctions.
If this is not the case, is there not a risk of major discrepancies arising between municipalities regarding the content of PIB contracts?
Indien dit niet het geval is, ontstaat dan niet de kans dat er grote discrepantie zal ontstaan tussen gemeentes onderling over de inhoud van PIB-contracten.
Asks why no appeal and objection procedure is provided for voluntary integrants whose PIB request may be rejected.
They ask why no appeal and objection procedure has been included for the voluntary integrant.
Zij vragen waarom er geen beroeps- en bezwaarprocedure is opgenomen voor de vrijwillige inburgeraar.
Argues integration should take place in countries of origin and at the immigrants' own cost, and that non-completion should lead to loss of residence rights.
The PVV members further hold that the costs of integration should be entirely borne by potential immigrants themselves.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn voorts van mening dat de kosten van de inburgering volledig voor eigen rekening van potentiële immigranten dienen te komen.

31809.s: The bill aligns several agricultural laws (Zaaizaad- en plantgoedwet 2005, Landbouwkwaliteitswet, Wet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden, Plantenziektenwet, Landbouwwet) with the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen by applying that framework to the relevant autonomous bodies and removing overlapping organisational provisions. It also repeals the Herinrichtingswet Oost-Groningen en de Gronings-Drentse Veenkoloniën and the Reconstructiewet Midden-Delfland, with transitional rules keeping their plans in force.
31809.j: The memorandum justifies the removal of provisions as duplicating the Kaderwet zbo, which already regulates the same matters, and transitional delegation for smooth completion of ongoing projects.
q: Article 9 can be dropped since articles 15 and 16 of the Kaderwet zbo regulate the same subject matter.
Artikel 9 kan vervallen aangezien de artikelen 15 en 16 Kaderwet zbo dezelfde materie regelen.
d: further rules for implementing the transitional herinrichting and reconstructie plans
Artikel III onderdeel H (artikel 12 lid 4 Wet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden)
rules on work plan, annual report, budget and accounts of the college
p: Repeals articles 31 to 35 and 39 to 41 of the Landbouwwet, removing statutory provisions on the Voedselvoorzieningsin- en verkoopbureau that were previously set by parliament.

parties: The VVD asks whether the adjustments to the Landbouwkwaliteitswet affecting certification bodies' statutes and regulations could cause problems, and whether ministerial regulations under the land consolidation and reconstruction acts are necessary and whether they are being used.
The VVD members wonder whether this is necessary?
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of dit noodzakelijk is?

31818.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Arcen en Velden and Venlo into a new municipality named Venlo, abolishing the two former municipalities and adjusting references in the judicial districts act, police act and safety regions act. It sets transitional arrangements for council elections, tax, shared arrangements, utilities and the first council election after the merger.
31818.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the voluntary herindelingsadvies of the municipalities, which received a positive opinion from the provincial executive, and notes that municipalities may change their name under the Gemeentewet.
q: The reorganisation advice of 17 June 2008 from the municipalities concerned carries a positive opinion from the provincial executive of Limburg.
Het herindelingsadvies van 17 juni 2008 van de betrokken gemeenten is voorzien van een positieve zienswijze van gedeputeerde staten van Limburg.

parties: Welcomes broad support and voluntariness of the merger but asks questions on regional coherence, administrative capacity and a possible border correction.
The voluntariness of this merger is beyond doubt.
De vrijwilligheid bij deze herindeling is aan geen twijfel onderhevig.
Asks whether the new municipality's governance will explicitly safeguard local identity and whether the merger will be evaluated after three years.
Is the government willing to evaluate the merger after 3 years on this point as well?
Is de regering bereid om de herindeling over 3 jaar ook op dit punt te doen evalueren?
Argues that council approval is insufficient for a far-reaching merger and asks how public support was measured, and questions the basis for the 40,000-inhabitant size.
In the view of the SP members, a reorganisation of such far-reaching nature that council approval alone is insufficient.
Naar de opvatting van de leden van de SP-fractie is een herindeling van zodanig ingrijpende aard dat louter goedkeuring door de gemeenteraad onvoldoende is.
Supports the merger and the border correction, and asks about the position of Beesel and the procedure that may lead to further mergers.
The VVD members consider this border correction very desirable.
De leden van de VVD-fractie achten deze grenscorrectie zeer wenselijk.
Asks whether referenda, polls or consultations were held and what the council and provincial voting results were.
The PVV members ask whether there have been referenda, polls or popular consultations in the municipalities concerned and, if so, what the outcomes were.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er referenda of peilingen of volksraadsplegingen zijn geweest in de betreffende gemeenten en zo ja, wat daarvan de uitkomsten waren?

31890.s: The bill amends the General Child Benefits Act (AKW) and the General Surviving Dependants Act (ANW) to tie entitlement for 16- and 17-year-olds to compliance with the new qualification obligation in the Compulsory Education Act 1969, and to codify the definition of 'own child' including DNA-established paternity. It also simplifies the AKW, repeals a 1994 act, and adds transitional rules.
31890.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations on the ground that details of time-spent assessment may prove necessary in practice, and that deviations from the statute for certain groups follow from the Jurgens motion inventory.
q: It may turn out that for certain parts of this article, particularly the assessment of the various time-spent conditions for child benefit entitlement, further rules are necessary.

Het kan blijken, dat voor bepaalde onderdelen van dit artikel met name op het punt van de beoordeling van de verschillende voorwaarden voor tijdsbesteding voor het recht op kinderbijslag nadere regels noodzakelijk zijn.
d: cases where a foster child is treated as a child
insurance for persons without lawful residence
rules on whether a child is substantially or largely supported by the insured
further rules on time-spent conditions for 16-17 year olds
rules granting child benefit entitlement in deviation from the statute
rules on paying child benefit to a person other than the household head
insurance for persons without lawful residence

parties: Asks what happens to youths who drop out and lose benefits, whether they stay in view of care teams, and how fraud and enforcement abroad are controlled.
Can the government explain what safeguards and accompanying policy exist to prevent these children from disappearing from view?
Kan de regering toelichten welke waarborgen er zijn en welk flankerend beleid er is om te voorkomen dat deze kinderen uit beeld verdwijnen?
Opposes financially penalising parents who cannot get their children to school, questions effectiveness and who can revoke benefits, and asks for evaluation before introduction.
These people should not be punished financially, but supported.
Deze mensen moet je niet financieel straffen, maar ondersteunen.
Welcomes linking benefits to the qualification obligation, placing responsibility on parents, and asks whether stricter conditions such as truancy or police contact should be added.
However these members ask whether the government has considered stricter conditions, such as making child benefit dependent on truancy.
Wel vragen deze leden of de regering ook gedacht heeft om nadere en scherpere voorwaarden te stellen, bijvoorbeeld de kinderbijslag afhankelijk te maken van spijbelgedrag.

Asks whether the measure is punitive and could undermine socio-economically weak parents, questions the certainty of cost estimates, and asks what 'serious relative truancy' means for legal certainty.
To what extent is it clear to parents when there is actually serious relative truancy?
In hoeverre is het voor ouders duidelijk wanneer daadwerkelijk sprake is van ernstig relatief verzuim?

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill linking child benefit for 16- and 17-year-olds to the qualification obligation lacks a sufficient justification regarding effectiveness, financial effects and serious truancy, and asked for more substantiation. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely disagreed on effectiveness, provided some additional explanation on financial effects and truancy, and made several drafting changes including extending entitlement for young people injured after obtaining a qualification.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the measure will effectively reduce early school leaving, given that some parents cannot control their children, and asked for better motivation; the government disagreed that the sanction would hit parents unable to act, but added clarifications on the policy context.

The Council found the financial effects (EUR 3.8 million more benefit payments) insufficiently substantiated and asked for further justification; the government added explanation but maintained its estimate based on SVB data.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to justify why serious relative truancy would more often lead to termination of child benefit; the government added a clarification that this is a means, not an aim in itself.
The Council made several editorial remarks on the bill text (punctuation, precise delegation limits in article 7 paragraph 10, and missing full stops), which were incorporated.

31926.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 1082/2006 on European Groupings of Territorial Cooperation (EGTS) in Dutch law, setting out ministerial approval and oversight of Dutch participation, registration, publication of statutes, annual reporting and audit, dissolution, and enforcement powers. It also amends the Trade Register Act and empowers an EGTS members' assembly to award subsidies for territorial cooperation programmes.
31926.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical implementation of the EU regulation and notes that Dutch accountability runs through parliament, provincial and municipal councils, and the minister's balancing role.
q: The public body may be used for the joint performance of (public-law) tasks of the participants.
Het openbaar lichaam kan worden gebuikt voor de gemeenschappelijke vervulling van (publiekrechtelijke) taken van de deelnemers.
d: approval of Dutch participation in and statute changes of an EGTS
designation of competent authority and approval of annual accounts
designation of supervisory persons by ministerial decision
rules on cross-border control of EGTS activities by other member states
further rules on subsidy-granting power of EGTS members' assembly
p: Parliamentary chambers may veto Dutch state participation in an EGTS within a set period, but the procedure replaces the normal authorisation-by-law requirement, which is a limit on parliament's prior-authorisation role.
The minister may ban EGTS activities on Dutch territory or require Dutch members to withdraw, enforceable by administrative coercion, subject to appeal under the Awb.
Grants the EGTS members' assembly a subsidy-granting power and allows the minister to set further rules, reducing the need for a statutory basis in the Awb sense.

parties: Questions the minister's broad control over EGTS formation (prior notice, statute approval, annual accounts, special supervisors, administrative coercion) and asks for more room for municipalities and provinces.
Isn't that too much of a good thing?
Is dat niet te veel van het goede?
Asks whether administrative burdens and accountability of EGTS can be reduced and why two ministries legislate partly overlapping matters.
They therefore ask whether the government will once again sympathetically consider ways to reduce the administrative burden.
Daarom vragen zij of de regering nog een keer welwillend wil kijken naar de mogelijkheden om de administratieve lasten te verminderen.
Argues national democracy has too few means to block unwanted cooperation and asks how citizens can seek redress and influence EGTS policy.
Where should a citizen turn if they disagree with the policy pursued by this European grouping?
Waar moet een burger zich melden als hij of zij het niet eens is met het door deze Europese groepering gevoerde beleid?

Asks about the public-law character of EGTS, democratic control by the assembly, the role of the Staten-Generaal and provincial bodies, and what happens if court and parliament disagree with the minister's decision.
Furthermore, the VVD members would like to learn from the government how democratic control over an established EGTS is arranged.
Voorts zouden de leden van de VVD-fractie graag van de regering vernemen hoe de democratische controle op een eenmaal ingestelde EGTS is geregeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on the draft Dutch implementing act for EU Regulation 1082/2006 on European Groupings of Territorial Cooperation (EGTS), supporting its aim but raising remarks on existing cross-border cooperation, publication of statutes, entry into force, legal personality, supervision and the use of bestuursdwang. The minister's reply accepts several points (e.g., adding an overview of cross-border cooperation, deleting the entry-into-force provision and the separate rule on amendments) but rejects others, such as narrowing the publication check, treating EGTS bodies as bestuursorganen, excluding decentral governments from supervision, and dropping bestuursdwang.
concerns: The Raad objects that Article 7 wrongly assumes statutes or agreements can be adopted without member consent required under Article 4 of the regulation; the minister maintains the safeguard but clarifies it is not a substantive review, and the amendment-related provisions are deleted.

The Raad notes that Article 7(4) on amendments is unnecessary since amendments form part of the statutes, and that entry into force of amendments is governed by the statutes themselves; the provisions are removed.

The Raad points out that all amendments to statutes must be published under Article 5, not only essential ones; the memorie van toelichting is adjusted to provide filing with the chamber of commerce for all amendments.
The Raad asks for an overview of existing forms of cross-border cooperation in the explanatory memorandum to assess the added value of an EGTS; an overview is added.

The Raad holds that an EGTS is a legal person under public law whose organs need not be explicitly designated bestuursorganen; the minister rejects this and keeps the explicit designation to avoid doubt and effects on SE and SCE entities.

The Raad advises that supervision under Article 16 should exclude decentral governments already subject to interbestuurlijk toezicht; the minister does not follow this, arguing the EGTS itself is not subject to such supervision.

The Raad considers bestuursdwang an unsuitable instrument to force decentral governments to withdraw from an EGTS and advises revising Article 18; the minister argues bestuursdwang is adequate and adds motivation and a last onder dwangsom option.

31944.s: The bill abolishes the Wet verzelfstandiging Informatiseringsbank and transfers the tasks and powers of the IB-Groep agency to the Minister, merging CFI and IB-Groep into the new Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs. It also moves the rules on the basisregister onderwijs into the Wet op het onderwijstoezicht and amends many education and social-security laws to replace references to the IB-Groep with references to the Minister.
31944.j: The memorandum justifies transferring IB-Groep's tasks to the Minister by noting the reduced need for an independent agency now that the arms-length goal can be achieved otherwise, and says the Wbp continues to govern data processing.
q: The current powers of the IB-Groep pass to the Minister.
De huidige bevoegdheden van de IB-Groep gaan naar de Minister.
d: Artikel I, A/H (Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, art. 2.5.5c, vijfde lid)
conditions for use of data with personal number in school funding
Artikel I, D (Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, art. 2.3.6c, derde lid)
rules on content and transfer of basisregister education data to Minister and inspectorate
Artikel V (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, art. 24g, eerste lid)
authorisation of staff processing personal data in basisregister onderwijs
p: Artikel IX; Artikelen I to XVIII (transfer of IB-Groep tasks)
The tasks and powers of the independent agency IB-Groep are transferred to the Minister, reducing the autonomous body's distance from ministerial control, with mandate to the new DUO.
Artikel V (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, art. 24b-24f, basisregister onderwijs)

The Minister becomes responsible controller and manager of the basisregister onderwijs and may use data for budget and policy preparation, while the bill keeps retention periods and access rules largely unchanged."}],
Artikel I, C/H (art. 2.3.6b, 2.5.5c) and Artikel XVIII, E
The Minister may correct student or participant data supplied by the competent authority and enter the corrected data into the register once the funding decision is final."}],

parties: Asks whether the minister can avoid involvement in individual cases now that the ZBO status is withdrawn and whether the merger is necessary to achieve the stated aims.
One of the arguments for privatising at the time was that the minister could then no longer deal with individual cases.
Een van de argumenten om indertijd over te gaan tot de verzelfstandiging was dat de minister zich dan niet meer met de individuele gevallen kon bezig houden.
Asks how ministerial responsibility for the new service will be handled so the minister neither intervenes in every case nor is forced to.
How is it prevented that the minister can interfere in every executive matter, and how is it prevented that the minister is forced to interfere in every executive matter?

Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de minister zich met ieder uitvoerende zaak kan bemoeien en hoe wordt voorkomen dat de minister gedwongen wordt zich met iedere uitvoerende zaak te bemoeien, zo vragen de leden.
Asks how DUO will account to the ministry and how Parliament's oversight changes compared with the current CFI and IB-Groep.
In what way does the Tweede Kamer's oversight of the new executive agency change compared with the current CFI and IB-Groep?
Op wat voor manier verandert het toezicht van de Tweede Kamer op de nieuwe baten-lastendienst ten opzichte van de huidige Cfi en IB-Groep?

Asks how legal protection and equal treatment of participants are guaranteed now that the minister gains discretionary power over individual cases, and whether consultation included student organisations.
How is the legal position of participants guaranteed now that the minister receives discretionary power to decide in individual cases?
Hoe wordt de rechtspositie van deelnemers gewaarborgd nu de minister discretionaire bevoegdheid krijgt om in individuele gevallen te besluiten?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill to repeal the Wet verzelfstandiging Informatiseringsbank and merge CFI and IB-Groep into the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) as a baten-lastendienst. It supports the bill but asks for a financial section and a fuller justification of the efficiency gains and of how ministerial interference in individual decisions will be prevented under mandate; the government reply accepted these points and amended the explanatory memorandum and drafting.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should include a financial section on costs for the state, distinguishing programme and implementation costs, and better justify the expected greater efficiency of the merger.
Under mandate the minister keeps the power to intervene in individual files, so the explanatory memorandum should explain how interference in individual decisions will be prevented.
Several technical and redactional corrections to article numbering, references and wording were recommended and adopted.

31953.s: This invoeringswet (implementing act) for the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo) amends numerous Dutch laws to integrate environmental, building, nature, monuments, mining and related permits into a single omgevingsvergunning with one competent authority and one procedure. It also sets transitional rules for pending permit and enforcement procedures and aligns the enforcement and appeal framework.
31953.j: The memorandum justifies the integration and delegated rule-making as reducing administrative burdens, creating one permit procedure and one appeal route, and aligning with the Wabo's uniform framework.
q: This bill for an implementing act regulates the consequences of introducing the environmental permit for numerous laws within environmental law.
Dit wetsvoorstel voor een invoeringswet regelt de gevolgen van de invoering van de omgevingsvergunning voor tal van wetten binnen het omgevingsrecht.
d: categories of activities requiring a permit
cases where permit requests are treated as combined requests
cases where permit refusal is avoided via deviation rules
cases where deviation from zoning or exploitation plans is permitted
rules on determining best available techniques for installations
exclusive rights to perform preparatory work for permit decisions
rules on national electronic permit register
transitional treatment of existing permits and decisions
permit conditions and application of Wabo provisions to mining permits
p: Allows deviation from binding zoning and exploitation plans through a permit, expanding administrative discretion relative to statutory land-use plans, with deviation rules set by general administrative order.
Applies uniform enforcement rules and designates a single enforcing authority, while enforcement quality standards do not apply to activities regulated by municipal ordinance.
Assigns a foundation to provide expert reports to the administrative judge on permit appeals, and excludes certain ministerial designation decisions from notice under Awb 7:1.
Replaces parts of mining legislation with a permit regime controlled by ministerial and provincial authorities, reducing legislative visibility of mining environmental rules.
Allows combined permit requests to be treated as requests for another permit type, with refusal only where permitting under the deviation rules is impossible.

parties: Asks about appeal and objection procedures, who counts as an interested party, and whether the Schutznorm requirement should be codified, to avoid legal disputes.
These members want clarity from the government on whether an objector is admissible in objection and appeal against the entire environmental permit if they are admissible on only one of its elements.

Deze leden willen graag duidelijkheid van de regering of een bezwaarmaker ontvankelijk is in zijn bezwaar en beroep tegen het verlenen van de gehele omgevingsvergunning als hij slechts op een van de elementen ontvankelijk is.
Asks how the local fire brigade's role and the enforcement structure relate to permit decisions, and how enforcement is ensured for building works exempt from permits.
What means do municipalities have to counter unwanted developments, such as building over back gardens?
Welke middelen hebben gemeenten om ongewenste ontwikkelingen, zoals het volbouwen van achtertuinen tegen te gaan?
Worries that the shift of competence to higher authorities removes democratic control by municipal councils over spatial plans, and criticises the silence-as-consent rule and the pressure on quality.

Is it true that the shift to other competent authorities means the national government or province can directly intervene in municipal zoning plans without the municipal council being able to exercise control?

Is het waar dat de verschuiving naar andere bevoegd gezagen betekent dat rijk of provincie direct kunnen ingrijpen in de bestemmingsplannen en beheersverordeningen van gemeenten, zonder dat daarbij de gemeenteraad nog controlerend kan optreden?
Supports fewer permits and a silence-as-consent rule, and asks how interbestuurlijk toezicht will be slimmed down.
The VVD members endorse the government's wish to considerably scale back inter-administrative supervision.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven de wens van de regering om interbestuurlijk toezicht sterk te versoberen.
Asks about the timing and readiness of the online ICT counter and whether provinces can prepare in time.
These members ask whether this is not far too late given the desired introduction of the Wabo on 1 January 2010.
Deze leden vragen of dit niet veel te laat is uitgaande van de gewenste invoering van de Wabo op 1 januari 2010.
Asks whether linking permits to zoning-plan revision and integrating Nature Conservation Act permits shifts competences between municipalities, provinces and the state.
Given the recent problems with permitting in and around nature protection areas and the uncertainty about this, these members would like to hear to what extent linking could shift competences.

Gezien de (recente) problemen rond de vergunningverlening in en rond Natuurbeschermingsgebieden en de onduidelijkheid hierover horen de leden graag in hoeverre het aanhaken een verschuiving van bevoegdheden op kan leveren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Invoeringswet Wabo, a draft law introducing the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht, raising objections on the grondexploitatie exemption power, the outsourcing of permitting work, appeal routes in environmental disputes, the missing Woningwet provision, the Wet voorkeursrecht, the ICT facility and municipal cost compensation. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, including the clausulering of the exploitatieplan exemption, expanded appeal routes and the Wet voorkeursrecht amendment, while keeping the outsourcing provision and arguing the cost compensation was adequately justified.
concerns: Exemption power in the exploitatieplan was not grounded in the Wro and was too broad; the Raad advised a clausulered power, which the government largely adopted with technical redrafting.

Absence of a Woningwet-type provision for planologisch strijdig bouwen creates legal uncertainty; government amended the articles and explanatory memorandum but considered the integrated approach sufficient.
Doubt on the necessity of the outsourcing provision (art. 7.5 Wabo) under procurement law; government maintained it, citing Scala and Auroux case law.
Aarhus Convention requires public participation for 'eenieder' rather than only belanghebbenden; government widened the inspraak circle accordingly.
Concerns about readiness of the landelijke ICT-voorziening by 1 January 2010; government outlined milestones and testing but kept the date.
Financial justification for municipal implementation costs was requested; government explained the difference between the Deloitte estimate and the agreed amount.
