31962.s: The bill introduces an international attestation de vita (proof of being alive) into the Dutch Civil Code, issued by the civil registrar or a competent diplomatic or consular authority under a 1998 Paris convention. It also adds a fee for each such attestation to the Wet rechten burgerlijke stand and sets the entry into force by royal decree.
31962.j: The memorandum justifies the new attestation procedure by the Paris convention and notes that the authority receiving the attestation may request verification under national law.
q: In implementation of the Paris Convention of 10 September 1998 on the issuance of an attestation de vita (Trb. 2004, 283), it is proposed to introduce an attestation de vita (proof of being alive) in international form.

Ter uitvoering van de op 10 september 1998 te Parijs tot stand gekomen Overeenkomst betreffende de afgifte van een attestatie de vita (Trb. 2004, 283) wordt voorgesteld een attestatie de vita (bewijs van in leven zijn) in internationale vorm in te voeren
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether proxy verification of a person's survival is more fraud-prone than in-person issuance and whether municipal GBA data is reliable enough to prevent wrongly issued certificates.

Is this way of establishing whether someone is alive not very susceptible to fraud, or at least more susceptible than issuing an attestation de vita in person, even if other documents such as a letter from the care home management are submitted?

Is deze manier van het vaststellen of iemand in leven is niet erg fraudegevoelig of in ieder geval fraudegevoeliger dan het in persoon afgeven van een attestatie de vita, ook als andere bescheiden, zoals een brief van de directie van het verzorgingstehuis, wordt overlegd?
Asks who bears responsibility when an error is made and who has verification competence for the Antilles and Aruba, and questions the choice of French as official language.
They ask the government who is responsible if an error has been made.
Zij vragen de regering bij wie de verantwoordelijkheid ligt als er een fout is gemaakt.

32169.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code to bar a community service sentence (taakstraf) for serious sexual and violent offences that caused serious bodily harm, and for the specified offences in articles 181, 240b and 248b, as well as for repeat offenders within five years, with an exception where a custodial or other deprivation-of-liberty sentence is imposed alongside. It also lets the legislature restrict judicial sentencing discretion and makes the bar apply to prosecutorial penal orders (strafbeschikking).
32169.j: The memorandum justifies the limits by the need for a clear statutory framework for community service to maintain public support, and states that judicial sentencing freedom is preserved within the statutory bandwidth; it drops an earlier proposal to let an general administrative order designate excluded offences.
q: Instead, it is proposed to include in the statute itself three offences that do not meet the main criteria for excluding a bare community service sentence.

In de plaats daarvan wordt voorgesteld om een drietal misdrijven die niet voldoen aan de in dit wetsvoorstel geformuleerde hoofdcriteria voor het uitsluiten van een «kale» taakstraf, op te nemen in de wet zelf.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 9, tweede lid)
Makes the judge's option to replace imprisonment with a community service sentence subject to exceptions set by statute, narrowing judicial sentencing discretion.
Fixes by statute which offences exclude a community service sentence, with the court required to motivate use of exceptions, while the judge may still combine it with imprisonment.

parties: Supports a clear statutory framework but asks the government whether a community service combined with a suspended sentence adequately meets the need for credible punishment, and questions the balance with judicial discretion.
At the same time they believe the Council of State's advice not to submit this law calls for a very careful weighing of the pros and cons.
Tegelijkertijd menen zij dat het advies van de Raad van State om deze wet niet in te dienen noopt tot een zeer zorgvuldige weging van de voor- en nadelen.
Asks for justification given the critical Council of State advice and for the sharpened prosecution guideline's effects, and questions whether judicial sentencing freedom is being unduly restricted.

These members ask for further justification of why the government considers it appropriate and necessary to legally position the community service as a suitable penalty for relatively lighter offences, in light of the very critical advice of the Council of State.

Deze leden vragen een nadere motivering met betrekking tot het feit dat de regering het passend en geboden acht de taakstraf wettelijk te positioneren als een passende straf voor naar verhouding lichtere strafbare feiten, in het licht van het zeer kritische advies van de Raad van State.

Agrees the law mainly codifies original legislative intent but flags the tension between judicial sentencing freedom and legislative limits, asking where the boundary lies and how much discretion must remain.

The SP members recognise a certain tension in the bill, namely the judge's sentencing freedom on one side and the legislature's task of laying down in law which penalties judges may impose in which cases on the other.

De leden van de SP-fractie herkennen een zeker spanningsveld in het wetsvoorstel, te weten de straftoemetingsvrijheid van de rechter aan de ene kant en de taak van de wetgever om in de wet vast te leggen welke straffen rechters op kunnen leggen in welke gevallen aan de andere kant.

Welcomes the bill, arguing judges have exceeded the legislative intent in imposing community service for serious offences; questions whether restricting sentencing freedom conflicts with the legality principle and ECHR article 6, and asks the government to define key terms.
In the view of the VVD members, community service is often seen in society as a less behaviour-correcting penalty than other forms of punishment.
Naar het oordeel van de leden van de VVD-fractie wordt de taakstraf in de samenleving vaak gezien als een minder gedragscorrigerende straf dan andere strafmodaliteiten.

Not in favour of minimum sentences and asks whether the third paragraph of the proposed article 22b amounts to one; asks whether the bill is the right instrument rather than a sharpened prosecution guideline, and whether judicial sentencing freedom is being undermined.
The ChristenUnie members ask whether the government believes that with this bill the legislature is encroaching on the judge's sentencing freedom.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen of de regering van mening is dat met dit wetsvoorstel door de wetgever aan de straftoemetingsvrijheid van de rechter wordt getornd.

Welcomes putting the restriction into statute; asks clarifying questions on the interaction with article 9 Criminal Code, the reach of the 'serious injury' criterion, and the motives behind the 14% of serious cases still receiving community service.
These members consider it a good thing that this is now being laid down in law.
Zij vinden het een goede zaak dat dit nu wordt vastgelegd in de wet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises against submitting the bill restricting judges' sentencing discretion to impose community service for serious sexual and violent offences and for recidivism, finding no clearly defined serious problem that the bill would solve. The government's reply disputes that community service for serious offences is an exception, points to the recent tightening of prosecution guidelines and to the need for a statutory positioning of community service, and proposes further research without withdrawing the bill.
concerns: The restriction of judicial sentencing freedom is disproportionate because the problem it targets, unfounded in the research, has not been demonstrated.

No clearly defined serious problem is shown to be solved; the government answers that community service for serious offences does occur and that statutory positioning is needed alongside tighter prosecution guidelines.
Limiting sentencing freedom weakens the right of access to an independent court with full jurisdiction under Article 6 ECHR; the government stresses that judicial discretion remains respected.
Drafting remarks: add 'en bij recidive van misdrijven' to the title and delete 'het bepaalde in' in the proposed third paragraph of article 22b, which the government adopted.

32196.s: The bill makes a set of technical amendments to the Medicines Act (Geneesmiddelenwet), including allowing nurses to attend scientific meetings, adjusting pharmacy and distribution rules, and tightening a delegation for pharmacovigilance rules so that ministerial regulations can no longer depart from the statute. It also amends the Individual Healthcare Professions Act (Wet BIG) so that nurses authorised to prescribe certain prescription-only medicines are recorded in the BIG register.
32196.j: The memorandum states that the earlier clause allowing deviations from the statute by delegated regulation is removed so that only more detailed rules can be set by ministerial regulation.
q: This subsection is amended so that deviations from the statute (text) are not possible and that on the basis of the ministerial regulation only more detailed provisions can be laid down.
Dit artikellid wordt zodanig aangepast dat afwijkingen van de wet(tekst) niet mogelijk zijn en dat op basis van de ministeriële regeling slechts nadere voorschriften kunnen worden gesteld.
d: further rules on pharmacovigilance in view of scientific and technical progress
regulation of conditional marketing authorisation conditions by the College
p: Ministerial regulation may set further rules on pharmacovigilance, but as amended it cannot depart from the statute itself.

parties: Asks whether restrictions apply to the congresses nurses may attend, and why the deadline for publishing marketing authorisations was loosened from 'onverwijld' to 'zo spoedig mogelijk'.
It may therefore take longer and there will be a less clear time limit.
Het kan dus langer gaan duren en er komt dus een minder duidelijke tijdslimiet.

Welcomes the added sanctions for online medicine trade but questions reminder advertising, unequal hospitality rules for nurses, and the government's failure to implement the Van der Veen motion on OTC classification.

After two years of waiting these members have concluded that the only way out of the impasse is a legal framework that forces the CBG to genuinely and permanently prioritise safety when classifying OTC medicines.

Deze leden zijn na twee jaar wachten tot de conclusie gekomen dat de enige oplossing om uit de impasse te komen is dat er een wettelijk kader komt dat het CBG dwingt de veiligheid echt en permanent voorop te stellen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed requirement to sell UAD over-the-counter medicines only from behind the counter should be dropped, because the explanatory memorandum did not justify reintroducing it so soon after the 2007 law and the 2002 abolition, and did not address investments already made by retailers. The government's reply accepted the advice in substance, removing the counter requirement and deferring the question to an evaluation planned for 2010.
concerns: Frequent legislative changes undermine the reliability of law, so a reintroduced counter requirement needed a convincing justification, which the memorandum lacked.
The memorandum did not show changed circumstances or unsafe medicine use that made a counter requirement necessary.
Retailers who invested since 2002 on the basis of the existing law would face new costs that the explanatory memorandum ignored.
Several minor editorial corrections were made to the bill.

32259.s: The bill implements the 2005 London protocols to the maritime and fixed-platform anti-terrorism conventions by amending the Criminal Code and the Extradition Act to extend Dutch jurisdiction and extraditability to the listed offences. It makes no new executive delegation of rule-making power and contains no emergency, sunset, or oversight-altering provisions.
32259.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as necessary to implement the 2005 protocols, with no justification for new executive powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that certain statutory provisions must be made to implement the Protocol of 2005 concluded in London on 14 October 2005 to the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Maritime Navigation.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat enige wettelijke voorzieningen moeten worden getroffen ter uitvoering van het op 14 oktober 2005 te Londen tot stand gekomen Protocol van 2005

parties: Asks how implementation would apply to a ship under Iranian flag transporting nuclear materials, without raising a check or oversight point.
What does the implementation of the amending protocols mean for the case of a ship sailing under the Iranian flag carrying nuclear materials?
Wat betekent de implementatie van de wijzigingsprotocollen voor het geval een schip dat onder Iraanse vlag vaart nucleaire stoffen vervoert?

32277.s: The bill makes numerous minor technical corrections and repairs across housing, spatial planning and environmental laws, including amendments to the Wet milieubeheer, Woningwet, Wet bodembescherming and Wet ruimtelijke ordening. Several provisions expand executive rule-making by allowing general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial or municipal instruments to set technical requirements, grant exemptions and exempt certain land developments from exploitation plans.
32277.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the exemption power by pointing to avoidable administrative costs where cost recovery yields little, while stating that cost recovery principles are unaffected.
q: To this end, Article 6.12, second paragraph, of the Wro creates the power to designate by general administrative order cases in which an exploitation plan may be waived.

Daartoe wordt in artikel 6.12, tweede lid, van de Wro de bevoegdheid gecreëerd om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur gevallen aan te wijzen waarin van het opstellen van een exploitatieplan kan worden afgezien.
d: cases where no exploitation plan is required
Artikel X.B (Woningwet art. 2, tweede t/m vierde lid)
technical rules and other requirements for open land and demolition
deviation from building rules for monuments and permission for exemption from demolition rules
designation of product categories through implementing measures in the form of regulation
Artikel III.C (Wet bodembescherming art. 18, derde lid)
designation of areas by provincial or municipal regulation for heat-cold storage
p: Expands the scope of general administrative order powers over open land, demolition and building work, leaving detail to the executive.
Artikel III.C (Wet bodembescherming art. 18, derde lid)
Allows municipalities and provinces to designate areas with stricter regimes, within limits set by the general administrative order.

parties: Wants the AMvB on municipal protection zones to be submitted to parliament in advance and to make clear that municipalities cannot unilaterally tighten protection regimes.
It must remain clear, however, that municipalities cannot simply tighten protection regimes at their own discretion by introducing their own rules.
Duidelijk moet echter blijven dat gemeenten niet zomaar naar eigen inzicht beschermingsregimes kunnen verzwaren door eigen regels te gaan invoeren.
Welcomes the bill as useful and necessary without raising check-related points.
Given the usefulness and necessity of the proposed changes, the PvdA members have noted the bill with approval.
Gezien het nut en de noodzaak van de voorgestelde wijzigingen hebben de leden van de PvdA-fractie met instemming kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel.

Opposes the Wabo and Crisis- en herstelwet, questions their timing and transitional arrangements, and asks why a discretionary AMvB exemption from land-development plans is needed and how splitting of projects is prevented.
On article IX, the SP members would also like a further explanation of the need for an AMvB that creates exceptions to the land-development plan for small cases.
Ten aanzien van artikel IX horen de leden van de SP-fractie ook graag een nadere duiding van de noodzaak voor een AMvB die voor kruimelgevallen een uitzonderingen maakt op het grondexploitatieplan?
Asks for more insight into the forthcoming AMvB on designating protected areas, including the scope of municipal discretion and the role of provinces in regional coherence.
What will the policy freedom of municipalities be in designating areas?
Wat zal de beleidsvrijheid van de gemeenten worden bij het aanwijzen van gebieden?

32358.s: The bill abolishes the Central Authority's power to represent parties in court under the international child abduction and child protection regimes, and concentrates first-instance and appeal jurisdiction in return-order cases at The Hague district court and appeal court. It also limits cassation to cassation in the interest of the law, lets the court give suspensive effect to appeals against return orders, and removes ordinary appeal against the appeal court's decision.
32358.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by faster return procedures in the child's interest, expertise built up at The Hague court, and the Central Authority's role being to seek amicable settlement rather than litigate against citizens.
q: The proposal to concentrate cases at the Hague district court and appeal court is driven by the expertise the Hague district court has already built up in international child protection cases.

Het voorstel tot concentratie bij de Rechtbank en het Gerechtshof 's-Gravenhage is ingegeven door de reeds opgebouwde expertise van de Rechtbank 's-Gravenhage in zaken van internationale kinderbescherming.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A en B (artikel 5 en 7 Uitvoeringswet internationale kinderontvoering)
The Central Authority loses its power to represent applicants in court, so the state no longer litigates directly against citizens in these sensitive cases; applicants must instead use a lawyer.
Artikel I, onderdeel D en F (artikel 11 en 13 Uitvoeringswet internationale kinderontvoering)

Concentration of return proceedings in The Hague courts and removal of ordinary appeal against appeal-court decisions narrow the avenues of legal review available to parties, while the court must motivate suspensive effect.

parties: Asks what the abolition of the Central Authority's procedural representation means for tasks, staffing and finances, and why access cases are not concentrated like return cases.
They can endorse the proposed amendments and have only a single question.
Zij kunnen de voorgestelde aanpassingen onderschrijven en hebben slechts een enkele vraag.
Questions whether the foreign parent can obtain equal legal representation in practice and asks whether judges' decisions on suspensive effect can rest on objective criteria.
Does the government share the view that objectifiable criteria for granting or refusing suspensive effect are desirable?
Deelt de regering de mening dat objectiveerbare criteria voor het al dan niet verlenen van een schorsende werking wenselijk zijn?

Criticises the bill's default of no suspensive effect on appeal, questions limits on cassation that may undermine legal protection, and asks for stronger Central Authority obligations to secure access arrangements.
The question is whether the government's proposal sufficiently meets the adopted De Wit motion.
De vraag is of de regering met dit voorstel voldoende tegemoet komt aan de aangenomen motie-De Wit c.s.

32367.s: The bill amends the Dutch Environmental Management Act (Wet milieubeheer) to replace the term 'energy-using products' with 'energy-related products' and align definitions with the recast EU Ecodesign Directive 2009/125/EC. It also updates references to the EU Ecolabel regulation and a related implementing act.
32367.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the recast EU directive and notes that enforcement tasks are assigned to existing supervisory bodies such as the VROM-inspectie and the Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as We hereby resolve and decree
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

parties: Supports sustainability via EU resource policy and asks for an ambitious approach to implementing measures at EU level, including how the House of Representatives will be involved.
They repeatedly state that an effective approach to sustainability must primarily take place through European resource policy.
Zij zetten bij herhaling uiteen dat een effectieve aanpak van verduurzaming primair via Europees bronbeleid moet gebeuren.
Welcomes integrating environmental aspects across the product lifecycle, which it sees as benefiting the environmental quality mark.
Including environmental aspects before, during and after use of the product will only benefit the value of the environmental quality mark.
Het meenemen van de milieuaspecten zowel voor, tijdens als na gebruik van het product zullen de waarde van het milieukeur alleen maar ten goede komen.

Asks why EU implementing measures take so long, whether member states may set national efficiency requirements in the meantime, and presses for dynamic energy norms that tighten automatically without new legislation.

They also urge that the energy standard in implementing measures be formulated dynamically: as technology advances, the standard should automatically be tightened without new legislation being needed.

Zij dringen er tevens op aan dat de energetische norm in uitvoeringsmaatregelen dynamisch geformuleerd wordt: naarmate de techniek voortschrijdt dient de norm automatisch, dus zonder dat nieuwe regelgeving nodig is, aangescherpt te worden.

Supports the energy-efficiency goal but asks how 'significant adverse effects' are defined and how the government guarantees that Dutch business interests are protected while implementing measures are not yet known.
The VVD members wonder what the standards are for 'significantly adverse'.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af wat de standaarden zijn voor «significant nadelig».

32376.s: The bill amends the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to align Dutch public transport concession rules with EU Regulation 1370/2007, including new rules on transparency, reciprocity, separate accounting, concession award without tender for certain regional authorities, and extended enforcement powers for the competition authority and plusregio executives. It also repeals several provisions and adds transitional rules for municipal transport companies.
32376.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to implement EU Regulation 1370/2007 and to allow regionally differentiated transport decisions, with the regulation's exceptions serving as safeguards.
d: applying EU regulation 1370/2007 to comparable transport
rules on the annual overview report
operating transport without concession during disruption
rules on separate accounting and cost allocation
exempting regional rail concessions from tendering in specified cases
applying transport rules to comparable services
p: Allows plusregio executives to award concessions to an in-house operator without tendering, reducing competitive scrutiny; the decision is political rather than subject to administrative appeal.
Gives the competition authority power to impose administrative fines, strengthening oversight of transport operators.
Grants plusregio executive bodies power to impose orders under administrative coercion to enforce concession obligations.

parties: Supports competition in public transport and the mandatory tendering in the G3 regions.
The VVD members support the amendment making mandatory tendering of public transport also apply to the G3.
De leden van de VVD-fractie ondersteunen de wijziging van het wetsvoor stel waardoor verplichte aanbesteding van openbaar vervoer ook aan de orde is voor de G3.
Opposes mandatory tendering, argues the regions should keep the choice, and questions the savings and market concentration.
Freedom of choice for regions also fits the vision the minister of Infrastructure and Environment expressed at the annual congress of Transport and Logistics Netherlands on 20 November 2010.
Keuzevrijheid voor regio’s past ook bij de visie die de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu verwoordde tijdens het jaarcongres van Transport en Logistiek Nederland op 20 november 2010.
Asks how quality and social safety are guaranteed, and how conflicts of interest and cross-subsidy are overseen.
These members ask who oversees whether there is a possible conflict of interest.
Deze leden vragen wie er op toeziet of er sprake is van een mogelijke belangenverstrengeling.
Welcomes the bill and asks for a chronological overview of when concessions will be tendered and examples from abroad.
The CDA members ask the government to set out in a chronological overview (in table form) when the various concessions will come up for tender.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om in een chronologisch overzicht (in tabelvorm) uiteen te zetten wanneer de verschillende concessies tot aanbesteding zullen komen.
Opposes the bill, arguing it removes local government authority and the choice to tender, and fears destruction of municipal transport companies.
These members ask why the government is so keen to make tendering mandatory when the aldermen in the G3 can already choose to tender themselves.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de regering aanbesteding zo dringend wil verplichten, terwijl de wethouders in de G3 er nu zelf al voor kunnen kiezen om aan te besteden.
Disappointed by mandatory tendering and the linked savings; supports local choice on tendering.
According to the D66 members, the city regions as local governments are best placed to make this assessment.
De stadsregio’s kunnen deze afweging volgens de leden van de fractie van D66 als lokale overheid het beste maken.
Questions the quality guarantees, the savings basis and the efficiency claims, and asks for justification of the government's position.
These members do not expect the proposal to lead to better public transport for travellers in the G3 and have the impression it is being used to legitimise a 120 million euro saving.
Deze leden verwachten niet dat het voorstel leidt tot beter openbaar vervoer voor reizigers in de G3 en hebben de indruk dat dit gebruikt wordt om een bezuiniging van 120 mln. te legitimeren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to implement EU Regulation 1370/2007, supporting its aim but raising points on cross-subsidy prohibition, extension of concession duration, and reciprocity. The government's nader rapport accepted most points: it dropped the cross-subsidy article and the publication requirement, clarified the option to extend concessions must be part of the original tender, and clarified the scope of the reciprocity provisions.
concerns: The Raad advised repealing the cross-subsidy prohibition in Article 54 or extending it to all directly awarded contracts; the government dropped Article 54 because the EU regulation's annex already applies directly.
The Raad advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that a concession extension must have been part of the original tender, and amending Article 24 accordingly.

The Raad advised dropping the publication requirement in Article 24(2) because general administrative law already covers publication, and justifying why the decision requirement does not apply to certain extended contracts.
The Raad advised the explanatory memorandum address other forms of public transport concessions to clarify the scope of the reciprocity provisions in Articles 48 and 53.

32439.s: The bill amends the Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning so that municipalities can, by ordinance, set and collect eigen bijdragen (co-payments) for maatschappelijke opvang and vrouwenopvang, instead of the shelter institutions doing so on their own initiative. It also makes these contributions subject to the general municipal framework, with a retroactive effect to 19 April 2010 following a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling.
32439.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the mismatch with the general Wmo framework and the CRvB ruling, and says the new rules improve legal protection because clients receive a decision and can appeal.
q: On the other hand, the legal position of these clients improves, since they will receive a decision stating how high the co-payment they owe is.

Daartegenover staat echter wel, dat de rechtspositie voor deze cliënten verbetert, aangezien zij een beschikking zullen ontvangen waarin staat hoe hoog de eigen bijdrage is, die zij verschuldigd zullen zijn.
d: municipal council sets co-payments for shelter and women's shelter by ordinance
p: ARTIKEL I, B and C (artikel 15 and 16)
Municipalities gain power to impose and collect co-payments for shelter services, with clients receiving a formal decision that can be appealed through administrative law channels.

parties: Asks whether the government considered a statutory change so shelter access stays an individual Wmo provision, and raises risks to national access and administrative burden.
Does the government share the VVD's concern that there are risks to national access and an increase in administrative burden?
Deelt de regering de zorg van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat er risico's zijn op het gebied van de landelijke toegang en een verzwaring van administratieve lasten?
Welcomes a uniform legal basis but insists on strict conditions and client consent for data exchange to protect women's safety, and asks who is responsible for their safety.
Data exchange between institutions, municipalities and the CAK may only take place under very strict conditions and only with the client's consent.
Gegevensuitwisseling tussen instellingen, gemeenten en het CAK dient daarom slechts onder zeer strenge voorwaarden, en uitsluitend met toestemming van de cliënt, te geschieden.

Supports the legal basis and the new objection right for clients, but questions the bureaucratic burden of CAK monitoring and the timing of the government's postponement of data exchange for women's safety.
This amendment also greatly improves the legal position of clients, who can now object to the decision they receive.
Tevens wordt met deze wijzing van de wet de rechtspositie van de clienten sterk verbeterd.

Opposes client contributions as unjust and a deterrent for people fleeing violence, fears cuts passed on via municipalities and inequality between municipalities, and asks how decisions reach homeless applicants without an address.
These members believe it is unjust and counterproductive to discourage people fleeing domestic violence or living on the street from accessing these services with fees.

Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat het onrechtvaardig en contraproductief is om mensen die vluchten voor huiselijk geweld of op straat leven de toegang tot deze voorzieningen te ontmoedigen met remgeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the government's proposal to let municipalities refuse Wmo support to EU citizens in their first three months or while job-seeking needed clearer grounding in the EU concept of social assistance under Directive 2004/38/EC, and that its scope be limited. The government's reply restricted the exception to maatschappelijke opvang (shelter) and not women's shelter, and revised the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling required a reasoned interpretation of 'social assistance' under Directive 2004/38/EC, and the government narrowed the exception to shelter while not fully providing the requested justification for the existing policy.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on the structure and numbering of the amendment, which the government adopted.

32457.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bankruptcy Act and Book 7 of the Civil Code to implement EU Directive 2009/44/EC on settlement finality and financial collateral, extending protected system participants, interoperability rules and collateral use for credit claims. It introduces a system operator concept and new rules on timing of irrevocability and collateral rights, with a limited exception protecting consumer debtors.
32457.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementation of the EU directive and as a means to make credit claims usable as collateral so banks can keep lending under higher capital requirements.

parties: Asks the government to put explanatory clarifications into the statutory text for legal certainty and to specify when an indirect participant may be treated as a participant.

These members recall the Council of State advice and the supplementary report and ask whether it is not desirable to include the requested clarifications in the statutory text for reasons of legal certainty.

Voornoemde leden brengen het advies van de Raad van State en het nader rapport in herinnering en vragen of het niet toch wenselijk is de gevraagde toelichtingen in de wettekst te verwerken om redenen van rechtszekerheid.
Asks how parties can prove they were or need not have been aware of insolvency proceedings and whether a bank facing insolvency could still transfer funds to third parties.

It cannot be that a financial institution against which insolvency proceedings are started, and which is therefore aware of this, can still transfer amounts to third parties and thereby harm creditors?

Het kan toch niet zo zijn dat een financiële instelling, tegen wie een insolventieprocedure wordt gestart, en die hiervan dus op de hoogte is, alsnog bedragen gaat wegboeken naar derden, en zo de schuldeisers dupeert?
Asks the government to adopt the Council of State advice to include criteria in the law for when systemic risk justifies treating an indirect participant as a participant.
These members consider it a good thing if the Council of State advice is adopted.
Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak als het advies van de Raad van State wordt overgenomen.
Asks whether the reform could weaken the position of debtors and how consumers would know whom to pay after assignment or pledge of claims.
Can the government guarantee that implementing the Amending Directive does not change the position of the debtor to their detriment?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de implementatie van de Wijzigingsrichtlijn niets ten nadele verandert aan de positie van de debiteur?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill implementing Directive 2009/44/EC on settlement finality and financial collateral in linked systems, but advises specifying criteria for when an indirect participant may be treated as a participant on systemic-risk grounds and clarifying the explanatory memorandum. The government's reply accepts most drafting remarks, adjusts the bill structure, and clarifies the explanatory memorandum, while stating that defining the EU term 'systeemrisico' is not for the national legislator.
concerns: The Afdeling advises stating criteria for when an indirect participant is treated as a participant on systemic-risk grounds, to avoid uncertainty about protection under article 212b Fw in bankruptcy.
The Afdeling advises clarifying in the explanatory memorandum, with examples, the circumstances in which a systemic risk may arise, given cross-border financial markets.
Several editorial remarks on terminology, a duplicate paragraph, a deleted article II part, and clarifications on pledge, collection and set-off are adopted.

32475.s: The bill extends Dutch criminal jurisdiction to prosecutions taken over from international tribunals, allowing the Minister of Justice to accept such requests without a treaty, with a new Sv procedure for refusal and advice. It also amends the International Crimes Act and the War Crimes Surrender Act, including rules on surrender and retroactive jurisdiction for genocide back to 1970.
32475.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary power by citing efficient and effective prosecution of serious international crimes and the binding nature of international norms through the involvement of the international community.
q: As soon as possible after receiving the prosecutor's advice, the Minister of Justice decides whether to grant or refuse the request to institute prosecution.

Artikel 552iif 1. Zo spoedig mogelijk na de ontvangst van het advies van de officier van justitie neemt de Minister van Justitie een beslissing, waarbij het verzoek tot het instellen van een strafvervolging wordt ingewilligd dan wel afgewezen.
d: Minister of Justice decides on acceptance or refusal of international tribunal prosecution requests
p: Artikel I and II (Art. 4a Sr, 552iia-552iif Sv)
The Minister of Justice gains discretion to accept prosecutions from international tribunals without a treaty basis, with only mandatory refusal grounds and a prosecutor's advice as checks.
Artikel IV (Art. 4 Wet overlevering inzake oorlogsmisdrijven)
The court's advice on surrender is kept binding in practice, though the minister retains the final decision on transport and procedure.

parties: Asks about costs, workload impact on courts flagged by the Raad voor de rechtspraak, forum shopping and possible conflicts with other states.
These members note that the Council for the Judiciary has found that the bill has consequences for the workload of the courts and therefore for capacity.
Deze leden merken op dat de Raad voor de rechtspraak heeft geconstateerd dat het wetsvoorstel consequenties heeft voor de werklast van de gerechten en derhalve voor de capaciteit.
Not convinced that taking over prosecutions is a durable solution or that Nederland should act as world arbiter; questions retroactivity against the legality principle.
Asks how the expected cost increase will be financed, including from development cooperation budgets, and how victims can join proceedings.
These members believe that if this bill becomes law, costs will rise.
Voornoemde leden menen dat als dit voorstel van wet tot wet verheven wordt, een kostenstijging zal plaatsvinden.
Supports retroactivity to 1970 but questions whether the Hague district court is being given tribunal-like status and wants clarity on enforcement in the Netherlands.
They have no difficulty whatsoever with the proposed retroactive effect back to 1970 in the proposed article 21, third paragraph, of the International Crimes Act.
Zij hebben geen enkele moeite met de voorgestelde terugwerkende kracht tot 1970 in het voorgestelde artikel 21, derde lid, Wet internationale misdrijven (Wim).
Supports broader prosecution powers but asks about manpower, the situation of long-resident Afghan 1F cases, and calls for faster procedures so suspicions do not last indefinitely.
These members believe that suspicions must not last forever.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat verdenkingen niet eeuwig mogen voortduren.
Sees no reason at this stage for further remarks on the bill.
At this moment they see no reason to make further remarks on this bill.
Zij zien op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het maken van nadere opmerkingen met betrekking tot dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill amending criminal law to improve prosecution of international crimes, but objects to the proposed power for the Netherlands to take over prosecutions from international tribunals, asking for clarification of legal and practical questions and for consideration of enforcement issues. The minister's reply accepts that the memorie van toelichting should address these points and that the bill and explanatory memorandum have been adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum address legal and practical questions raised by the takeover power, including use of articles 552x to 552gg Sv, and the government adopted this advice and amended the bill and memorandum.

The Afdeling doubts the explanatory memorandum's claim that the takeover power will be used very rarely, given possibly large and complex cases; the minister maintains the expectation of few requests but clarifies the power imposes no obligation.

The Afdeling flags practical difficulties in gathering evidence abroad where no treaty or mutual legal assistance arrangements exist, and the minister responds that such requests will be weighed against prosecution policy including evidence-gathering possibilities.

The Afdeling questions whether enforcement of a Dutch judgment following takeover must always take place in the Netherlands, and the minister's reply addresses this only indirectly through the decision-making criteria.

32529.s: The bill improves the position of foster parents by adding a foster-care chapter to the Youth Care Act with foster contracts, subsidies, foster parent councils with consultation and consent rights, and a conflict commission. It abolishes parental contributions to youth care and ends child benefit for parents whose child is placed out of home for at least five consecutive days per week.
32529.j: The memorandum justifies the subsidy delegation as allowing the ministers to set the basic amount and supplements, and presents the abolition of contributions as financially neutral and a means to raise foster allowances.
q: Our Ministers shall lay down rules on supplements to be granted to the basic amount or reductions to be applied to it.
Onze Ministers stellen regels omtrent op het basisbedrag te verlenen toeslagen of op het basisbedrag toe te passen kortingen.
d: basic subsidy amounts, supplements and reductions for foster care
rules on sharing information with foster parents
determination of child benefit eligibility via placement notifications
p: Foster parent councils gain consultation and consent rights over provider decisions, with a conflict commission able to issue binding rulings.

parties: Asks how the workability of the division of guardianship between bureau jeugdzorg and foster parents is guaranteed, and about the risk of foster parents withholding consent and resulting waiting times.
These members ask how the workability of this situation is guaranteed, both for foster parents and for the bureau jeugdzorg.
Genoemde leden vragen zich op welke manier de werkbaarheid van deze situatie gewaarborgd is, zowel voor de pleegouders als voor het bureau jeugdzorg.
Asks whether the higher foster allowance will cover the extra special costs foster parents incur and where they can claim them.
They ask whether the increase in the foster care allowance will cover the extra special costs that foster parents incur for the foster child.
Zij vragen of de verhoging van de pleegoudervergoeding de extra bijzondere kosten die pleegouders maken (voor het pleegkind) zal dekken.

Supports the reform but echoes the Raad van State's criticism that removing child benefit for partially placed children may undermine natural parents' role; asks for careful protection of the child's interest and of the national framework.
We therefore ask the government to look again carefully at these cases where children are partly cared for but parents lose child benefit.
Wij vragen daarom de regering nog eens goed te kijken naar deze gevallen waar kinderen gedeeltelijk worden opgevangen, maar waar ouders wel de kinderbijslag verliezen.
Supports simplification but warns that low-income families may lose substantially, widening inequality, and asks for rent-style examples and protection of low-income parents.
Is it really the intention of this bill to further widen the differences between rich people with children and poor people with children?
Is het werkelijk de bedoeling van dit wetsvoorstel de verschillen tussen rijke mensen met kinderen en arme mensen met kinderen nog verder te vergroten?

Objects that the proposal does not differentiate by duration of foster care, so parents with real costs lose child benefit; asks whether differentiation will be reconsidered and requests mandatory feedback and renewed consultation of foster parents.
These members find this situation in principle undesirable, because it directly affects the child and any other children in the family.
Deze leden vinden deze situatie in principe onwenselijk, omdat dit direct van invloed is op het kind en de eventuele andere kinderen van het gezin.
Raises concerns about the fundamental right to family and family life: immediate loss of child benefit, emotional effects, and reduced natural-parent influence and sense of temporary placement.
These members believe the measure affects the emotional bond between child and biological parent(s).
Genoemde leden menen dat de maatregel invloed heeft op de emotionele band tussen kind en biologische ouder(s).
Asks how the five-consecutive-days threshold is applied and whether the child benefit saved reaches the child, and how natural parents stay involved in care, especially with voluntary placement.
They ask what safeguards exist that parents can maintain contact with their child, especially when placement is voluntary in an institution.
Zij vragen welke waarborgen er zijn dat ouders contact met hun kind kunnen onderhouden, zeker wanneer bijvoorbeeld sprake is van vrijwillige plaatsing in een instelling.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill to improve the position of foster parents, mainly objecting that ending child benefit for parents whose child is placed out of home, combined with abolishing the parental contribution, conflicts with the purpose of the AKW and with human-rights and social-charter obligations, and advised further consideration of foster-parent legal protections. The government's nader rapport largely followed the advice by adding eligibility conditions and a five-day threshold, and rebutted the main objection on child-benefit purpose and fund figures while accepting the drafting and foster-contract points.
concerns: Ending child benefit on out-of-home placement may breach Article 8 ECHR and social charter obligations; government argued no interference with family life and adjusted the bill to apply only after five consecutive days of placement.

The combined measure to fund higher foster allowances conflicts with the purpose of the AKW and lacks quantified justification; government rebutted that parents no longer bear daily costs and supplied budget figures.
Effects on parents in part-time foster care and loss of kindgebonden budget could worsen parents' finances; government narrowed the scope to placements of at least five days.

Foster-parent suitability conditions should be set in the statute rather than ministerial regulation, and the regulatory relationships need clearer explanation; government moved the conditions into the law and dropped the delegated relationship rule.
Several drafting points on delegation consistency, article ordering and cross-references were raised; government adopted nearly all of them.

32538.s: The bill establishes a Kaderwet veteranen that obliges the Minister of Defence to promote recognition of veterans, to provide material, psychosocial and mental health care support to veterans and their relations, and to maintain a veterans registration system. It allows detailed rules to be set by general administrative order (AMvB), with further subdelegation to ministerial regulation.
32538.j: The memorandum justifies subdelegation to ministerial regulation by the administrative and detailed nature of implementing rules that often need amendment.
q: Since further elaboration of the above activities and facilities will in many cases involve administrative provisions or details of the scheme, the second paragraph allows subdelegation to ministerial regulation.

Aangezien ter nadere uitwerking van de hiervoor vermelde activiteiten en faciliteiten in veel gevallen sprake zal zijn van voorschriften van administratieve aard, dan wel uitwerking van details van de regeling, biedt het tweede lid de mogelijkheid van subdelegatie naar ministeriele regeling.
d: facilitating recognition initiatives, distinction and reunions for veterans
rules on assistance, rehabilitation and benefit processing for veterans
rules on social support and mental health care for veterans
organisation and management of veterans registration system and data sharing
designation of missions whose participants count as veterans
p: Mandatory registration of veterans' personal data in a government system, with detailed rules and third-party data sharing left to a general administrative order, with advisory input from the data protection college.
The Minister alone designates which missions qualify for veteran status.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on the draft Kaderwet veteranen, raising concerns about the added value of the bill, the scope of the veteran definition (including active-duty personnel), the criteria for missions, the veterans' registration data delegation and subdelegation. The government reply states it has adopted most points: it broadened the care duties, reverted the definition to former soldiers, clarified mission criteria and the registration delegation, and removed unnecessary subdelegation.
concerns: The Raad doubts the added value of statutory care duties that do not give veterans concrete rights, and advises making them concrete; the government concretised the material and social care duties.
The Raad objects to including active-duty military in the veteran definition and asks to reconsider it; the government reverted to the original definition of former soldiers.

The Raad asks for clarification of the criteria for designating missions and the consequences of withdrawing a designation; the memorandum was supplemented, though the government considered withdrawal not possible.
The Raad asks that the delegation for providing personal data to third parties be clausulated at statutory level because it infringes privacy; the government did so.
The Raad asks to justify or remove subdelegation in the bill; the government removed subdelegation for the registration and reported it elsewhere.
The Raad advises consulting the Cbp on the bill; the government declined at this stage but will consult it on the implementing decree.

32556.s: The bill amends the Wet overige OCW-subsidies to remove several provisions, simplify the law and tighten the delegation of subsidy-granting power so that it can only go to independent administrative bodies covered by the Kaderwet ZBO's. It also restructures the Act, redefines the supplementary-application rule and lets the minister designate supervisors by decision.
32556.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation restriction by arguing that delegating subsidy power to a body without Kaderwet ZBO safeguards would create an unregulated independent body, which it considers undesirable.
q: Delegating subsidy power to, for example, a foundation would create an independent administrative body without complying with the Kaderwet ZBO's requirements.

Door delegatie van de subsidiebevoegdheid aan – bijvoorbeeld – een stichting zou dus een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) worden gecreëerd zonder dat daarbij aan de voorschriften van de Kaderwet ZBO's zou worden voldaan.
d: subsidies granted in urgent or incidental cases under a general administrative order or ministerial regulation
delegation of subsidy-granting power to an independent administrative body (ZBO)
minister designates persons to supervise compliance by decision
p: Allows the minister to grant subsidies under this Act in urgent or incidental cases and in anticipation of amending other laws, subject to a four-year limit and a parliamentary pre-consultation step.
Restricts delegation of subsidy-granting power to independent administrative bodies so that the Kaderwet ZBO's conditions apply, which constrains executive delegation.
Lets the minister designate supervisors by decision, published in the Staatscourant, for subsidies not granted per financial year.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill amending the Wet overige OCW-subsidies to align it with the 2010 subsidy guidelines, but advises clarifying in the explanatory memorandum the retroactive effect back to 1 January 2010. The minister responded by amending the explanatory memorandum to address the retroactivity point.
concerns: The proposed retroactive effect of the amendments back to 1 January 2010 needs further explanation in the memorandum and, if necessary, adjustment of the bill.

32565-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the Staten-Generaal (IIA), the parliamentary budget, by adjusting appropriations and commitments for several articles, as shown in an attached supplementary budget statement. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: We have deemed and resolved ... The budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2010 is amended.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd.

32574.s: The bill makes unauthorised fishing on another party's fishing rights a criminal offence under the Economic Offences Act, and tightens enforcement powers and penalties in the Fisheries Act 1963. It also abolishes the large-fishing-gear licence (akte), removes the spieringtuig definition, and amends the Animal Act and related laws.
32574.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and stronger powers by the need to combat fish poaching, which threatens fish stocks and professional fishers' livelihoods.
q: For this reason the House of Representatives urged more adequate enforcement against fish poaching.
Om die reden is door de Tweede Kamer aangedrongen op een adequatere handhaving van visstroperij.
d: designation of fish species by ministerial regulation
temporary transfer of archive records to a legal person designated by the minister
rules on use of veterinary medicines and feed for animals
exemptions from Animal Act rules by general administrative order
ex officio amendment, supplementation or withdrawal of decisions
p: Enforcement officials may open closed fish containers and lift fishing gear on first demand, extending search powers over fishers.
The minister may designate a legal person to manage archive records and may inspect them at any time.
Exemptions from the Animal Act may be granted by general administrative order, not only by the minister.
Fisheries Act offences are moved into the Economic Offences Act, enabling special investigative powers such as covert observation and wiretapping.

parties: Asks whether a judge retains effective instruments to prevent malafide fishers reoffending once the visakte is abolished, and whether powers to withdraw professional fishing rights should be arranged first.
What instruments will a judge still have to effectively prevent a malafide fisher from offending again?
Welke instrumenten heeft een rechter straks nog ter beschikking om effectief te voorkomen dat een malafide visser wederom in de fout zal gaan?
Asks whether the new offences leave enforcement officers of Sportvisserij Nederland without powers and whether the government will reconsider this with the sector.
Is the government willing to examine this unexpected effect further in consultation with the sport fishing sector?
Is de regering bereid om in overleg met sportvisserijsector deze onverwachte uitwerking nader te bezien?
Asks whether evidentiary problems will make it legally difficult to impose actual penalties on people caught with fish without recognised professional status.

Questions whether leaving the decision to release non-native fish to the fishing rightholder without state-level weighing of interests is adequate, and whether abolishing the visakte removes a periodic public-law review of large gear.
Does the government agree with the PvdD members that great restraint must be exercised for such release decisions and a careful weighing of the different interests must take place?

Is de regering het met de leden van de PvdD-fractie eens dat voor dergelijke uitzettingsbeslissingen grote terughoudendheid moet worden betracht en een zorgvuldige afweging van de verschillende belangen moet plaatsvinden?
Supports the bill and the abolition of the visakte, while asking why quota-exceeding fishing is excluded from criminalisation and requesting a collective registration system for fish withdrawals.
They also support the proposal to abolish the visakte system.
Zij steunen ook het voorstel om het stelsel van de visakte op te heffen.

32710-III.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2010 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet, the Oversight Committee for the intelligence and security services, and the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency. It changes the budgeted amounts in thousands of euros to reflect realised spending and revenue, with no new powers or delegations.
q: The change (– 269) results from a staffing establishment that was not fully filled throughout the year.
De mutatie (– 269) is het gevolg van een niet volledig bezette personele formatie gedurende het gehele jaar.

32718.s: The bill amends the Dutch Collective Dismissal Notification Act so that its notification and consultation duties apply regardless of the route an employer uses (UWV permit, court dissolution or mutual termination agreement), and makes dismissals and termination agreements voidable if these duties are not met. It also requires courts to verify compliance before granting dissolution, with an exception where compliance would endanger reinstatement or remaining jobs.
32718.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need to involve unions in collective dismissals early and to prevent employers avoiding the act by choosing alternative termination routes, and justifies the consultation waiver by the need to protect reinstatement in urgent financial situations.
q: The third paragraph lapses.
Het derde lid vervalt.
d: minister's approval to disapply consultation duty
p: Competent authority may waive the consultation requirement where compliance would endanger reinstatement or remaining jobs, subject to ministerial approval that may be refused only for conflict with law or the public interest.
Court may grant dissolution despite non-compliance with consultation if the employer shows that compliance would endanger reinstatement or remaining jobs.

parties: Asks why termination agreements should be equated with unilateral dismissal and raises legal uncertainty from the annulment ground.
This entails a risk of legal uncertainty for both the employer and the employee.
Dit brengt een risico van rechtsonzekerheid met zich mee voor zowel de werkgever als werknemer.
Supports the bill in general but objects to the shortened waiting period and wants stronger safeguards for workers' representatives.
The amendment aimed to clarify the dismissal routes, not to restrict employees' rights.
De wetswijziging had tot doelstelling het verhelderen van de ontslagroutes, niet het beperken van rechten van werknemers.
Supports extending the WMCO but rejects provisions it says disadvantage workers, including the shift of burden of proof for non-consultation onto unions and workers.
This applies to the actual shortening of the waiting period before dismissal and to the proposal that the burden of proof for non-consultation by the employer shifts to the unions and employees.

Dit geldt voor de feitelijke bekorting van de wacht tijd tot opzegging en voor het voorstel dat de bewijslast bij de niet-raadpleging door de werkgever van belanghebbende vakbonden en de ondernemingsraad wordt gelegd bij de vakbonden en werknemers.
Questions whether the new annulment ground creates too much uncertainty and asks how the consultation requirement relates to existing law.
The CDA members further wonder whether the annulment ground now being introduced does not lead to too much uncertainty.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich voorts af of de vernietigingsgrond, die nu wordt geïntroduceerd, niet tot teveel onduidelijkheid leidt.
Welcomes bringing termination agreements under the WMCO but asks why the one-month waiting period is shortened and whether the UWV or courts verify consultation.
The SP members believe the one-month period should remain in the WMCO.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat de termijn van een maand in de WMCO gehandhaafd moet blijven.
Asks about administrative and financial consequences for businesses and about the Europe-based exemptions for teaching staff and clergy.
The D66 members are curious whether the bill leads to administrative burdens for businesses.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn benieuwd of het wetsvoorstel leidt tot administratieve lasten voor bedrijven.
Asks for explanation of whether the scope of the Act is widened and of the choice of terminology, and asks about the intended entry-into-force date.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government for further explanation of whether the scope of the Act is nevertheless widened.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om een nadere toelichting of de reikwijdte van de wet toch wordt vergroot.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill extending the collective dismissal notification duty (Wmco) to terminations by mutual consent and to court dissolution requests, but asks the government to clarify whether teachers and clergy are excluded and to align the revised article 2 with Directive 98/59/EC. The minister's reply explains that the exclusions for public-law employees, teachers and clergy are long-standing and consistent with the Directive, and the advice is taken as far as it is adopted or explained.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the government to clarify whether the exclusion of teachers and clergy from the notification duty is intended, and to adapt the bill if necessary.
The Afdeling asks that revised article 2 Wmco be aligned with Directive 98/59/EC, which provides no basis for excluding teachers and clergy.

32763.s: The bill allows natural persons to submit a certificate of conduct (VOG) application electronically via DigiD and removes the mayor's advisory role, while adjusting retention periods so they run from a decision not to prosecute. It also lets the College voor de Rechten van de Mens... rather, the College (Minister/College) disclose non-anonymised judicial data for research and statistics, with details left to an AMvB.
32763.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB and disclosure powers by the burden of prior anonymisation on prosecutors and the College's ability to assess requests, and removes the mayor's role as practically dead letter.
q: In practice there is a need for the College itself to have the power to disclose non-anonymised prosecution data.
In de praktijk bestaat er behoefte aan dat het College zelf over de bevoegdheid tot verstrekking van niet-geanonimiseerde strafvorderlijke gegevens beschikt.
d: rules on disclosure of judicial data for policy research and statistics
p: The College is empowered to release non-anonymised judicial data for research, with conditions set by AMvB and a requirement that results not be traceable to individuals.
The mayor's formal advisory role on certificates of conduct is removed because it had become practically unused.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, in a 7 February 2011 opinion, that a bill combining electronic applications for certificates of conduct with rules on information requests for fine enforcement should be split, while otherwise raising no substantive objections. The minister's nader rapport of 28 April 2011 reports that the bill was split as advised, with the fine-enforcement part sent separately to the Tweede Kamer, and that the remaining bill includes technical and redactional corrections.
concerns: The bill mixes subjects lacking sufficient substantive coherence and should be split into a bill on electronic certificate-of-conduct applications and a bill on information provision to the public prosecutor for fines.

32780-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets, adjusting appropriations for bodies such as the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer and the National Ombudsman. It takes effect on 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets for 2011 is amended
De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd

32781.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to bring money exchange businesses (wisselinstellingen) under its licensing and supervision regime, repealing the separate Wet inzake de geldtransactiekantoren. It also makes technical and substantive changes on premium pension claims, takeover bids, trust offices, sanctions and EU regulation enforcement, including powers to designate supervisors and fines by general administrative order.
32781.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a way to implement EU regulations quickly and to avoid lengthy statutory amendments, limiting them to designating authorities and detailing sanctions.
q: The proposed delegation provisions are limited to designating the competent authorities and further elaborating the sanctioning of the provisions of a regulation.
De voorgestelde delegatiebepalingen beperken zich tot het aanwijzen van de bevoegde autoriteiten en het nader uitwerken van de sanctionering van de bepalingen van een verordening.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdelen G en H (artikelen 1:24 en 1:25 Wft)
designation of supervisor for EU regulations by general administrative order
ARTIKEL I, onderdelen L en M (artikelen 1:79 en 1:80 Wft)
listing of EU regulation provisions subject to sanction
designation of states whose supervision of money exchangers is adequate
exemption from licensing requirement for money exchangers
amount of administrative fines for counterfeiting breaches
ARTIKEL VII, onderdeel C (artikel 2a Wet toezicht trustkantoren)
exemption from trust office licensing for categories of trust offices
p: ARTIKEL VII, onderdeel G (artikel 25 Wet toezicht trustkantoren)
Allows the supervisor to appoint a curator over a trust office's organs, overriding their powers, when statutory requirements are not met.
Requires the AFM to obtain DNB's view before withdrawing a designation of a prudentially supervised firm.
ARTIKEL I, onderdelen G en H (artikelen 1:24 en 1:25 Wft)
Lets the central bank and AFM be designated by general administrative order as enforcers of EU regulations, with powers limited by the regulation itself.

parties: Asks on what criteria the AFM will set a deadline for a potential bidder and on the basis for the 9- and 6-month bans, and whether misuse is foreseen.
Can the government indicate on the basis of which criteria the AFM will actually decide to set a deadline for a potential bidder when requested to do so?
Kan de regering aangeven op basis van welke criteria de AFM daadwerkelijk zal besluiten een termijn te stellen aan een potentiële bieder wanneer daar om verzocht wordt?

Asks why employees and shareholders are not interested parties under the General Administrative Law Act for a put-up-or-shut-up decision, and why the delegation of supervisor designation was not placed in the law as the Council of State advised.

Favours a takeover panel with market participants to take over supervision of mandatory bids from the Ondernemingskamer and AFM, and asks why the technical versus substantive changes are not clearly distinguished.

The CDA members are attracted to the idea that supervision of the mandatory bid by the Ondernemingskamer, and supervision of the formal aspects of the bidding process by the AFM, would pass to a new independent 'takeover panel'.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn gecharmeerd van het idee dat het toezicht op het verplichte bod door de Ondernemingskamer, als het toezicht op de formele aspecten van het biedingsproces door AFM over zou gaan naar een (nieuw) onafhankelijk «overnamepanel».
Asks whether it is government policy that financial supervision may not be stricter than the EU minimum, and how virtual trust offices abroad and the 25% beneficial-owner threshold will be policed.
Is it a policy of this government that supervision of the financial sector may not be stricter than the absolute minimum prescribed by a European directive?
Is het een beleid van deze regering dat toezicht op de financiële sector niet strenger mag zijn dan het absolute minimum dat door een Europese richtlijn wordt voorgeschreven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2012 supports the bill's aim but raises objections on the coherence of its parts, the delegated framework for implementing EU regulations (which reduces clarity of enforcement powers), and the extension of the trust office licensing requirement to foreign providers as a restriction on free movement of services. The government's reply accepts most points: it restructures the EU-regulation framework, justifies the trust-office extension, and makes several technical amendments, though it keeps the bill together rather than splitting it.
concerns: Advised that the Wft itself must name the supervisors eligible for designation and make enforcement powers for EU regulations clear, which the government adopted by redrafting the delegation provisions.

Concern that the proposed EU-regulation framework makes it unclear from the law which enforcement powers apply; the government amended the bill so powers such as penalty orders and fines must be expressly granted.

The extension of trust-office licensing to foreign service providers restricts free movement of services and must be justified under the general-interest exception; the government added justification and a designated-state exemption.
Multiple redactional and cross-reference corrections, including the citation year, treaty references, and the Bankwet and Wtt article references, were adopted.
Coherence of the bill's diverse amendments was questioned; the government defended keeping them together as part of an annual financial-markets amendment cycle.

32826.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2009/110/EC on electronic money institutions into the Dutch Financial Supervision Act, creating a licensing regime and prudential and conduct rules for electronic money issuers. It also renames 'kredietinstelling' to 'bank' throughout many laws and sets out transitional rules and redemption rights for electronic money holders.
32826.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the directive's technical requirements and to adapt rules to small institutions and changing market conditions.
q: It is therefore not necessary to include an additional provision to give effect to this member state option.
Het is daarom niet nodig om een additionele bepaling op te nemen om aan deze lidstaatoptie invulling te geven.
d: partial or full exemption from licensing for small electronic money institutions
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel BH (artikel 4:31, vierde lid Wft)
rules on conversion of funds into electronic money
manner of safeguarding client funds received
minimum solvency requirements for electronic money institutions
data to be submitted with licence application and agent notification
p: The Nederlandsche Bank may order an electronic money institution to house non-payment activities in a separate legal entity where they threaten financial soundness or supervision.
The supervisor may block or suspend voting rights of shareholders who acquire a qualifying holding over its objection, and may impose sanctions on managers.
Electronic money may only be issued at nominal value; the provision sets a technical limit on issuance rather than shifting power materially.

parties: Asks how safety for consumers is weighed against easier market entry, including the 20% capital tolerance and the choice of member-state option 3 and the 150 euro storage cap.
How does this relate to consumer protection?
Hoe verhoudt zich dit tot de consumentenbescherming?
Asks for the legal basis and deadline for refunding e-money holders and why the time limit is left to contracts rather than statute.
Would it not be desirable to anchor this term in law instead of leaving it to the contract between the e-money institution and the cardholder?

Is het niet wenselijk deze termijn wettelijk te verankeren in plaats van deze over te laten aan de overeenkomst aangaande de terugbetalingvoorwaarden tussen de elektronischgeldinstelling en de houder van de kaart?
Asks for justification of the many member-state options, the absence of liquidity requirements, safeguarding scope, and the delayed implementation that led to a Commission warning.
An important point for the CDA members is that no providers enter the e-money market that engage in irresponsible practices.
Belangrijk punt voor de leden van de CDA-fractie is dat er geen aanbie ders komen op de markt voor elektronisch geld die onverantwoorde praktijken uitvoeren.
Asks the basis for the 5 million euro and 150 euro thresholds and what objections were raised in consultation.
What exactly were the objections to a lower amount and who raised them?
Wat waren precies de bezwaren tegen een lager bedrag en door wie zijn deze bezwaren geuit?

32835.s: The bill requires owners of Dutch seagoing ships and foreign ships calling at Dutch ports to carry an insurance certificate against maritime claims, implementing EU Directive 2009/20/EG. It also empowers the Minister to order removal of ships lacking the certificate and sets out inspection and enforcement arrangements.
32835.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to implement the EU directive and to deter substandard ships through inspections and sanctions.
q: Supervision of compliance with this obligation for Dutch ships is regulated by this bill.
Het toezicht op de naleving van deze verplichting voor Nederlandse schepen wordt met dit wetsvoorstel geregeld.
d: designation of officials supervising insurance requirement
minister may order removal of ship from port
p: The Minister may order a ship removed from a port when the insurance certificate is found missing during inspection.

32844.s: This omnibus bill corrects technical defects and makes minor amendments across several infrastructure and environmental laws, including the Wabo introductory act, the Wet ruimtelijke ordening, the Wet milieubeheer and the Wet geluidhinder. It mostly restates or narrows existing powers and includes a few delegations to administrative bodies and a clarified power to designate notified bodies under explosives law.
32844.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical corrections of drafting errors and as necessary to align Dutch law with EU directive 93/15/EEG and with the intended scope of earlier Wabo and Wro provisions.
d: Artikel IV, onderdeel C (Wabo art. 2.11, tweede lid)
categories of activities requiring permit under art. 2.1(1)(c)
Artikel IV, onderdeel E (Wabo art. 2.27, eerste lid, new sentence)
designated body may identify categories of cases exempt from verklaring van geen bedenkingen
Artikel IX, onderdeel A (Wet geluidhinder art. 55)
noise regulation under article 55 paragraphs 2 and 4
Artikel IX, onderdeel B (Wet geluidhinder art. 87b, derde lid, a)
categories of rail vehicles and measurement rules for noise emission
Artikel IX, onderdeel C (Wet geluidhinder art. 89, tweede lid)
measures and programme rules for previously notified cases
Artikel XII, onderdeel E (Wet milieubeheer art. 9.2.2.3)
permit refusal or withdrawal grounds under environmental permit rules
Artikel VIII (Wet explosieven voor civiel gebruik art. 5, eerste lid)
designation of notified bodies for explosives conformity assessment
p: Artikel XII, onderdeel E (Wet milieubeheer art. 9.2.2.3)
Expands the grounds on which the competent authority may refuse or withdraw environmental permits to include international treaty obligations and Bibob integrity considerations.
Artikel XIII (Wet op de economische delicten art. 1a)
Renumbers and reorganises references to environmental offences subject to economic offence procedures without substantive change.

parties: No questions or remarks; no check-related concern raised.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Citizens are sidelined by delegating permit-related decisions and narrowing who counts as an interested party; the SP wants independent review and asks why a five-year pre-emption period is chosen.
With this, and in combination with the newly introduced concept of interested party, citizens are, in the view of the SP, increasingly being sidelined.
Hiermee, en in combinatie met het geïntroduceerde begrip belanghebbende, wordt de burger naar het idee van de leden van de SP-fractie steeds meer buiten spel gezet.

Asks for explanation of delegating to an administrative body the power to exempt categories of cases from the declaration of no objections, and why this is not deferred to the broader environmental law reform.
Why has the government chosen to include this change in this bill rather than waiting for this reform?
Om welke reden heeft de regering er voor gekozen deze wijziging bij dit wetsvoorstel mee te nemen en niet te wachten tot deze herziening?

Argues that extending a pre-emption right after a court annulment conflicts with the law's principles and property rights, and asks the government to confirm legal certainty on contractual pre-emption rights.
The effect of the pre-emption right is extended by this proposed change at the expense of the interests of the owner of the immovable property concerned.
De werking van het voorkeursrecht wordt door deze voorgestelde wijziging uitgebreid ten koste van het belang van de eigenaar van de onroerende zaak waarop de bepaling van toepassing is.

32853.s: The bill amends Article 3:310(4) of the Dutch Civil Code so that a victim's claim for damages against the perpetrator of a criminal offence is not time-barred for as long as the right to prosecute that offence has not lapsed. The explanatory memorandum addresses concerns about the presumption of innocence and rejects alternative limits proposed by the Dutch judiciary association.
32853.j: The memorandum justifies the rule by the need to let victims claim damages while criminal prosecution remains possible, and it considers and rejects the judiciary's suggested limits.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable to amend the Civil Code so that a victim of a criminal offence can claim damages, at least as long as the right to prosecute that offence has not lapsed

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is het Burgerlijk Wetboek te wijzigen zodat een slachtoffer van een strafbaar feit schadevergoeding kan vorderen, ten minste zolang het recht tot strafvordering van dat strafbare feit niet is verjaard

parties: Asks whether the bill resolves all civil liability problems from abolishing limitation for serious crimes, and how the civil judge would determine whether a criminal limitation period has run.
