First, the VVD members ask the government to confirm that this bill will resolve all possible civil liability problems arising from abolishing the limitation period for serious crimes, in conjunction with the retroactive revision bill.

Allereerst vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie aan de regering de bevestiging dat met dit wetsvoorstel alle mogelijke problemen rond de civielrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid die kunnen voortvloeien uit de afschaffing van de verjaringstermijn voor zware misdrijven uitvoering van het wetsvoorstel herziening ten nadele met terugwerkende kracht, zullen zijn opgelost.
Accepts the bill but asks how joining a civil claim to a criminal case relates to the presumption of innocence, including whether a criminal court could acquit yet still rule on the civil side.
Nevertheless, these members ask how this should be viewed in light of joining a civil claim to a criminal trial.
Toch vragen voornoemde leden hoe dit in het licht van het voegen van een civiele zaak in een strafproces kan worden gezien.

Asks whether the existing paragraph 5 still fits the proposed paragraph 4 and wants the advantages and disadvantages of the Netherlands Association for the Judiciary's alternative of tying extension to a complaint.
These members would like the advantages and disadvantages set out regarding the proposed Article 3:310(4) and the alternative proposed by the NVvR.
Deze leden zouden graag de voor- en nadelen uiteengezet zien voor wat betreft het voorgestelde artikel 3:310, vierde lid, en de alternatieve mogelijkheid voorgesteld door de NVvR.
Supports the change but asks about the burden of proof in civil versus criminal law, how judges handle acquittals, and whether the wider limitation rules should be reviewed.
It is good that the government proposes that the civil claim for damages against the perpetrator does not expire before the limitation period set in criminal law.
Het is goed dat de regering voorstelt te bepalen dat de rechtsvordering tot schadevergoeding tegen de dader niet eerder verjaart dan de verjaringstermijn die hierop in het strafrecht staat.
Asks how the bill relates to a parallel bill amending the same article and whether a conflict rule is needed.
These members ask how this relates to the other bill and whether it is necessary to include a conflict rule in the bill.
Deze leden zich hoe dit zich met elkaar verhoudt en of het niet noodzakelijk is een samenloopregeling op te nemen in het wetsvoorstel.
Supports the aim of improving the position of victims and has no additional questions.
They endorse the objective of this bill to improve the position of victims and surviving relatives.
Zij onderschrijven de doelstelling van dit wetsvoorstel om de positie van slachtoffers en nabestaanden te verbeteren.
Asks whether a conflict rule exists given that another bill modifies the same article.
Can the government indicate whether a conflict rule is nevertheless provided for?
Kan de regering aangeven of er nochtans is voorzien in een samenloopregeling?

32862.s: The bill amends the Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen to introduce a basisnet of roads, rail and inland waterways with maximum individual and group risk ceilings for transporting hazardous substances, set by ministerial regulation. It also expands the minister's routing powers (including banning hazardous goods from roads), revises municipal routing, and adds exemption and dispensation powers.
32862.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and routing powers as needed for flexible, integral risk management and effective control of the transport risk, with the routing power as ultimum remedium and reporting to the Tweede Kamer.
q: The basisnet is designed as a robust and future-proof system.
Het basisnet is ontworpen als een robuust en toekomstvast systeem.
d: designation of roads, rail lines and waterways forming the basisnet
setting placeable risk ceiling locations (PR and GR ceilings)
rules on how risk monitoring studies are carried out
shifting risk ceiling locations after notifying parliament
rules on public-safety grounds, application data and conditions for exemptions
p: Minister may ban hazardous goods transport on designated roads, waterways and rail lines in the interest of public safety, including by time period, and must do so when risk ceilings are exceeded."
Minister may refuse exemptions on public-safety grounds and set conditions, with broad discretion over exemptions from routing bans."
Minister may set additional, stricter group risk ceilings by ministerial regulation where deemed necessary."
Municipal routing is restricted so that it does not apply to roads designated in the basisnet, reducing local discretion."

parties: Asks how risk ceilings are set in advance and whether a verantwoordingsplicht where a municipality judges itself is acceptable.
The VVD members ask the government whether the accountability obligation does not amount to a municipality judging itself, the "butcher inspecting his own meat".'
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering of bij de verantwoordingsplicht geen sprake is van de gemeente die zichzelf beoordeelt, de «slager die zijn eigen vlees keurt».
Shares Raad van State concerns about ministerial delegation and democratic legitimacy of basisnet decisions, and asks about the role of the municipal council.

Given that the government states it is for the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment to set the basisnet and related matters, the CDA members join the Council of State in its concerns about the democratic legitimacy of these decisions.'

Gelet op het feit dat de regering stelt, dat het aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu is om het basisnet en de daarmee samenhangende zaken vast te stellen, sluiten de leden van de CDA-fractie zich bij de leden van de Raad van State aan waar het de democratische legitimiteit van deze besluiten betreft.
Criticises that the ministry only checks ceiling exceedances after the fact, and questions limited municipal routing powers for rail.
Does the government also share the VNG's view that this is wholly insufficient for hazardous-goods transport by rail?'
Deelt ook de regering de mening van de VNG dat dit voor vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen per spoor volstrekt onvoldoende is?
Questions exclusion of the basisnet decision and ceilings from appeal and objection under the Awb negative list, and the enforcement burden on municipalities.

The PvdA members ask the government why the designation of the basisnet and the setting of risk ceilings were placed on the so-called negative list of the General Administrative Law Act, so that no appeal or objection is possible.'

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering waarom er voor gekozen is om de aanwijzing van het basisnet en de vaststelling van de risicoplafonds op de zogenaamde negatieve lijst van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht te zetten.
Asks that the Tweede Kamer be involved before major changes to group risk, and questions the choice of ministerial regulation over an AMvB.
These members consider it important that the Tweede Kamer also be involved in (major) changes to the group risk before they are implemented.'
Genoemde leden vinden het wel van belang dat de Tweede Kamer ook bij (grote) wijzigingen van het groepsrisico wordt betrokken voordat deze worden doorgevoerd.
Has no questions or remarks at this stage.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.'
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Has no questions or remarks at this stage.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.'
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Asks whether and when the government will bring forward measures so group risk stays below agreed values, and asks about German assurances on the third track.
The VVD members note that group risk remains too high in a number of places.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat het (groeps)risico op een aantal plaatsen echter te hoog blijft.
Questions why municipalities still lack the population data and calculation files underlying the risk ceilings, and asks about responsibility for measures in Dordrecht and Zwijndrecht.
The PvdA members ask whether it is true that municipalities still do not have the population data and other calculation files used for the basic network calculations.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of het klopt dat de gemeenten nog steeds niet over de bevolkingsgegevens en andere rekenbestanden beschikken waarmee de basisnetberekeningen zijn uitgevoerd.
Asks how the minister's power to set and exceed risk ceilings, routing powers and exemption decisions will be monitored and used, and on what criteria.
The CDA members gather from the explanatory memorandum that the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment is responsible for setting the risk ceilings.
De leden van de CDA-fractie maken uit de Memorie van Toelichting op dat de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu verantwoordelijk is voor het vaststellen van de risicoplafonds.
Asks for clarification on liability for exceeding risks between the network manager, municipality and third parties, and about which advisory opinions were adopted.
Critical of the risk calculation models and asks the government to respond to criticism from the Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen; also questions the unclear legal position of rail yards.
The GroenLinks members are critical of the calculation models used to map safety risks.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks zijn kritisch over de rekenmodellen die gebruikt worden om de veiligheidsrisico's in kaart te brengen.

Objects to broad ministerial delegation for changing risk ceilings without set criteria or formal consultation, and asks for prior information to parliament and a formal consultation right with reasons.
For the ChristenUnie members, concern about the far-reaching delegation to the minister for setting risk ceilings has not yet been resolved.
Voor de leden van de ChristenUnie is de zorg over de vergaande delegatie aan de minister met betrekking tot het vaststellen van de risicoplafonds nog niet weggenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet basisnet amending the Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen, supporting its aim but raising concerns about delegation of essential basisnet elements to a ministerial regulation, limited appeal options, and the missing remediation scheme. The minister's reply largely accepted the delegation and remediation points by moving elements to an AMvB and clarified the monitoring and consultation issues, while defending the exclusion of appeal.
concerns: Essential elements of the basisnet (risk ceilings, reference points) should be set at AMvB level rather than ministerial regulation; the government moved these to the AMvB level in part while keeping technical details in regulation.

Exclusion of appeal and objection for the designation of routes and risk ceilings via the negative list of the Awb is questionable; the government defended the exclusion on grounds of integrality but sharpened the justification.
Data-provision rules for provinces and municipalities require an AMvB as legal basis, so the ministerial regulation provision was removed.

Remediation scheme for existing or planned vulnerable objects in risk zones should be set at least at AMvB level; the government agreed to elaborate it in the Besluit transportroutes externe veiligheid.
Monitoring obligation wording in article 15 second paragraph was unclear regarding the five-year cycle and was clarified.

Consultation of the IPO and VNG under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen was not done before advice; government states earlier informal input was incorporated, and it did not change the proposal beyond clarifications.

32871.s: This omnibus bill updates references across many statutes to the renamed Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and to other renamed ministries after the departmental reorganisation, and repairs various technical defects. It also amends several energy, competition and telecom provisions, including tariff-setting and enforcement details.
32871.j: The memorandum justifies the technical corrections as necessary to restore consistency after the departmental reorganisation and to fix drafting omissions, rather than to expand executive power.
q: Thus, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, We have resolved and agreed as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: competition authority tariff efficiency policy rules
rules to counter hoarding of goods
nuclear energy general administrative measures under Kernenergiewet
telecom number plan and number allocation rules by college

parties: The PvdA finds it undesirable that licensing and enforcement/supervision of a new nuclear power plant sit under one ministry, citing Japan's separation of these functions after Fukushima, and asks whether the EU and IAEA reviews support the change.
Under the proposed amendment, licensing of a new nuclear power plant and its enforcement and supervision are placed under the responsibility of a single ministry.
Bij de voorgestelde wijziging wordt vergunningverlening voor een nieuwe kerncentrale en handhaving en toezicht daarop onder de verantwoordelijkheid van één ministerie geplaatst.

33000-IXA.s: The bill formally sets the 2012 budget statement for the Dutch National Debt (IXA) in thousands of euros, with the statement attached as schedule. It enters into force on 1 January 2012 and is to be published in the Staatsblad, with ministries and officials ordered to implement it.
q: The budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2012 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33078.s: The bill makes agricultural farm dwellings that may be occupied by third parties, and dwellings in their surroundings, part of the farm for environmental law purposes, so that the environmental protection level follows the planning status rather than actual use. It makes parallel amendments to the Wet geluidhinder, Wet milieubeheer and Wet geurhinder en veehouderij definitions.
33078.j: The memorandum justifies the change by stating that environmental protection should follow planning status rather than actual use, to increase rural vitality without unnecessarily restricting neighbouring farms.
q: The starting point is that environmental law is written to protect the environment and spatial planning law grants powers in connection with good spatial planning.
Het uitgangspunt is dat het milieurecht is geschreven ter bescherming van het belang van het milieu en het ruimtelijke ordeningsrecht bevoegdheden geeft in verband met een goede ruimtelijke ordening.
p: Ties the environmental status of farm dwellings to planning decisions and permits, lowering protection for nearby residents where actual use had been higher than planning status.

parties: Asks how the rules would apply to residential buildings on industrial estates and whether municipalities could adopt similar use rules, and how existing VAB policy is affected.
Is it possible that after this bill is introduced, municipalities adopt a similar use arrangement for company dwellings on industrial estates inhabited by third parties?
Is het mogelijk dat gemeenten na invoering van dit wetsvoorstel eenzelfde soort gebruiksregeling opnemen voor door «derden» bewoonde bedrijfswoningen op industrieterreinen?
Raises health risks from livestock proximity, questions whether residents have less protection, and asks whether residents can challenge designation and whether neighbouring firms can object.
In the government's view, does one resident have less right to protection than another?
Is het in de ogen van de regering zo dat de ene bewoner minder recht heeft op bescherming dan de andere?
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Supports a national structural solution for thousands of houses, relying on municipalities to designate them and asking the government to address a coulant approach with municipalities for cases not yet covered.
Municipalities can, under this legislation, designate the former farmhouse as a rural dwelling in the zoning plan.
Gemeenten kunnen met deze wetgeving in het bestemmingsplan de voormalige boerderij als plattelandswoning bestemmen.
Doubts the need for a separate bill, questions the different protection levels for company and residential dwellings, and asks why local tailoring via municipal regulation is excluded.
Why is this now regulated nationally instead of leaving room for a local ordinance?
Waarom wordt dit nu landelijk geregeld in plaats van ruimte te houden voor een plaatselijke verordening?
Asks why the designation is automatic rather than left to municipalities preparing zoning plans, and what happens when neighbouring firms expand.
These members ask why it was not chosen to leave this choice to the municipality preparing the zoning plan.
Genoemde leden vragen waarom er niet voor is gekozen deze keuze over te laten aan de gemeente die het bestemmingsplan opstelt.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill that makes planning status rather than actual use decisive for environmental protection, and that excludes agricultural farmhouses used as ordinary dwellings (plattelandswoningen) from protection against their farm's emissions. The minister's reply accepts most remarks: it adds explanation on the limited scope, justifies the absence of transitional law by pointing to a small number of cases, adds consultation details on IPO and VNG, and adds a passage on reduced compliance costs.
concerns: The memorie van toelichting should explain why neighbouring third-party farms face fewer problems from farmhouses, justifying the limited scope of the bill.

The absence of transitional law is inadequately justified because some legally inhabited dwellings would lose a higher protection level; the government explains these are few and that legal occupation is defined broadly, adding a reference in the explanatory memorandum.

The definition 'voorheen behorend tot' could include dwellings already reclassified as ordinary homes, so the explanation should address this and the bill adjusted if needed; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

Under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen, the bill affecting provinces and municipalities should have been submitted to the IPO and VNG for advice; the memorandum now records that they chose to limit input to officials.

33096.s: The bill amends the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs to add a location code to the student data that vocational and adult education institutions supply, so municipalities can enforce truancy and school-leaving rules more efficiently. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and applies to both funded and non-funded institutions.
q: to add a location code to the data the institution supplies in order to enable municipalities to carry out their truancy duties more efficiently
om een locatiecode toe te voegen aan de gegevens die de instelling levert teneinde gemeenten beter in staat te stellen hun taken ten aanzien van verzuim efficiënter uit te voeren

parties: Asks whether poor contact between truancy officers and mbo locations actually causes inadequate action on early school leaving, and warns the location code could add bureaucracy without clear effect.
It must be prevented that adding the location code leads to an extra administrative burden without clear effect and thereby, however small it may be, to unnecessary bureaucracy.

Voorkomen moet worden dat het toevoegen van de locatiecode tot een extra administratieve last leidt zonder duidelijk effect en die daarmee – hoe klein die dan ook moge zijn – tot onnodige bureaucratie leidt.
Supports the bill as a tool for municipalities to enforce compulsory education and asks whether the VNG and other parties see added value and whether the administrative burden is limited.
They believe that combating early school leaving still deserves a great deal of attention and note that early detection of truancy is a necessary condition for that.
Zij menen dat de bestrijding van voortijdig schoolverlaten nog altijd veel aandacht verdient en constateren dat vroegtijdige signalering van schoolverzuim een noodzakelijke voorwaarde daarvoor vormt.
Endorses the need to combat truancy and early school leaving and sees no reason to ask questions.
The members endorse the need to combat truancy and early school leaving.
De leden onderschrijven de noodzaak van het bestrijden van schoolverzuim en voortijdig schoolverlaten.
Welcomes the bill but asks why the location of the supervisor matters, how the code relates to youth care, whether a single code could suffice, and about the MBO-Raad's administrative cost concerns.

The members ask whether the amounts stated in the explanatory memorandum were used as the extra administrative burden during consultation, or whether the MBO-Raad itself indicated other or higher burdens.

De leden vragen of bij de consultatie de in de memorie van toelichting genoemde bedragen zijn gebruikt als zijnde de extra administratieve lasten of heeft de MBO-raad tijdens de consultatie zelf andere of meer administratieve lasten aangegeven.

33168.s: The bill amends the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg and related health-care laws to allow medical-specialist care providers that meet conditions (including a three-year investment period, a quality test, a supervisory board hearing and a board approval) to distribute profits, while banning profit distribution for intramural AWBZ care and academic hospitals. It gives the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit supervisory, instruction, penalty and fine powers over these rules.
33168.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to attract investment in medical-specialist care while keeping quality, accessibility and financial continuity safeguarded by the regulator and supervisory bodies.
q: So it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: Artikel I, A (artikel 41d, eerste lid, onderdeel c)
subsidy-related temporary bar on profit distribution by the regulator's decision
Artikel I, B (artikel 41d, eerste lid, onderdeel a)
ministerial decision confirming quality and safety management before profit distribution
p: Gives the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit power to issue instructions to providers to comply with profit-distribution rules and to order recovery of unlawfully distributed profits.
Allows the regulator to impose penalty payments or make non-compliance public, and in urgent cases to publish without the usual procedure.
Gives the regulator power to impose administrative fines up to 500,000 euros or ten percent of turnover for breaches of the profit-distribution rules.
Requires a ministerial declaration of good governance before profit can be distributed, a discretionary executive gate on private profit distribution.

parties: Asks how the quality test, the supervisory board's advisory role on financial reserves, and the Wfz guarantee operate in practice, and whether the Rijksoverheid could be called upon as backstop.
They are positive about the government's proposal to make profit distribution possible for providers of medical-specialist care.
Zij staan positief tegenover het voorstel van de regering om winstuitkering mogelijk te maken bij aanbieders van medisch-specialistische zorg.
Opposes profit distribution in care, questions the timing and route of the bill, and asks whether safeguards such as volume agreements and the three-year rule are sufficient and tested.
The PvdA members have read this bill with concern. These members cannot agree with what is proposed.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met zorg kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel. Deze leden kunnen zich niet vinden in het voorgestelde.
Supports the bill as a step towards market competition and innovation, asks for exclusion of insurers and pharma investors and a mandatory innovation share of profits.
These members see this as a next step in the process towards more market competition, the aim of which should be more innovation, quality improvement and better service to the patient.
Deze leden zien dit als een volgende stap in het proces naar meer marktwerking waarvan het einddoel meer innovatie, kwaliteitsverbetering en betere dienstverlening aan de patiënt moet zijn.

Accepts profit distribution under conditions but insists quality and patient interests be secured, asks about periodic quality testing, solvency requirements, Wfz guarantees and the Cools report's preconditions.
The bill must fit the demand-driven approach now being introduced throughout the care system.
Het wetsvoorstel moet passen in de vraagsturing die thans in het zorgstelsel overal wordt ingevoerd.

Strongly opposes the bill as privatisation of healthcare, questions the necessity and procedure, and argues the three-year wait, IGZ one-off test and advisory-only supervisory boards are symbolic safeguards.
These members regard this bill as a new low in the sell-off of healthcare for the profit of a few at the expense of many.
Deze leden beschouwen dit voorstel als een nieuw dieptepunt in de uitverkoop van de gezondheidszorg tot winst van enkelen en tot schade van velen.
Sees benefits of more investment and quality incentives but stresses the need for strict conditions and balanced regulation, asks why three years rather than five, and calls for quality indicators.
That fact requires balanced regulation and strict conditions to limit these risks to a minimum.
Dat gegeven vereist een evenwichtige regulering en strikte voorwaarden om deze risico’s tot een minimum te beperken.
Not yet convinced the bill is necessary, asks about alternatives, risks of cherry-picking and volume growth, and whether the bill should await evaluation of the B-segment expansion.
These members see room for hospitals to improve efficiency and care quality, but they are not yet convinced this amendment is necessary.
Deze leden zien dat er een verbeterpotentieel is voor ziekenhuizen voor het verhogen van efficiency en zorgkwaliteit, maar zij zijn er nog niet van overtuigd dat deze wetswijziging nodig is.
Asks whether the government's claim that the extra conditions do not deter investors is based on actual investor signals, and asks about the basis for the 20% solvency norm.
The explanatory memorandum states that the additional requirements imposed on profit distribution are not deterrent.
In de memorie van toelichting wordt aangegeven dat de extra eisen die gesteld worden aan winstuitkering niet afschrikwekkend zijn.

Worries that profit distribution could hollow out hospitals, that quality indicators are not yet reliable, that hospital property may be overvalued, and that the bill is premature; asks for a pilot and for ownership and control safeguards.

Given the coalition agreement, these members are not opposed to the possibility of profit distribution, but want to prevent investors from hollowing out the hospital in quality terms in a way not reflected in solvency figures and other financial indicators.

Deze leden staan, gezien het Regeerakkoord, niet afwijzend tegenover de mogelijkheden van winstuitkering, maar willen voorkomen dat investeerders het ziekenhuis kwalitatief kunnen uithollen op een manier die niet wordt gereflecteerd in solvabiliteitscijfers en andere financiële indicatoren.

Has new doubts given the financial chaos in hospitals and insurers and the Court of Audit's finding that quality transparency is still lacking; asks whether it is too early and whether the bill should wait.
In addition, the Netherlands Court of Audit concludes that the government has not yet succeeded in increasing transparency on quality of care.
Daarnaast concludeert de Algemene Rekenkamer dat de regering er nog niet in is geslaagd de transparantie in de kwaliteit van zorg te vergroten.

Opposes profit distribution in care as public money should not flow to private shareholders; points to Slotervaart hospital governance conflicts and asks for municipal and worker representation on supervisory boards and binding governance code.
These members are of the view that distributing profit does not fit in healthcare.
Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat het uitkeren van winst niet past in de zorg.

Calls the bill increasingly risky, questions the problem it solves, doubts that governance improves through private investors, asks about conflicts of interest, creditor ranking on bankruptcy, NZa monitoring capacity and EU law compatibility.

Sees potential benefits for capital access and innovation but warns of risks to quality and accessibility requiring strict conditions; asks about the 20% solvency and three-year rules and comparison with Germany and Sweden.
These members also note, however, that profit distribution in healthcare carries risks to quality and accessibility.
Genoemde leden stellen echter ook vast dat aan winstuitkering in de zorg risico's voor de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid verbonden zijn.

Questions whether profit distribution to shareholders fits the nature of care, whether it is desirable for profits to flow to providers rather than patients, and how volume growth driven by financial motives can be prevented.
For these members the question remains whether profit distributions from care providers to shareholders fit the character of care.
Voor deze leden blijft de vraag staan of winstuitkeringen van zorgaanbieders aan aandeelhouders wel passen bij het karakter van de zorg.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill allowing profit distribution by medical-specialist care providers but raises objections on the conditions for profit distribution, EU free capital movement and freedom of establishment, the waiting period, top-income rules, and transfer of assets. The minister's reply largely adopts the advice: it justifies the conditions, adds the coherence requirement, extends the foreign legal entity clause, adjusts the waiting period explanation, and drops the top-income provision and asset-retention provisions.
concerns: Conditions on profit distribution may restrict free movement of capital; the explanation must address the coherence requirement from the Hartlauer and Petersen case law, which the government then added.

Excluding foreign legal entities from profit distribution restricts freedom of establishment and needs justification under the public health exception; the government changed the provision to allow them under the same conditions.
The three-year waiting period may be an ineffective remedy against short-term investors and creates investor uncertainty; the government defended it as balanced but clarified its reasoning.
Investment willingness may fall under the conditions, and the explanation should justify the conditions better; the government referred to a SEO study and consultations.
Asset-retention rules for pre-existing assets may conflict with Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR; the government dropped the asset-retention provisions and the related Wtzi article 18.

Article 16, which blocks profit distribution while top-income penalties remain unpaid, risks misuse as a collection tool against investors not responsible for the excess pay; the government deleted it.
Board and supervisory body approval requirements for profit distribution affect corporate law allocation of powers; the government explained the approach as consistent with Dutch company law.
The distinction between the first investor's waiting period and later investors is unclear; the government explained the reasoning but did not change the design.

33186.s: The bill establishes the Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) by merging the competition authority NMa, the telecom and postal regulator OPTA, and the Consumentenautoriteit into one independent administrative body. It also amends numerous sector laws to replace the old authorities with the ACM and strengthens consumer-protection enforcement tools such as binding instructions and higher fines.
33186.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on efficiency and effectiveness of market supervision and on the need for independence of the regulator from ministers.
q: The purpose of establishing the ACM is to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of market supervision in the Netherlands.
Doel van de oprichting van de ACM is vergroting van de effectiviteit en de efficiëntie van het markttoezicht in Nederland.
d: appointment and composition of ACM members
ACM mandate regulation for staff powers
detailed rules on information exchange with ministers
transitional rules on consequences of the new law
p: The minister may annul only general-scope ACM decisions taken ultra vires, and the ordinary annulment power over individual decisions is excluded.
The ACM gains a binding instruction power and the ability to impose higher administrative fines of up to EUR 450,000, with a cap set by the bill.

parties: Asks why the ACM is not given its own legal personality given independence concerns, and questions the lack of formal appointment criteria for board members.
Would a public profile clearly stating the competences and expertise expected of board members not be much more transparent?
Zou een openbaar profiel waarin duidelijk aangegeven wordt welke competenties en deskundigheid van de bestuurders verwacht wordt niet veel transparanter zijn?
Questions the choice of a small zbo without legal personality for parliamentary control and independence, and asks about ministerial ultra vires powers and restrictions on information sharing.
What are the consequences of the choice for a small zbo for parliamentary control over supervision of the various markets?
Wat zijn de gevolgen van de keuze voor een klein zbo voor de parlementaire controle ten opzichte van het toezicht op de verschillende markten?
Worries the ACM would become too powerful with insufficient democratic control, asks about balance of powers, limits on ministerial approval of policy rules, and rights of appeal against sanctions.
As the bill is now designed, it gives the ACM, in the view of the CDA members, too great a position of power over which the democratically elected government has insufficient control.

Zoals het wetsvoorstel nu is vormgegeven geeft het, naar de mening van de leden van de CDA-fractie, de ACM een te grote machtspositie waar het democratisch gekozen bestuur onvoldoende controle op heeft.
Asks how the role of the minister of EL&I changes in steering the three ACM components and what the drawbacks of a zbo without own legal personality are.
What are the disadvantages of a zbo without its own legal personality and without its own staff compared with a zbo with its own legal personality and staff?
Wat zijn de nadelen van een zbo zonder eigen rechtspersoonlijkheid en zonder eigen personeel ten opzichte van een zbo met een eigen rechtspersoonlijkheid en eigen personeel?
Worries that budget cuts will erode supervision quality, questions the ultra vires power of the minister, and asks how the Kamer is informed of annulled decisions.
The D66 members also ask the government what the greater power the minister of EL&I receives under this bill means for policy choices.
Tevens vragen de leden van de D66-fractie aan de regering wat de grotere bevoegdheid die de minister van EL&I krijgt met onderhavig wetsvoorstel betekent voor beleidskeuzes.
Asks how conduct supervision will be strengthened compared with the current situation, particularly regarding consumer harm in oligopolistic markets.
In what way will the merged supervisor be given the opportunity to monitor, for example, codes of conduct in the sector?
Op welke wijze krijgt de samengevoegde toezichthouder de mogelijkheid om bijvoorbeeld gedragscodes in de sector te monitoren?
Asks whether the ACM will take broader societal and long-term interests into account and whether it will be accessible to complaints from consumers and those harmed by external effects.
Asks how a balanced allocation of attention and staff across the three work areas is guaranteed and what role the ministers and their policy rules play.
How is a balanced distribution and setting of priorities guaranteed?
Hoe wordt een evenwichtige verdeling en prioriteitsstelling gewaarborgd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill establishing the Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), merging NMa, OPTA and CA, and raised concerns about the choice for two separate laws, expanded CA enforcement powers, the state-law position of the ACM, and information sharing, recommending adjustments. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the remarks, justifying the two-law approach and the enforcement powers, and adding clarifications, while rejecting some points such as a ministerial approval power over ACM policy rules.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the necessity of splitting the institutional and material bills into two separate laws and of the transitional period, which the government defended while adding explanation and a target date for the second law.

The Afdeling found no demonstrated urgency for bringing forward expanded CA enforcement powers in the institutional bill, which the government justified by parliamentary wishes and consumer protection needs.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on ministerial accountability and supervision over ACM policy rules given EU independence requirements, leading to clarified annulment grounds and competences but no ministerial approval power.
The Afdeling asked that the law specify which minister may annul ACM rules, which the government clarified in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that ACM not be granted legal personality reasons be explained and that annual report transmission be aligned with the Kaderwet, which the government addressed by explanation and amending the provision.

The Afdeling advised aligning the disclosure rule in article 7 with the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens and the EU privacy directive, and the government referred to existing safeguards in paragraph two.

The Afdeling made numerous redactional remarks on article references and transitional provisions, most of which were followed while the government declined the general suggestion to split article references into subparagraphs.

33280-X.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence by a supplementary budget, raising commitments, expenditure and receipts by the stated amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2012, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence for 2012
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie

33294.s: The bill inserts a new article 13a into the General Child Benefits Act that suspends the indexation of the basic child benefit amount on 1 January 2013 and 1 January 2014. It sets the price index base used for the July indexations of 2013 and 2014 and terminates the rule on 1 January 2015.
33294.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension by the goal of controlling expenditure on child benefit; it does not justify any delegation of power.
q: in connection with controlling child benefit expenditure, to forgo indexation of the basic child benefit amount in the General Child Benefits Act on 1 January 2013 and 1 January 2014
in verband met beheersing van de uitgaven aan kinderbijslag de indexering van het basiskinderbijslagbedrag in de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet per 1 januari 2013 en per 1 januari 2014 achterwege te laten

parties: Asks the government why the price-index deviation for indexation is tied to the period three months earlier.
The VVD members ask whether the government can explain why the deviation in the price index is linked to the period three months earlier.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven waarom er gekozen wordt om de afwijking van de prijsindex te relateren aan de periode van drie maanden geleden?
Understands the need for a balanced budget but prefers leaving child schemes untouched; asks about the scope of non-indexation and income effects across income groups.
However, they prefer to leave the child benefit schemes untouched.
Zij geven er echter de voorkeur aan om de kindregelingen ongemoeid te laten.
Accepts the budgetary necessity but asks for detailed income effects by household size and income group, and how affected citizens will be informed.

33348.s: The bill creates a consolidated Dutch nature protection law (Wet natuurbescherming) implementing the EU Habitats and Birds Directives and biodiversity treaties, covering protected areas (Natura 2000), species protection, and forest felling rules. It largely decentralises implementing powers to the provinces while keeping certain national competences with the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation.
33348.j: The memorandum justifies decentralisation to provinces as the appropriate scale for regional nature policy and retained national powers where national coordination or international obligations require it.
q: The state remains responsible under this bill for designating Natura 2000 areas and setting conservation objectives.
Het Rijk blijft overeenkomstig dit wetsvoorstel verantwoordelijk voor de aanwijzing van Natura 2000-gebieden en voor het vaststellen van de instandhoudingsdoelstellingen.
d: designating categories of activities and areas where national minister holds competence
programmes to reduce pressures on nature areas
rules on sale of bird species and their products
rules on extraction and exploitation of protected species
categories of effects not counted as significant and assessment methods
provincial regulations imposing obligations for categories of activities near Natura 2000 areas
p: Allows derogation from the strict no-significant-effect test for plans and projects where alternatives are absent and overriding public interest exists, with compensatory measures.
Permits exemptions from species protection prohibitions under listed grounds, subject to conditions that no other satisfactory solution exists and conservation status is not harmed.

parties: Argues the bill over-emphasises ecology and fears too many rules, asking how the balance between protection, enjoyment and use is struck.
The bill on many points gives insufficient attention to the balance between economy and ecology.
Het wetsvoorstel heeft op tal van punten onvoldoende oog voor de balans tussen economie en ecologie.
Worries provinces are not bound to achieve internationally required results and questions the lex silencio positivo provision.
The PvdA members note with surprise that the lex silencio positivo has been included in the bill.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie constateren met verbazing dat de lex silencio positivo is opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how national systemic responsibility and uniform enforcement across provinces will be ensured after decentralisation.
How will uniformity in implementation and enforcement across the provinces be maintained?
Hoe gaat uniformiteit in uitvoering en handhaving bij de verschillende provincies gehandhaafd worden?
Wants more practical room for landowners and managers, certification and experimentation clauses instead of heavy regulation.
The bill is too focused on regulation and offers little room for proactive action.
Het wetsvoorstel is te veel gericht op regulering en biedt weinig ruimte voor proactief handelen.
Supports decentralisation but asks for enforceable results per province, provincial audit requirements and clearer intrinsic-value wording.
Asks how coherence between provincial and national nature policy and the intrinsic-value principle will be operationalised and guaranteed.
They ask the government to explain how coherence can be secured in the law or possibly in the national nature vision.
Zij vragen de regering toe te lichten op welke wijze samenhang in de wet of eventueel in de nationale natuurvisie geborgd kan worden.
Calls for a results obligation rather than an effort obligation and asks how national responsibility will be enforced over the provinces.
The GroenLinks members miss in the relevant articles the obligation not only to make efforts but also to ensure those efforts lead to the desired results.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie missen in de betreffende artikelen de verplichting om niet alleen inspanningen te plegen maar ook ervoor te zorgen dat deze inspanningen tot de gewenste resultaten leiden.
Notes the Raad van State criticised the objective clause as legally empty and confusing, and asks why the government did not delete it.
Argues decentralisation without result obligations undermines coherent policy and asks what powers the national state retains to enforce international targets.
What options does the government have to take back control if international obligations are not met?
Welke mogelijkheden heeft de regering om de regie terug in handen te nemen, indien internationale verplichtingen niet worden gehaald?
Asks whether enforcement shifting to municipalities is adequately resourced and whether a single clear competence allocation is preferable.
Is the government willing to allocate extra funds to support municipalities in carrying out this task?
Is de regering bereid extra middelen uit te trekken om gemeenten te ondersteunen om deze taak uit te voeren?
Asks how conflicts between national and provincial nature visions are resolved and how the national vision will be leading, while seeking reduction of regulatory burden.
These members are concerned that this is still unclear.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen dat dit nog steeds onduidelijk is.
Asks how the government will ensure coherence in how provinces protect their nature areas and how provinces coordinate with other authorities.
The PvdA members ask the government again to explain how provinces should pay attention to coherence with the policy and responsibilities of other authorities when implementing their policy.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering nogmaals nader in te gaan op hoe de provincies bij de invulling van hun beleid aandacht dienen te besteden aan de samenhang met het beleid en verantwoordelijkheden van andere overheden?

Requests a per-province update on the provincial nature network before the debate and questions the broad discretion in the 2.9 by-law exemption and the codes of conduct, asking about parliament's influence.
What formal influence do the House and the provincial states have in this process?
Welke formele invloed hebben de Kamer en de provinciale staten in dit proces?

Raises concern about rising administrative burden for hunters and landowners, asks whether hunting plans can be simplified, and questions discretion in the definition of wildlife stock and predator control.
The CDA members are very concerned about the large increase in burden for hunters and land users, game hunters and wildlife management units.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn zeer verontrust over de grote lastenstijging voor jachthouders en grondgebruikers, jagers en wildbeheereenheden.

Asks whether the Rijk has an emergency power to intervene if provinces fail their nature duties, asks for clear monitoring responsibility, and questions the treatment of intrinsic value and the relation to the Omgevingswet and the programmatic approach to nitrogen with a possible pre-consultation of parliament.

Asks the government to evaluate the regulatory burden before the act is folded into the Omgevingswet, cites the ACTAL advisory report, and asks how the vague intrinsic-value concept will be operationalised by administrative bodies.
Is the government willing to evaluate the regulatory burden before the Nature Conservation Act is incorporated into the Omgevingswet, in line with the ACTAL advice?
Is de regering bereid om de regeldruk te evalueren voordat de Wet natuurbescherming wordt opgenomen in de Omgevingswet, conform het advies van ACTAL

Argues the purpose clause on intrinsic value has no independent meaning yet creates confusion, citing the Raad van State, and asks about exempting landowners from insurance obligations and about the burden on municipalities.
Does the government share the view of the SGP members that including the proposed purpose clause in the act itself at least creates confusion?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie dat het opnemen van de voorgestelde doelbepaling in de wet zelf op zijn minst verwarring schept?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the nota van wijziging to the Wet natuurbescherming but advises revising the national nature vision wording, deleting the power to set rules by AMvB on provincial nature visions, deleting the purpose clause, and narrowing the exemption for woody biomass plantations. The government's nader rapport accepts the nature vision wording change and deletion of the AMvB power, but keeps the purpose clause and the biomass exemption while explaining its reasoning.
concerns: The national nature vision's wording of strengthening biodiversity and landscape values should be clarified to allow weighing against other societal interests; government adopted the 'zo mogelijk versterken' wording.
The power to set further rules by AMvB on the content of provincial nature visions conflicts with decentralisation principles and should be deleted; government deleted it.
The purpose clause in article 1.8a adds no value and may create confusion; it should be deleted and placed in the explanatory memorandum; government retained it.
The exemption from replanting duty for woody biomass plantations should be left to provinces, since naming tree species complicates regulation; government kept the statutory exemption.
The criteria for listing protected species should be explained in the explanatory memorandum; government added them.
The pending CJEU case on mitigating measures under the Habitats Directive should be taken into account; government referred to the subsequent ruling and adjusted the programmatic approach.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 29 June 2012 on the draft Wet natuurbescherming (Nature Protection Act) raises serious objections: it questions whether limiting protection to the EU minimum is justified, whether the decentralised allocation of powers across three government tiers is efficient, whether enforcement capacity and legal certainty suffice, and whether the planning-based replacement of permits is equivalent. The government's nader rapport of 17 August 2012 accepts several points (strengthened afstemming, clearer provisions on Rijk-provinces responsibilities, removal of the Habitat-judgment reference in the explanatory memorandum) while defending the core choices of deregulation, centralised bird-hunting opening and the aanschrijvingsbevoegdheid.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for explicit justification of the choice not to protect beyond the EU minimum; the government states it did not aim for minimum protection and points to additional measures, though it accepts the need for further reflection.

Doubts whether the three government tiers have sufficient expertise and resources and whether the decentralised division of tasks ensures efficient coherent implementation; government adds consultation duties but defends the division.
The open-ended zorgplicht and the aanschrijvingsbevoegdheid, applied after activities, leave citizens and companies with little legal certainty and raise enforcement doubts.

Replacing permits with planning protection of the EHS is not shown to offer equivalent protection, given differences in case-by-case assessment and external effect; the government disputes equivalence but acknowledges possible additional instruments.

Centralised ministerial powers for exemptions from harm-prevention rules and opening of hunting are not adequately justified against the decentralisation principle; government keeps the central regime for landelijke schade but drops the Habitat-judgment reference.
Financial and administrative burdens for provinces and municipalities are insufficiently quantified and the implementation timetable is unclear; government commits to further alignment with the IPO.

33357.s: The bill replaces the Wet voorraadvorming aardolieproducten 2001 with a revised regime requiring minimum oil stocks, implementing Directive 2009/119/EG, and raising the stockholding percentage for market participants from 5% to 12%. It sets out stockholder obligations, COVA's governance and levy financing, supervision by designated officials, and appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
33357.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rule-making mainly as implementation of Directive 2009/119/EG and as needed to set thresholds and percentages that can adjust to the dynamic oil market.
q: Directive 2009/119/EC aims to tighten the national and international control system.
Richtlijn 2009/119/EG beoogt een aanscherping van de nationale en internationale controlesystematiek.
d: percentage of stockholding obligation for market participants
method of calculating obligations for market participants
content, manner and timing of stock data reporting
temporary reduction of required stocks in an oil crisis
conditions for exemption from stockholding obligation
further conditions for holding stocks abroad
conditions for holding stocks in NL for other countries
p: The minister may in an oil crisis or threatened crisis temporarily reduce required stocks and order stocks moved to the Netherlands, with limited constraints on the scope of such orders.
The minister may amend COVA's statutes and issue binding instructions to COVA after only consulting its board.
If the minister judges COVA is seriously neglecting its task he may take necessary measures, deviating from COVA's statutes, after giving COVA a chance to comply.
The minister may grant, restrict, condition, amend or withdraw exemptions from the stockholding obligation, including ex officio on grounds of important reasons.
Appeal against decisions under the Act lies to the specialist College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven, which is preserved until the general administrative procedure law applies.

parties: Asks about the financial amounts shifting to industry, possible exemptions for some players, and the effect on fuel prices and the state budget.
Can the government commit that such exemptions will not be an issue?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat dergelijke vrijstellingen niet aan de orde zijn?
Questions the timing of the bill, the calculation of stockholding obligations, the government's power to raise COVA's obligations and the anti-speculation AMvB, pressing for procedural clarity.
In what way can the government determine that the petroleum products COVA must hold are increased?
Op welke manier kan de regering bepalen dat de door COVA aan te houden aardolieproducten worden verhoogd?
Critical of holding stocks in other member states, asks whether Dutch stocks abroad can be claimed directly, and doubts the claimed absence of extra burdens on industry.
It is obvious that each member state would first ensure it does not face an oil shortage, even if the stock is on paper meant for another country.
Het ligt voor de hand dat iedere lidstaat dan eerst ervoor zorgt dat het zelf geen olietekort komt ook als de betreffende voorraad op papier voor een ander land bedoeld is.
Asks who decides on deploying the stock and on what grounds, how often it has been used, trading and speculation in the stock, and environmental effects of underground storage.
Who ultimately decides on deploying the stock and on what grounds?
Wie bepaalt uiteindelijk de inzet van de voorraad en op welke gronden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing Directive 2009/119/EC on minimum oil stocks should proceed after adjustments on financial aspects (costs for affected market participants) and the ticket system (supervision of foreign tickets, justification for removing ministerial approval for domestic tickets). The minister's reply accepted these points, added clarifications and redactional changes, and sent the revised bill to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for information on the extra costs for market participants lacking sufficient stocks under the new obligations, which the reply addressed in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the criteria for granting ministerial consent to cross-border tickets, given the duty to keep stocks permanently accessible, which the reply addressed in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for justification of the removal of ministerial consent for domestic tickets; the reply explained that such tickets are already notified and that notification is now made explicit.
Numerous redactional remarks on definitions, cross-references, wording of economic offences and transitional provisions were largely adopted, with a few exceptions reasoned in the reply.

33438.s: The bill replaces the licence requirement for certain special medical procedures under the Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen with a temporary duty to notify the Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid within three months of starting. It also sets administrative fines for breaches of the licensing and notification rules and extends economic-offence liability to the new notification duty.
33438.j: The memorandum justifies the notification duty as a temporary safeguard for careful ending of the licence requirement, allowing risk-based supervision by the inspectorate.
q: With this bill, as a transitional measure towards full integration into the regular healthcare system, a temporary start notification duty is proposed.
Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt, bij wijze van overgangsmaatregel naar een volledige inbedding in het reguliere zorgstelsel, een startmeldingsplicht voor beperkte duur voorgesteld.
d: manner and data for the start notification
p: Gives the Minister power to impose administrative fines of up to EUR 33,500 or EUR 13,400 for breaches of the licensing and notification rules.

parties: Worries that removing prior quality review and authorisation risks fragmentation and overcapacity, and asks how the IGZ will supervise risk-based after notification and requests a per-procedure evaluation after one year.
For these members, the main concerns are the disappearance of quality review in advance, possible fragmentation of supply, and the risk of overcapacity and overtreatment.
Voor deze leden zijn punten van zorg vooral het verdwijnen van de toetsing op kwaliteit vooraf, mogelijke versplintering van het aanbod en het risico van overcapaciteit en overbehandeling.

Asks for justification of the two-year limit and what safeguards exist against fragmentation, cost increases and quality decline after the notification duty lapses, and whether risk-based IGZ supervision suffices.
What guarantees are there that after the start-notification duty ends, no fragmented supply, cost increase or quality decline occurs?
Welke waarborgen zijn er dat na het beëindigen van de startmeldingsplicht geen versnipperd aanbod, kostenstijging of kwaliteitsvermindering optreedt?

Opposes replacing careful prior authorisation with abstract ex-post risk supervision for a vulnerable patient group, questions the speed of deregulation, and cites the NVRO's view that prior review is necessary.
The SP considers it undesirable, given care, quality and the vulnerability of cancer patients, that careful prior assessment of a permit is replaced by abstract ex-post risk supervision.

De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het met oog op zorgvuldigheid, kwaliteit en de kwetsbaarheid van de doelgroep van kankerpatiënten ongewenst dat de zorgvuldige beoordeling van een vergunning vooraf wordt vervangen door abstract risicotoezicht achteraf.
Asks whether the two-year duration should be longer and how the notification duty applies to facilities doing only nursing or care acts, plus questions on the basis for administrative fines.
The CDA members ask whether the period should not be longer.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de termijn niet langer van duur zou moeten zijn.

Accepts the goal of deregulation but flags risk of substantial volume growth amid cost pressures, asks how IGZ risk-based supervision will work, and asks whether the government will evaluate the notification duty after two years.
However, abolishing the permit requirement creates a risk of a substantial increase in volume.
Door het afschaffen van de vergunningplicht ontstaat echter het risico op een aanzienlijke volumetoename.

33465.s: The bill amends the Water Act to lengthen the validity of the Hydraulic Boundary Conditions and safety assessment cycle to up to twelve years, transfer general supervision of primary flood defences from the provinces to the national minister, and restructure subsidy and co-financing rules for flood protection measures between the state and water boards. It also requires the water boards to be consulted on various regulations and orders an evaluation report by 2019.
33465.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and shifts by efficiency and budgetary needs, and by the principle that only one tier should be responsible for supervision.
q: For that reason it is proposed to transfer supervision of the primary flood defences, currently held by provincial executives, from the provinces to the national government.
Om die reden wordt voorgesteld om het toezicht op de primaire keringen, dat thans bij gedeputeerde staten rust 56 , over te dragen van de provincies naar het Rijk.
d: Hydraulic Boundary Conditions for primary flood defences
safety assessment cycle and reporting for dike rings
subsidy regulation: cost estimates and eligible costs
designation of measures eligible for 100% subsidy
p: General supervision of primary flood defences moves from provincial executives (gedeputeerde staten) to the national minister, concentrating oversight in one executive tier.

The minister may set and enforce payment obligations annually before the budget is final, and may offset amounts and collect by dwangbevel.Parliament's budget role is slightly bypassed by pre-budget determinations.'

parties: Asks about cost increases for certain water boards and the estimated administrative burden per authority.
These members ask whether there is a risk that some water boards facing large tasks will face unreasonable cost increases.
Deze leden vragen wel of er een risico bestaat dat sommige waterschappen, waar een grote opgave speelt, met een onredelijke lastenstijging worden geconfronteerd.
Asks how innovation and cost control will be balanced and how the new Omgevingswet will incorporate instruments.
The PvdA members ask how the project procedure instrument of the current Waterwet will be fitted into the new Omgevingswet.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe het instrument van de projectprocedure uit de huidige Waterwet in de nieuwe Omgevingswet ingepast zal worden.
Asks about administrative burden on citizens and transparency over which authority is responsible.
The PVV members further ask to what extent this amendment adds value for citizen transparency.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen verder in hoeverre deze wetswijziging van toegevoegde waarde is voor de transparantie voor de burger.

Criticises limited information to parliament on project-level finances and delays in audit reports, and wants key requirements placed in the law rather than ministerial regulation to allow parliamentary scrutiny.
In the view of the SP members this is certainly not done in all cases. Regulating matters by ministerial regulation or general administrative order escapes too much prior review by the House.

Naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie wordt hier zeker niet in alle gevallen gehoor aan gegeven. Het regelen van zaken per ministeriële regeling of algemene maatregel van bestuur onttrekt zich te veel aan toetsing vooraf door de Kamer.

Asks about consequences of the 10% project contribution for water boards and whether the state's 50% share is guaranteed amid budget cuts; notes water boards are only heard on prioritisation despite funding half.
Can the government explain why they are only heard while they provide 50% of the contribution?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom zij slechts gehoord worden terwijl zij 50% van de bijdrage leveren?
Doubts that water boards have no control over the solidarity funds they contribute and asks for a clearer definition of their influence over spending and prioritisation.
The D66 members have considerable doubts that the water boards in principle have no say over the money they contribute to the solidarity component.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben wel de nodige twijfels bij het feit dat de waterschappen in beginsel geen zeggenschap hebben over het geld dat zij bijdragen aan het solidariteitsdeel.
Supports the agreement and robust financing but questions the 10% project contribution's effectiveness as an efficiency incentive and its burden on sparsely populated water boards.
The said members doubt whether the government has done justice to the motion Wiegman et al. with this choice.
Genoemde leden betwijfelen of de regering met deze keuze recht heeft gedaan aan de genoemde motie Wiegman c.s.
Supports implementing the Bestuursakkoord Water and has no further questions.
They support the implementation of what was agreed in the Bestuursakkoord Water and currently have no further questions.
Zij steunen de uitvoering van hetgeen in het Bestuursakkoord Water is afgesproken en hebben op dit moment geen nadere vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Waterwet amendment (flood protection efficiency and financing) raises major objections to structurally financing the Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma from water board levies, and asks for clarification on supervision, debt collection and the testing frequency. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the points on supervision, collection and testing frequency with clarifications, but defends the structural financing and the solidarity-based levy system, citing the disadvantages of the alternatives.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that structurally using water board levy revenue for national interests conflicts with the belief-payment-control principle and undermines board control over its funds; the government keeps the structural arrangement and only offers consultation on programme and subsidy scheme.

The Afdeling finds that reducing state expenditure is insufficient justification for a structural contribution from water boards' taxpayers; the government considers the alternatives (flat subsidy cut, differentiated subsidies) less suitable and keeps the solidarity system.
The Afdeling asks to explain in the explanatory memorandum the scope of and relationship between state and provincial supervisory powers over primary flood defences; the government clarified this.

The Afdeling doubts that the statutory power to collect contributions by dwangbevel is needed and may conflict with Article 436 Rv; the government retains the power as a last resort and clarifies its exceptional use.
The Afdeling asks the memorandum to explain how the reduced testing frequency relates to maintenance and subsidy applications; the government added this explanation.

33474.s: The bill amends the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs so that schools must also report grades or final marks for designated examination components to the national basic register (BRON), for students in vocational education. It also amends the Wet op het onderwijstoezicht so these grades can be recorded in the diploma register alongside diplomas.
33474.j: The memorandum justifies the reporting obligation by the need for information on exam results to evaluate policy on basic skills in vocational education.
q: To evaluate the policy pursued on the components Dutch language, arithmetic and English in mbo programmes, information on the exam results obtained by students is needed.
Bij het evalueren van het gevoerde beleid voor de onderdelen Nederlandse taal, rekenen en Engels in mbo-opleidingen is informatie nodig over de behaalde examenresultaten van de studenten.
d: Artikel I (art. 2.5.5a, lid 2, onderdeel h WEB)
designation of examination components whose grades must be reported

parties: Asks whether exam results are evaluated every year to allow the department's policy to be assessed and adjusted, and asks about the costs of software adjustments for the institutions and the state budget.
They ask the government whether an evaluation based on exam results takes place every year.
Zij vragen aan de regering of er ieder jaar een evaluatie op basis van examenresultaten plaatsvindt.

Asks whether the registered results will be used for supervisory purposes despite being intended mainly for policy evaluation, and whether benchmarking could create perverse incentives in admissions policy.
These members ask whether this means the results will not be used for supervisory purposes.
Deze leden vragen of dit betekent dat de resultaten niet zullen worden gebruikt voor toezichtsdoeleinden.

33480-V.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the budget statement of the CBI agency by enacting supplementary budget statements tied to the Najaarsnota, with effect from 1 December 2012. It is a routine budgetary adjustment that sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect if published late.
q: In accordance with the State Budget Regulations and the Accounting Act of 2001, notable differences between the original and current estimates must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de oorspronkelijke en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

33519.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to implement several policy goals of the 2011–2015 Strategic Agenda, including a new associate degree (Ad) framework, changes to degree titles, admission and selection rules, study choice advice, three-year bachelor tracks for vwo students, and higher tuition for excellent programmes. It shifts several admission and selection decisions to ministerial regulation and gives the minister new powers to designate master programmes and grant exemptions from prior approval.
33519.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for flexibility and for ensuring that the rules can be adjusted by ministerial regulation, while noting the minister's aim to keep access open and relevant consultation with institutions.
q: The starting point remains that bachelor graduates can always follow a master programme.
Het uitgangspunt blijft dat er voor bachelorafgestudeerden altijd een mogelijkheid is om een masteropleiding te volgen.
d: programmes subject to additional admission requirements and procedural rules
programmes subject to national prior education requirements and vocational transition rules
procedural rules and additional selection rules for capacity-limited admission
conditions and further rules for higher tuition for excellent programmes
further requirements for application for ministerial consent to new programmes
changing programme names with accreditation body consent
numerus fixus for oversupplied labour market fields
p: Institutions may set enrolment caps and select applicants on qualitative criteria, with rules to be set in ministerial regulation.

Minister may oblige universities to designate master programmes for bachelor graduates, while institutions may add qualitative admission requirements; the statutory guarantee of a master place is removed.
Minister may grant institutions consent to charge higher tuition for excellent programmes, with conditions attached that may be extended beyond those listed.
Minister may limit or attach other conditions to consent for new programmes and may grant exemptions from prior approval without a time limit.

parties: Asks whether the government fully honours the agreements with universities and HBO-raad and why the doctoral cycle is left to an experimental AMvB rather than being embedded in the bill.
Is the government of the opinion that with this bill it fully honours all the agreements made?
Is de regering van mening dat zij met dit wetsvoorstel alle gemaakte afspraken volledig nakomt?
Welcomes the bill as a step toward the right student in the right place, but asks for detail on exceptions, the mbo admission rules and expected effects.
The bill aims to get the right student in the right place and to achieve more differentiation in the educational offer.
Het wetvoorstel beoogt om de juiste student op de juiste plaats te krijgen, en meer differentiatie in het onderwijsaanbod te bewerkstelligen.
Broadly agrees with the Strategic Agenda premises but asks about the concrete elaboration of parts of the bill.
The members do have questions about the elaboration of parts of the final bill.
De leden hebben wel vragen bij de uitwerking van onderdelen in het definitieve wetsvoorstel.

Worries that tuition-related selection, the removal of the basic grant and the public transport card cut access, and that vague, institution-set admission criteria lack transparency and invite arbitrariness.
How is it prevented that the requirements acquire the appearance of arbitrariness when each institution and/or programme composes its own set of requirements?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de eisen de schijn van willekeur krijgen, wanneer elke instelling en/of opleiding zijn eigen eisenpakket samenstelt?
Supports differentiation and stricter quality, but asks how it fits with the social loan system and transport cuts, fearing excellent programmes become inaccessible and the system opaque.

Is the government not afraid that, after introduction of the social loan system, these qualitatively excellent programmes will be accessible to far fewer students because they will not study out of fear of debt?

Is de regering niet bang dat, na invoering van het sociale leenstelsel, deze kwalitatief uitmuntende opleidingen voor veel minder studenten toegankelijk zijn omdat zij uit leenangst niet gaan studeren?
Asks which concrete measures deliver each of the bill's stated aims and what accountability the autonomy of institutions implies.

Furthermore the members want to know what the government exactly means by the sentence on page 4 of the explanatory memorandum: 'This autonomy, however, also entails taking responsibility and being accountable for it.'

Voorts willen de leden weten wat de regering exact bedoelt met de zin op pagina 4 van de memorie van toelichting: «Bij deze autonomie hoort echter ook het nemen van verantwoordelijkheid en daarop aanspreekbaar zijn.»
Asks whether institutional autonomy is weakened by powers shifting to the NVAO and the minister, and whether the timetable is realistic.
To what extent is the autonomy of institutions weakened by this bill?
In hoeverre wordt de autonomie van instellingen afgezwakt door dit wetsvoorstel?
Supports diversity in quality but criticises uniform quality testing and asks for a more fundamental vision on the bachelor-master structure and the guaranteed master access.
Does the guarantee of admission to a master not conflict with the principles of the bachelor-master system?
Strijdt de garantie van toelating tot een master niet met de uitgangspunten van het bachelor-mastersysteem?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the draft bill amending the WHW (higher education act) on selection, differentiation, the promotiestudent and titulature, asking for reconsideration of the promotiestudent and a clearer overall analysis. The minister's nader rapport accepts many points: it drops selection-at-the-gate, adapts the Associate degree and titulature, withdraws the promotion-education provisions in favour of an experiment, and adds consultation and clarifications on ministerplaatsen.
concerns: Advice that the degree of differentiation in the higher education system should be better motivated and limited to keep the system transparent for students and employers; the government accepted the need for clearer explanation and drop of selection-at-the-gate but defended differentiation.
Unclear rights for applicants registering after 1 May; the government amended articles 7.31b and 7.31c and added explanation in the memorie van toelichting.

Risk that the abolition of the doorstroommaster leads to shortages of master places for average students; the government added a ministerial power to limit master programmes with additional selection criteria in article 7.30b.
Advice to require at least one selection criterion based on objective data such as exam grades; the government declined, arguing relevance and objectivity of selection suffice.

Serious risk that introducing the promotiestudent at scale would displace werknemers-promovendi and harm research quality; the government withdrew the statutory promotion-education provisions and will allow a limited experiment by AMvB.

Concern that abolishing the distinction in titulature blurs the binary hbo/wo system; the government argued the binary system is retained and that the NVAO will check the added Arts/Science designation, without fully addressing the concern.
Request to address the European dimension, Bologna process and article 165 TFEU; the government explained the contribution to mobility and recognition and added a passage to the introduction.

Concerns about the abolition of ministerplaatsen for Caribbean students and the lack of consultation; the government added a provision on taking account of applicants from the Caribbean part of the Kingdom and planned consultation with the islands and countries.
Redactional comments on wording of several articles, adopted in the nader rapport, with one imperative formulation qualified.

33537.s: The bill creates a central register of exemptions from compulsory education and of substitute compulsory education for young people, managed by the Minister via DUO, and requires municipalities to report such exemptions. It amends the Leerplichtwet 1969 and the Wet op het onderwijstoezicht to set data requirements, retention, access and an evaluation clause within five years.
33537.j: The memorandum justifies the register by the need to correctly identify early school leavers and to enforce the Leerplichtwet, and cites privacy safeguards and an evaluation clause following a parliamentary motion.
q: The bill includes an evaluation clause in article 34 of the WOT, so that within five years an evaluation must take place of the effectiveness and effects of the register of exemptions and substitute compulsory education.

Het wetsvoorstel omvat een evaluatiebepaling in artikel 34 van de WOT waardoor er binnen vijf jaar een evaluatie moet plaatsvinden over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van het register vrijstellingen en vervangende leerplicht.
