d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 3c Leerplichtwet 1969) / Artikel II, onderdeel C (artikel 24k3 lid 1 WOT)
further rules on the register and data access
Artikel II, onderdeel C (artikel 24k5 lid 7 WOT)
rules implementing the provision of data from the register
p: Artikel II, onderdeel C (artikel 24k5 lid 2 en 4 WOT)
The Minister receives personal identifiers of exempted young people and may use them to check school enrolment, widening executive access to individual education data.
The Minister must report to the States-General within five years on the register's objectives, a review mechanism for the new data system.

parties: Asks how exemption data will be coded, what the concrete improvements are, and what the purpose is for retaining data until one year after the child turns 18.
Can the government explain whether a target is linked to reducing truancy, these members ask.
Kan de regering toelichten of er een doelstelling is gekoppeld aan het verminderen van het verzuim, zo vragen deze leden.
Questions the government's decision to follow the CBP privacy advice fully instead of rebutting it, and warns that lenient granting of exemptions could harm young people's prospects.
Why did the government not set aside the advice with reasoned arguments?
Waarom heeft de regering het advies niet beargumenteerd naast zich neergelegd?
Welcomes the registration aim but asks whether anonymised data on exemption reasons can be recorded and whether the affected youth will receive proper support.
Is it possible, for these reasons, to register anonymously so this information becomes available to the ministry and the House, these members ask.
Is het mogelijk, om deze redenen, om geanonimiseerd te registeren, zodat deze informatie beschikbaar komt voor het ministerie en de Kamer, zo vragen genoemde leden.

33555.s: The bill amends many Dutch statutes to replace references to the former municipal basic administration of persons with the new Wet basisregistratie personen (basisregistratie personen), and to remove social-fiscal number (sociaal-fiscaalnummer) references in favour of the citizen service number. It also makes technical adjustments tied to the introduction of the new population registry across justice, interior, education, finance, defence, transport, social affairs and health laws.
33555.j: The memorandum explains that the changes are technical alignments of existing statutes to the new registry law and that the social-fiscal number is no longer needed as a separate identifier.

parties: Asks what happens to persons whose identity cannot be reliably established and how the registry for voters with special residence status is regulated and how privacy is protected.
The VVD members wonder what happens to persons whose identity cannot be reliably established.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af wat er gebeurt met personen waarvan de identiteit niet deugdelijk kan worden vastgesteld.
Asks about the conditions under which the minister may assign citizen service numbers and the consequences of abolishing the sofinummer for citizens who cannot be reliably identified.
What are the consequences of abolishing the sofinummer for this group (who cannot or do not want to identify themselves reliably) and for the government?
Welke gevolgen heeft het schrappen van het sofinummer voor deze groep (die zich niet deugdelijk wil of kan identificeren) en voor de overheid?
Asks how the government will ensure that persons with an unverified sofinummer are informed of its abolition and of the steps needed to obtain a citizen service number.
Asks whether the registration of stillborn children's names is possible under current rules and whether the model burial permit form can be adjusted.
Is it possible to adjust this form so that the name of the stillborn son or daughter is stated first and then the mother's details?
Is het mogelijk dit formulier zodanig aan te passen dat eerst de (naam van de) levenloos ter wereld gekomen zoon of dochter wordt genoemd en daarna de gegevens van de moeder?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the Aanpassingswet basisregistratie personen but asks for justification of several non-technical changes and for more explanation on removing the sociaal-fiscaalnummer. The minister's nader rapport responds by retaining the deurwaarder provision, adding explanatory text on the reintegration bureau powers and the sofinummer, and adopting the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the removal of the doelbindingsbepaling for bailiffs' use of the burgerservicenummer be justified; the government retained the sixth paragraph of article 475g Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the added authority for reintegration bureaus to use the burgerservicenummer; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a reference to article 68(2) Wet werk en bijstand.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of consequences for groups that may be unable to obtain a burgerservicenummer after removal of the sofinummer; a passage was added to the memorandum.
The Afdeling made numerous redactional comments in an annex, which the government adopted.

33573.s: The bill creates a temporary legal basis for experiments before the 2014 and 2015 elections, letting the Minister of Interior allow a new ballot-paper model for voters abroad (sent earlier or electronically, with party logos) and a centralised vote count in participating municipalities. The experiments may depart from specified articles of the Kieswet by general administrative order, with four weeks' parliamentary pre-submission, and the law expires on 1 January 2018.
33573.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by arguing that testing with a new ballot model cannot proceed without departing from Kieswet provisions, and that specificity and parliamentary pre-submission ensure controlled delegation.
q: The bill limits the subject matter of experiments, permits only controlled delegation, and is temporary in nature.
Het wetsvoorstel clausuleert de materie waarmee kan worden geëxperimenteerd, staat enkel gecontroleerde delegatie toe en is tijdelijk van aard.
d: designate experiments, participating municipalities and voting facilities
detailed rules on experiments, departing from specified Kieswet articles
deviations from Kiesbesluit and model regulations
p: The Minister may unilaterally order experiments and choose voting facilities, with municipal consent as the only check on local participation.
Power to depart from specified Kieswet provisions is delegated to an AMvB, bounded by enumerated articles and a four-week voorhang requirement.

parties: Asks how the secrecy of the vote is guaranteed and whether treating a list-only vote as a vote for the list leader departs from the Dutch person-based electoral system.
The VVD members ask the government to explain why this choice would not infringe the Dutch electoral system, which is based on voting for persons.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering nader uit een te zetten, waarom deze keuze geen inbreuk zou betekenen op het Nederlandse kiesstelsel, dat immers uitgaat van stemmen op personen.
Asks for information on the preparation and timing of the electoral-technology study and whether central counting could delay the preliminary result.
These members attach importance, alongside careful and uniform vote counting, to a rapid preliminary result on election night.</br>
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hechten naast een zorgvuldige en uniforme stemopneming ook aan een snelle voorlopig uitslag op de verkiezingsavond.
Asks why no statutory conditions for transporting ballots are included and how it can be verified that the person receiving a postal ballot is the one who votes.
The PVV members ask why it was chosen not to include measures in the law on the conditions for transporting ballots between the polling station and the central counting location.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom ervoor is gekozen geen maatregelen in de wet op te nemen betreffende de voorwaarden van het vervoer van stembiljetten tussen stemlokaal en de (centrale) plaats waar de stembiljetten geteld worden.
Fears greater fraud risk and loss of public oversight when ballots are transported to a central location, and questions the vague notions of 'adequate safeguards' and 'further measures'.
In the experiment this is no longer possible: at the polling stations and at the central counting location, but not during transport.
In het experiment is dit niet meer mogelijk: wel op de stembureaus, en wel op de centrale plaats waar geteld wordt, maar niet gedurende het vervoer.

Supports central counting for efficiency but stresses that transparency and controllability for voters, parties and media must be preserved; asks for evaluation criteria to be sent to parliament in advance.
These members attach importance to the process becoming more transparent and easier for voters, political parties and the media to check.
Deze leden hechten er belang aan, dat het proces transparanter wordt en beter te controleren voor kiezers, politieke partijen en de media.

Questions why electronic counting is being abandoned, argues that counting rules should rest on technology-independent principles, and worries that central counting and ballot transport reduce citizens' ability to control the process.
They ask whether voters' possibilities to control the process do not in fact become smaller, because the scale on which counting takes place increases.
Zij vragen zich af of de controlemogelijkheden van kiezers op het proces niet juist kleiner worden, omdat de schaal waarop geteld wordt toeneemt.
Asks whether the list-vote arrangement for voters abroad does full justice to the Dutch list system and whether votes allocated to the list leader could disadvantage other candidates.
A vote cast only for a list and not for a candidate is under the proposal automatically assigned to the list leader.
Een stem die enkel is uitgebracht op een lijst en vervolgens niet op een kandidaat wordt in het voorstel automatisch toegekend aan de lijsttrekker.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the temporary experiment law on new ballot papers and central vote counting but raises objections on balancing election safeguards, accessibility for blind, visually impaired and low-literacy voters, holding experiments in municipal elections, evaluation criteria, logo registration, invalid votes, re-runs and fraud risks in central counting, and advises revision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adds explanatory text, and removes the in-person ballot and electronic counting experiments.
concerns: Advised explaining how the balance between election safeguards is struck and the negative side effects of the experiments; government added a paragraph to the explanatory memorandum.

Advised more reasoning on accessibility for blind, visually impaired and low-literacy voters and the effect of logos and photos; government removed the in-person ballot experiment, leaving the point largely moot.

Advised against holding experiments in municipal council elections because a whole-municipality experiment could affect the outcome of binding elections; government dropped this in-person ballot experiment.
Advised deleting the evaluation's aim of determining whether an election was lawful, since the elected body alone decides on validity; government clarified the explanatory memorandum.
Advised specifying measurable success criteria and comparison method for evaluating the experiments before they start; government added these to the explanatory memorandum.
Advised aligning the evaluation frequency in the bill with the explanatory memorandum; government clarified the distinction.
Advised clarifying logo registration rules and their relation to trademark case law and the short appeal period; government added explanation and a 42-day filing deadline.
Advised reconsidering counting a vote cast only for a list as a valid vote for the list leader, as it departs from the candidate-based system; government disagreed.
Advised regulating whether re-runs follow experiment rules and providing a statutory basis if an experiment causes a re-run; government clarified that normal rules apply.

Advised addressing fraud risks during transport of ballots in central counting and measures to reduce them; government added preliminary list-level counting at the polling station and sealed packages.
Advised adding rules for software checking by manual sampling and explaining the central counting re-count authority; government dropped electronic counting and clarified the re-count powers.
Advised addressing the timing risk of starting central counting the day after elections given short statutory deadlines; government argued the timeline remains achievable based on prior re-counts.
Gave several redactional comments on article numbering, wording and structure; most were incorporated, while one was not adopted because it departed from prescribed drafting model.

33582.s: The bill amends article 151c of the Gemeentewet to remove the requirement that municipal camera surveillance in public space be fixed, allowing the mayor to deploy cameras flexibly within a designated area for a period the mayor sets. It also obliges the mayor to withdraw the area designation once camera use is no longer necessary for public order, and requires an evaluation within five years of entry into force.
33582.j: The memorandum justifies the wider powers by citing municipal need for flexible camera use against shifting nuisance and by the evaluation finding that fixed cameras are insufficient, while noting privacy safeguards such as the withdrawal duty and the EVRM Article 8 proportionality test.
q: The bill removes the requirement of fixed camera surveillance from article 151c of the Gemeentewet.
Het wetsvoorstel schrapt het vereiste van vast cameratoezicht uit artikel 151c van de Gemeentewet.
d: Artikel I, A, lid 2 (nieuw art. 151c lid 2)
mayor designates area and duration of camera deployment
general administrative measure on technical aspects of camera surveillance
p: The mayor may deploy mobile cameras in a designated area without a specific placement decision under the Awb, removing the procedural step of individual placement decisions and no statutory maximum duration is set.
Artikel I, A, lid 3-4 (art. 151c lid 2 en 5)
The mayor determines the duration of the area designation, and the bill imposes a mandatory withdrawal once cameras are no longer necessary for public order.
The Minister must report to the States General on effectiveness and effects within five years of entry into force.

parties: Welcomes flexible camera use against public order disturbances but asks about fixed cameras, private cameras and the scope of mobile deployment.
These members see in this an additional means to counter disturbances of public order.
Deze leden zien hierin een extra middel om verstoringen van de openbare orde tegen te gaan.
Asks whether the conclusions on effectiveness are overstated and how proportionality and citizen notice are assessed.
Of course deploying cameras must always remain a weighing between protecting the personal interests of citizens and the general interest of safety and public order.
Uiteraard moet het inzetten van camera’s altijd een afweging blijven tussen aan de ene kant de bescherming van de persoonlijke belangen van de burger en aan de andere kant het algemeen belang.
Supports giving the mayor power to deploy flexible camera surveillance so that displaced nuisance can be followed, asking mainly about adjacent municipalities.
For these members it is therefore important that mobile camera surveillance can be moved quickly and easily.
Voor deze leden is het dan ook van belang dat mobiel cameratoezicht snel en gemakkelijk kan worden verplaatst.
Notes an inconsistency between strict necessity criteria and the broad public order rationale, doubts that drones or aerial cameras pass privacy and ECHR tests, and opposes preventive claims.
These members have serious reservations about this. The intrusion on privacy with these means, certainly with flying cameras, is much greater than with static cameras.
Deze leden hebben hier ernstige bedenkingen bij. De inbreuk op de privacy is met deze middelen, zeker waar het gaat om vliegende camera’s, veel groter dan statische camera’s.
Welcomes flexibility but asks for clarity on the differing proportionality and subsidiarity tests and on whether withdrawal and evaluation of designations actually happen.
These members ask whether and how it is checked that such an evaluation and the finding that the justification has lapsed are actually carried out.
Deze leden vragen of en hoe wordt nagegaan of zo’n evaluatie en het vaststellen van het wegvallen van de rechtvaardigingsgrond ook daadwerkelijk wordt verricht.
Asks for evidence of effectiveness, safeguards against misuse, privacy risks of aerial cameras, and supervision of camera footage by outsourced staff.
They acknowledge that the effectiveness of camera surveillance stands or falls with its application.
Zij erkennen dat de effectiviteit van cameratoezicht staat of valt met de toepassing ervan.
Worries that the general area designation weakens citizens' appeal rights and notice, and asks whether mobile and aerial cameras and periodic evaluation need stronger statutory safeguards.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill broadening the mayor's power to deploy flexible/mobile camera surveillance for public order, asking for clarity on which camera types fall within its scope and noting one minor drafting remark. The government's nader rapport states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on scope and the drafting remark was followed.
concerns: The Afdeling advised deleting the proposed new third paragraph because the content was already regulated in Stb. 2012, 316, and the government adopted this redactional remark.

The Afdeling found the scope of the proposed flexible camera surveillance unclear for municipalities and citizens and asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify which mobile camera types are covered, which the government addressed by supplementing the memorandum.

33591.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, the 2012 trade agreement between the EU and its member states on one side and Colombia and Peru on the other. The explanatory memorandum notes the agreement is mixed, with some areas under national competence, and describes its institutional and monitoring arrangements.
33591.j: The memorandum justifies the approval by stating the agreement is balanced and reflects Dutch negotiating aims, with mechanisms for supervision and dispute handling.
q: A balanced free trade agreement has been concluded that does justice to the Dutch objectives.
Er is een evenwichtig Vrijhandelsakkoord gesloten dat recht doet aan de Nederlandse inzet.

parties: Asks about the volume of trade liberalised, development cooperation commitments, the banana trade dispute and which member states supported or opposed the Dutch positions.
The VVD members still have some questions about the proposed treaty.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben nog wel enkele vragen over het voorliggen verdrag.
Supports the agreement's economic opportunities and human rights leverage but asks how trade unions and civil society will be involved in monitoring and what other sanctions exist beyond suspension.

The PvdA members consider the establishment of monitoring mechanisms in the trade agreement of great importance, but ask how it can be guaranteed that trade unions and civil society organisations are involved in this monitoring?

De leden van de PvdA fractie vinden de totstandkoming van monitoringsmechanismen in het vrijhandelsverdrag van groot belang, maar vragen hoe kan worden gewaarborgd dat de vakbonden en organisaties uit het maatschappelijk middenveld worden betrokken bij deze monitoring?
Has serious concerns about the human rights clause lacking clear compliance criteria, binding monitoring and automatic sanctions, and about the effects of a parliamentary rejection on implementation.
However, a compliance mechanism with clear criteria for human rights is lacking.
Echter, een nalevingmechanisme met heldere criteria voor mensenrechten ontbreekt.
Welcomes linking trade to fundamental rights but asks for the precise content of the human rights commitments, the sanctions for breach, and concrete biodiversity and sustainability mechanisms.
Nevertheless, they have concerns and questions about the precise elaboration and safeguards.
Desalniettemin hebben zij zorgen en vragen over de precieze uitwerking en waarborgen.

33618.s: The bill transfers power to set core objectives (kerndoelen) for Frisian language teaching in primary, secondary and special education from the national government (by general administrative order) to the provincial states of Fryslân, subject to approval by the Minister of Education. It also lets Gedeputeerde staten grant exemptions from the obligation to teach Frisian, with criteria set in a policy rule.
33618.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the principle that Fryslân, as a province with Frisian as official language, should have control over language policy, with constitutional limits (Article 23 Grondwet) addressed by procedural and substantive conditions and ministerial approval.
q: it is desirable that the core objectives for Frisian language education in primary, secondary and special education be set by the provincial states of Fryslân
wenselijk is dat de kerndoelen voor het onderwijs in de Friese taal in het primair onderwijs, het voortgezet onderwijs en het speciaal onderwijs worden vastgesteld door provinciale staten van Fryslân
d: Artikel I (WPO art. 9, vierde en zesde lid)
core objectives for Frisian language in primary education
exemption criteria for teaching Frisian via policy rule of Gedeputeerde staten
core objectives for Frisian language and culture in secondary education
exemption criteria for teaching Frisian via policy rule of Gedeputeerde staten
core objectives for Frisian language in special education
Artikel V (WEC art. 14c, vijfde lid; 14f, vierde lid)
core objectives for Frisian in special secondary education profiles
p: Provincial states and Gedeputeerde staten gain discretion over the Frisian curriculum and exemptions, subject to ministerial approval and consultation with schools.
The Minister retains an approval power over provincial core objectives, with parliament informed of the intention to approve or refuse, and the Onderwijsraad advising.

parties: Asks how the minister will keep oversight of Frisian education quality after delegation, and what the status is of the Onderwijsraad advice if the minister disagrees.
They ask how the minister will still keep a finger on the pulse regarding the quality of Frisian education.
Zij vragen op welke manier de minister nu nog een vinger aan de pols houdt als het gaat om de kwaliteit van het Friese onderwijs.
Supports delegating the power to set Frisian core objectives to the province because provincial level better judges the knowledge needed.
In the eyes of the PvdA members it is fine that the power to set Frisian core objectives is delegated to the province of Fryslân.
Het is in de ogen van de leden van de PvdA-fractie prima dat de bevoegdheid om kerndoelen Fries vast te stellen wordt gedelegeerd aan de provincie Fryslân.

Asks whether decentralisation could endanger the integration of language curricula and whether the province could make Frisian compulsory, questioning the province's capacity versus ministry civil servants.
These members ask why the Frisian provincial states would be better at this than civil servants at the ministry of education.
Deze leden vragen waarom de Friese staten daarin beter zouden zijn dan de ambtenaren op het ministerie van onderwijs.

Supports the goal but asks how the ministerial approval procedure works if core objectives are not approved and how sufficient support for provincial objectives is judged; notes the role of parliament was adjusted after Raad van State criticism.
However, these members ask how it is judged that there is sufficient support for the provincial core objectives.
Wel vragen deze leden hoe wordt geoordeeld dat er voldoende draagvlak is voor de provinciale kerndoelen.
Stresses that under Article 23 of the Constitution parliamentary involvement must have a place in the procedure, and questions the exemption for areas with less Frisian.
Moreover, it is important that in light of Article 23 of the Constitution the bill provides that parliamentary involvement has a place in the procedure.
Het is bovendien belangrijk dat in het licht van artikel 23 van de Grondwet in het wetsvoorstel is geregeld dat parlementaire betrokkenheid een plaats houdt in de procedure.

Argues the proposed vertical decentralisation is incompatible with the framework for such delegation and the goal could be achieved otherwise; asks why the formal procedure matters and the scope of vertical delegation is too broad.

They point out however that the proposed vertical decentralisation is incompatible with the frameworks that apply to this form of decentralisation, while the intended goal can moreover be achieved in another way.

Zij wijzen er echter op dat de voorgestelde verticale decentralisatie onverenigbaar is met de kaders die ten aanzien van deze vorm van decentralisatie gelden, terwijl het beoogde doel bovendien op een andere wijze kan worden bereikt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 12 October 2012 on a bill delegating the setting of Frisian-language core objectives and exemption criteria to the province of Fryslân found the justification for the delegation and the weakening of parliamentary involvement insufficient, and advised reconsidering it with an enhanced advisory role for the province. The government's reply of 22 April 2013 revised the bill by introducing a ministerial approval power, parliamentary information and a Onderwijsraad step, and by dropping the minister's consent power over exemption criteria, while making the criteria a beleidsregel.
concerns: The Afdeling found that delegating the core objectives for Frisian to the province removes parliamentary involvement, which was insufficiently justified, and proposed an enhanced advisory procedure instead.
The Afdeling found the link between the decentralisation and the stated goals of language use and teaching quality insufficiently explained in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling questioned the justification for the minister's prior consent power over the provincial exemption criteria, given the Onderwijsinspectie recommendations and the existing provincial competence since 1980.
The Afdeling noted the unclear legal character of the exemption criteria and advised making it explicit in the text.
The Afdeling made redactional comments on the bill's wording, numbering and cross-references, which were adopted.

33640-X.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Defensie), adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2013 and orders its publication in the Staatsblad.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2013
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2013

33645.s: The bill aligns Caribbean Netherlands education laws (Leerplichtwet BES, WEB BES, WPO BES, WVO BES) with recent Dutch mainland changes, including truancy measures, school-personnel quality duties, referentieniveaus for language and arithmetic, and a transitional housing regime for 2011-2017. It also amends the Monumentenwet BES and adds a ministerial power to set rules on school mergers.
33645.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the small number of schools on the islands, which makes detailed statutory rules unsuitable, and to the need to align with mainland rules.
q: To avoid undesirable differences between the European Dutch laws and those for the Caribbean Netherlands, an inventory was made of all amendments to European Dutch laws.
Om geen ongewenste verschillen te laten bestaan tussen de Europees Nederlandse wetten en die voor Caribisch Nederland, is een inventarisatie gemaakt
d: reference levels for Dutch language and arithmetic
further rules on the school education report
Artikel IV, G and I (WVO BES arts. 72, 116)
rules on arithmetic test for exams
administrative fine imposed by minister on school head
specification of data exchanged using personal student number
p: Artikel II, G (WEB BES art. 11.1b) and Artikel III, J, Artikel IV, M
The minister jointly responsible with island councils for school housing 2011-2017 may adopt and amend housing plans in agreement with the island authority, with publication in the Staatscourant.
Artikel III, K and I (WPO BES art. 149, 51)

The minister may use student personal numbers from the basic education register to send inspection summaries to parents, and the Inspectorate's school reports are sent to parents directly by the minister when the school fails to do so.

parties: Asks why reference levels apply only to secondary education, whether primary education is ready, and why no central attendance register exists in Caribbean Netherlands.
Can the government indicate why primary education is not yet ready for this?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom het basisonderwijs hier nog niet klaar voor is?
Asks how the evaluation and monitoring of the changes will be carried out, by whom, and what the government can do if the intended results fall short.
Agrees with not introducing reference levels in primary education yet, but asks the government to justify why secondary education is ready.
Can the government further substantiate that secondary education is ready for the introduction of the reference levels and the stricter examination requirements?
Kan de regering nader onderbouwen dat het voortgezet onderwijs klaar is voor invoering van de referentieniveaus en de verscherpte exameneisen, zo vragen zij.

33663.s: The bill transfers responsibility and funding for external maintenance and building adaptations of primary school buildings from municipalities to the competent school boards, amending the Primary Education Act, the Expertise Centres Act and the BES Primary Education Act. It adds temporary transitional rules, including a ministerial regulation granting additional funding per pupil to smaller school boards and transitional provisions for pending objections and appeals.
33663.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation by its administrative, temporary nature and the need to ease the transition for school boards.
q: Our Minister shall establish rules of a temporary nature that facilitate the introduction of the Act
Onze Minister stelt regels van tijdelijke aard vast die de invoering van de Wet ... vergemakkelijken
d: temporary rules and additional funding for school boards during transition
temporary rules and additional funding for expertise centre boards during transition
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 194a WPO); Artikel II, onderdeel E (artikel 178b WEC)

The minister may set temporary funding rules and eligibility thresholds by ministerial regulation without parliamentary approval, shifting budget decisions away from municipalities, subject to a four-year sunset.

parties: Asks who will hold the control power over spending now that municipal council oversight of school maintenance budgets falls away, and whether the Inspectorate or supervisory boards take it.
Previously, however, the municipal council could supervise these expenditures of the Executive Board.
Voorheen kon echter de gemeenteraad deze uitgaven van het College van B&W 3 controleren.
Asks whether the transferred budget will be earmarked, and why earmarking was not chosen.
The PvdA members ask whether the added budget will be earmarked within the lump sum.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen zich af of het toegevoegde budget aan de lumpsum geoormerkt wordt.
Has no questions on the bill.
These members see no reason to ask questions.
Deze leden zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.
Questions the government's reasons for the change, the vagueness of renovation responsibility, and whether the proposed transition arrangement and definition of renovation are adequate.
The SP members are critical of the government's proposal and therefore ask a number of further questions.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn kritisch op het voorstel van de regering en stellen daarom nog een aantal vragen.
Objects that the transfer is imposed rather than left to the school board's choice, and asks why boards cannot opt to keep maintenance funds with the municipality.
These members have great difficulty with the compulsory nature of this bill, in that the transfer does not become a choice of the competent authority but is imposed by the government.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben grote moeite met het verplichtende karakter van dit wetsvoorstel in de zin dat de overheveling niet een keuze wordt van het bevoegd gezag, maar wordt opgelegd door de overheid.
Supports the transfer but argues full decentralisation on request should be allowed per the Beertema motion and asks whether municipalities can condition funds on building condition.
They do not share this reasoning and moreover find that it does not do justice to the adopted Beertema motion.
Zij delen deze argumentatie niet en vinden bovendien dat daarmee geen recht gedaan wordt aan de aangenomen motie-Beertema.
Supports the transfer but asks for a financial safety net and a guarantee fund for school boards facing risks of large long-term maintenance investments without collateral.
Is a guarantee fund provided to cover such risks, these members want to know.
Wordt voorzien in een waarborgfonds om dergelijke risico's af te dekken, zo willen deze leden weten.

Asks whether the transfer adequately serves local tailoring and whether additional safeguards for renovation are needed, and questions the wisdom of expanding school board autonomy over finances given past misconduct.
These members ask whether, given the new allocation of responsibilities, it is not necessary to provide some further safeguards regarding renovation.
Deze leden vragen of het niet noodzakelijk is om gezien de nieuwe verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling, enige nadere waarborgen te bieden met betrekking tot renovatie.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill transferring responsibility for exterior maintenance and adaptations of primary school buildings from municipalities to school boards was insufficiently motivated, especially regarding draw of support among small boards, unequal effects, and the need for a transitional arrangement, and advised revision. The government's reply accepted the need for a transitional scheme, narrowed the delegation provision, added explanations and redactional changes.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum insufficiently motivates the positive expectations and the choice to transfer maintenance, including why support now exists among small boards when it did not in 2005.
A transitional arrangement addressing the largest maintenance backlogs is a necessary condition for responsible introduction, with main elements set in the bill itself.
The delegation provision for the transitional arrangement (article IV) is too vague and should specify that it covers financing of backlog maintenance and a temporary scope.
Effects on schools with low pupil numbers and small boards with poorly maintained buildings were insufficiently analysed; the government added explanation but no nulmeting.
Redactional remarks on placing transitional provisions in the body of the amended laws and wording of article VI were adopted.

33672.s: The bill amends the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, Wet op de loonbelasting 1964, Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling to create a box 3 tax exemption for pension excess schemes and lijfrente-excedentregelingen, with fixed contribution and accrual caps. It sets detailed rules for these schemes and allows the minister to set further rules by ministerial regulation and general administrative order.
33672.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated detail as necessary for enforcement and administration of the complex exemption rules and for aligning with the pension age change.
q: From an enforcement perspective it is required that pension assets built up under the reversal rule cannot be mixed with net pension assets.
Vanuit het oogpunt van handhaving is namelijk vereist dat het pensioenvermogen dat met toepassing van de omkeerregel wordt opgebouwd niet kan worden vermengd met het nettopensioenvermogen.
d: exemption from separate-entity rule for insurers with separated assets
exemption from insurer restriction where separately administered schemes
timing of latest start of pension excess
periods counted as service years and pensionable pay
application of loonbelasting rules, cooperation of pension schemes and implementation
annual yearly rate percentages changed in line with pension age; ministerial rules on reduction
exemption from provider restriction for separated assets
exemption from insurer restriction where separated assets

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the Wet pensioenaanvullingsregelingen in its proposed form, objecting that the pension excess schemes yield little return against high administrative costs, that compulsory participation would unduly restrict spending freedom, and that the Pensioenwet and fiscal rules are not aligned. The government's nader rapport accepts some points (costs, communication, the Pensioenwet link, article V) but maintains the compulsory option and the box 3 placement, so the advice is only partly followed.
concerns: Excess schemes offer little benefit to participants relative to high implementation costs, so their value is doubtful; the government acknowledges higher costs but says the balance differs across schemes.

Compulsory participation in excess schemes would be a disproportionate burden and unduly limit employees' freedom to spend net income; the government keeps the option of compulsory collective schemes.

Ringfencing, separate administration and the Pensioenwet prohibition on ringfencing may conflict with the proposal; the government says the Pensioenwet applies and the delegation will only be used if systemic risks are excluded.
Exclusion of providers from other EU/EEA states may restrict freedom of services; the government replies that Article 19a Wet LB 1964 does admit them.
The transitional/commencement provision should be adjusted to depend on the Witteveenkader bill; the government amended it.

33681.s: The bill extends the term of municipal councils in municipalities facing a boundary reorganisation from 1 January 2015 so that the 2014 council elections are skipped for them, avoiding two elections in a short period. It also sets shortened election deadlines and a fallback election date of 6 October 2014 if the underlying reorganisation bill is not enacted in time.
33681.j: The memorandum justifies shortening the electoral deadlines by pointing to the usual practice in interim council elections caused by municipal reorganisations, and notes that gedeputeerde staten hold the power to shorten the deadlines under the Arhi law.
q: In the case of reorganisation elections, the power to shorten the deadlines under article 55, third paragraph, of the Arhi Act belongs to the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
In het geval van herindelingverkiezingen komt de bevoegdheid tot verkorting van de termijnen ingevolge artikel 55, derde lid, van de wet Arhi toe aan gedeputeerde staten.
d: shortened electoral deadlines for council election in reorganised municipality

parties: Regrets the absence of a general, structural solution in the Wet Arhi and asks the government about its timing and reasons for not amending the Wet Arhi.
The VVD members first note that they regret that there is still no general and structural solution regarding extending the term of municipal councils in the Wet Arhi.

De leden van de VVD-fractie merken allereerst op dat zij het jammer vinden dat er nog geen sprake is van een algemene en structurele oplossing inzake de verlenging van de zittingsduur van gemeenteraden in de Wet Arhi.
Supports the bill's content but asks why a general regulation was not adopted earlier, as the Raad van State suggested, and when one will be submitted.
Moreover, the Raad van State stated in its advice that converting a specific postponement act into a general regulation need not be very complicated.
Bovendien, zo stelde de Raad van State in zijn advies, hoeft het omzetten van een specifieke uitstelwet in een algemene regeling niet heel gecompliceerd te zijn.
Asks why the existing Wet Arhi is not amended instead of producing temporary special laws.
Producing extra (temporary) laws when an amendment to an existing law would suffice seems a strange move in this respect.
Extra (tijdelijke) wetten produceren, terwijl een wijziging van een bestaande wet voldoet, lijkt in dit opzicht een vreemde zet.
Argues the bill deprives voters of a say on the merger, since the current council decides on the merger; proposes holding elections anyway with a consultative referendum.
The voter is deprived of the chance to express themselves.
De kiezer wordt de kans ontnomen zich uit te spreken.
Endorses the Raad van State advice for a general, structural Wet Arhi regulation and asks when such a proposal can be expected.
These members note that the government intends to bring about such a regulation before the municipal council elections of 2018.
Deze leden constateren, dat de regering voornemens is een dergelijke regeling tot stand te brengen vóór de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 2018.
Agrees with the Raad van State that the case against a structural Wet Arhi provision is thin and asks for a timeline for the promised general regulation.
They therefore look forward to the promised proposal for a general, structural regulation in the Wet Arhi being brought into procedure soon.
Zij zien dan ook graag het toegezegde voorstel voor een algemene, structurele regeling in de Wet Arhi spoedig in procedure gebracht worden.
Supports postponing elections but asks why a general Wet Arhi regulation was not proposed, why municipalities are not named in the statute, and whether obsolete similar laws should be repealed.
They wonder whether it would not be advisable to also repeal these laws.
Zij vragen zich af of het geen aanbeveling verdient ook deze wetten in te trekken.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that a general and structural rule be added to the Wet arhi instead of repeatedly extending council terms via separate bills, and suggested a redactional annex for the proposed articles. The government acknowledged the desirability of a general regulation but kept the bill as drafted, citing the tight timetable, and announced a separate bill for a structural arrangement.
concerns: The Council urged enacting a general and structural arrangement in the Wet arhi rather than a recurring one-off bill, which the government declined to adopt in this bill, though it promised a separate proposal.
The Council suggested redactional changes to the draft articles, which the government's reply implicitly accepts through the proposed text of the annex.

33717.s: The bill caps the amount schools may charge per student for teaching materials and adds a power for schools to prescribe electronic information carriers within that cap, with the cap set by general administrative order (AMvB). It also abolishes the WTOS allowance for under-18s in secondary vocational education, folding the budget into the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget), and amends related education and participation laws.
33717.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route by saying the definition still needs working out and that room must be kept for innovation, and that the amount can be adjusted easily if needed.
q: By including the amount in a general administrative order, it is easier to adjust the maximum amount if needed.
Door het bedrag in een algemene maatregel van bestuur op te nemen, is het eenvoudiger het maximum bedrag aan te passen indien dat nodig blijkt.
d: maximum amount per student for teaching materials
conditions for applications under the WTOS
p: Artikel I A, art. 6e lid 2 and 4

The statutory cap on teaching-material spending is left to a general administrative order, so the amount can be changed without a new statute, though the cap itself is stated in the bill's explanation.
The school's liability to recover teaching-material costs from parents or students is retained, while the inspectorate's role is said to continue."}],

33726.s: The bill abolishes the general allowance for chronically ill and disabled persons (Wtcg), the CER reimbursement for the mandatory deductible, and the tax deduction for specific care costs, and replaces the Wtcg allowance for disabled workers with new flat-rate allowances in three work/benefit laws. It also sets transitional rules and amends related laws, with the Wtcg itself withdrawn from 1 January 2016.
33726.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the poor targeting of the allowances, administrative difficulty and budget risks, and says the annual amount adjustments follow the tax correction factor.
q: the eligibility criteria often need adjustment and lead to risks for budgetary controllability
de criteria voor toekenning vaak aanpassing behoeven en tot risico's op het punt van de budgettaire beheersbaarheid leiden
d: CAK determines right to and amount of allowance ex officio
Artikel VI (artikel 63a WWNV, tweede en derde lid)
annual adjustment of the allowance amount by ministerial regulation
replacing the allowance amount by general administrative order with a set effective date
Artikel VII (artikel 65l WAO, derde en vijfde lid)
annual adjustment of WAO allowance amount
replacing WAO allowance amount by general administrative order
Artikel VIII (artikel 67i WAZ, derde en vijfde lid)
annual adjustment of WAZ allowance amount
replacing WAZ allowance amount by general administrative order
Artikel IX (artikel 3:75 WWNJ, derde en vijfde lid)
annual adjustment of WWNJ allowance amount
replacing WWNJ allowance amount by general administrative order
one-time indexation of amounts in Articles VI to IX from 1 January 2014
p: Artikel VI, VII, VIII, IX; Artikel X
Allowance amounts for disabled workers can be changed by ministerial regulation and by general administrative order, departing from the amounts fixed in the statute without parliamentary approval.
Artikel I, onderdeel C en D; Artikel XVI

CAK may no longer revise or reclaim earlier allowance decisions to the detriment of beneficiaries, a protection removed for the executive's administrative convenience, while transitional rules keep old law for pending objections and appeals.

parties: Supports abolishing the untargeted schemes and asks whether municipalities have sufficient options to compensate the target group adequately.
These members therefore fully support the line of scrapping the current untargeted schemes and transferring the freed-up funds to municipalities so they can offer tailored support to this group.

Genoemde leden staan daarom volledig achter de lijn om de huidige ongerichte regelingen te schrappen en de vrijkomende middelen over te hevelen naar gemeenten zodat zij maatwerk kunnen bieden voor deze doelgroep.
Asks how municipalities can compensate people above the 110% benchmark, what legal options exist, and whether a categorical scheme could limit discretion and bureaucracy.
What (legal) options do municipalities have to financially support people with an income above the special assistance norm when that is needed?
Welke (wettelijke) mogelijkheden zijn er voor gemeenten om ook mensen met een inkomen boven de bijzondere bijstandsnorm financieel te kunnen ondersteunen wanneer dat nodig is?
Objects to abolishing the allowances without an alternative, warns of postcode-dependent inequality under municipal discretion, and asks for a uniform national scheme.
These members ask the government to create a statutory national tailored scheme so that no legal inequality arises between a person with high care costs in one municipality and one in another.

Genoemde leden vragen de regering een wettelijke landelijke maatwerkregeling te maken waarmee er geen rechtsongelijkheid ontstaat tussen iemand met hoge zorgkosten in de ene gemeente en in de andere gemeente.
Questions whether income policy should be national, notes the bill lacks detail on the form of municipal provisions, and doubts the target group will be reached; requests clarification.
It is not clear to the CDA members what form and character the municipal tailored provisions, as the government believes they will need to be made possible, will take.

Het is de leden van de CDA-fractie niet duidelijk hoe de vorm en het karakter van de gemeentelijke maatwerkvoorzieningen zoals de regering meent dat die mogelijk gemaakt zullen moeten gaan worden, eruit gaan zien.

Notes the bill lacks provisions on how municipal tailored support and client rights in the Wmo will be structured, making assessment impossible without the Wmo bill; asks for timing and allocation key.
The present bill, however, contains no provisions on how municipal tailored support is to be organised, nor on how client rights will be safeguarded in the new Wmo.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel voorziet echter niet in bepalingen voor de inrichting van het gemeentelijk maatwerk, noch voor de wijze waarop cliëntenrechten in de nieuwe Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) zullen worden geborgd.
Asks why automatic compensation is replaced, whether municipalities will compensate automatically or only on request, and how mondige-only access is prevented; asks about client organisation input.
How will it be prevented that only assertive chronically ill and disabled people gain access to the new scheme?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat alleen mondige chronisch zieken en gehandicapten toegang tot de nieuwe regeling zullen krijgen?
Asks whether the shift is motivated by savings, why the budget is not earmarked, and requests evaluation and a result obligation for municipalities.
Does the government intend to evaluate this bill to see whether the current target group is indeed better reached through municipal provisions?
Is de regering voornemens dit wetsvoorstel te evalueren om te bezien of de huidige doelgroep door de voorzieningen bij gemeenten wel beter wordt bereikt?
Asks whether the Raad van State's call for clearer legal frameworks will be heeded, and whether conscientious objectors who lose the tax deduction will be compensated.
Given the large impact of abolishing the tax deduction for conscientious objectors, these members ask whether the government is willing to maintain the deduction for conscientious objectors.
Gelet op de grote impact van de afschaffing van de fiscale aftrekmogelijkheid voor gemoedsbezwaarden, vragen deze leden of de regering bereid is de aftrek voor gemoedbezwaarden in stand te houden.
Objects to municipal discretion and unearmarked funds that may be too small after deductions, arguing income policy belongs with the national government and that duties and rights need safeguarding.
Income policy is a matter for the national government, not for municipalities.
Inkomenspolitiek is een zaak van het rijk, niet van gemeenten.
Worries about unequal rights across municipalities and the loss of compensation for chronically ill and disabled people, asking the government to justify the cuts.
They believe this creates more legal equality for residents in the Netherlands.
Zij menen dat hiermee meer rechtsgelijkheid voor inwoners in Nederland ontstaat.
Asks whether the government will withdraw the bill given the income effects on vulnerable groups and whether public support was tested.
Is the government willing to withdraw the bill now that its effects on the elderly, chronically ill and disabled are clear?
Is de regering bereid het wetsvoorstel in te trekken nu blijkt wat de effecten hiervan zijn voor ouderen, chronisch zieken en gehandicapten?
Questions whether municipalities are obliged to compensate and whether individuals have legal protection under the discretionary decisions, including how rights are guaranteed.
How is the legal protection of citizens guaranteed here?
Hoe is hier de rechtsbescherming van burgers gewaarborgd?
Asks for firmer monitoring commitments of income effects so no groups fall between the cracks.
These members ask the government for a firmer and more concrete commitment on this point.
Genoemde leden vragen op dit punt een hardere en meer concrete toezegging van de regering.
Asks for monitoring of the bill's effects, access to personal data for municipalities, and clarity on when municipal versus bijzondere bijstand support applies.
Is the view shared that it is important to monitor the effects of this bill so it becomes clear how the income position of chronically ill and disabled people develops?

Wordt de opvatting gedeeld dat van belang is, dat de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel worden gemonitord zodat inzichtelijk wordt op welke wijze de inkomenspositie van chronisch zieken en gehandicapten zich ontwikkeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill abolishing the general allowance for chronically ill and disabled people, the compensation for the mandatory deductible, and the specific care-cost deductions, replacing them with municipal tailor-made provisions, and found the bill should not be sent until clarity on the municipal legal framework was provided. The government's nader rapport replies that the 'Hervorming van de langdurige ondersteuning en zorg' note provides the clarity, that the Wtcg-discounts and the arbeidsongeschiktheid allowance will be moved, and that VNG will be formally consulted on the Wmo bill.
concerns: The Afdeling said clarity on the intended legal framework for municipal tailor-made provisions was needed before the measures could be introduced responsibly; the government points to the 'Hervorming' note and an amended explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling argued that municipal provisions would not compensate lower and middle incomes losing the allowances, and that the explanation gave no insight into whether the targeted groups still needed the allowances.

The Afdeling said decentralisation meant municipalities would decide whether and how to provide support, removing uniformity and leaving unclear whether funds reach intended recipients; the government accepts variation as inherent to tailor-made decentralised provision.

The Afdeling noted that moving from statutory entitlements to discretionary municipal provision weakens legal protection, while the government replies that citizens can still appeal municipal decisions and that Wmo contains safeguards.
The Afdeling asked for the explanatory memorandum to address the distributional effects on middle incomes and cumulative burdens; the government added an income-effects discussion.

The Afdeling flagged the Wtcg-discounts on Wmo and AWBZ co-payments and the arbeidsongeschiktheid allowance as needing explanation and possible relocation; the government added their repeal and moved the allowance to the relevant benefit laws.
The Afdeling advised formal VNG advice on the bill and noted consultations had not been reflected; the government says VNG will be consulted on the forthcoming Wmo bill rather than this one.

33735.s: The bill creates a statutory framework for implementing EU European Regional Development Fund regulations in the Netherlands, including designating authorities, rules on subsidy grants and recovery, supervision and reporting, and legal protection. It delegates many detailed rules to ministerial regulations, general administrative orders and delegations to implementing authorities, with the Minister empowered to designate and withdraw authorities.
33735.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to effectuate the EU regulations and to allow detailed rules per programme period to be filled in by lower regulation.
q: The bill is therefore limited to main lines so that details per programme period can be filled in by lower regulation.
Het wetsvoorstel beperkt zich daarom tot hoofdlijnen zodat details per programmaperiode bij lagere regelgeving nader ingevuld kunnen worden.
d: rules on concluding cross-border cooperation agreements
further task descriptions of designated authorities
rules on relations between authorities and the Commission, including data exchange
detailed subsidy rules: eligibility, ceilings, criteria, amounts, conditions, control
delegation of subsidy decision-making by ministers or local/provincial bodies to an authority
Minister may demand all information and documents from authorities
Minister may assign reporting duties to an authority
p: The Minister may withdraw an authority's designation and appoint another body to perform its tasks, after giving a warning and a deadline to remedy.
Broad powers for ministerial regulations to set detailed subsidy conditions, with local-level regulatory autonomy limited for co-financing.
Authorities may refuse, reduce, withdraw or retroactively amend subsidies, and the Awb safeguards on withdrawal time limits do not apply where a treaty obligation requires it.
Designated supervisors receive supervisory powers under the Awb, including for foreign personnel, with ministerial approval required for foreign staff exercising them in the Netherlands.
Appeals against subsidy decisions for a project are concentrated in one district court, with judicial review preserved.

parties: Asks about sanctions for non-compliance, flexibility of a law versus a general administrative measure, and the scope of ministerial instructions to managing authorities.
The bill therefore proceeds from their autonomy.
Het wetsvoorstel gaat dan ook uit van hun autonomie.
Supports the bill but asks why parliamentary involvement through a pre-consultation procedure for general administrative measures is not included.
why parliamentary involvement in the form of a pre-consultation procedure for general administrative measures has not been included in the bill.
waarom parlementaire betrokkenheid in de vorm van een voorhangprocedure voor de algemene maatregelen van bestuur niet in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen.
Asks which regional projects will no longer receive EFRO funding and the effects on employment.
The CDA members ask which regional projects will no longer receive EFRO funding?
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen welke regionale projecten geen geld meer krijgen van het EFRO?
Questions the necessity of the implementing law given existing arrangements, and asks whether a fixed period should apply to the time given to an authority to fulfil its task.
to what extent this implementing act is necessary, given that the provinces and municipalities manage very well under the current arrangement.
in hoeverre deze uitvoeringswet noodzakelijk is, gezien het feit dat de provincies en gemeentes met de huidige regeling uitstekend uit de voeten kunnen.
Questions the overhead and value of EU-channelled subsidies, asks how democratic control and parliamentary oversight of spending and results are ensured, and asks which bodies the bill designates.
What, in the government's view, is the democratic control that should take place over the spending of these funds?
Wat is in de visie van de regering de democratische controle die op de besteding van deze gelden plaats moet vinden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the draft EFRO Implementation Act but raises several points on task neglect, authorities, the coordinating body, delegation, subsidies, limitation periods, scope and draft regulation texts, and advises revision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, amends the bill accordingly, and rejects the call to broaden its scope beyond EFRO.
concerns: The text and explanatory memorandum on withdrawal of designation for task neglect did not align and have been brought into line.
The explanatory memorandum on authorities' data exchange and the rules under article 4 is supplemented, noting Wbp requirements.
Sub-delegation by authorities without involvement of the original delegating body, and the choice between amvb and ministerial regulation, were objected to; article 7(4) was deleted.
Article 5 on coordinating bodies was unclausulated as to tasks and powers; it now limits designation to EFRO-based powers and tasks.
Provisions included 'for the case that' were questioned as to necessity; the bill was adjusted accordingly.
The relationship between article 10 and the Awb subsidy grounds was unclear and the explanatory memorandum was clarified.
Derogation from Awb limitation periods in article 10(4) was limited to cases where a treaty obligation requires it, with the explanation aligned.
The Afdeling questioned the narrow scope limited to EFRO rather than a general act covering all European funds; the government rejected broadening it, citing EFRO's decentralised character.
Draft EU regulation texts were not final; the government commits to resubmit for advice if substantial changes follow.
Redactional comments on the wording of article 11 were adopted.

33750-V.s: This bill fixes the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including its policy articles and non-policy articles, in thousands of euros. It also fixes the 2014 budget statement for the agency CBI (Centre for the Promotion of Imports from Developing Countries), with entry into force on 1 January 2014.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2014, annexed to this act, is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.
Other fiscal measures 2014.
Overige fiscale maatregelen 2014.

parties: Welcomes simplification measures such as private-deed gifts and the ANBI extension, and asks about a successions exception and childcare partner rules.
The VVD members have noted the bill amending several tax laws and other laws (Overige fiscale maatregelen 2014).
De leden van de fractie van de VVD hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel Wijziging van enkele belastingwetten en enige andere wetten (Overige fiscale maatregelen 2014).
Questions the risk of political arbitrariness in the ANBI integrity rule and asks whether revoking ANBI status is a matter for a judge rather than tax law.
Does the government agree with the Council of State and the VFI that withdrawing ANBI status is a matter for the judge and not for tax legislation?

Is de regering het eens met de Raad van State en de brancheorganisatie voor goede doelen VFI dat het al dan niet intrekken van de ANBI-status een zaak is van de rechter en niet van de fiscale wetgeving?
Objects to the distinction in the ANBI integrity amendment and asks for the change to be reversed; also questions WOZ deviation for serviceflats and the abolition of the notarial deed.
These members therefore request that the amendment following the Council of State's remarks be reversed.
Genoemde leden verzoeken de wijziging naar aanleiding van de opmerkingen van de Raad van State dan ook terug te draaien.
Asks why substantive changes were introduced by nota van wijziging, avoiding Council of State advice, and why the substance requirements are left to an AMvB without parliamentary involvement.
Why was it chosen to fill in the information obligation for service bodies by general administrative order, so that the House is not involved?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen de inlichtingenverplichting voor dienstverleningslichamen in te vullen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur, zodat de Kamer er niet bij wordt betrokken?
Asks the government to respond to NOB comments, suggests seeking Council of State advice on the nota van wijziging, and questions legal grounds and ANBI sanction proportionality and due process.
These members ask the government also to respond to the questions and comments of the NOB, the RB and the EPN on this bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering om tevens in te gaan op de vragen en opmerkingen van de NOB, de RB en de EPN bij onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Argues the ANBI integrity change is not technical and should be a separate bill, and asks about its application to human-rights organisations convicted abroad.
In the view of these members this is not a technical amendment, and they therefore ask why this change was not regulated through a separate bill.

Naar de mening van deze leden is hier geen spraken van een technische wijziging en deze leden vragen de regering dan ook waarom er niet gekozen is voor het regelen van deze wijziging via een afzonderlijk wetsvoorstel.
Sees erosion of taxpayer legal protection in abolishing prior notification for exchange of information and asks that revoking ANBI status be decided by a criminal judge.
They believe this substantially undermines the legal protection of taxpayers.
Zij menen dat hiermee de rechtsbescherming van belastingplichtigen wezenlijk wordt aangetast.
Asks for a point-by-point government response to EPN remarks on defiscalising succession law.
They ask the government whether a point-by-point response can be given to the reservations and questions of the EPN on the defiscalisation of inheritance law.
Zij vragen de regering of een puntsgewijze reactie gegeven kan worden op kanttekeningen en vragen van de Vereniging van Estateplanners in het Notariaat (EPN) rond de defiscalisering van het erfrecht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2014 bill but raises objections on applying a non-WOZ valuation rule for serviceflats in inheritance tax (inroad on the objective system, unclear necessity of delegation, overly broad delegation clause) and on the ANBI integrity provision (missing link to the institution's own involvement), advising adaptation. The government's nader rapport accepts these points: it removes the delegation basis, puts the valuation rules and definition in the statute, and ties the ANBI sanction to the offender acting in that capacity.
concerns: The delegation of valuation rules and definition of serviceflats to an AMvB was insufficiently justified and too broad; the government removed the delegation basis and included the rules in the statute.

Departure from the objective WOZ valuation for serviceflats risks precedent and was insufficiently motivated; the government argues the exception is specific to serviceflats and adopted the statutory rules without a full change of the WOZ principle.
The ANBI integrity provision did not reflect that the institution itself must be implicated in the offence; the provision and explanatory memorandum were amended accordingly.
Editorial and technical comments in the annex on renumbering of the Wet op de verbruiksbelastingen provision were adopted.

33771.s: This omnibus bill makes mostly technical and terminological corrections across many laws under the Ministry of Security and Justice, including the Civil Code, the Administrative Law Act, bankruptcy and criminal procedure rules, and BES laws. It replaces references to the Queen with the King and updates outdated court and article references, with no substantive expansion of executive power.
33771.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as correcting technical defects and minor non-substantive amendments, with no new delegation or powers claimed.
q: The vast majority of the articles repair technical legislative defects or make substantive changes of a minor nature.
Verreweg de meeste artikelen repareren wetstechnische gebreken of brengen inhoudelijke wijzigingen van ondergeschikte aard aan

parties: The VVD supports the bill's purpose but asks the government to clarify ambiguous provisions on annual account adoption, the scope of exclusion from deliberation for executive directors, and the wording of articles on shareholder meetings, which bear on the clarity and oversight of corporate governance rules.
They endorse the purpose and necessity of the bill, which aims to repair identified legislative technical imperfections in various laws.
Zij onderschrijven de strekking en de noodzaak van het wetsvoorstel dat beoogt geconstateerde wetstechnische onvolkomenheden in diverse wetten te repareren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supported the Verzamelwet Veiligheid en Justitie 2013 but raised one main point: the proposed change from 'strafrechtspleging' to 'rechtspleging' in article 8(5) Wjsg for transfers of justice data abroad was not clearly aligned with the scope of article 11 of the Kaderbesluit dataprotectie and article 36 Bjsg. The minister's reply reports that this change was dropped from the bill, and that remaining technical and drafting remarks were incorporated.
concerns: The proposed amendment of article 8(5) Wjsg broadening the purpose to 'rechtspleging' lacked sufficient justification and grounding relative to Kaderbesluit dataprotectie article 11 and article 36 Bjsg, and was withdrawn from the bill.
Drafting remarks on article VII, onderdeel B (should be onderdeel A) and article XXXI, and on article XXVI references and annex heading, were incorporated.

33780.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by reallocating and adding funds, mainly €650 million from an incidental supplementary budget distributed across primary, secondary, vocational, higher and university education. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 11 October 2013.
33780.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendment by the need to adjust the departmental budget, with the €650 million distributed over education sectors; it does not justify any delegation or new powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2013

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2013

33816.s: The bill allows courts to extend supervision after conditional release and tbs by removing the nine-year cap on conditional termination of detention and lengthening probation periods for conditional release. It also creates a new standalone supervision measure, imposed alongside sentencing for sex and serious violent offenders, that can restrict behaviour and movement for two to five year periods renewable without a legal maximum.
33816.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by citing public safety, recidivism reduction, research on supervision effectiveness, and the periodic judicial review that limits duration to what is necessary and proportionate.
d: conditions and electronic monitoring set by court within measure
p: New standalone measure lets prosecutors seek extended, renewable restrictions on freedom of movement and behaviour for sex and serious violence offenders without a legal maximum duration.
Removal of the nine-year maximum for conditional termination of tbs and extension of probation periods on prosecution request widens executive-driven supervision of ex-detainees.
Appeal against decisions on the measure goes to the court of appeal and decisions are immediately enforceable, subject to possible suspension by the appeal judge.

parties: Supports long-term supervision of sex and violent offenders but asks whether the many overlapping supervision regimes could be simplified and how victims' interests are protected.
There is a strong societal need for this, given that recidivism in these forms of crime is also alarmingly high.
Hieraan is een grote maatschappelijke behoefte, mede gelet op het feit dat recidive ook bij deze vormen van criminaliteit verontrustend hoog is.
Questions whether a court should impose the standalone measure at sentencing years before it could be enforced, and asks for a clear overview of the many overlapping supervision instruments.
However, they also read in the explanatory memorandum that a shaken legal order could be grounds for a judge to impose the standalone measure named in the bill.
Zij lezen in de memorie van toelichting echter ook dat een geschokte rechtsorde aanleiding zou kunnen zijn voor een rechter om de in het wetsvoorstel genoemde zelfstandige maatregel op te leggen.
Questions the justification for abolishing the maximum duration for conditional termination but not for TBS with conditions, and doubts that the bill will relieve the TBS system.
On the same reasoning, should this term not also be abolished?
Zou, op grond van dezelfde redenering, deze termijn niet ook geschrapt dienen te worden?
Questions whether the two-stage procedure, where the measure is imposed at sentencing but enforced later, undermines legal certainty and foreseeability for the offender.
Argues the bill is premature and lacks proportionality, necessity and effectiveness evidence, since the 2008 extension has not been evaluated and implementing bodies oppose it.
They consider the justification of the bill on the aforementioned points to be deficient.
Zij beschouwen de onderbouwing van het wetsvoorstel op de voornoemde punten als gebrekkig.
Supports supervision if responsibly designed but asks how risk assessment avoids both underestimation and overestimation of recidivism to protect fundamental rights.
Not only to protect society but also to protect the fundamental rights of the person concerned must this be adequately safeguarded.
Niet alleen ter bescherming van de samenleving, maar ook ter bescherming van de grondrechten van de justitiabele dient dit afdoende geborgd te zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board issued a critical opinion on a bill introducing a standalone behaviour-influencing and freedom-restricting measure (GVM) for long-term supervision of former TBS detainees and serious sex/violence offenders, abolishing the maximum duration of conditional termination of TBS detention, and extending probation periods. The government's reply (nader rapport) addresses each point, accepting several recommendations (justification of durations, narrower criteria, EVRM/EU law discussion) while rejecting the recommendation to narrow the 'repeat offence' criterion and to postpone abolishing the maximum duration pending evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether a GVM of up to five years, renewable without limit, is proportionate to the seriousness of the offence and the duration of a capped TBS; the government justified durations and added explanation but did not change the structure.

The criterion 'serious risk of repeat offence' is too broad and not linked to the nature or gravity of the offence; the government narrowed it to offences carrying a TBS-eligible maximum but rejected narrowing to violence against bodily integrity.
The judge must make a prognosis of future recidivism at sentencing, a novel and difficult task; the government argued the reclassering report and type of offence suffice, without changing the bill.
Abolishing the maximum duration of conditional termination of TBS is premature without evaluation of the 2008 extension; the government disagreed and maintained the abolition.

The conditions could amount to deprivation of liberty under Article 5 ECHR (Guzzardi); the memorie van toelichting was expanded to address this, with the government stating the measure itself does not ground deprivation of liberty except via substitute detention.
A ban on leaving the Netherlands must meet the Free Movement Directive 2004/38 criteria of current, genuine and sufficiently serious threat; the explanatory memorandum was clarified accordingly.
Cooperation between police, reclassering, clinics and prosecution is not yet sufficiently worked out; the explanatory memorandum was expanded.
Justification for the two-year minimum and the restriction to yearly terms was requested; the government explained differentiation is possible within those terms.

Minimum probation period of one year for conditional release conflicts with short sentences and proportionality; the government clarified the change enables behavioural intervention rather than prescribing a minimum.

33834.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to introduce an annual obligation on fuel suppliers to ensure a share of transport energy is renewable, and creates an electronic register of renewable transport energy units tradable between parties. It sets account, registration, verification and enforcement rules administered by the emissions authority NEa, with many details left to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
33834.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the need for technical detail and flexibility, such as the pending EU debate on conventional biofuel caps and the not-yet-developed forms of renewable energy.
q: It is not possible to determine now exactly whether such a restriction should be imposed, where it is best placed, and what it should consist of.
Het is niet mogelijk om nu al precies te bepalen of zo’n beperking moet worden opgelegd, waar die beperking het beste kan worden neergelegd en waaruit die beperking zou moeten bestaan.
d: energy content calculation rules for fuels
exempting categories of fuel suppliers from obligations
limits on use of conventional biofuels
share of energy content that constitutes annual obligation
data to be reported for annual supply entries
rules on ex officio determination of supplied quantities
rules for inboekers of gaseous biofuel or electricity
requirements for other renewable transport energy
determination of inbooked quantities and proof of compliance
percentage of renewable electricity counted for transport
categories of renewable energy with multiplication factors
rules on suspending or refusing credit issuance
operation, organisation and security of the register
categories of companies eligible for trading accounts
rules on refusing, blocking or closing accounts
fees for account holding, charged to users
share of credits that may be saved to next year
transitional conversion of prior surplus into credits
p: The emissions authority may ex officio set supplied quantities and adjust them retroactively up to five years later.
The authority may suspend or refuse credit issuance where it suspects misuse or fraud, with rules left to an order in council.
The authority may unilaterally redetermine past inbookings and reclaim credits up to five years after the fact.
The authority may refuse, block or close register accounts where it has reason to believe requirements are not met.

parties: Welcomes the simplification of the administrative system and asks a single question about it, without raising a check concern.
Agrees with transparency goals but asks the government to explain the removal of the 3.5% fuel blending floor and about the timing of the delegated regulations to parliament.

These members further ask when the Decree and the Regulation will be submitted to the House.](The PvdA members also ask whether the government is considering removing the 3.5% floor and what the advantages and disadvantages are.)
Deze leden vragen voorts wanneer het Besluit en de Regeling aan de Kamer worden voorgelegd.
