Objects that essential rules are moved to ministerial regulations, sidelining parliament, and that controls on biofuel origin and HBE savings are weak; asks for the basic norms to be anchored in the statute.
Precisely because a new HBE system is being set up, the SP members urge that the norms and basic mechanisms be anchored in the law.
Temeer omdat er nu een nieuw systeem wordt opgetuigd van HBE's dringen de leden van de SP-fractie er op aan om de normstelling en de basismechanismen in de wet te verankeren.
Asks about the NEa annual report, including its publication deadline (the 2012 report is still unpublished) and transparency on fossil fuel origin, pressing for timely oversight output.
These members note that the 2012 report has still not been published.
Deze leden constateren dat de rapportage van 2012 nog steeds niet is gepubliceerd.

Raises verification and enforcement doubts about whether paper HBE entries reflect actual biofuel use, the Council of State's concerns on market dependence, and unclear chain responsibility; asks who controls and who is liable.
The D66 members ask the government how it guarantees that the paper obligation to have a certain number of HBEs on the books actually means companies have used sustainable biofuels.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering hoe ze garandeert dat de papieren verplichting om een bepaald aantal HBE's in de boeken te hebben staan, ook daadwerkelijk betekent dat bedrijven duurzame biobrandstoffen hebben gebruikt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill establishing a register for renewable transport energy (HBE trading) but raises concerns about transparency and dominant market positions in the HBE market and about exports of biofuels, and advises amending the bill and explanatory memorandum. The government's reply accepts the points on transparency and export, adds quarterly publication and clarifications, and adjusts the bill with minor changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for analysis of the market for renewable fuel units, transparency, and risk of dominant market positions, which the government answers by pointing to market structure, a price overview, a savings limit, and quarterly publication.
The obligation for the registering company to prove that biofuels were not exported is only in the explanatory memorandum and not in the bill, so the memorandum was aligned with the bill text.

The feasibility of the verification obligation for the registering company regarding onward export is questioned, and the government responds that the bill does not prohibit such export, as under current rules.
Redactional remarks are adopted, except one on the definition of transport, which the government explains is governed by the definition of supply to the Dutch transport market.

33861.s: The bill expands the disciplinary and order measures available against life-appointed Dutch judicial officials, adding a written reprimand by the Supreme Court, disciplinary suspension of up to three months with possible pay withholding, and a power to temporarily remove judges from office or transfer them to another court. It also makes a certificate of good conduct (VOG) a mandatory requirement for appointment as a judicial official or board member.
33861.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded measures by the need for proportionate responses to misconduct and the lack of intermediate sanctions, while stressing that judicial independence is preserved through statutory conditions for suspension and dismissal.
q: Therefore it must be sufficiently regulated that impermissible conduct can always be met with a response that is appropriate given the seriousness of the case concerned.
Daarom moet afdoende geregeld zijn dat ontoelaatbaar gedrag altijd voorzien kan worden van een reactie die passend is, gelet op de ernst van het betrokken geval.
d: certificate of good conduct requirement for appointment
p: Expands the range of disciplinary sanctions against life-appointed judicial officials, including suspension and dismissal grounds, with decisions taken by the Supreme Court and the court president.

Allows a single chamber of the Supreme Court, on request of the court president, to remove a judicial official from office on urgent grounds for up to thirty days before full suspension proceedings."}],

parties: Asks whether the proposed sanctions meet ECHR proportionality requirements from Volkov v. Ukraine and whether the statute of limitations is adequate, and wants order measures also available as disciplinary sanctions.
Is the government of the opinion that the bill nevertheless meets the requirements of ECHR case law, in particular the Volkov v. Ukraine case?
Is de regering van mening dat het wetsvoorstel desondanks voldoet aan de vereisten van de jurisprudentie van het EHRM, met name die uit de zaak-Volkov vs. Oekraïne?
Supports broadening the sanctions toolkit to correct and prevent improper conduct and asks only a few clarifying questions.
They believe the proposed expansion of the toolkit against judges showing improper conduct allows sanctions that can help correct and prevent that conduct.

Zij zijn van mening dat met de voorgestelde uitbreiding van het instrumentarium tegen rechters die ongeoorloofd gedrag vertonen, sancties kunnen worden opgelegd die kunnen bijdragen aan het corrigeren en voorkomen van dat gedrag.

Welcomes broader disciplinary measures but asks how quality of judgments is assessed, proposes internal review committees, and questions the discretion over withheld pay and urgent removal from office.
Who decides at what moment and how much salary is withheld?
Wie bepaalt op welk moment en hoeveel loon wordt ingehouden?

Supports broader disciplinary powers but questions whether financial sanctions and the leave reduction apply equally to judicial officials, whether a written reprimand should remain a step before dismissal, and how urgent removal affects perceived sanction.
They ask the government whether, given the severity of dismissal, the proportionality principle requires that a written reprimand be given to the person concerned first.
Vragen de regering of gezien de zwaarte van de maatregel van ontslag, het proportionaliteitsbeginsel meebrengt dat eerst een schriftelijke berisping wordt gegeven aan de betrokkene.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against seven amendments to a bill on disciplinary measures for life-appointed judicial officials, concluding that transfer and demotion, salary withholding, conditional sanctions, the reprimand-like warning, the post-appointment certificate of conduct, the register of secondary positions, and replacing the agreement requirement of article 51 Wrra with an advisory right should not be adopted in the proposed form. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice in full, including the recommendation to prepare a separate bill on article 51 Wrra.
concerns: Demotion and transfer as disciplinary measures would undermine the authority and independence of judges and conflict with article 117 of the Constitution on appointment powers.
Involuntary demotion raises questions under article 6 ECHR on the independent and impartial tribunal requirement.
Withholding salary for up to three months threatens judicial independence and is disproportionate.
Conditional dismissal would leave a judge without sufficient authority to function and is disproportionate for minor triggers.
The certificate of conduct after appointment adds nothing because the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens already allows relevant information to be shared.
The warning measure is redundant given the existing written reprimand and the register amendment duplicates existing article 44 Wrra.

Replacing the agreement requirement with an advisory right conflicts with international consultation standards and creates an unjustified distinction with ordinary civil servants; a separate bill is advised.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on a bill expanding disciplinary and other measures against life-appointed judicial officials, raising concerns about the proportionality of suspension, the lack of lighter sanctions, overlapping competences between court presidents and the Hoge Raad, the buitenfunctiestelling procedure, and the mandatory VOG for judicial board members. The minister's nader rapport accepts some points (voorwaardelijk ontslag, the buitenfunctiestelling referral, the competence overlap) and rejects others (lighter sanctions, deletion of the VOG requirement).
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the suspension measure is proportionate and asked for examples of suitable cases, which the government addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked why lighter financial sanctions as in the ARAR and Brra were not introduced, and the government kept its choice not to include them.

Overlapping competences between the court president and the Hoge Raad for a written reprimand were problematic; the government adopted the Afdeling's proposal that the president cannot reprimand when a Hoge Raad claim is pending.
The Afdeling found the reasoning against conditional dismissal unconvincing but agreed it should not be included, and the explanatory memorandum was adapted accordingly.
The buitenfunctiestelling should not depend solely on a request by the court president; the government adopted the Afdeling's point and allowed the procureur-generaal to act as well.
The Afdeling considered a new VOG for judicial board members unnecessary, but the government kept the requirement and only strengthened its justification.
The Afdeling listed several redactional and wording corrections, which the government largely adopted.

33930-V.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, plus the CBI agency budget, via a supplementary budget law (slotwet). It sets the amended figures, states that amounts are in thousands of euros, and sets entry into force the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
33930-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, explaining deviations from budget with production timing, project start-up delays, personnel cost accounting and lower liquidity needs.
q: In accordance with the Government Budget Regulations and the Accounting Act 2001, notable differences between the previous (second supplementary budget) and current estimate must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de vorige (tweede Suppletoire Begroting) en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

33951.s: This is a technical repair bill (Reparatiewet BZK 2014) correcting drafting errors and updating various Interior Ministry statutes, including the Kieswet, Leegstandwet, Woningwet, and rent-control and party-financing rules. It makes a few substantive adjustments, such as extending transitional rules for building permits and changing vacancy-permit conditions, but mainly corrects cross-references and wording.
33951.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation corrections as repairing an omission in the original delegation basis for tenant objection procedures, and the other changes as technical corrections.
q: Through an oversight, the aforementioned delegation basis was not also included for the tenant's option to object to a landlord's proposed rent increase.
Abusievelijk is verzuimd voormelde delegatiegrondslag ook op te nemen ten aanzien de mogelijkheid van de huurder tot het maken van bezwaar tegen een voorstel tot huurverhoging van de verhuurder
d: ARTIKEL III (Art. 7:253 BW, lid 1 derde volzin)
data the tenant must provide with rent objection
ARTIKEL VIII, onderdeel A (Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte art. 10 lid 2)
annual adjustment of income limits for rent increases
regulation on income limits for income-dependent rent increase 2014 re-based on new statutory ground
p: Municipal mayor and aldermen gain power to withdraw vacancy-law permits when owners supplied incorrect information, with time limits on permits set out in the statute.
Removes municipal building-regulation power to set urban planning rules, shifting such rules into zoning plans, with transitional rules running to 1 July 2018.

parties: Asks whether the second amendment, made unworkable by another law, changes the bill's practical purpose.
The second amendment states that because the Rotterdam Act was adopted, the amendment instruction in article III is unworkable.
In de tweede nota van wijziging staat dat door de aanname van de Rotterdamwet, de wijzigingsopdracht in artikel III onuitvoerbaar is.
Asks for justification of moving the basis for parking norms exclusively into zoning plans, given the upcoming Omgevingswet's flexibility.
They read in articles XX and XXIII that the Housing Act and Wabo are amended so that the basis for setting parking norms can only be through the zoning plan.
Zij lezen in de artikelen XX en XXIII dat de Woningwet en Wabo zodanig worden gewijzigd dat de grondslag voor het stellen van parkeernormen voortaan alleen via het bestemmingsplan kan geschieden.
Asks whether the government will respond to the Electoral Council's criticism that the fix for conflicting Kieswet articles 17 and 19 does not clearly resolve what gets disclosed.
The Electoral Council states that it is still not entirely clear what exactly is made public.
De Kiesraad stelt dat nog niet helemaal duidelijk wordt wat precies openbaar wordt gemaakt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the Reparatiewet BZK 2014, a technical repair bill, and offered only redactional remarks on a title and article placement. The minister accepted the redactional remarks and reports the bill was adjusted to the Wet aanpassing waterschapsverkiezingen.
concerns: Redactional remarks on the title ('Leegstandswet' corrected to 'Leegstandwet') and on placing article XXI as an amendment to the Woningwet were incorporated.

33960.s: The bill merges the 16 regional Halt bureaus into a single Halt organisation, adjusting the Justice subsidies act and the BZK subsidies framework accordingly. It also adds a new general subsidy power for immigration and asylum activities, lets the minister set subsidy ceilings, and removes a ministerial-regulation basis for Halt cost rules.
33960.j: The memorandum justifies moving Halt cost-price setting from a ministerial regulation to the yearly subsidy letter because cost parameters must be adjusted periodically during the post-merger transition.
q: it is chosen to regulate the determination of the cost prices of the respective modules through the yearly subsidy grant letter to Halt, instead of in a ministerial regulation

wordt ervoor gekozen de bepaling van de kostprijzen van de respectievelijke modules te regelen door middel van de jaarlijkse subsidieverleningsbrief aan Halt, in plaats van in een ministeriële regeling
d: subsidy ceiling and distribution; further rules on immigration and asylum subsidies
Halt subsidy calculation via yearly subsidy letter instead of regulation
p: Gives the minister open subsidy power for immigration and asylum activities with discretion over how a capped amount is divided.
Removes statutory provisions on Halt support subsidies and reporting-related paragraphs, reducing statutory specification of executive subsidy conduct.

34000-IX.s: This bill formally adopts the 2015 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), fixing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rule tied to 1 January 2015 and orders publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2015 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34059.s: The bill modernises Dutch civil procedure by replacing the separate summons and petition procedures with a single procesinleiding and a simplified basic procedure centred on one written exchange and an oral hearing, with new statutory deadlines and greater judicial case management. It also moves civil and administrative litigation toward mandatory electronic filing and allows combined claims and petitions in one proceeding, with changes to bailiff service and default judgments.
34059.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and delegations as necessary to simplify and digitise civil procedure, speed up cases and make the judiciary more accessible.
q: The bill therefore contains a number of new deadlines, such as a deadline for filing a statement of defence.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat daarom een aantal nieuwe termijnen, zoals een termijn voor het indienen van een verweerschrift.
d: exceptions to mandatory electronic filing of documents
rules on digital traffic with the court and the digital case system
p: The judge may depart from the basic procedure, altering deadlines and hearing structure, in consultation with the parties, giving the court more case-management discretion.
Artikel I, Art. 111 lid 2 onder h / Art. 112 Rv

Claimants become responsible for serving the summons themselves, and the mandatory bailiff service for defendants is no longer required, shifting service burdens onto the citizen while retaining a default-judgment safeguard.

parties: Asks about security of digital case files, dependence on DigiD, and the realism of the timetable and expected savings.
What has the government done to rule out these scenarios?
Wat heeft de regering gedaan om deze scenario’s uit te sluiten?
Asks whether digitisation impedes access to justice for citizens and small entities without digital means, and whether oral hearings are sufficiently safeguarded under Article 6 ECHR.
To what extent are the interests of citizens who are not sufficiently able to litigate digitally taken into account?
In hoeverre wordt er rekening gehouden met de belangen van burgers die niet voldoende in staat zijn via de digitale weg te procederen?
Raises concerns about access to justice costs, the timing of hearings and judgments, and whether parties are adequately informed of procedural consequences.
However, this does not mean the same as financially more accessible.
Dit betekent echter niet hetzelfde als financieel toegankelijker.
Asks for oversight of the KEI programme's cost, governance, ICT expertise, procurement with spir-it, and requests the business case and reviews to be shared with parliament.
Was there an open tender for the KEI programme, or was it awarded privately to spir-it, the judiciary's ICT company?
Heeft er een open aanbestedingstraject plaatsgevonden voor het Programma KEI of is dit onderhands toebedeeld aan spir-it, het ICT-bedrijf voor de rechtspraak?
Asks about privacy and fraud safeguards for the digital file, and about the lack of verification of data supplied by the claimant.
Why is no provision made for checking the data the claimant supplies?
Waarom is niet voorzien in een controle van de gegevens die de eiser opgeeft?
Welcomes modernisation but asks how legal protection of persons served informally is ensured and how identification and outage procedures will work.

How is the legal protection of the person summoned guaranteed, for example by ensuring that the letter or e-mail has reached the defendant, now that it no longer has to be served in person by the bailiff?

Hoe wordt de rechtsbescherming gewaarborgd van degene die wordt opgeroepen, bijvoorbeeld door zeker te stellen dat de brief of e-mail is aangekomen bij de verweerder, nu deze niet langer in persoon door de deurwaarder hoeft te worden betekend?
Asks for privacy information duties, control over dissemination of audio-visual recordings, and periodic evaluation of security.
These members ask whether it is ensured that parties with access to digital audio or video recordings cannot further disseminate them on the internet.
Deze leden vragen of wordt geborgd dat partijen die toegang hebben tot digitale beeld- of geluidopnamen deze niet verder kunnen verspreiden op internet
Asks whether a binding maximum decision period and hardship exceptions for digital procedure obligations should be introduced.
They ask whether it would not be better to include a final decision deadline within which the judge can still reach a judgment.
Zij vragen of het niet beter zou zijn een uiterste beslistermijn op te nemen waarbinnen de rechter alsnog tot een uitspraak kan komen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill to simplify and digitise civil and administrative procedure but advises decoupling digitisation from the procedural simplification, and raises financial, procedural and drafting objections. The government's reply largely accepts the technical and drafting points, explains why digitisation is linked to simplification, and adjusts the bill and explanatory memorandum where the advice was followed.
concerns: The Afdeling advises decoupling the digitisation of procedures from the simplification and uniformisation of procedural law, since digitisation is not a necessary precondition for simplification; the government rejects full decoupling on grounds of organisational burden and inconsistency with the new procedure.

The Afdeling asks for an adequate description and coverage of the financial consequences of the digitisation programme; the government adds information on a temporary financial contribution and ICT cost estimates.

The Afdeling asks for clarity on the choice between claim and request procedures and on the consequences of combined procedures; the government explains the combined procedure and adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that the Awb and Rv be harmonised on electronic signatures, time limits for witnesses, minutes of hearings and related provisions; the government follows most of these technical points.
The Afdeling makes numerous technical and redactional comments on the draft articles, which the government largely adopts.

34068.s: The bill introduces a per-day personal contribution for detainees, persons placed at the government's disposal, and parents or young adults in custody toward the costs of their stay, capped at €11,860 (detainees) and €11,680 (TBS), with the Minister collecting it and able to agree to debt-settlement waivers. It also extends a parental contribution to juvenile detention and amends the Civil Code-related insolvency rules so these contributions are not treated as debts from a conviction.
34068.j: The memorandum justifies the contributions by the high costs of detention caused by criminal conduct and the need for equal treatment across custodial regimes, and says decisions remain subject to judicial review before the administrative court.
q: Against the (wrongly set) contribution, the decision to grant or refuse a payment arrangement, deferral of payment or debt forgiveness, an objection can be lodged after an objection procedure with the administrative court.

Tegen de (verkeerd vastgestelde) eigen bijdrage, de beslissing om (g)een betalingsregeling te treffen, (geen) uitstel van betaling te verlenen of de schuld niet kwijt te schelden (zie hieronder) kan – na een bezwaarprocedure – worden opgekomen bij de bestuursrechter;
d: designation of organisation to collect contribution
indexation of maximum contribution amount to consumer price index
daily contribution rate and collection procedure
rules on power to cooperate in debt settlements
designation of organisation to collect contribution
indexation of maximum amount and contribution rules
parental contribution rules incl. amount, deadlines, collection, exemptions
designation of organisation to collect parental contribution
Minister may disapply or deviate from parental contribution rules on grounds of unfairness
p: Art. I, art. 7c; Art. II, art. 10c; Art. III, art. 7d(2)
The Minister gains discretion to waive or reduce collection of the contribution through debt-settlement agreements and, for parents, to disapply the rule on grounds of unfairness.
Art. I, art. 7b(5); Art. II, art. 10b(5)

The Minister may recover unpaid contributions directly from assets, income and property, applying enforcement provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure without a court order, with appeal to the administrative court available.

parties: Supports the principle that offenders should partly pay detention costs and considers implementation challenges outweighed by the bill's benefits.
They therefore support the purpose of the bill that whoever commits a criminal offence and is sentenced to detention must partly bear the resulting costs themselves.

Zij ondersteunen dan ook de strekking van het voorstel dat degene die een strafbaar feit heeft gepleegd en daarvoor wordt veroordeeld tot een verblijf in een penitentiaire inrichting of een tbs-instelling de daaruit voortvloeiende kosten deels zelf moet dragen.
Worries that high debts from the fee will increase recidivism and questions the effectiveness and the minister's discretion in debt settlements.
They share the concern that imposing own contributions will lead to higher debt burdens for former detainees and thereby harm resocialisation.
Zij delen de zorg die daar leeft dat het opleggen van eigen bijdragen zal leiden tot hogere schuldenlasten bij ex-gedetineerden en dat daardoor de resocialisatie geschaad wordt.
Opposes the bill as contrary to the resocialisation principle, pointing to debt accumulation and lack of accessible debt assistance.
These members consider it in any case contrary to the principle of resocialisation.
Deze leden achten het in ieder geval in strijd met het resocialisatiebeginsel.
Asks why no impact analysis on reasonable contribution levels was done, why advice was not acted on, and about low expected collection rates.
The said members ask the government to what extent it has considered amending or withdrawing this proposal on the basis of the advice received.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering in hoeverre zij op basis van de binnengekomen adviezen heeft overwogen onderhavig voorstel aan te passen of in te trekken.
Asks factual questions about detention costs, the 7 million euro revenue estimate, and treatment of TBS patients and life-sentenced prisoners.
Can the amount of 7 million euros be further substantiated?
Kan het bedrag van 7 miljoen euro nader worden onderbouwd?
Questions feasibility, the reversal of the 2008 cabinet position, and the empirical basis for the claim that debt is not criminogenic.
On the basis of what data or research does the government believe that this position is tenable for the target group of its bill?
Op grond van welke gegevens of onderzoek meent de regering dat die stellingname houdbaar is voor de doelgroep die zij met haar wetsvoorstel beoogt?
Supports the principle in principle but raises practical obstacles to implementation and asks for clarification of the bill's provisions.
Insofar as prisoners are able to, it is good that they are asked for a personal contribution to detention costs.
Voor zover gedetineerden ertoe in staat zijn, is het goed dat er van hen een eigen bijdrage in de kosten van detentie wordt gevraagd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the proposed per-day and procedural cost contributions for convicted persons, citing debt-driven recidivism risk, weak financial projections, and delegation and retroactivity concerns. The government's reply rejected the financial and recidivism objections in large part but adjusted the bill: the maximum contribution was set in law, the invoice timing and parental contribution were changed, and the electronic detention element was removed.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the projected net revenues and considers the financial justification incomplete, so the contributions should be abandoned.
The Afdeling warns that debt from the contributions raises recidivism and hinders resocialisation, and the government reply disputes the causal link while adding payment arrangements.
Essential elements such as the amount and the maximum contribution were delegated to an AMvB without sufficient justification.
Immediate effect for existing cases was insufficiently motivated and should be reconsidered with transitional law.
The cumulation with exclusion from social security benefits was not justified, and the contribution for parents of minors is disproportionate compared to the youth care rate.
Under EHRM article 6 the procedural cost contribution may amount to a criminal charge given its size, and this was not adequately explained.
The procedural contribution upon objection to a penal order may influence the accused's procedural choices, contrary to the bill's stated premise.

34085-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget (second supplementary budget) for the other high state bodies and the Governors' offices, adjusting appropriations for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, National Ombudsman and governor cabinets. It takes effect on 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: the need has become apparent to amend the budget of the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' Cabinets (IIB) for the year 2014
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs (IIB) alle voor het jaar 2014

34086.s: The bill reforms the enforcement of criminal sentences by shifting formal responsibility for execution from the public prosecution service to the Minister of Security and Justice, and introduces a unified regime for enforcement-stage court decisions. It also modernises service of judicial documents, allowing electronic service and centralised coordination, and gives the Minister power to end enforcement of non-remittable fines.
34086.j: The memorandum justifies centralising enforcement in the Minister by pointing to actual practice, where executive agencies already carry out enforcement, and to the need for more efficient and coordinated execution.
q: The proposed article 6:1:1 Sv better reflects the division of powers than the current article 553 Sv.
Het voorgestelde artikel 6:1:1 Sv geeft beter dan het huidige artikel 553 Sv de verdeling van bevoegdheden weer.
d: technical rules for postal, service and electronic transmission of judicial notices
designation of officials who may carry out service
delegation of Minister's enforcement powers to officials
detailed rules on enforcement, supervision, probation and profit distribution
p: Formal responsibility for enforcement of criminal decisions moves from the public prosecutor to the Minister, who gains control over execution decisions.
The Minister may end enforcement of non-remittable fines when no reasonable purpose is served, a discretionary power outside judicial control.
The prosecution service may require any person to provide information needed for service of judicial notices.

parties: Welcomes the bill's faster and more certain execution but asks whether legal safeguards are needed against increased political attention to individual cases after responsibility moves to the Minister.
The literature notes that the proposed change will most likely lead to more political attention for individual cases.
In de literatuur is opgemerkt dat de voorgestelde wijziging hoogstwaarschijnlijk zal leiden tot meer politieke aandacht voor individuele zaken.
Supports the bill's goals of faster start and effective execution of sentences and strengthened victim position, and asks practical questions about execution of sentences.
They too believe that the execution of sentences must start sooner, that execution must actually take place, and that the position of victims must be strengthened.

Ook zij zijn van mening dat met de tenuitvoerlegging van straffen sneller moet worden gestart, die tenuitvoerlegging ook daadwerkelijk moet plaatsvinden en dat de positie van slachtoffers daarin versterkt moet worden.
Worries that budget cuts to police, prosecution, judiciary and probation could undermine careful execution, and asks how the Minister will prevent political influence on execution decisions.
According to the Minister this is consistent with current practice, but how does he prevent the risk that decisions within execution are politically influenced more than now?
Volgens de Minister sluit dit aan bij de huidige praktijk, maar hoe voorkomt hij het risico dat beslissingen in het kader van de tenuitvoerlegging meer dan nu het geval is politiek worden beïnvloed?

Asks how the extra step of transmitting judgments to the Minister fits with faster execution, whether procedural consequences of missed deadlines should be codified, and how the bill fits with budget cuts.
As the Rvdr already indicates, this seems to be an additional step compared to current practice in the courts.
Zoals de Rvdr al aangeeft, lijkt hiermee sprake van een extra stap ten opzichte van de huidige rechtspraak.

Questions whether shifting responsibility to the Minister is a real shift or merely centralisation on paper, asks about sanctions for missed deadlines, and about self-reporting offenders who do not appear.
Is it not just more centralisation on paper?
Is het niet meer centralisatie op papier?

Notes that nearly all advisory bodies warn that execution moves further into the political sphere, doubts the government's denial of politicisation, and asks why full responsibility should shift to the Minister.

These members note that virtually all advisory bodies point out that the execution of sentences will thereby come much more into the political sphere than under the current practice of article 553 Sv.

Voornoemde leden constateren dat vrijwel alle adviesinstanties erop wijzen dat de executie van straffen daarmee veel meer in de politieke sfeer komt te liggen dan in de huidige praktijk van artikel 553 Sv het geval is.

Says shifting responsibility to the Minister brings execution into a more political context, misses an analysis of risks, and asks for further analysis and comparison with neighbouring countries; also asks how the subsistence minimum is applied in fine collection.
They miss in the explanatory memorandum an analysis of which dangers this entails, and find that referring to three individual past cases offers no guarantee that such a shift will not take place.

Zij missen in de toelichting een analyse welke gevaren dit met zich meebrengt en vinden het verwijzen naar drie individuele casus uit het verleden geen garantie bieden dat een dergelijke verschuiving niet plaats zal vinden.

Supports the general line of the bill and clearer execution rules, but asks whether the bill will actually increase the number of sentences executed and whether the rules on early release should be fundamentally reconsidered.
They do ask to what extent this bill can contribute to actually improving the number of sentences that are carried out.
Wel vragen zij in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel ertoe kan bijdragen dat ook het aantal vonnissen dat wordt uitgevoerd ook echt verbetert.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division praised the new enforcement book in the Code of Criminal Procedure but advised against three service fictions (service on a household member, on the legal aid lawyer, and on the employer) and against the criminal offence of failing to deliver a judicial notice, citing insufficient justification and privacy concerns. The government's reply reports that the three service fictions and the criminal offence were removed from the bill, and that the Council's concern on gijzeling for unpaid confiscation orders was followed.
concerns: Service on the employer was an disproportionate intrusion on privacy and burdened employer-employee relations, and was removed.
Necessity and effectiveness of the criminal offence for failing to deliver a judicial notice were not shown and it would undermine effective service; removed.
Service on the lawyer risked breaching the accused's right to be present under Article 6 ECHR and required a clearer choice mechanism; the fiction was removed.
Service on a person found at the registered address was insufficiently justified and imposed a heavy duty; the fiction was removed.

Gijzeling for unpaid confiscation orders was disproportionate compared to the one-year maximum for compensation orders and the history of dual punishment; the government now requires a court application.
The need for the retained rechtsgeding tot herkenning was unjustified; the government found it unused and removed the related article.
Redactional comments on article numbering and cross-references were adopted.

34176.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to implement EU Directive 2013/34/EU on annual financial statements, adjusting size thresholds, disclosure rules, audit requirements and terminology. It also creates a new article 2:392a enabling a general administrative order (AMvB) to set rules for country-by-country reporting of payments to governments by extractive and old-growth logging companies.
34176.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route by stating that it allows quick response to changes and that the imperative delegation was formulated on the advice of the Council of State.
q: The advantage of laying these rules down in a decree is that changes can be responded to quickly.
Het voordeel van het neerleggen van deze regels in een besluit is dat er snel op wijzigingen kan worden ingespeeld.
d: reporting of payments to governments by extractive and logging firms

parties: Asks about calculating size thresholds for group parents and explores reducing administrative burden for micro firms, without raising oversight or review concerns.
These members still have some questions and some suggestions for improvement.
Deze leden hebben nog enkele vragen en enkele suggesties tot verbetering.
Supports the goals but asks for a clearer definition of 'project' so citizens can monitor how governments spend extractive revenues, and for stronger, proportionate sanctions.

It has however become clear to these members that, for both investors and accountants, it is unclear to what extent this is an active investigative duty for the external auditor to identify material misstatements in the annual report and report them in the auditor's opinion.

Het is deze leden evenwel gebleken dat het, zowel bij beleggers als bij accountants, onduidelijk is in hoeverre dit een actieve onderzoeksplicht betreft voor de externe accountant om materiële onjuistheden in het jaarverslag te signaleren en daarover te rapporteren in de controleverklaring.
Welcomes transparency on payments to governments but questions whether the EUR 20,250 maximum fine is deterrent enough and asks why reporting is limited to extractive and logging sectors.
Under Article 51 of the Directive, EU Member States must provide for sanctions that are effective, proportionate and dissuasive.
Volgens artikel 51 van de Richtlijn dienen de EU-lidstaten te voorzien in sancties die doeltreffend, evenredig en afschrikkend zijn.
Asks what material misstatements the external auditor must report and whether the payments overview should be included in the audited management report to allow shareholder accountability.
These members would like the government's response to this, and also whether the Directive allows room for such an amendment.
Graag vernemen deze leden hierop een reactie van de regering en ook of de Richtlijn ruimte biedt voor een dergelijke wijziging.
Asks about the share of firms falling under micro thresholds, the rationale for specific criteria, and options for filing balance sheet data via the tax authority.
Can the government explain why it did not choose to introduce additional differentiation for new businesses?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom niet is gekozen voor het opstellen van additionele differentiatie voor nieuwe ondernemingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with the bill implementing the EU Accounting Directive in Book 2 of the Civil Code, but recommends terminology alignment and a mandatory, concretely bounded delegation basis for public-payments reporting in extractive and old-growth logging sectors. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adopting the terminology changes, the mandatory delegation and its concretisation, and the goodwill and disclosure clarifications, while declining to define jaarrekening by reference to the directive.
concerns: The optional delegation basis for public-payments reporting is made mandatory and concretised with reference to EU directives, as advised.
Terminology is aligned with the directive (bestuursverslag, uitzonderlijke omvang) to avoid divergent interpretation and ensure legal certainty.
Advice to define jaarrekening by reference to the directive's article 4 was not adopted because the content is already in Article 2:361 BW.
Information moved from overige gegevens to the jaarrekening notes is now explained in the explanatory memorandum, and the goodwill amortisation disclosure duty is limited to exceptional cases.

34194.s: The bill harmonises instruments in the Participatiewet and Ziektewet so that a national no-risk policy (no-riskpolis) for employers hiring people with work limitations is administered by UWV instead of municipalities, for the period up to 1 January 2021. It also adjusts related wage-cost subsidy, premium discount and WIA provisions, with a sunset date returning municipal competence in 2021.
34194.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary centralisation to UWV by referring to agreements with social partners and VNG and to the feasibility of UWV administration, with no specific justification for the ministerial rule-making power.
q: The bill includes a sunset provision so that the arrangement ends after five years.
In het wetsvoorstel is een horizonbepaling opgenomen waardoor de regeling na vijf jaar eindigt.
d: II A (Art. 8a, lid 2, onderdeel c Participatiewet)
municipal rules on compensation amount and duration for sick employees
rules on the UWV no-risk policy

parties: Wants harmonisation to respect the new division of powers under decentralisation and allow tailored arrangements between employers and municipalities/UWV, and opposes UWV protocols restricting employers' free choice of job coach.

Any harmonisation should, in the view of this faction, respect the new division of powers under decentralisation and allow as much tailored arrangement as possible between employers and municipalities/UWV.

Een eventuele harmonisatie dient wat de leden van genoemde fractie betreft de nieuwe verdeling van bevoegdheden onder de decentralisatie te respecteren en moet zoveel mogelijk maatwerk tussen werkgevers en gemeenten/Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) mogelijk maken.
Asks why the changes are time-limited to 2020 and whether they should be permanent, and questions the legal basis of the interim UWV-municipality arrangement for 2015.
Would it not have been more logical, given the importance the government attaches to harmonising these instruments and the urgent request from the Werkkamer, to make the changes permanent?

Zou het gezien het belang die de regering hecht aan de harmonisatie van deze instrumenten en het dringende verzoek van de Werkkamer hiertoe niet logischer zijn geweest om de wijzigingen permanent te maken?
Raises questions about implementation, consequences for the target group, and why beschut werk and other groups are excluded from the instruments.
What considerations does the government have for not making the beschut werk target group eligible for the instruments in this act?
Welke overwegingen heeft de regering om de doelgroep voor beschut werk niet in aanmerking te laten komen voor de instrumenten in deze wet?
Supports a level playing field and harmonisation but notes the proposal implies a restriction of municipal policy freedom that municipalities valued.
However, these members note that the VNG, via the Werkkamer, requests a restriction of municipal policy freedom, which municipalities placed great value on when the Participatiewet was introduced.

Wel merken deze leden op dat de VNG hiermee via de Werkkamer verzoekt om een inperking van de gemeentelijke beleidsvrijheid, waaraan gemeenten bij de invoering van de participatiewet juist zeer veel waarde hechtten.

Sees added value in harmonisation but notes persistent differences (loondispensatie unavailable to municipalities), and asks how the no-risk policy evaluation will be designed and whether it is part of the statute.
Asks the government why it does not want to make the instruments uniform on this point.
Vragen de regering waarom zij op dit punt het instrumentarium niet wil uniformeren.
Asks about timing of the job coach consultation, whether the Kamer will be informed of results, the evaluation scope, and how uncertainty over the no-risk policy's continuation is prevented.
Can the government indicate when the outcome of this consultation is expected and whether the Kamer will be informed of the result, these members ask.
Kan de regering aangeven wanneer de uitkomst van dit overleg wordt verwacht en of de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd over het resultaat, zo vragen deze leden.

Supports harmonisation of instruments and asks why the bill does not equalise the unfair differences between loondispensatie and loonkostensubsidie, and why employers lose the mobility bonus for leerwerkbedrijf placements.
They support harmonising instruments that help employers hire people with disabilities and believe further harmonisation should be considered.
Zij ondersteunen een harmonisatie van instrumenten die werkgevers ondersteunen bij het in dienst nemen van arbeidsgehandicapten.

34200-IV.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement (Slotwet) of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (section IV), recording realised figures against the original and supplementary budgets. It sets figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2014
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2014

34200-VI.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement (Slotwet) of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the related agency budget statement, adjusting appropriations and realised spending figures. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for the year 2014 (final budget act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2014 (Slotwet)

34239.s: The bill amends Boek 8 of the BES Civil Code so that the 1999 Montreal Convention on international air carriage applies to international and certain domestic flights from the BES islands, overriding conflicting provisions of the Wet luchtvervoer BES. It also repeals Article 1 of the Wet luchtvervoer BES, which contained an outdated reference to Article 66 of the Constitution.
34239.j: The memorandum justifies the change as aligning the domestic regime with the international convention and updating an obsolete constitutional reference; it contains no new executive powers to justify.
q: Since it is desirable that the statutory regulation of air transport within the Kingdom aligns with the statutory regulation of international air transport, the third paragraph of Article 1322 declares the Montreal Convention applicable by analogy to domestic air transport from the BES.

Aangezien het wenselijk is dat de wettelijke regeling van het luchtvervoer binnen het Koninkrijk aansluit bij de wettelijke regeling van het internationale luchtvervoer, wordt in het derde lid van artikel 1322 het Verdrag van Montreal van overeenkomstige toepassing verklaard

parties: The VVD supports harmonising passenger rights but asks whether compensation under EU rules applies to Caribbean passengers and whether drug-flight controls are affected; it raises no explicit check concern.
These members support the Minister's aim to bring unity to the passenger rights applicable to Caribbean Netherlands and European Netherlands.
Deze leden ondersteunen de inzet van de Minister eenheid te brengen in de passagiersrechten die van toepassing zijn op Caribisch Nederland en Europees Nederland.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised sending the bill implementing the Montreal Convention into Book 8 BW BES to parliament, but asked the government to better justify the claimed alignment with the Book 8 system of the European Netherlands and to explain which provisions of the Wet luchtvervoer BES are displaced. The government's reply accepted both points, explaining the systematic choice with precedents in Book 8 and adding clarifying text to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The alignment with the Book 8 system of the European Netherlands as justification needed further motivation, which the government supplied by citing earlier precedents for sea, road and air passenger transport.
The explanatory memorandum did not identify which provisions of the Wet luchtvervoer BES are displaced by the Convention or why they cannot lapse, and the memorandum was supplemented to address this.
A redactional remark asked for clarification in the explanatory memorandum about domestic air transport from the BES islands, which was incorporated.

34248.s: The bill abolishes the Centrale Commissie voor de statistiek (CCS), an oversight body for the Central Bureau voor de Statistiek, and transfers its programme-setting and advisory tasks to the Director-General of Statistics, who becomes the sole head of the CBS. It also requires the Minister to approve the multi-year and annual work programmes against financial and organisational conditions, while making the Director-General's independence and some oversight mechanisms more explicit.
34248.j: The memorandum justifies removing the CCS as an unnecessarily complex two-body structure and states that the Kaderwet framework and an explicit independence evaluation sufficiently safeguard the Director-General's independence.
q: The abolition of the CCS (currently 8 members) fits current agency policy of minimising separate statutory bodies to keep responsibilities and powers between Minister and agency as transparent as possible.

De opheffing van de CCS (momenteel bestaande uit 8 leden) past bij het huidige zbo-beleid om met het oog op een zo transparant mogelijke verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden en bevoegdheden tussen Minister en zbo zo min mogelijk te voorzien in andere wettelijke organen
d: Director-General adopts internal administrative regulation (bestuursreglement) on CBS structure and leadership
Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 2a, derde lid)
Rules on replacement of the Director-General
Director-General adopts multi-year programme, subject to ministerial approval
Director-General adopts annual work programme, subject to ministerial approval
Minister sets financial and organisational conditions standpoint for the multi-year programme
Further rules (nadere regels) under the Act
p: Artikel I, onderdelen E, F, H, M, T, V, W, X, AA (opheffing CCS)

Abolition of the CCS removes a separate supervisory body over the Director-General, leaving oversight to the Minister under the general Kaderwet framework, with a periodic evaluation of independence as a partial safeguard.
Artikel I, onderdeel I (art. 14, vijfde lid) en onderdeel J (art. 15, zesde lid)
The Minister's approval of programmes is limited to refusal on fit with financial and organisational conditions, and the conditions standpoint is sent to parliament.

parties: Questions whether abolishing the CCS is justified, asks for a better rationale, and asks how the independence of the data protection officer and the role of parliament are safeguarded.
The PvdA members require a better justification for abolishing the CCS than that 'every additional statutory supervisory body reduces transparency'.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie verlangen een betere onderbouwing voor de opheffing van de CCS dan dat «ieder extra wettelijk toezichthoudend orgaan de transparantie vermindert».

Disappointed that the CCS advice on an external oversight body with a statutory basis was not followed, and argues that removing advisory roles in appointment, suspension and dismissal of the DG creates subordination to the Minister.
The SP members are disappointed that this advice was not heeded and ask the cabinet to argue why this was not done.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn teleurgesteld dat aan dit advies geen gehoor is gegeven en verzoeken het kabinet te beargumenteren waarom dit niet is gebeurd.
Worries that the Minister may gain too much influence over the CBS, may give direct instructions to the CBS or DG, and asks about consequences for independence under EU standards.
These members also ask whether, through this bill, the Minister would not gain too much influence over the CBS.
Tevens vragen deze leden of de Minister door middel van dit wetsvoorstel niet teveel invloed krijgt op het CBS.
Asks how the independence of the CBS remains guaranteed and what the bill means for the CBS plan to add interpretation to published figures, plus financial consequences.
The D66 members ask the government to explain further how the independence of the CBS remains guaranteed.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de onafhankelijkheid van het CBS gewaarborgd blijft.

34257.s: The bill amends the Civil Code, Code of Criminal Procedure and Criminal Code to extend compensation for non-pecuniary loss (affectieschade) to close relatives of persons who suffer serious and lasting injury or die, via fixed amounts set by general administrative order. It also lets such relatives and third parties claim in criminal proceedings and extends the Violent Offences Compensation Fund to cover them.
34257.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of fixed amounts and indexation to executive rules as allowing easy future adjustment to changing social views and practice.
q: The amount of the sums will be set by general administrative order, so that any future adjustment, for example due to changing social views, can be made relatively easily.

De omvang van de bedragen wordt bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vastgesteld, zodat een in de toekomst eventueel wenselijke aanpassing daarvan, bijvoorbeeld in verband met veranderende maatschappelijke inzichten, betrekkelijk eenvoudig zal kunnen plaatsvinden.
d: I.C art. 6:107 lid 1 onder b, lid 3 BW
fixed compensation amounts and criteria for serious and lasting injury
fixed compensation amounts for relatives upon death
further rules specifying serious and lasting injury
p: I.C art. 6:107 lid 1 onder b, lid 2 BW
Extends compensation rights to a defined class of close relatives, with the level of amounts and criteria left to executive rules and judicial interpretation of 'close personal relationship'.

parties: Asks how the 'ernstig en blijvend letsel' criterion is to be interpreted and on what data the 70% threshold rests, and whether intent should affect compensation levels.

On the basis of what data and information has the government assumed that a permanent functional impairment of 70% or more will in practice constitute serious and permanent injury as referred to in the bill?

Op basis van welke gegevens en informatie heeft de regering aangenomen dat bij een blijvende functiestoornis van 70% of meer in de praktijk sprake zal zijn van ernstig en blijvend letsel als bedoeld in het wetsvoorstel?
Welcomes the bill but questions whether criminal courts will decide victim claims as often as hoped and how the scope of 'buiten de rechter om' is to be understood.
What is meant by 'can be carried out outside the court'?
Wat wordt bedoeld met «buiten de rechter om kunnen worden uitgevoerd»?
Fears that relatives will in practice be unable to claim affectieschade in criminal proceedings due to timing, costs and lack of free legal aid, leaving the right a dead letter.
They even fear a dead letter where serious and permanent injury is concerned.
Zij vrezen zelfs een dode letter waar het gaat om ernstig en blijvend letsel.
Asks whether the bill truly gives relatives legal victim status and warns against prosecutors and courts invoking the disproportionate-burden argument too readily.
They also ask whether the government agrees that the prosecution service and judiciary must guard against too readily invoking this legal (art. 361 Sv) and logistical argument
Zij vragen de regering ook of zij de mening deelt dat door het OM en Rechtspraak moet worden gewaakt voor al te snel gebruikmaking van dit juridische (art. 361 Sv) en logistieke argument
Asks technical questions on late-emerging permanence of injury, limitation periods and the reclaiming of compensation if injury later proves non-permanent.
The members ask how matters are handled if it only becomes apparent at a much later stage that the injury is permanent.
De genoemde leden vragen hoe gehandeld wordt indien in een veel later stadium pas blijkt dat het letsel blijvend is.
Raises principled and practical questions on the purpose of financial redress alongside criminal punishment and the effect on sentencing and the collectability of damages from offenders.
Can the government clarify why, in its view, financial redress is necessary alongside the retribution that could take place through criminal law?
Kan de regering verduidelijken waarom financiële genoegdoening naar haar mening noodzakelijk is, naast de vergelding die via het strafrecht zou kunnen plaatsvinden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill to allow compensation for affectieschade (non-pecuniary grief damages) to relatives of victims who died or suffered serious lasting injury, and to facilitate joinder of such claims in criminal proceedings. The government's nader rapport accepted the technical remarks: it extended the criminal joinder provision to transferred damage and amended the Wsg, but did not fully adopt the request to abolish the notification requirement for transfer under general title.
concerns: The draft article on criminal joinder (art. 51f Sv) did not cover transferred damage from injury, contrary to the explanatory memorandum; the government corrected it to include the persons under art. 107(1)(a) and (b) BW.

The Afdeling asked for a justification for keeping the notification requirement for transfer of smartengeld under general title; the government kept the rule and gave a reasoned defence, though it did not fully explain the choice in the way the Afdeling asked.

The bill did not amend the Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven, so relatives of seriously injured victims could not claim from the fund; the government amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.

34266.s: The bill amends the Wet op de vaste boekenprijs (Fixed Book Price Act) to modernise the definition of 'boek' so that accompanying related electronic services are covered, to include music publications in the exemption for free copies, and to tighten the timing rules for adjusting or abolishing the book club price. It makes only technical changes to the Act and contains no new executive powers.
q: Having considered that, following the second evaluation of the Fixed Book Price Act, it is desirable to amend that Act to modernise the definition of book and make technical changes.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is om naar aanleiding van de tweede evaluatie van de Wet op de vaste boekenprijs die wet aan te passen

parties: The VVD considers the change too limited to promote innovation and bundled sales, and asks whether the unclear definition of 'hoofdproduct' could expose bookshops to fines from the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Does the government agree with the members that an unclear definition with possible fines as a result still inhibits innovation?
Is de regering het met de leden eens dat een onduidelijke definitie met mogelijke boetes tot gevolg de innovatie alsnog remt?
The D66 supports the bill and the goal of the fixed book price, but asks the government to explain its expectation of no substitution and how the research on substitution will be designed.

Can the government explain on what this expectation that no substitution will take place is based, and why the government nevertheless chooses to investigate whether the modernisation of the concept of book does not lead to substitution?

Kan de regering toelichten waar deze verwachting, dat er geen substitutie zal plaatsvinden, op is gebaseerd, en waarom de regering er dan toch voor kiest te onderzoeken of de modernisering van het begrip boek niet leidt tot substitutie?

34275.s: The bill establishes a general child benefit (kinderbijslag BES) for residents of the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, with the amount set at USD 38 per child and adjustable by ministerial regulation. It sets eligibility rules, payment, suspension, reclaim and administrative fines, and assigns implementation to the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
34275.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for simplicity, feasibility and tailoring to the small public bodies, and by the need to adjust amounts and control rules in practice.
d: further rules on child residence and foreign-residence exceptions
adjusting child benefit amounts for price changes and special circumstances
details of benefit refusal by general administrative order
rules on reclaiming wrongly paid benefit
enforcement and offsetting of administrative fines
rules on when reclaim must take place
p: The minister may change benefit amounts by ministerial regulation, including increases in special circumstances, without parliamentary approval.
The minister may temporarily or permanently refuse benefit for non-compliance, with an exception where no fault exists.
The minister may suspend payment on clear indications or a reasonable suspicion, after giving the recipient a chance to respond in some cases.
The minister may reclaim wrongly paid benefit, with a preference claim ranking ahead of other creditors.
The minister may impose administrative fines up to the benefit loss or a criminal-law fine ceiling, with the amount set by general administrative order.
Data from education and social insurance bodies must be shared free of charge with the minister for implementation.

parties: Asks the government to justify the need for a general child benefit, the causes of poverty on the BES islands, and how many cases the eligibility exception covers.
Can the government give a fuller justification for why a general child benefit for the BES islands is appropriate?
Kan de regering uitvoeriger motiveren waarom een algemene kinderbijslag voor de BES-eilanden op zijn plaats is?
Asks for clarification of the ministerial-regulation power allowing deviation from the five-year residence requirement and whether families could face negative income effects.
Can the government further explain the conditions and the way in which deviation can be made?
Kan de regering de voorwaarden en de manier waarop er afgeweken kan worden nader toelichten?
Questions why an income-dependent scheme was not chosen, which would better support lower incomes, and asks for distributional effects.
Does the government not consider it desirable that lower incomes are supported better, more effectively and more in the costs of the child?
Acht de regering het niet juist wenselijk dat lagere inkomens beter, effectiever en meer worden ondersteund in de kosten van het kind?
Supports the goal of income-independent child benefit but asks for justification of the single flat amount and the 38 USD level.
They lack a further motivation here.
Zij missen hier een nadere motivatie.
Asks for an evaluation after entry into force on effectiveness against poverty, implementation, numbers and costs, and how privacy is safeguarded in data exchange between agencies.
These members ask the government how privacy is safeguarded in this exchange of data.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe de privacy gewaarborgd wordt bij deze uitwisseling van gegevens.
Welcomes the bill as implementing the motion and reaching more families, and asks for clarity on communication and help with application forms.
These members are grateful that this implements the earlier motion Schouten/Van Laar.
Deze leden zijn dankbaar dat hiermee uitvoering wordt gegeven aan de eerder ingediende motie-Schouten/Van Laar
Asks why the benefit is not differentiated by age or number of children and whether 38 USD is sufficient given local living costs.
These members would like to know why no child benefit differentiated by age has been provided for.
Graag vernemen deze leden waarom er niet is voorzien in een kinderbijslag die is gedifferentieerd naar leeftijd

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the child benefit amount of USD 38 per child per month for the Caribbean Netherlands be independently motivated and that the lack of differentiation between islands be explained, before sending the bill to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) argues the amount is justified by equivalence with the former fiscal allowance and the Schouten-Van Laar motion, explains the uniform amount by historical practice, and notes that differentiation is already provided for in the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling found the amount of the child benefit was not independently motivated but only referenced to the former fiscal allowance and a motion, and asked for a separate justification; the government considered further motivation unnecessary.

The Afdeling asked why no distinction was made between the islands as is done for widow and orphan pensions; the government explained the uniform amount and noted that differentiation is provided for in articles 9 and 10 for future indexation.

Several wording and technical adjustments were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum, including the definition of foster child, the rules on children in publicly funded institutions, and the entry-into-force provision.

34347.s: The bill amends the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs to require a statutory complaints procedure with an independent complaints committee at vocational institutions, and to give student councils advisory power over school cost policy. It also allows the Minister to grant time-limited (eighteen-month) diploma recognition to certain institutions, shortens sanction procedures, and tightens recognition rules for non-publicly funded institutions.
34347.j: The memorandum justifies the time-limited recognition as a way to reduce risks of low-quality education and to give students an informed choice.
q: To prevent as far as possible that students follow courses that do not meet the standards and are therefore of insufficient quality, this bill provides for the possibility of granting diploma recognition for a course for a period of eighteen months.

Om zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen dat studenten opleidingen volgen die niet aan de standaarden voldoen en dus van onvoldoende kwaliteit zijn, wordt met dit wetsvoorstel voorzien in de mogelijkheid om diploma-erkenning voor een opleiding te geven voor de periode van anderhalf jaar.
d: time-limited diploma recognition decisions for certain institutions
p: The Minister may grant time-limited diploma recognition for eighteen months to new or recently warned institutions, with automatic extension unless the Minister withdraws it."

parties: Questions why the recognition regime for non-funded vocational programmes is stricter than for publicly funded ones and whether the government's justification is proportionate.
On the adjustment of diploma recognition for non-funded programmes, the members are critical and not convinced by the government's proposal.
Ten aanzien van de aanpassing diploma-erkenning voor niet-bekostigde opleidingen zijn de leden kritisch en niet overtuigd door het voorstel van de regering.
Welcomes statutory complaint rights as strengthening the position of students and asks whether the government's 'inspanningsverplichting' wording weakens institutional responsibility.
They value the statutory anchoring of the complaint right that the bill aims for, mainly as a change that should strengthen the position of mbo students.
Zij waarderen de wettelijke verankering van het klachtrecht, die het wetsvoorstel beoogt, vooral als een wijziging die de positie van de mbo’ers moet versterken.
Asks whether complaint committee decisions are binding, what appeal routes exist, and why participant councils lack consent rights on school costs.
Can the government further explain whether the decisions of the complaints committee are binding?
Kan de regering voorts toelichten of de uitspraken van de klachtencommissie bindend zijn?
Asks whether statutory anchoring of the complaint scheme is necessary and what problems it solves, and questions the added value of advisory rights on school costs.
These members are of the view that it must always be carefully weighed whether a statutory regulation is necessary or not.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat steeds goed moet worden afgewogen of een wettelijke regeling nodig is of niet.
Asks why an ombudsman was not chosen for complaints and why participant councils were not given consent rights on school costs.
Furthermore, the members ask the government to explain further why an ombudsman was not chosen.
Voorts vragen de leden de regering nader toe te lichten waarom niet gekozen is voor een ombudsman.
Asks what concrete changes statutory anchoring of complaint rights will bring and what the expected effect on expensive programmes will be.
The said members ask what changes the statutory safeguarding of the complaint right will bring about in practice.
De genoemde leden vragen welke veranderingen de wettelijke borging van het klachtenrecht in de praktijk teweeg zal brengen.

Asks why the sector should not first be given time to resolve complaints itself, and why the government did not take a more restrained stance on non-funded education and differed in complaint procedures across sectors.

These members ask why, in view of these developments, it does not make sense to first wait and see whether the intended goal can be achieved by the sector itself on the basis of the new possibilities.
Deze leden vragen waarom het gezien deze ontwikkelingen niet in de rede ligt eerst af te wachten of het beoogde doel door de sector zelf op grond van de nieuwe mogelijkheden kan worden bereikt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill amending the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs to parliament after remarks on the motivation of the student complaints right and the advisory right on school costs were addressed. The minister's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, the Awb was applied in a tailored way, and most of the drafting and diploma-recognition points were adopted.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for the motivation of the complaints regime to be updated, since the cited Inspectie research and JOB data predate recent improvements; the government supplemented and updated the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling doubted the added value of an advisory right on school-cost policy and asked for it to be justified; the government expanded the justification but kept the advisory right.
The Afdeling asked the government to explain why the Awb is applied only in part to MBO institutions rather than directly to public institutions; the government explained the tailoring rationale.
The Afdeling asked for the exclusion of Awb article 9:7(1)(f) to be reconsidered; the provision was kept but the explanatory text was adjusted.
The Afdeling asked that the diploma-recognition term be framed as a derogation from the main rule of indefinite recognition and that a fiction be avoided; the government amended article 1.4.1.
The Afdeling considered the fifth paragraph of article 1.4.1 superfluous; the government kept it but clarified its purpose in the commentary.
The Afdeling made several redactional suggestions to the bill text, which the government incorporated.

34365.s: The bill implements the 2006 EU-Iceland-Norway surrender agreement by applying the Dutch Surrender Act's procedural chapters to European arrest warrants from Norway and Iceland. It makes refusal of surrender mandatory for offences committed in the Netherlands or outside its territory where Dutch law would not allow prosecution, subject to a prosecutor's request to waive refusal reviewed for reasonableness by the court.
34365.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural extension as necessary to implement the agreement, and the waiver option as allowing concentration of prosecution in one state for good administration of justice.
q: It is proposed to make the refusal grounds described in the first paragraph mandatory rather than optional.
Voorgesteld wordt om de in het eerste lid omschreven weigeringsgronden een verplicht in plaats van een facultatief karakter te geven.
d: entry into force set by royal decree
p: Makes refusal of surrender mandatory in listed cases, strengthening protection against surrender, with the prosecutor able to request waiver subject to court review of reasonableness.

parties: Asks whether the political offence exception will be narrowed and how the bill differs in practice from earlier arrangements, touching on limits to surrender.
Can the government confirm this? Can it also be confirmed that this therefore implies that surrender for political offences will not be restricted?
Kan de regering dit bevestigen? Kan voorts worden bevestigd dat dit dus impliceert dat de overlevering voor politieke delicten niet zal worden beperkt?
Questions whether surrender of persons for relatively minor offences can be prevented and why dual criminality depends on Norway's or Iceland's choice.
How will it be prevented that surrender takes place in cases involving relatively minor offences?
Hoe zal worden voorkomen dat overlevering plaatsvindt van gevallen waar het relatief kleine strafbare feiten betreft?
Asks why the Council of State's advice to delete article 2 was followed and requests examples of flagrant fundamental-rights violations that could block surrender.
They further ask the government to give examples of 'flagrant violations of fundamental rights' that could lead to non-surrender of the person concerned.
Zij vragen de regering voorts voorbeelden te geven van «flagrante schendingen van de fundamentele rechten» hetgeen zou kunnen leiden tot niet-overlevering van de betrokken persoon.
Asks why Netherlands makes its dual criminality decision depend on Norway and Iceland and requests figures on extradition requests.
How many extradition requests does the Netherlands make to these countries annually?
Hoeveel uitleveringsverzoeken doet Nederland op jaarbasis aan deze landen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill implementing the EU-Iceland-Norway surrender agreement, but objected to the unnecessary duplicate refusal ground in article 2 and asked for better justification of article 3. The government's reply followed the advice by deleting article 2 and explained why article 3 is retained as written out in full.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the refusal ground in article 2 duplicates directly applicable treaty provisions without explanation, and advised deleting it, which the government did.
The Afdeling asked for justification of why article 13 of the Surrender Act was copied rather than applied by reference, and the government justified its choice for transparency.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks on terminology and placement, largely adopted by the government.

34374.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Civil Code and the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte so that a tenant's rent-related household income declaration is attached to rental proposals and the tax inspector must issue such a declaration to a landlord on request. It also makes a conforming wording change and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: Subject to article 12 of the Advisory Referendum Act, this law enters into force at a time to be set by royal decree.
Onder toepassing van artikel 12 van de Wet raadgevend referendum treedt deze wet in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether sanctions on landlords for misuse are still needed and how often misuse occurred in 2015, and whether the change creates an extra barrier for landlords.
These members ask the government whether there is indeed still reason to impose the mentioned sanctions on landlords in case of misuse.
Deze leden vragen de regering of er inderdaad nog steeds aanleiding is om de genoemde sancties aan verhuurders op te leggen in het geval van misbruik.
Asks whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority was consulted on the bill and what its advice was, given the sensitivity of the data.
Because of the sensitivity of the requested data, these members would like to know whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority was consulted on this bill and what its advice was.
Deze leden willen vanwege de gevoeligheid van de opgevraagde gegevens graag weten of de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens geconsulteerd is over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hoe hun advies luidde.

Accepts the clarification and tougher enforcement against landlords, but raises strong privacy concerns about excessive requests and asks for figures, misuse, and links with the municipal population register.
The SP members ask how the bill relates, in the context of data provision by the Tax Authority, to the approach to housing fraud.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe het voorliggende wetsvoorstel in het kader tot de gegevensverstrekking bij de Belastingdienst zich verhoudt tot de aanpak van woonfraude.
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
The CDA members have taken note with interest of the bill and have no further questions or remarks.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennis genomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben verder geen vragen en opmerkingen.
Regards unlawful requests for income statements as a serious privacy violation and asks how often they occurred and whether violations could be mapped, not only punished.
The D66 members consider unlawfully requesting an income statement a very serious violation of privacy.
De leden van de D66-fractie achten het onrechtmatig opvragen van een inkomensverklaring een zeer ernstige schending van de privacy.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises sending the bill amending Boek 7 BW and the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte on tax data disclosure to parliament, but advises deleting the use of the expedited procedure under article 12 Wrr for the entry-into-force provision, since the changes are purely technical. The minister did not follow this advice, arguing the changes must take effect before the Belastingdienst portal opens on 1 February 2016, while making a non-substantive redactional change to clarify the obligation to provide the income statement.
