concerns: The Afdeling considers that the use of the expedited entry-into-force procedure under article 12 Wrr is unjustified for purely technical changes and advises deleting it; the government did not delete it but made a redactional clarification.

34383.s: The bill amends Article 2:391(5) of the Dutch Civil Code so that the mandatory management report of large companies must include a non-financial statement, in line with EU Directive 2014/95/EU. It also provides a legal basis for an general administrative order (AMvB) to set detailed rules on the content, publication and audit of that non-financial statement.
34383.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB basis by stating that the detailed rules on the non-financial statement will follow the same approach as the existing delegation for corporate governance statements, and points to the Besluit bekendmaking niet-financiële informatie.
q: Article 2:391(5) of the Civil Code already provides a basis for an general administrative order to set more detailed rules on the content, disclosure and audit of a corporate governance statement.

In artikel 2:391 lid 5 BW is een grondslag opgenomen om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur in het bijzonder nadere voorschriften te stellen omtrent de inhoud, de openbaarmaking en het accountantsonderzoek
d: detailed rules on content, disclosure and audit of non-financial statement

parties: Questions the added value and the cost burden of the mandatory non-financial statement and asks about the pros and cons of an auditor review role on its content.

The VVD members note that an unqualified extension of the obligation to include non-financial information in a management report will substantially increase the burden on organisations falling within the scope of the directive.','concerns_en':'Questions the added value and the cost burden of the mandatory non-financial statement and asks about the pros and cons of an auditor review role on its content.'}, {

De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat een ongeclausuleerde uitbreiding van de verplichting niet-financiële informatie op te nemen in een bestuursverslag een substantiële vergroting van de lasten voor de organisaties die onder de reikwijdte van de richtlijn vallen, zal betekenen.

34446.s: The bill amends the primary, special and secondary education acts so that the individual support part of a pupil's development plan (handelingsdeel) may only be set once agreement with the parents is reached, with parallel changes for expertise centres. It also adds an evaluation clause requiring a report to parliament within three years.
34446.j: The memorandum justifies the agreement requirement by pointing to the need for consensus with parents, with disputes referred to a national complaints committee and education consultants.
q: It is further prescribed that schools may only set the development plan after consultation aimed at agreement has been held with the parents.
Voorgeschreven is verder dat scholen het ontwikkelingsperspectief pas vaststellen nadat op overeenstemming gericht overleg met de ouders is gevoerd.
p: ARTIKEL I A (artikel 40a lid 2 WPO); ARTIKEL II C (artikel 41a lid 2 WEC); ARTIKEL III A (artikel 26 lid 2 WVO)

Schools must reach agreement with parents before setting the individual support part of a development plan, a constraint on the school authority's unilateral decision-making rather than a shift to the executive.

parties: Questions whether requiring parental agreement undermines teachers' professional freedom and creates legal uncertainty and possible impasses; asks about the role of the dispute procedure.
They ask whether the government acknowledges that this construction may lead to unclarity, as the Council of State also states.
Zij vragen of de regering erkent dat deze constructie tot onduidelijkheid kan leiden zoals ook de Raad van State stelt.
Supports a stronger role for parents as full conversation partners and asks whether the inspectorate will supervise schools that do not involve parents.
The PvdA members are of the view that parents must be able to think along as full conversation partners about the care and support of their children at school.](Note: see evidence_en)
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van oordeel dat ouders als volwaardige gesprekspartner moeten kunnen meedenken over de zorg en ondersteuning van hun kinderen op school.
Supports the bill and stronger parental influence, but asks about the procedure when agreement fails, including mediation by education consultants and the dispute committee.
These members also ask what procedure must be followed if school and parents do not reach agreement and can call on mediation by education consultants.
Deze leden vragen tevens wat de te volgen procedure is als school en ouders er niet samen uitkomen en een beroep kunnen doen op bemiddeling door onderwijsconsulenten.
Asks for quantitative justification of the amendment, who has final decision power in an impasse, and how the bill fits with reducing bureaucracy.
Who has the power to enforce a decision in such a situation?
Wie heeft er in een dergelijke situatie doorzettingsmacht?

Supports a better balance between parents and schools but questions the position of parents when no agreement is reached, the binding nature of the dispute committee's ruling, and whether choosing another school is realistic.
They ask to what extent parents have a position if agreement unexpectedly cannot be reached.
Zij vragen in hoeverre de ouders een positie hebben als er onverhoopt geen overeenstemming kan worden bereikt.
Asks why parental consent is required for the handelingsdeel while only consultation applies to the ontwikkelingsperspectief, and warns of undesirable juridification and funding issues.
Does this bill not lead to undesirable juridification, while parents must precisely reach a desired outcome through conversation with the school?
Leidt dit wetsvoorstel niet tot onwenselijke juridisering, terwijl ouders juist in gesprek met de school tot een gewenste uitkomst moeten komen?
Questions the necessity of the bill given the lack of described problems, its speed of amendment after the Passend Onderwijs law, and the credibility of government consistency.
These members ask whether they may rightly conclude that the need for this proposal is not so much prompted by problems or bottlenecks, but only by political choices.
Deze leden vragen of zij hieruit terecht mogen opmaken dat de noodzaak voor dit voorstel niet zozeer is ingegeven door problemen of knelpunten, maar enkel door politieke keuzes.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the bill to the Tweede Kamer, arguing that requiring parental consent for the handelingsdeel within a year of passend onderwijs is insufficiently justified, unstable regulation, and blurs the school's professional autonomy. The government's reply disputes the impasse concern, explains that schools must still provide support without consent, and adds a three-year evaluation clause.
concerns: The Council argues the bill amends the handelingsdeel procedure too soon after passend onderwijs, undermining regulatory stability; the government accepts the point in principle but says the motion required implementation and adds an evaluation clause.

The Council finds no evidence of serious problems after introduction of passend onderwijs that justify the amendment; the government does not accept this and points to parental support for the bill in the consultation.

The Council says that without consent the school cannot implement the handelingsdeel, creating an impasse and possible exclusion of the child; the government argues schools still must provide support and the bill does not impose a veto.
The Council raised redactional points on article numbering and specification of subsections, which the government adopted and corrected.

34455.s: The bill implements EU Market Abuse Regulation 596/2014 and Directive 2014/57/EU into the Dutch Wft and Wet op de economische delicten by repealing the old national market-abuse provisions and expanding supervisor sanction powers, including higher administrative fines (up to 10% of turnover), temporary trading bans for natural persons, and mandatory publication of sanction decisions. It also adds a general power to lay down further rules by AMvB for the proper execution of EU regulations.
34455.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and higher fines by EU harmonisation requirements and the need for effective, deterrent enforcement of the regulation.
q: The aim is to harmonise the enforcement of the regulation's rules as much as possible.
Het doel is om de handhaving van de normen uit de verordening zoveel mogelijk te harmoniseren.
d: further rules for execution of EU regulations on financial markets
fine amounts and categories for supervisory breaches
raising turnover-based fine percentage to 15% for EU-required cases
further rules on exercise of supervisory powers in chapter 1.4
procedures for reporting infringements of the market abuse regulation
p: Maximum administrative fines are raised and the amounts per category are set by AMvB, with EU-required increases allowed without statutory ceiling.
Supervisors may impose turnover-based fines up to 10% of net turnover, raisable to 15% by AMvB, for firms above a threshold.
The supervisor may temporarily ban natural persons from trading for their own account for up to one year, renewable once.
Mandatory publication of sanction decisions is extended, with a five-day waiting period and exceptions, and urgent publication allowed without waiting for court interim relief.

parties: Asks why the bill delegates detailed rules to AMvB rather than statute, how Parliament will be involved, and whether a pre-consultation procedure exists, citing the Council of State's advice to limit delegation.
Choices in legislation and regulation must ultimately be made by the House of Representatives.
Keuzes in wet- en regelgeving moeten uiteindelijk door de Tweede Kamer worden gemaakt.
Welcomes tougher sanctions for economic offences and asks about scope of turnover-based fines and the ban on exercising functions, without raising check concerns.
Adding a sanction of 10% of turnover is a very serious sanction.
De toevoeging van een sanctie van 10% van de omzet is een zeer serieuze sanctie.
Asks why recidivism fines are not doubled for large firms and whether whistleblower financial incentives will be used, and questions the added value of AFM access to telecom data.
The SP members would like to hear from the government what the added value of this would be.
Graag horen de leden van de SP-fractie van de regering wat hiervan de toegevoegde waarde zou zijn?

Raises concern about a possible legal gap in seizure powers, asks the government to act quickly, and asks how delegation grounds are chosen, including whether wiretapping needs judicial authorisation.
The CDA members want to prevent criminals and law violators from escaping their deserved punishment through gaps in the law and therefore ask the government to quickly introduce legislation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen voorkomen dat criminelen en wetsovertreders door mazen in de wet onder hun verdiende straf uitkomen en vragen de regering dan ook snel met wetgeving te komen.
Asks for comparisons of member state sanctions, fine levels, and expected administrative burdens of the new rules.
The PVV members want to know which member states have not introduced criminal sanctions for violations of the national law implementing the 2003 market abuse directive.

Ook willen de leden van de PVV-fractie weten welke lidstaten geen strafrechtelijke sancties hebben ingevoerd voor schendingen van het nationale rechte dat uitvoering geeft aan de richtlijn marktmisbruik 2003.
Asks the government's reasons for not granting the AFM power to freeze accounts, noting other member states allow it and cross-border transfers of funds.
On the second point, the possibility of freezing (securities) accounts, it is not clear to these members why the decision on this has been postponed.
Ten aanzien van het tweede punt, de mogelijkheid om (effecten)rekeningen te kunnen bevriezen, is het deze leden niet duidelijk waarom de beslissing hierover wordt doorgeschoven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill implementing EU Regulation 596/2014 and Directive 2014/57/EU on market abuse may proceed, but that the delegation basis in article I(B) for general administrative-order rules implementing EU regulations is too broad and should be limited to concretely named provisions of the Wft. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects narrowing to named provisions as impractical, instead restricting the delegation to two policy areas and to the subject matter regulated by the relevant regulation, and notes that any extension of AFM powers would require a new advice request.
concerns: The delegation basis for general administrative-order rules implementing EU regulations is too broad and should be limited to concretely named Wft provisions; the government retains a general basis but limits it by policy area and subject matter.
Redactional remarks, including specifying 'personen' as natuurlijke personen or rechtspersonen and detailing the transposition table per article, have been incorporated.

The Afdeling asks to be consulted if the bill is amended to grant the AFM powers to access telecom traffic data and freeze securities accounts; the government states this is not part of the bill and the Afdeling will be asked for advice if needed.

34491.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to add and harmonise rules on board (bestuur) and supervision for associations, cooperatives, mutual guarantee companies and foundations, including a monistic board option and a regime of board and supervisory director liability. It also modernises the court-ordered dismissal of foundation directors and extends it to supervisory directors of foundations.
34491.j: The memorandum justifies the new rules as clarifying an incomplete legal framework and aligning foundations with the governance standards already applying to NVs and BVs, rather than expanding executive power.
q: The bill does not intend to change existing board and supervisory structures across the different types of legal persons.
Het wetsvoorstel beoogt niet om wijziging te brengen in bestaande bestuurs- en toezichtstructuren bij de verschillende soorten rechtspersonen.
d: provisions in articles of association for replacing absent or incapacitated directors
Minister of Security and Justice sets rules for assessing requests for advance funding for curator investigations
p: The Minister of Security and Justice may set rules governing whether a curator's request for advance funding for a pre-bankruptcy investigation is granted, within limits the minister sets.
Supervisory bodies gain power to suspend directors of a rechtspersoon, a shift toward internal checks rather than the executive.

parties: Welcomes greater legal uniformity and clarity but asks about the relationship with the Wet controle op rechtspersonen and whether the process changes anything substantive.

That the rules and requirements for the association, cooperative, mutual guarantee company and foundation are largely aligned with those for the BV and NV they find positive in terms of both clarity and content.

Dat de regels en vereisten voor met name de vereniging, de coöperatie, de onderlinge waarborgmaatschappij (hierna: owm) en de stichting in grote lijnen gelijk worden getrokken met de regels en vereisten voor de besloten vennootschap (hierna: bv) en de naamloos vennootschap (hierna: nv) vinden zij zowel qua duidelijkheid als wetsinhoud positief.

Supports a statutory rule on conflicting interests of directors and supervisors and asks who determines whether a conflict exists, and asks what concrete problems the bill solves for small informal bodies.
The PvdA members favour a statutory rule on conflicting interests that directors and supervisory board members may have in relation to the legal person.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn voorstander van een wettelijke regeling met betrekking tot tegenstrijdige belangen die bestuurders en commissarissen kunnen hebben ten aanzien van de rechtspersoon.
Asks the government to substantiate the perceived need for a monistic board model and whether it increases risks of conflicts of interest.
Does the chance of conflicts of interest increase if these legal forms opt for a monistic system?
Neemt de kans op belangenverstrengeling toe als in deze rechtsvormen wordt gekozen voor een monistisch systeem?

Supports better supervision where needed but questions the optional supervisory body and monistic model for foundations, the higher director-liability thresholds, and the lack of a remedy against dismissed former directors without enquiry-chamber proceedings.
Can the government explain why it did not opt for a mandatory choice between one of the two forms of supervision?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom niet is gekozen voor een verplichtende keuze voor een van beide vormen van toezicht?
Asks who defines conflicting interest, whether the liability thresholds for small foundations and associations are appropriate, and how the wording of the new liability article should be read.
Does responsibility for defining a conflict of interest lie with the individual director or with the board as a whole?
Ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het definiëren van tegenstrijdig belang bij de individuele bestuurder of bij het bestuur als geheel?
Asks whether the substantially changed bill requires new advice from the Council of State and why Article 2:9 BW is retained, including the meaning of 'serious reproach' and improper governance.
Is the amendment not such that a new advice from the Advisory Division of the Council of State would be appropriate?
Is de wijziging niet dusdanig dat een nieuw advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) op zijn plaats zou zijn?

Welcomes the amendments but questions the scope of the presumption of liability for directors of foundations and associations and the criteria for dismissal of underperforming board members by the court.

They consider the proposed amendments an improvement on the original proposal, particularly regarding the initially proposed harmonisation of provisions in the general part of Book 2 of the Civil Code

Zij achten de voorgestelde wijzigingen een verbetering van het oorspronkelijke voorstel met name waar het gaat om de initieel voorgestelde uniformering van de bepalingen in het algemene deel van Boek 2 BW
Asks whether the monistic board model still safeguards the Rhineland model and stakeholder interests, and why the bill took over two years.
These members are curious whether, in the government's view, the monistic board model offers sufficient safeguards to protect the Rhineland model embraced by the government.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of naar de mening van de regering het monistisch bestuursmodel afdoende waarborgen biedt om het door de regering omarmde Rijnlands model te waarborgen.
Seeks clarity on consequences for small foundations and associations and on the 'no serious reproach' criterion in Article 2:9 BW, including its legal certainty.
These members ask the government whether this still meets the objective of the Rhineland model, requesting clarity on the precise consequences for smaller foundations and associations.
Deze leden vragen de regering of hiermee nog voldaan wordt aan de doelstelling

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the uniform general regulation of governance and supervision for all legal persons in Book 2 BW, citing insufficient justification, overlap with sector-specific law, and premature timing before the evaluation of the 2013 NV/BV rules. The government's nader rapport largely rejects these objections, defending the uniformity, clarifying the wording, and adding explanatory notes.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether a uniform general regulation of governance for associations and foundations is necessary and desirable, given their diversity, and asked for a substantiated justification or withdrawal.
The Afdeling considered the proposal premature and advised awaiting the evaluation of the 2013 NV/BV rules before adopting the conflict-of-interest, governance and monist-system provisions.
The Afdeling warned that the extension of the liability-in-bankruptcy regime to all associations and foundations could be too far-reaching, and asked for justification and comment on insurability.

The Afdeling noted that sector-specific laws often prescribe supervisory bodies and monist choices differently, and asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify the relation to existing statutory arrangements.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the deletion of article 2:57(4) BW, of the jurisdiction and reinstatement exclusions in article 2:9b(3)-(4), and of the absence of transitional amending legislation.

34518.s: The bill requires the child protection board to investigate and request a court ruling on contact or visitation between a child and a parent suspected or convicted of killing the other parent, and lets the court refuse contact. It also makes a parent who was refused such contact inadmissible to re-apply for two years if the earlier refusal exceeded two years, with transitional rules for pending cases.
34518.j: The memorandum justifies the two-year inadmissibility period by the child's need for rest after a traumatic loss and by ECHR case law allowing temporary restriction of court access.
q: Given the child's interest in peace after the traumatic loss of a parent, limiting the parent's possibility to file a request to once every two years is not unreasonable.

Gelet op het belang van het kind bij rust na het traumatisch verlies van een ouder, is een beperking van de mogelijkheid tot het indienen van een verzoek door de ouder tot eens in de twee jaar niet onredelijk.
p: Shifts the decision on contact or visitation from the guardian or certified institution to the child judge, with the child board initiating the proceedings.
Makes a suspected or convicted parent inadmissible to request modification of a contact refusal for two years, limiting access to the court.

parties: Questions whether the two-year inadmissibility period fits all cases and whether the presumption of innocence is respected when suspects, not only convicted parents, are covered.
However, this bill provides that the right to contact or visitation after partner killing is restricted not only for a convicted perpetrator parent but also for a suspected perpetrator parent.

In dit wetsvoorstel staat echter dat het recht op contact of omgang na partnerdoding niet alleen wordt geclausuleerd voor een veroordeelde dader-ouder vanwege partnerdoding, maar ook voor een verdachte dader-ouder vanwege partnerdoding.
Asks why a two-year period was chosen and whether it is justified in individual cases, and questions how the inadmissibility term fits with ECHR case law.
These members want to know why specifically a period of two years was chosen.
Deze leden willen weten waarom specifiek voor een termijn van twee jaar is gekozen.
Doubts that the extension of the inadmissibility period is sufficiently motivated as necessary, and asks for a judicial duty to justify the period in each case.
Will there also be a duty on the judge to give reasons for the inadmissibility period, so that it is clear why a two-year period is justified in the individual case?
Zal er op de rechter ook een motivatieplicht voor de termijn van niet-ontvankelijkheid liggen waardoor duidelijk wordt waarom in het individuele geval een termijn van twee jaar gerechtvaardigd is?
Asks whether ECtHR case law allows even longer bars and whether the child-protection body has enough resources and powers to monitor the child.

These members ask the government whether current practice is sufficiently safeguarded by article 1:377g of the Civil Code, which gives the child an informal legal route to request contact or visitation.

Deze leden vragen de regering of in de huidige praktijk voldoende is geborgd door middel van artikel 1:377g Burgerlijk Wetboek, dat het kind een informele rechtsingang geeft om contact of omgang te vragen.
Stresses individual, case-by-case assessment and worries that a fixed two-year bar may prevent individualised judicial balancing and may conflict with ECHR Article 6.
Is it not precisely important to maintain that individual approach in order to make the right balancing of all interests possible?
Is het niet juist van belang om die individuele benadering vast te houden om zo met het oog op alle belangen de juiste afweging te kunnen maken?
Asks the government why existing legal frameworks would be insufficient to prevent children being forced to visit a parent in prison, and how unnecessary burdens on children will be avoided.
The SGP members ask the government to explain why the current legal frameworks would fall short in preventing children from being forced against their will to see their parent in prison.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven waarom de huidige wettelijke kaders tekort zouden schieten om te voorkomen dat kinderen tegen hun wil hun ouder in de gevangenis moeten zien.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against the bill restricting contact after partner killing: it questioned the mandatory court procedure for the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, the default rule of no contact unless in the child's interest (tension with ECHR art. 8 and IVRK art. 9), and the fixed two-year contact bar. The government's reply largely adopted the default-rule objection, partly followed the mandatory-procedure and two-year points, and defended the two-year non-admissibility period with reference to ECtHR case law.
concerns: The default rule 'no contact unless in the child's interest' conflicts with ECHR art. 8 and IVRK art. 9(3), and the government removed it.
The mandatory court procedure for the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming in all cases is not adequately justified; the government retained it largely but tied it to pending guardianship proceedings.
A fixed two-year contact bar limits the court's ability to make an individual assessment; the government changed it to a non-admissibility period of two years rather than a fixed duration.
The two-year period is not clearly consistent with ECtHR case law (Nekvedavicius), which requires re-examination at least annually.

34527.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen to implement EU Directive 2015/2376 on automatic exchange of tax rulings and advance pricing arrangements. It creates definitions for cross-border rulings and advance pricing agreements and obliges the Minister to automatically share specified information with other EU member states and the Commission, subject to exemptions.
34527.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary implementation of an EU directive, with no delegation of rule-making power to justify.
q: Council Directive 2015/2376/EU of 8 December 2015 amending Directive 2011/16/EU as regards mandatory automatic exchange of information in the field of taxation
Richtlijn 2015/2376/EU van de Raad van 8 december 2015 tot wijziging van Richtlijn 2011/16/EU wat betreft verplichte automatische uitwisseling van inlichtingen op belastinggebied

parties: Asks about the purpose, proportionality and legal protection of exchanging ruling information with all member states and the European Commission, and about taxpayer appeal rights.
To what extent is the exchange with all tax authorities proportionate?
In hoeverre is de uitwisseling naar alle belastingautoriteiten proportioneel?
Welcomes the directive as a tool against tax avoidance but asks about its scope and the role of the European Commission in reviewing rulings.
What exactly is the role of the European Commission regarding the exchange of rulings and their content, the PvdA members ask.
Welke rol heeft de Europese Commissie precies met betrekking tot de uitwisseling van rulings, en met betrekking tot de inhoud van die rulings, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.

Questions why ruling information about natural persons is excluded, why the taxpayer rather than the tax authority fills in the template, and whether the Chamber will be informed about implementation.
Does the government agree with these members that the accuracy of the information in the standard form must be the responsibility of the Tax Administration?
Is de regering wel met deze leden eens dat de juistheid van de informatie in het standaardformulier de verantwoordelijkheid van de Belastingdienst moet zijn?
Supports information sharing but presses on implementation capacity, enforcement of exchanges by other member states, confidentiality exceptions and annual reporting to parliament.

The CDA members further ask whether the government is willing to report annually in the annual report how many rulings per EU member state have been exchanged and how many exchange requests were not honoured.

Verder vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie of de regering bereid is om jaarlijks in het jaarverslag te melden hoeveel rulings per EU-lidstaat zijn uitgewisseld en hoeveel uitwisselingsverzoeken niet zijn gehonoreerd.
Supports EU-level cooperation but asks about reciprocity with Germany, the taxpayer's right to object to shared information, and oversight of the exchange.
The members ask the government what the state of affairs is regarding the data exchange with Germany.
De leden vragen de regering wat de stand van zaken is met de gegevens uitwisseling met Duitsland.
Asks about sanctions and verification of basic information exchange, whether exchanges are clearly cross-border, and how other countries apply unilateral agreements.
How and by whom is it checked whether member states actually do this?
Hoe en door wie wordt gecontroleerd of lidstaten dit ook daadwerkelijk doen?
Questions the two-stage exchange, the use of the 40 million euro threshold for older rulings, and the possible public disclosure of exchanged information in view of transparency.
Regarding the information exchanged in the first step, the members are curious to what extent parts of this information could also be made public, given the aim of transparency.

Wat betreft de inlichtingen die nu in de eerste stap uitgewisseld worden, zijn de leden benieuwd in hoe verre welke onderdelen van deze informatie ook publiek bekend gemaakt zouden kunnen worden, gegeven het streven naar transparantie.

34545.s: The bill temporarily introduces a reduced energy tax rate for electricity supplied to dedicated electric vehicle charging points with their own connection, up to 10,000 kWh per year, and exempts such electricity from the renewable energy levy. It delegates to a general administrative order and ministerial regulation the conditions for applying the rate and the definition of a company in difficulty.
34545.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set out in lower regulation how beneficiaries prove eligibility and what counts as a company in difficulty, drawing on practical signals.
q: To this end, a general administrative order will concretely specify what is to be understood by companies in difficulty.
Hiertoe zal bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur concreet worden aangegeven wat onder bedrijven in moeilijkheden moet worden verstaan.
d: conditions for applying reduced rate and definition of company in difficulty
detailed rules for implementing the reduced rate

parties: Asks why a new tax facility is used on top of an existing subsidy scheme and why the first electricity band is raised to fund it.
How does the government view the fact that this temporary facility in the energy tax comes on top of the subsidy scheme 'Green deal publicly accessible charging infrastructure'?
Hoe kijkt het de regering aan tegen het feit dat deze tijdelijke faciliteit in de energiebelasting, bovenop de subsidieregeling «Green deal openbaar toegankelijke laadinfrastructuur» komt
Asks about market structure, charging costs and how much of the tax cut reaches drivers.
To what extent will a lower energy tax be passed on to drivers of electric cars?
In hoeverre zal een lagere energiebelasting worden doorgegeven aan bestuurders van elektrische auto’s?
Demands a detailed demonstration that the bill really makes the business case work and asks what happens if the European Commission reacts negatively.
These members want a detailed explanation with examples showing that this bill indeed makes the business case for public charging points sound.
Deze leden willen een uitgebreide uiteenzetting zien met voorbeelden waaruit blijkt dat dit wetsvoorstel de businesscase van openbare laadpalen inderdaad sluitend maakt.
Questions whether the tax reduction is the right instrument, citing Raad van State advice that the existing subsidy could simply be raised.

In line with the Council of State's questions, the CDA members ask to what extent the subsidies from the Green Deal charging infrastructure for electric transport are still insufficient.</evidence_en>
In lijn met de vragen van de Raad van State vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie in hoeverre de subsidies vanuit de Green Deal laadinfrastructuur elektrisch vervoer nog onvoldoende zijn
Asks about the precise legal form of the nil rate and whether the subsidy scheme should simply be raised instead.
There is already a subsidy scheme, why not simply increase that subsidy scheme?
Er is al een subsidieregeling, waarom gewoon niet die subsidieregeling verhogen?
Welcomes the bill as implementing a motion but asks why the measure is temporary, why home charging is excluded, and for detailed tax-burden comparisons.
Can the government explain why, in addition to the steps taken, it has not chosen to apply the same conditions to home charging as to public charging?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom er in aanvulling op de gezette stappen, niet voor wordt gekozen om ook voor thuisladen dezelfde voorwaarden als voor openbaar laden te hanteren
Broadly satisfied with the bill, notes the unequal treatment of home chargers and asks about the VAT treatment for leased cars.
On the whole they are satisfied and think the bill addresses a clear bottleneck.
Op hoofdlijnen zijn zij tevreden, en denken dat het wetsvoorstel tegemoet komt aan een duidelijk knelpunt.
Asks about expected uptake, effects on home charging, consistency with tax simplification and cost per tonne of CO2 avoided.
One of the aims of the tax measures package is to simplify the tax system. How does this bill fit with that aim?
Een van de doelstellingen van het pakket belastingmaatregelen is om te komen tot een vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel. Hoe past dit wetsvoorstel in dit streven?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill on a temporary reduced energy tax rate for electricity from charging points with a separate grid connection to the House, but questions whether a tax facility is justified rather than an extension of the existing non-fiscal Green Deal subsidy, and flags the mismatch between the 'public' label and the actual technical scope. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport defends the choice for a tax measure, accepts the point about the title and considerans by removing the word 'openbare' and adjusting the explanatory memorandum, and forwards the amended bill to the House.
concerns: The Afdeling questions the need for a new tax facility when an existing Green Deal subsidy already pursues the same goal, and asks for a reasoned justification or adaptation; the government disagrees and maintains the tax measure, citing the Tweede Kamer motion.

The term 'openbare laadpalen' in the title, considerans and explanatory memorandum does not match the technical criterion of a separate grid connection, so the wording should be adjusted; the government removed the term accordingly.

34554.s: The bill (Fiscale vereenvoudigingswet 2017) simplifies tax rules across income tax, wage tax, corporate and dividend tax, VAT, excise, and environmental taxes, and harmonises collection and legal protection for tax and benefit debts under the Invorderingswet 1990 and the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen. Key shifts include tax collection powers for benefits and a unified court route, while several provisions delegate detailed rules to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
34554.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and collection powers mainly by administrative simplification and debtor-oriented consistency rather than by detailing their limits.
d: Artikel V (art. 4a Wet DB 1965), zesde lid
reporting overview of dividend withholding exemptions
Artikel VI (art. 29 Wet OB 1968), negende lid
exceptions for cash-payment discounts in VAT refunds
Artikel VI (art. 29 Wet OB 1968), tiende lid
form and content of refund requests
Artikel VIII (art. 36 Wet op de accijns), vijfde lid
conditions and limits on environmental tax reduction
collector may withhold payment of tax assessments via binding decision
p: Artikel XII (art. 12, 22-24, 28, 33 Awir) and Artikel XIII (art. 25-26 IW 1990)
Benefit and tax collection and refund decisions move under the collector's exclusive authority, with the administrative appeal to the director replaced by the fiscal courts.
The collector may withhold payment of an assessment in listed circumstances, subject to a binding decision open to appeal.
Artikel XIII (art. 25-26 IW 1990) and Artikel XII (art. 22 Awir)
Collection and offset powers over tax and benefit debts are extended, including offsetting benefit refunds against tax debts.

parties: Asks why debt-collection rules differ between tax and allowance debts and whether the preferential status and set-off changes affect other creditors.
What are the consequences for other creditors now that allowance debts (like tax debts) become preferential?
Wat zijn de gevolgen voor andere schuldeisers nu de toeslagschulden (net als de belastingschulden) preferent worden?
Welcomes the unified collection regime and fiscal judicial review but asks about costs of court proceedings and the fair application of the subsistence allowance.
They welcome the initiative to prepare each year a bill containing simplifications.
Zij juichen het initiatief toe om jaarlijks een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden dat vereenvoudigingen bevat.
Asks how intent or gross negligence will be assessed, whether contact is made before set-off, and whether courts can cope with the extra workload.
Has it been examined whether the courts can adequately cope with this extra workload?
Is onderzocht of de rechtbanken deze extra werkdruk voldoende aankunnen?
Praises collection simplification but worries that automatic residual-debt write-off after 24 months may hurt enforcement and budget, and asks about legal aid effects.
After the 24-month tailored arrangement, every residual debt is written off.
Na de maatwerkregeling van 24 maanden wordt elke restschuld kwijtgescholden.
Asks why separate tax and allowance debt tracks exist and whether the rules overlap or can be simplified.
Supports collection simplification but asks about protection of the attachment-free amount, legal remedies if it is not respected, and the effects on legal aid.
How is it guaranteed that the attachment-free amount is respected until connection to the register, or if connection proves impossible?
Hoe wordt gegarandeerd dat de beslagvrije voet wordt gerespecteerd tot het moment dat aangesloten is bij het register of indien aansluiting niet mogelijk blijkt?
Criticises set-off that pushes people below the subsistence minimum and asks why it is not suspended now pending connection to the attachment register.
Would it not be more logical to suspend set-off now, until connection to the attachment register is achieved?
Is het dan niet logischer om nu al de verrekening op te schorten, totdat aansluiting op het beslagregister is gerealiseerd, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Fiscale vereenvoudigingswet 2017 may proceed to parliament, but that the explanatory memorandum should address how the Dutch VAT treatment of bad debts, especially the supplementary measures for repaid claims and factoring, relates to the EU VAT Directive. The State Secretary's nader rapport states the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented with references to the relevant Directive provisions and two technical amendments were made.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify how the supplementary measures on bad-debt VAT relate to the EU VAT Directive, and the government supplemented the memorandum with references to the relevant Directive provisions.
Two technical improvements were made on tax payability after later payment and on transfer of bad debts to another entrepreneur, plus some textual clarifications.

34590.s: The bill amends the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen and the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to add seasonal work as a restriction on the combined residence and work permit, implementing Directive 2014/36/EU. It also creates a general duty for administrative bodies to share data for implementing the Wav, lets the minister refuse seasonal combined permits where the employer has no economic activity, and adds a fine-based ground for refusal.
34590.j: The memorandum justifies the new data-sharing power and refusal ground by the additional requirements that follow from implementing the directive.
q: A general provision for data provision for the implementation of the Wav was still missing and is now necessary because of the additional requirements for the employment permit and combined permit arising from the implementation of the directive.

Een dergelijke algemene bepaling voor de gegevensverstrekking voor de uitvoering van de Wav ontbrak nog en is nu noodzakelijk vanwege de aanvullende eisen voor de tewerkstellingsvergunning en gecombineerde vergunning die voortvloeien uit de implementatie van de richtlijn.
d: rules on data provision between administrative bodies
p: Allows the minister to refuse a seasonal combined permit where the employer has no economic activity, expanding executive discretion over migrant workers.
I.B (article 5, sixth and seventh paragraphs Wav)
Authorises broad data sharing among administrative bodies and with the UWV, with a privacy limit where personal life would be disproportionately harmed.

parties: Asks why the 24-week duration deviates from the directive and how the new tax-and-premium refusal ground would be verified in practice, including whether the IND is equipped to judge postbox companies.
Because what if employers now pay taxes and premiums in a country other than the Netherlands? Will the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND) check this?
Want wat als werkgevers nu belastingen en premies betalen in een ander land dan Nederland? Gaat de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) hier dan op toetsen?

Asks how the directive's facilitated admission provision will be implemented, whether implementing rules in the Regeling will be mandatory or optional, and warns of increased regulatory burden flagged by UWV, requesting how correct implementation is guaranteed.
The CDA members ask the government whether the provisions in this regulation will be filled in optionally or not.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of de bepalingen in deze regeling al dan niet facultatief worden ingevuld.

Asks about the material consequences of limiting seasonal work designation to agriculture and horticulture for other sectors such as hospitality and tourism, and why the implementation deadline of 30 September 2016 was missed.
They ask what the material consequences of this are, both for the agriculture and horticulture sector and for sectors that also have seasonal work.
Zij vragen wat hiervan de materiële gevolgen zijn, zowel voor de land- en tuinbouwsector als voor sectoren die ook seizoensarbeid kennen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board advised sending the bill implementing Directive 2014/36/EU on seasonal workers to parliament, but asked for changes on the scope list of seasonal sectors, mandatory refusal grounds, the public order ground, extension of permits, the single-application system, and removal of the referendum reference. The minister's reply accepts most points, adopting the sector list in a ministerial regulation, clarifying the tax-fraud refusal ground, adding the health ground, supplementing the explanatory memorandum, and deleting the referendum sentence.
concerns: Imperative refusal and revocation grounds of the directive were implemented only through facultative provisions; the advice was to implement them properly, which the reply addresses via the regulation and the transposition table.
The refusal ground for undeclared work and non-compliance with legal obligations needed clarification, as fines or OM contact do not necessarily mean undeclared work; the reply clarified the wording.
The legal status of the list of seasonal sectors was unclear; the reply moved the list into a ministerial regulation.

The public order ground was not fully implemented and the national concept was not reconciled with the EU concept; the reply added the health ground and retained the existing public order provision with its justification.
The explanation of how permit extensions are permitted was missing; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The single-application system for seasonal work differs from the approach used for intra-corporate transferees and the choice was not explained; the reply justifies the chosen system.
The bill could not be subject to a consultative referendum because it only implements a directive; the second sentence of article III was deleted.

34608.s: The bill introduces a collective action regime (art. 3:305a BW and new Title 14A of the Code of Civil Procedure) allowing representative foundations and associations to sue for mass damages, with an Exclusive Interest Representative appointed by the Amsterdam district court and binding collective settlements. It tightens admissibility requirements (supervisory body, representativeness, financial means, transparency, Dutch legal connection) and adds court approval of settlements.
34608.j: The memorandum justifies the regime by the need for a 'stok achter de deur' to force defendants to negotiate mass damages, and says the court is best placed to decide such claims given its expertise and independence.
q: The court is by its nature best equipped to dispose of a collective claim, given its expertise, independence and impartiality.
De rechter is bij uitstek geëquipeerd voor afdoening van een collectieve vordering, vanwege zijn deskundigheid, onafhankelijkheid en onpartijdigheid.
p: Gives courts a central role in assessing collective claims, appointing a representative and approving settlements, expanding judicial control over collective redress for affected citizens.

parties: Worries that the bill could make the Netherlands a haven for mass claims and asks how defendants will be protected from unfounded or frivolous claims.
At the same time they fear the strongly negative consequences of such a possibility as mass claims.
Tegelijkertijd vrezen zij de sterk negatieve consequenties van een dergelijke mogelijkheid als massaclaims.

Fears the exception allowing the court to admit an organisation without meeting strict admissibility criteria could be used as a back door, and worries about the role of the exclusive representative and opt-out timing.
These members fear that in practice this provision could be used as a back door by parties who would normally not pass the admissibility test.
Deze leden vrezen dat deze bepaling in de praktijk als achterdeur kan worden gebruikt door partijen die normaliter niet door de toets van ontvankelijkheid zouden komen.

Asks how the courts are compensated for extra workload, how financial burdens are guaranteed to be bearable, and questions the reasons for concentrating cases at one court and the monitoring of funding.
How is the judiciary compensated for this?
Hoe wordt de rechtspraak hierin gecompenseerd?
Questions the concentration of cases at the Amsterdam court against the Judiciary's view and the regular rules on relative competence, and asks about the reach of the bill against the State.
These members therefore do not find it logical that the main rule is that cases are handled in Amsterdam unless decided otherwise.
De hoofdregel dat het in Amsterdam behandeld wordt tenzij daar anders wordt beslist, achten deze leden dan ook niet logisch.

Shares the Council of State's concerns about the scope rule and EU Brussels I-bis, doubts the need for concentration at one court, asks why the second opt-out was dropped, and wants clarity on hearing rights of non-appointed claimants and on appeal rights.

It strikes the D66 members that, despite the opposite advice of the Council of State and the recommendations of the Jurists' Group, the second opt-out as currently regulated in the WCAM was chosen to be dropped from this bill.

Het valt de leden van de D66-fractie op, dat ondanks de tegenovergestelde adviezen van de Afdeling en de Aanbevelingen van de Juristengroep, ervoor is gekozen de tweede opt-out zoals deze thans in de WCAM is geregeld, in onderhavig wetsvoorstel te schrappen.
Asks whether the judge should ex officio review whether class members' interests are safeguarded in third-party-funded cases, and about the scope for punitive damages and the investment climate.

Welcomes the deletion of the concentration clause and the second opt-out moment but asks how venue rules and conflicting filings by different representatives will work in practice, warning of arbitrariness.
These members believe this could lead to arbitrariness and that clarity is needed in such cases.
De aan het woord zijnde leden zijn van mening dat dit tot willekeur kan leiden en dat men erbij gebaat is bij duidelijkheid in dergelijke gevallen.
Supports the bill's benefits but asks how judicial review of third-party litigation funding will work, noting the court's wide discretion, and suggests a maximum term for the second opt-out.
These members read in this a relatively large discretion for the judge to review this or not.
Deze leden lezen hierin een relatief grote beoordelingsvrijheid van de rechter om dit al dan niet te toetsen.

Questions whether the judge's discretion to review funding by third parties is sufficient to prevent abuse, whether the judge may skip that review, and asks for a reasonable maximum term for the second opt-out.
Does this freedom also mean the judge can decide not to carry out this review?
Betekent deze vrijheid ook dat de rechter kan besluiten om deze toets niet uit te voeren?

Worries the bill does not adequately prevent opportunistic foundations from free-riding on the exclusive representative's work and profiting from damages, and asks how the unfair terms rules might apply.

These members find it undesirable that a foundation does no more than be established, recruit participants, make no-cure-no-pay arrangements and wait on this business model for others to reach a settlement.

Voornoemde leden vinden het onwenselijk dat een stichting niet meer doet dan opgericht te worden, het werven van gedupeerde deelnemers, daarmee (no cure no pay) betalingsafspraken maakt en op basis van dit verdienmodel af te wachten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the collective damages action bill but advises revision: the geographic admissibility requirement must not undermine the useful effect of Brussels I bis, the role of non-appointed claimants and the Exclusive Interest Representative needs clarification, a second opt-out after court approval of a settlement should be provided, and alternatives should be discussed. The minister's reply largely rejects the second opt-out and adds clarifications on jurisdiction, procedure and alternatives, while making redactional changes.
concerns: The admissibility requirement of a sufficiently close link with the Dutch legal sphere could restrict the useful effect of the Brussels I bis Regulation, especially for forum selection; the reply clarifies the reasoning but does not amend the requirement.

The role of non-appointed claimants as parties and how they may make submissions alongside the Exclusive Interest Representative is unclear; the reply explains the court's discretion and procedural guidance.
A second opt-out after court approval of the settlement should be provided, as under the WCAM; the minister declines, citing adequate safeguards during the procedure and a clearer choice moment.
Alternatives to the court procedure, such as an independent expert body or partial-issue referral, should be discussed; the reply adds an analysis of their advantages and disadvantages.
Redactional corrections to article cross-references in the draft provisions were adopted.

34617.s: The bill extends paid kraamverlof (birth leave) under the Wet arbeid en zorg by adding three days of unpaid leave that are compensated by a UWV benefit, and makes conforming amendments to minimum wage, benefits and civil code provisions. It also sets the effective date and provides that the leave right applies to children born on or after entry into force.
34617.j: The memorandum justifies the daily-wage rules by noting that employees who have worked less than a year need different calculation rules, which makes the delegation necessary.
q: Deviating rules are also possible if the employee has worked for their employer for less than a year.
Afwijkende regels zijn ook mogelijk indien de werknemer korter dan een jaar heeft gewerkt bij zijn werkgever.
d: rules on determining and revising the daily wage for the benefit
control rules set by the UWV
entry into force by royal decree
p: The UWV may set control rules, limited to what is strictly necessary for correct implementation, which expands its verification discretion over benefit claimants.

parties: Asks whether the bill should wait for the SER follow-up study and the Raad van State advice, and questions the bureaucratic complexity and BRP access for UWV.
The Raad van State gives clear advice on this: wait for the SER follow-up study.
De Raad van State geeft hierover een helder advies: wacht het vervolgonderzoek van de SER af.
Welcomes the bill as a step toward broader partner leave and asks technical questions on implementation, pensions and the complexity of the scheme.
These members therefore see this bill as an important step toward further expanding partner leave after the birth of the child.
Deze leden zien dit wetsvoorstel dan ook als belangrijke stap naar verdere verruiming van het verlof van de partner van de moeder na de geboorte van het kind.
Finds the extension too short compared with other European countries and asks whether the unpaid leave keeps socioeconomic inequality between parents.
However, these members are critical of the length of the extension.
Wel zijn deze leden kritisch op de duur van de uitbreiding.
Supports extending paternity leave but asks why the government did not await the SER advice and why three days were chosen; raises UWV system problems.
The CDA members would have liked the government to take account of the recently published SER advice in the bill.
Zo hadden de leden van de CDA-fractie graag gezien dat de regering in het wetsvoorstel rekening had gehouden met het onlangs gepubliceerde advies van de SER
Disappointed by the pace and extent of the extension and implementation delay to 2019; asks for an explanation of the delay.
These members think it is good that movement is in the right direction by extending paid kraamverlof. But the extent and the pace disappoint the members.
Deze leden vinden het goed dat er in de goede richting wordt bewogen door het betaald kraamverlof uit te breiden. Maar de mate waarin en het tempo waarop, stelt de leden teleur.
Sees the extension as a welcome first step, asks why it is not fully collectively funded and why self-employed partners are excluded.
They find it very positive that the limited number of paid kraamverlof days for fathers and co-mothers is now being extended to five days.
Zij vinden het zeer positief dat het beperkte aantal dagen betaald kraamverlof voor vaders en meemoeders nu wordt uitgebreid naar vijf dagen
Doubts the causal evidence and desirability of the extension, raises substitution of employer-paid leave and questions the choice of funding source and exclusion of self-employed.
In that light, they doubt the desirability and added value of the proposed extension.
Zij betwijfelen in dat licht de wenselijkheid en meerwaarde van de voorgestelde uitbreiding.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises against sending the bill to parliament until its remarks are addressed, arguing the expansion of paid partner birth leave by three days is limited in purpose yet has complex, costly implementation and anticipates a pending SER study. The government reply largely rejects the timing and financing objections, accepts the change to how the allowance is paid through the employer, and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The complex implementation through UWV and employers, with high administrative costs and systems changes, was criticised; the government changed the payment route via the employer but kept the collective financing structure.

The Afdeling asked why the leave is expanded now while the SER conducts a broader study, and considered the benefit limited relative to costs; the government rejected this as an obstacle, citing the bill's fit with SER recommendations.
The position of self-employed people, who are excluded from the collective financing, was not addressed in the explanatory memorandum; the government added clarification without changing the scheme.

34626.s: The bill makes mainly technical changes to the pay, allowances and pension rules for members of the Tweede and Eerste Kamer, ministers, state secretaries, and Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer and Ombudsman officials. It adds the grounds for disability support, information and communication facilities, and allowances for foreign travel, and adjusts income offset and pension percentages.
34626.j: The memorandum justifies the disability-facility and retroactive lump-sum provisions as technical corrections that remove omissions and make parliamentary membership more accessible.
d: Artikel I D (Art. 4 Wet schadeloosstelling leden Tweede Kamer)
procedure for offsetting side income of Kamerlid, griffier reclaims excess
Artikel I F (Art. 10 Wet schadeloosstelling leden Tweede Kamer)
disability facilities for Kamerlid via griffier under WIA-based provisions
Artikel III (Art. 2a Wet rechtspositie ministers en staatssecretarissen)
disability facilities for ministers and state secretaries under WIA-based provisions

parties: Asks whether the new statutory basis broadens IT provision and who judges necessity, including the role of the tax inspector.
Is it only up to the clerk to assess whether the items made available are necessary?
Is het enkel aan de griffier om te beoordelen of de ter beschikking gestelde zaken noodzakelijk zijn?
Asks whether simplified reporting of side-job income affects the Kamer registers and why allowances were not lowered.
Asks how the bill relates to the UN disability convention and why these provisions were not included in the separate implementing bill.
How does the present bill relate to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities?
Hoe verhoudt het voor-liggende wetsvoorstel zich tot het VN-verdrag inzake de rechten van personen met een handicap

34635.s: The bill amends the Kieswet to set an explicit deadline of five working days for the Kiesraad to forward requests from foreign authorities checking whether persons are excluded from passive voting rights in European Parliament elections, implementing Directive 2013/1/EU. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
34635.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a requested implementation of an EU directive by the European Commission, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: This bill implements an urgent request from the European Commission to explicitly include in the Kieswet the response period stated in the amending directive for requests from foreign authorities.

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt uitvoering gegeven aan een dringend verzoek van de Europese Commissie tot het expliciet opnemen in de Kieswet van de, in de wijzigingsrichtlijn genoemde, reactietermijn

parties: Asks what steps the government has taken at EU level to agree on a single set of translations of the declarations issued by the Minister of Security and Justice, as the Kiesraad suggested.
What steps has the government taken to make arrangements about this at European level, so that there is one set of translations that the various authorities can use?
Welke stappen heeft de regering gezet om hierover in Europees verband afspraken te maken, zodat er één set vertalingen komt, waarvan de verschillende autoriteiten gebruik kunnen maken?

34662.s: The bill amends the earlier bill on phasing out owner-managed pension schemes (PEB) by adjusting transition deadlines, valuation rules, and the timing of tax deductions for pension-related costs. It also changes the effective date and retroactivity of its provisions and adjusts a ministerial delegation clause on transition periods.
34662.j: The memorandum explains that the delegation clause remains useful after the delayed entry into force and that adjusted references are needed, without giving a separate justification for new powers.
q: Under that delegation clause, the Minister of Finance can, by setting further rules, give an extra period to complete the steps necessary for the PEB phase-out.

Op grond van die delegatiebepaling heeft de Minister van Financiën de mogelijkheid om onder het stellen van nadere regels een extra periode te geven voor het afronden van de in het kader van de uitfasering van het PEB noodzakelijke handelingen.
d: extra transition period for completing PEB phase-out steps

parties: Wants speed for entrepreneurs but asks whether the government has consulted practitioners and whether all problems and earlier wrong answers are resolved.
To what extent have all problems in the documents forming part of the legislative history been resolved with the amendment, including all incorrect answers to questions in the written rounds?

In hoeverre zijn met de novelle alle problemen uit de stukken die onderdeel uitmaken van de wetsgeschiedenis opgelost, dus ook alle foutieve antwoorden op bijvoorbeeld vragen in de schriftelijke rondes?
Asks the government to respond to the NOB's differing interpretation of article 34e and to the RB's questions on the indexation asset item.
The PvdA members ask the government to respond to paragraph 1 of the NOB's commentary on this amendment.](The NOB appears to apply a different interpretation of article 34e.)
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering om een reactie te geven op paragraaf 1 van het commentaar van de NOB op deze novelle.
Questions why the State Secretary now says the deduction was wrongly suggested, and repeats request for example calculations left unanswered.

The SP members wonder why the State Secretary of Finance now says that the suggestion that such a deduction was possible was wrongly created.](Also requests example calculations previously left unanswered.)
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen zich af waarom de Staatssecretaris van Financiën nu zegt dat «ten onrechte de suggestie is gewekt dat een dergelijke aftrek wel mogelijk is».

Questions the government's contradictory answers to the Chamber and Senate, the retroactivity of the amendment, the three-month grace period, the partner signature requirement, and the phased deduction.

The CDA members therefore wonder what caused the "confusion" on 20 December 2016, since the Chamber was already told in the response to the report (pp. 31, 32 and 43) that the indexation obligation forms part of the buy-out or conversion value.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich dan ook af waar de «verwarring» op 20 december 2016 door veroorzaakt werd, nu reeds aan de Tweede Kamer in de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag (blz. 31, 32 en 43) al geantwoord is dat de indexatieverplichting deel uitmaakt van de te hanteren afkoop- of omzettingswaarde.
Asks how the government failed to notice the overly strict rule earlier, why the deduction is phased between ages 67 and 87, and what the retroactive effect means for directors.
The D66 members ask the government how it is possible that it was not yet known that the bill contained an overly strict rule.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering hoe het kan dat er nog niet bekend was dat het wetsvoorstel eigenlijk een te strenge regeling omvatte.

34725-IIA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for 2016, the closing budget law (Slotwet), setting out actual spending and revenue against the adopted budget in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2016.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2016.

34743.s: The bill amends the Waterwet and the Wet maritiem beheer BES to regulate marine geo-engineering activities under the 1996 London Protocol, requiring permits for placing substances at sea for such activities. It adds enforcement powers for inspectors and criminal liability, and includes transitional rules for existing exemptions.
34743.j: The memorandum justifies the new permit regime as the Dutch implementation of the binding 2013 Protocol amendment on marine geo-engineering.
q: An amendment to Annex 4 of the 1996 Protocol applies for this article from the day it takes effect internationally, unless a ministerial decision sets a different date.

Een wijziging van bijlage 4 bij het Protocol van 1996 gaat voor de toepassing van dit artikel gelden met ingang van de dag waarop die wijziging internationaal in werking treedt, tenzij bij ministerieel besluit
d: ministerial decision setting a different date for entry into force of Protocol annex amendments
ministerial decision setting a different date for applying Protocol annex 4 amendments
permit conditions and restrictions attached by the minister
p: Creates a permit requirement for marine geo-engineering, with the minister assessing applications against Protocol annexes 4 and 5 and attaching conditions.
Gives supervisors power to detain vessels and halt work where geo-engineering rules are breached.

parties: Has no questions about the bill.
They have no questions about this.
Zij hebben hier geen vragen over.
Has no questions about the bill.
They have no questions about this.
Zij hebben hier geen vragen over.
Has no questions about the bill.
They have no questions about this.
Zij hebben hier geen vragen over.
Asks which bodies would carry out scientific research under the permit exception and which body would assess whether such research is legitimate.
And which body or bodies will assess whether such scientific research is legitimate?
En welke instantie(s) gaat/gaan toetsen of dergelijk wetenschappelijk onderzoek legitiem is?

Fears irreversible harm from marine geo-engineering and questions whether the Caribbean constituent countries can permit, monitor and remedy experiments, and whether the Netherlands would be involved in vetting and monitoring.
Will the Netherlands be involved in assessment, licensing and monitoring?
Wordt Nederland betrokken bij toetsing, vergunningverlening en monitoring?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill on marine geo-engineering permits (Waterwet and Wet maritiem beheer BES) to parliament, raising only one substantive remark about the explanatory memorandum's claim that the bill could be subject to an advisory referendum, plus several drafting comments. The government's reply accepted the remark by removing the referendum statement and adopted most drafting changes, while keeping some existing wording for continuity.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum's statement that the bill could be subject to a referendum was removed because the referendability of the related approval act is still undecided.

Several drafting comments on wording in articles 6.3 and 10.2a/10.3 of the Waterwet were adopted, such as adding 'opzettelijk' and revising the phrasing on permits, while some existing wording was kept for continuity.

34761.s: The bill creates a Netherlands Commercial Court (NCC) and Netherlands Commercial Court of Appeal in Amsterdam, allowing parties to international commercial disputes that have agreed to it to litigate and receive judgments in English. It adds higher court fees for these cases and rules on transfers to and from the NCC and on fee refunds.
34761.j: The memorandum justifies the new court by reference to lower transaction costs, reduced court workload, and budget-neutral funding through higher court fees, with consumer protections preserved.
q: Consumers and small entrepreneurs are unlikely to be confronted with an English-language procedure at the NCC.
Consumenten en kleine ondernemers zullen niet snel geconfronteerd worden met een procedure in het Engels bij de NCC
d: NCC rules of procedure (procesreglement) for interim proceedings

parties: Asks whether the budget of two million euro is sufficient and how the Supreme Court would handle English-language cassation requests, raising questions about court resources and procedure.
Can these members conclude that the revenue from court fees will then be at most 2 million euro (100 times 15,000 plus 25 times 20,000 euro)?
Kunnen deze leden concluderen dat de opbrengst uit griffierechten dan maximaal 2 miljoen euro zal zijn (100 keer 15.000 plus 25 keer 20.000 euro)?
Stresses that Dutch must remain the starting point for civil cases and asks whether stronger parties could force the forum choice, raising concerns about protection of weaker parties by the courts.
The CDA members note that the bill does not change the rules on international jurisdiction of the Dutch judge.](Forum choice remains fully in force.)
De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen dat het wetsvoorstel niet de regeling van internationale rechtsmacht van de Nederlandse rechter wijzigt.

Asks whether enough English legal expertise exists among judges, whether smaller parties can afford the higher fees, and whether fee reduction under Article 6 ECHR is possible, raising access and judicial quality concerns.
The members ask whether knowledge of the English legal language is sufficiently present among Dutch judges.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen of kennis van de Engelse juridische taal voldoende aanwezig is onder Nederlandse rechters.
Warns of a race to the bottom in social and legal standards, two-tier justice through higher fees, and asks why the bill serves foreign business rather than ordinary citizens.
The SP members are in principle not in favour of cost-covering court fees.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn in beginsel geen voorstander van kostendekkende griffierechten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill allowing English-language proceedings and judgments at the Amsterdam NCC and NCCA, but asked for a fuller justification of why English judgments are warranted despite earlier arguments against them, why Supreme Court briefs cannot be in English, and a substantive response to consultation comments. The minister's reply supplemented the explanatory memorandum on the NCC(A) rationale, explained that the Supreme Court will keep ruling in Dutch but may allow English briefs case by case, and expanded the consultation section.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of why judgments in English are necessary, given that comparable Dutch-only situations were justified on similar grounds earlier; the government added explanation on the international character of NCC(A) cases and the English-language legal practice.

The Afdeling asked why English-language cassation briefs and defence statements cannot be filed with the Supreme Court; the government explained the need for Dutch rulings for legal unity but added that the Supreme Court may allow English filings on joint request of the parties.

The Afdeling advised substantive responses in the explanatory memorandum to the consultation comments, including those on cost-covering court fees and equality; the government expanded the advice and consultation section accordingly.

34770.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht, the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling to implement EU Directive 2016/97 on insurance distribution. It extends supervisory notification, sanction and conduct rules to insurance intermediaries, direct insurers, health insurers and pension insurers.
34770.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as needed to implement the directive's detailed requirements on information, suitability and cross-border procedures, with rules to be set in lower regulation.
d: information provision on pension payout contracts
rules on how agent intermediaries ensure compliance of linked intermediaries
rules on when suitability statements may be given after contract conclusion
information to be submitted for cross-border notification by intermediaries
p: Extends the supervisor's power to order cross-border intermediaries to cease new contracts when prior notice to the home-state authority has been given and not remedied.

Allows the supervisor to bar a cross-border intermediary from operating in the Netherlands immediately, without prior notice to the home-state supervisor, where urgent action protects clients' rights.
Limits the supervisor's use of its enforcement power for the duty of care to cases of evident abuses that could harm trust in insurer or markets.}
Gives the supervisor power to publish warnings or statements naming the intermediary or insurer for certain conduct breaches involving investment-component insurance.
Requires public disclosure of sanctions and directions after they become final, with the supervisor allowed to postpone or anonymise disclosure on proportionality or stability grounds.
Requires insurers and intermediaries to notify the AFM when they cease responsibility for a linked intermediary.

parties: Asks about the timing of implementing regulations, sanction levels of the AFM, and the administrative and compliance burden on small intermediaries.
What consequences does this have for financial advisers and for the mandatory service document?
Welke gevolgen heeft dit voor de financieel adviseurs en voor het verplichte dienstverleningsdocument?
Asks for motivation of each Member State option chosen and an overview of cumulative EU regulatory costs on the insurance sector.
First, the PVV members note that the Netherlands has chosen to use three Member State options.
Allereerst merken de leden van de PVV-fractie op, dat Nederland ervoor gekozen heeft gebruik te maken van drie lidstaatopties.
Asks whether the bill changes the existing provision ban, the meaning of the new term independent advice, and how enforcement applies to foreign intermediaries.
If the professional competence requirements differ, how does the government guarantee a level playing field between Dutch and non-Dutch intermediaries and insurers?
Indien de eisen voor vakbekwaamheid verschillen, hoe garandeert de regering dan een gelijk speelveld tussen Nederlandse bemiddelaars en verzekeraars en niet-Nederlandse bemiddelaars en verzekeraars?
Supports the directive for a level playing field and stronger client protection, and asks how the objective character of advice is to be established.
In this context, these members support maintaining the provision ban for complex products.
Deze leden ondersteunen in dit kader de handhaving van het provisieverbod voor complexe producten.

Urges the government not to be naive about industry self-regulation, to use Member State options such as mandatory advice and bundling limits, and to address barriers to access to advice for low-income consumers.
Precisely because market failure can continue unabated, the government should not be restrained in implementing the Member State options, the SP members judge.
Juist omdat dit marktfalen onverminderd op kan treden, dient de regering niet terughoudend te zijn met het implementeren van de opties van de EU-lidstaten, zo oordelen de leden van de SP-fractie.

34806.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Binnenmaas, Cromstrijen, Korendijk, Oud-Beijerland and Strijen into a new municipality, Hoeksche Waard, and abolishes the five former municipalities. It also makes consequential amendments to the electoral law, the safety region law and the judicial division act, and assigns the new municipality transitional roles under the general municipal reorganisation act.
34806.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by describing an existing inter-municipal cooperation body and a regional council with binding power, which the province found limited.
q: This bill aims to merge the municipalities of Binnenmaas, Cromstrijen, Korendijk, Oud-Beijerland and Strijen into the new municipality Hoeksche Waard.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt tot samenvoeging van de gemeenten Binnenmaas, Cromstrijen, Korendijk, Oud-Beijerland en Strijen tot de nieuwe gemeente Hoeksche Waard.
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks how the merger will strengthen the region's governance and whether the proposed regional council model is legally viable.
To what extent would this model be legally sustainable?
In hoeverre zou dit model juridisch houdbaar zijn?
Asks for the advisory report and response note to be formally sent to the House and questions whether online publication counts as submission.
These members ask the government to still send the reorganisation advice and the accompanying response note to the House.](Partial)
Deze leden vragen de regering het herindelingsadvies en de bijbehorende reactienota alsnog aan de Kamer toe te zenden.
Supports reorganisation in principle but questions local public support, the citizen poll's timing and outcome, and the rejected referendum option.
Naturally, public support is important in this regard.
Vanzelfsprekend is daarbij draagvlak onder de bevolking van belang.
Asks how residents, civil society and local politics were involved in preparing the proposal and how access to services will be guaranteed.
These members ask the government to further explain how residents, civil society organisations and local politics were involved in the preparation of the municipal reorganisation proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Argues a merger lacks popular support, since two-thirds of residents in three municipalities opposed it, and asks why the option of further cooperation was not examined first.
