According to these members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, if there is support from the population.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Has no need for further explanation at this stage.
These members do not feel a need for further explanation at this stage.
Deze leden hebben in deze fase geen behoefte aan een nadere toelichting.
Stresses that reorganisation should be voluntary and bottom-up, questions the lack of local consensus, and asks whether the regional council option was fairly assessed.
After all, the starting point for reorganisation should be that it takes place from the bottom up and voluntarily.
Uitgangspunt bij herindeling dient immers te zijn dat deze van onderop en vrijwillig plaatsvindt.

34815.s: The bill amends the Blood Supply Act to let the Blood Supply Organisation transfer or outsource essential tasks and goods to other legal persons with the Minister's consent, and to give the Minister powers over those entities. It also adds rules on non-statutory activities, pricing of blood products, data use, and a Minister's power to set minimum prices and grant exemptions by ministerial regulation.
34815.j: The memorandum justifies the new consent and supervisory powers as necessary for coordination and efficient blood supply, and notes that all Minister decisions are subject to judicial review.
q: It is desirable that the Minister of VWS has public-law powers over the subsidiary that carries out work essential to the statutory tasks.

Het is wenselijk dat de Minister van VWS publiekrechtelijke bevoegdheden heeft ten aanzien van de dochteronderneming die werkzaamheden uitvoert die essentieel zijn voor de uitvoering van de wettelijke taken.
d: maximum size of non-statutory activities of the organisation
Minister decides which supervisory powers apply to other legal persons per consent decision
rules setting minimum prices for blood products and intermediates
p: The Minister may consent to outsourcing or transfer of essential tasks and attach conditions, and may exercise supervisory powers over other legal persons when necessary for proper execution of the Act.
Consent for profit-oriented entities is refused unless no disadvantage results, and consent can be withdrawn, with decisions published in the Staatscourant.
The Minister is empowered by ministerial regulation to set minimum prices for blood products sold by the organisation.
The health inspectorate may issue binding orders to other legal persons handling essential blood supply tasks where no other law provides this power.

parties: Asks for an overview of forthcoming subordinate regulation and how the House will be involved in it.
Can the government give a complete overview of the regulations to be developed, including an overview of what they will regulate?
Kan de regering een totaaloverzicht geven van de te ontwikkelen regelgeving, inclusief een overzicht van hetgeen daarin geregeld is, wordt of kan worden?
Asks whether the Authority for Consumers and Markets was involved and how cross-subsidy and sluiproute risks between statutory and non-statutory profits are controlled.
Is there not a risk that this creates a backdoor route for distributing profits from statutory activities?
Bestaat niet het risico dat hiermee een mogelijkheid voor een sluiproute wordt gecreëerd om winsten uit wettelijke activiteiten uit te keren?
Questions why the ministry's own expertise was relied on rather than outside expertise such as the ACM, and why the existing budget-approval oversight is considered insufficient.
These members also ask why the government did not consider it important to involve outside knowledge, for example that of the ACM?
Deze leden vragen ook waarom de regering het niet van belang heeft geacht om kennis van buiten te betrekken, bijvoorbeeld de kennis van de ACM?
Critical of Sanquin pursuing commercial activities alongside public powers and asks whether profits from donated blood are being diverted.
Does the government consider it desirable that Sanquin, alongside its statutory public powers, apparently also pursues commercial activities?
Vindt de regering het wenselijk dat Sanquin naast haar wettelijke publieke bevoegdheden, daarnaast blijkbaar commerciële activiteiten nastreeft?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Blood Supply Act to limit financial risks at Sanquin, approving the aim but asking for clarification on transferable tasks, ministerial powers over Sanquin BV, plasma sourcing, pricing and data handling. The minister's nader rapport accepts most points, partly declines others (e.g. Mededingingswet art. 25b, ACM involvement), and reports the amendments made.
concerns: Advice to clarify in the statute, rather than in a policy rule, which work cannot be transferred, since the policy rule offers insufficient legal certainty.
Advice that the non-transferable core tasks be specified by law or by general administrative order rather than in beleidsregels.
Advice to clarify the new statutory task and whether the basic plasma-medicine stock must come from domestically collected blood.
Advice that the minister's powers over Sanquin BV may be exercised only in the interest of the blood supply, so Sanquin BV's market activities are not unnecessarily restricted.
Advice to clarify the handling of donor personal data between Sanquin and Sanquin BV, answered by pseudonymisation and limited access in the explanatory memorandum.
Advice to apply Mededingingswet art. 25b on separate accounting, not followed because the Regeling begroting already requires separate bookkeeping.
Advice to involve the ACM in preparing the bill, not followed because enforcement lies with the minister and the ACM lacks the relevant market knowledge.

34824.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Leerdam, Vianen and Zederik into the new municipality Vijfheerenlanden, places it in the province of Utrecht and adjusts the provincial boundary. It also makes related changes to electoral districts, judicial districts, safety regions and joint arrangements, and lets the new municipality act as successor in transitional matters.
34824.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional deviation powers by the need to arrange safety region, health service and environmental service membership within the new territorial boundaries.
q: When making the arrangements arising from the changed boundaries, participants may depart from what the joint arrangement provides on amendment and termination.
Bij het treffen van de voorzieningen die voortvloeien uit de gewijzigde indeling kunnen de deelnemers afwijken van hetgeen in de gemeenschappelijke regeling is opgenomen
d: transitional arrangements for joint regulations and deviation from their terms
p: Participants in joint arrangements may depart from their own regulations when making transitional arrangements, with a six-month deadline that the provincial executive may extend by up to six months.

parties: Asks whether the government is willing to activate article 41(7) of the Arhi and how it will handle the unwinding of joint regulations with large financial consequences.
The VVD members would like a response from the government on whether it is willing to activate article 41(7) of the Arhi.
Gaarne krijgen de leden van de VVD-fractie een reactie van de regering op de vraag of de regering bereid is om artikel 41, zevende lid van de Wet algemene regels herindeling (Arhi), te activeren.
Argues that publishing the herindelingsadvies and the provincial position on a website is not equivalent to submitting them to the House, and asks that they be sent to the Chamber.
These members believe that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn van mening, dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
Notes the merger was adopted by majority in all municipalities and asks about the petition against placing the new municipality in Utrecht and about funding of friction costs.
They read that the reorganisation advice was adopted by a majority of votes in all municipalities.
Zij lezen dat het herindelingsadvies in alle gemeenten met een meerderheid van stemmen is vastgesteld.

Asks how residents, civil society and local politics were involved and how accessibility of facilities is guaranteed, and questions the democratic legitimacy of financial decisions in joint regulations.
These members also ask whether the government will elaborate on the democratic legitimacy of the (financial) decision-making in the joint regulations.

Ook vragen deze leden tot slot of de regering nader wil ingaan op de democratische legitimatie van de (financiële) besluitvorming in de gemeenschappelijke regelingen waar de betrokken gemeenten en provincies bij betrokken zijn.

Stresses that mergers should be bottom-up with resident support, questions whether a majority of residents supports it and why no citizen consultation took place, and doubts the expected efficiency gains.
According to these members, mergers should only take place from the bottom up, if there is support from the population.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderop, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Notes broad local, regional support and asks for clarification of the status of the ontvlechting from South Holland, its costs and who bears them.

The ChristenUnie members request the government to clarify the current state of affairs regarding the preparation and coordination of the unwinding from the province of South Holland, what costs this entails and to whom those costs will be attributed.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten wat de huidige stand van zaken is met betrekking tot de voorbereiding en coördinatie van de ontvlechting uit de provincie Zuid-Holland, welke kosten dit met zich mee brengt en aan wie die kosten toegerekend zullen worden.
Insists that the reorganisation must be bottom-up and voluntary, questions the provincial boundary decision and the financial and safety consequences for remaining municipalities and regions.
For the SGP members, an important principle is that reorganisation takes place from the bottom up and that it is voluntary and has sufficient public support.
Voor de leden van de SGP-fractie is het een belangrijk uitgangspunt dat herindeling van onderop plaatsvindt en dat het vrijwillig en met voldoende draagvlak plaatsvindt.

34833.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Geldermalsen, Lingewaal and Neerijnen into a new municipality called West Betuwe, with effect from a date set by royal decree. It also designates the new municipality for the purposes of existing rules on tax, joint arrangements and utilities, and updates the electoral, housing-market and safety-region lists accordingly.
34833.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the wish of the three municipalities to cooperate more closely and their joint study of scenarios leading to a merger.
q: it is desirable to merge the municipalities of Geldermalsen, Lingewaal and Neerijnen into the new municipality of West Betuwe
het wenselijk is de gemeenten Geldermalsen, Lingewaal en Neerijnen samen te voegen tot de nieuwe gemeente West Betuwe
d: fixing the date the law enters into force by royal decree

parties: The VVD has no remarks or questions on the bill.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The CDA asks for the merger advice and the province's views to be sent to the House, since publication on a website is not equivalent to submission to parliament.
These members are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn van mening, dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
The D66 notes the merger was bottom-up and unanimous and has no further questions at this stage.
They read that this reorganisation took place from the bottom up and was unanimously adopted in all municipal councils.
Zij lezen dat deze herindeling van onderop heeft plaatsgevonden en in alle gemeentegraden unaniem is vastgesteld.
GroenLinks asks how residents, organisations and local politics were involved and how accessibility of services is guaranteed after the merger.
These members ask the government to explain further how residents, civil society organisations and local politics in the municipalities were involved.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest.
The SP questions whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and the financial risks of a possible budget shortfall.
These members ask whether a majority of residents supports the merger and, if no citizen consultation was held, why that was not chosen.
De leden van de SP-fractie de vragen of er een meerderheid van de bewoners voor de herindeling is, en als er geen burgerraadpleging heeft plaatsgevonden waarom daarvoor niet is gekozen.
The ChristenUnie supports the merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the proposed merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.
The SGP stresses voluntariness and sufficient support, and asks about village-identity policy, the role of area brokers, and whether neighbouring municipalities that want to merge are excluded.
For the SGP members, an important starting point is that reorganisation takes place from the bottom up and that there is voluntariness and sufficient support.
Voor de leden van de SGP-fractie is het een belangrijk uitgangspunt dat herindeling van onderop plaatsvindt en dat er sprake is van vrijwilligheid en voldoende draagvlak.

34842.s: The bill modernises the Dutch framework for recovery and resolution of insurers by adding a new chapter 3A.2 to the Wft, giving DNB resolution powers (bail-in, transfer, bridge institution, asset separation) and requiring recovery and preparatory crisis plans. It abolishes the transfer scheme (overdrachtsregeling), the emergency regime (noodregeling) and the life insurer support scheme, moving some bewindvoerder powers into the Faillissementswet.
34842.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the risk of disorderly insurer failure, the need to align with EU recovery and resolution standards and the loss of state-aid compatibility of the existing support scheme.
q: Uncontrolled resolution of an insurer may, given its social function, the risk of contagion within an insurance group and the effect on confidence in insurers, lead to considerable social unrest.

Het ongecontroleerd afwikkelen van een verzekeraar kan vanwege zijn maatschappelijke functie, het risico op besmettingseffecten binnen een verzekeringsgroep en het effect op het vertrouwen in verzekeraars leiden tot aanzienlijke maatschappelijke onrust.
d: resolution plan content and procedure for insurers
content, submission and format of preparatory crisis plans
rules on establishment, financing and governance of bridge institution
rules on establishment and governance of asset management vehicle
rules on calculation of creditor losses in ex post valuation
p: DNB may decide to resolve an insurer and impose bail-in or transfers on shareholders, creditors and policyholders without creditor consent, based on broad public-interest criteria.
DNB may appoint a special administrator or take over control of a resolved entity and deviate from statutory and articles-based management duties.
DNB may restrict creditors' enforcement rights and suspend termination rights of counterparties until a set deadline.
Resolution measures are excluded as grounds for contractual termination and transactions are shielded from avoidance actions under civil and bankruptcy law.
Resolution decisions are exempt from consent requirements and corporate or supervisory notification and procedural rules.

parties: Asks how the resolution decision is kept from being taken too lightly given open norms and DNB's discretion, and how the process is kept proportionate and legally certain.
how is it prevented that the decision to resolve is taken too lightly
hoe wordt voorkomen dat er te lichtvaardig met het besluit tot afwikkeling omgegaan wordt
Asks whether DNB's roles in drafting resolution plans and judging resolvability are mixed up and whether an independent check or separation of powers is needed.
whether it would not be wise to have an independent review somewhere in the process
of het niet verstandig is ergens in het proces ook een onafhankelijke toets te laten plaatsvinden
Questions the automatism in the resolution decision and whether the supervisor's discretion combined with judicial review would better guarantee objectivity.
How does the government assess the risk that this automatism loses all room for tailoring?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering het risico om door dit automatisme elke vorm van maatwerk te verliezen?
Has serious doubts about the bail-in of policyholders and asks whether policyholders are protected when group interests conflict with theirs.
The SP members have serious doubts about the proposed bail-in.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben grote twijfels over de bail-in die wordt voorgesteld.
Asks about the European framework, the comparison of security for pension participants, and why ex-ante funding was not chosen.
Can the government explain why ex-ante fund formation was not chosen in that light?
Kan de regering in dat licht toelichten waarom niet is gekozen voor (ex ante) fondsvorming.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wft to create a resolution framework for insurers, including resolution plans, and warned about property rights (Article 1 First Protocol ECHR), shareholder rights under EU company law, the lack of automatic suspensive effect of appeals, and the proportionality of the broad resolution criteria, recommending consultation with the European Commission before submission. The Minister's reply (nader rapport) largely rejects the need for automatic suspension and EU consultation but accepts supplementing the motivation, tightening the public-interest criterion and clarifying the financing scheme.
concerns: Resolution instructions may interfere with insurers' property rights under Article 1 First Protocol ECHR and Article 17 EU Charter, requiring reasoned justification; the government supplemented the memorandum.

Override of shareholder rights may conflict with EU company law directive; the Council advised consulting the Commission first, but the government found the bill compatible and saw no need for a formal Commission opinion.
Mandatory resolution criteria set a low threshold and leave DNB no room for case-by-case balancing; the government tightened the public-interest test but kept the mandatory character.
Advised weighing automatic suspensive effect of appeals against resolution-plan instructions; the government declined, citing the ordinary interim-relief route.
Financing scheme lacked a cap and justification for operational costs; the government added explanation to the memorandum.

34851.s: This bill implements the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in Dutch law, establishing the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens as the supervisory authority and setting national rules for processing special categories of personal data, criminal-law data, and exceptions to data subject rights. It also repeals the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens and sets transitional and evaluation provisions.
34851.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and exceptions as necessary to implement the GDPR's own open clauses and to ensure the supervisory authority can function under EU law.
d: rights of chair and members of the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens set by general administrative order
rules on exercise of employment powers over secretariat staff
further rules on health data processing exceptions
designating other cases where a national identification number may be used
designating accreditation body under GDPR Article 43
assigning further tasks to the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens to implement binding EU acts
p: Allows controllers to disapply data subject rights and notification duties for broad public interests, subject to necessity and proportionality safeguards.
Permits processing of criminal-law data by public-law cooperation bodies where necessary for their tasks, with safeguards.
Allows the authority to suspend decision deadlines to comply with EU cooperation obligations.

parties: Asks how the household-activity exemption and consent rules will apply in practice and whether employers may record employee health data.
These members note that the AVG and the bill hardly address what exactly falls under purely personal or household activities.
Het valt deze leden op dat in de AVG en het wetsvoorstel nauwelijks wordt ingegaan op de vraag wat precies onder zuiver persoonlijke of huishoudelijke activiteiten valt.
Worries about the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens combining advisory, investigative and fining powers, and about the absence of a prior binding instruction before fines.
The CDA members look with concern at the multitude of tasks the AP combines in one organisation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie kijken bezorgd naar de veelheid aan taken die de AP in één organisatie verenigt.
Supports stronger privacy protection but asks how automated profiling such as SyRI fits Article 22 and what human involvement means.
They ask the government to explain how this article relates to the use of a profiling system such as SyRI.
Zij vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe dit artikel zich verhoudt tot het gebruik van een profileringssysteem als SyRI.
Asks whether the regulation strikes the right balance between EU unification and national discretion and how interpretation of open norms is controlled.
These members ask the government whether the AVG strikes the right balance between unification and discretionary room.
Deze leden vragen de regering of in de AVG een juiste balans is gevonden tussen unificering en discretionaire ruimte.
Questions why the regulator's budget remains part of the Justice ministry budget, which may compromise its independence, and whether the extra funding is sufficient.
Would it not be better for the independent position of the AP if it had its own budget?
Zou het niet beter zijn voor de onafhankelijke positie van de AP wanneer zij beschikt over een eigen begroting?
Argues for extra safeguards for employees under Article 88 because consent in unequal employment relations is not truly voluntary, and questions the regulator's independence.
The members therefore consider an employee's consent to allow the employer to process data an insufficient safeguard.
Het geven van toestemming door een werknemer om zijn werkgever in staat te stellen gegevens te verwerken achten de aan het woord zijnde leden dan ook een onvoldoende waarborg.
Asks for clarification of confidentiality exceptions for the regulator and why the prior binding instruction obligation was dropped.
They ask the government to explain why, despite the Council of State's remarks, the bill omits the obligation for the AP to issue a binding instruction before imposing a sanction.

De aan het woord zijnde leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten waarom, ondanks de opmerkingen van de Afdeling hierover, in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel de verplichting voor de AP ontbreekt om voorafgaand aan de oplegging van een sanctie de verantwoordelijke een bindende aanwijzing te geven.
Warns that EU law overrides national data protection and that national parliament is bypassed, asking whether the EU process can be slowed.
These members really have just one question: can this EU train be slowed down?
De voornoemde leden hebben eigenlijk maar één vraag. Kan deze EU-trein worden afgeremd?
Asks that the bill keep other protected interests in view, avoid bureaucratising small organisations and churches, and use the available exemptions broadly.
They have the impression that the AVG contains far-reaching provisions on privacy protection whose consequences are not always foreseeable.
Zij hebben de indruk dat de AVG vergaande bepalingen bevat inzake de bescherming van de privacy, waarvan de consequenties niet altijd goed te voorzien zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Uitvoeringswet AVG, stressing the constitutional shift of data protection to EU level, the need for fuller explanation of the EU cooperation and Comité mechanisms, weaker reasoning for not using Article 88 and 9(2)(i) discretion, unclear accountability of the Comité, and insufficient attention to implementation and evaluation. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, adds a constitutional paragraph, an evaluation clause, a statutory open preparation procedure for codes of conduct, and an expanded implementation section, while rejecting the call for a full inventory of policy choices.
concerns: The Afdeling notes the shift of data protection competence to the EU level weakens the role of the national legislator under Article 10 of the Constitution; the government adds a constitutional paragraph in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asks for clarity on the openness, stakeholder involvement and accountability of the European Data Protection Board and national supervisors, which issue quasi-regulation; the government considers the AVG checks and balances adequate and adds explanation of the Comité's tasks.

The Afdeling asks for a substantive weighing of policy choices where the AVG leaves room for national rules (employment, health data); the government declines a full inventory but adds explanatory passages on Article 88 and Article 9(2)(i).

The Afdeling finds the treatment of implementation burdens and urgency insufficient and asks for a coherent implementation programme and attention to technological developments; the government expands the memorie van toelichting with implementation costs and initiatives and discusses blockchain and big data.
The Afdeling asks for an evaluation clause in the Uitvoeringswet; the government adds one.

The Afdeling advises that the scope of the Uitvoeringswet be tied to the AVG's Article 2 exceptions, applying the AVG by analogy to processing outside EU law, and that the boundary with the directive on criminal justice data be explained; the government adopts an analogy clause and expands the scope explanation.
The Afdeling advises applying the uniform open preparation procedure of the Awb to approval decisions on draft codes of conduct; the government adds a second paragraph to Article 14.

34860.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet EZK en LNV) makes many technical and corrective amendments to various laws under the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, fixing wrong references, typos and gaps. It also removes some provisions and adjusts delegation and enforcement details, such as the Minister's power to collect fines and fund chamber of commerce tasks.
34860.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as correcting errors, omissions and outdated references, and notes that the Minister's power to collect fines already exists under the Awb.
q: The proposed amendment in part A corrects the erroneous numbering.
De voorgestelde wijziging in onderdeel A herstelt de foutieve nummering.
d: Artikel V, onderdeel A (Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, artikel 3, derde lid)
setting subsidy ceilings and distribution method by general administrative order
p: Artikel XIV (Wet op de Kamer van Koophandel, artikel 35a)
Extends cost-recovery rules to chamber of commerce tasks regulated by other laws, with the financing of such tasks left to the relevant other statute where not regulated.
Artikel XII, onderdeel L (Wet natuurbescherming, artikel 4.6)
Restricts provinces' and municipalities' regulatory powers over tree stands outside built-up areas, a provision not yet in force.

parties: No questions or comments on the bill.
The members of the VVD group have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.
No questions or comments on the bill.
These members have no questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks the government to clarify hunting-permit requirements and the minimum six-year term for sub-letting hunting rights, citing unclear legal text and practical risks.

These members ask whether the government is willing to amend article 3.20 of the Nature Protection Act so that the condition, as previously included in article 36 of the Flora and Fauna Act, clearly reappears in the Nature Protection Act.

Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is artikel 3.20 van de Wet natuurbescherming zo aan te passen dat de voorwaarde, zoals eerder opgenomen in artikel 36 van de Flora- en Faunawet, duidelijk terugkomt in de Wet natuurbescherming.

34932.s: The bill extends from nine to twelve years the period during which designations of military airfields under the Aviation Act retain their validity, by amending Article XVIII of the 2008 Aviation Act amendment. It also sets the entry-into-force rule tied to the Consultative Referendum Act.
34932.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the delayed completion of the environmental impact report and the noise-calculation problems at Woensdrecht and De Kooy.
q: "not longer than nine years" is replaced by "not longer than twelve years".
wordt «niet langer dan negen jaar» vervangen door «niet langer dan twaalf jaar».
p: Extends by three years the validity of existing military airfield designations made under the Aviation Act without renewed parliamentary review.

parties: Supports the extension but questions whether it is truly the last one, given earlier optimistic timelines and shortage of personnel at Defence, and asks what is being done to strengthen capacity and how it affects other processes.
These members see the need to extend the transitional period by three years to ensure careful preparation of the aviation decisions.
Deze leden zien de noodzaak om de overgangstermijn met drie jaar te verlengen om zorgvuldige totstandkoming van de luchtvaartbesluiten te borgen.

Expresses scepticism about the reliability of the three-year timeline after two extensions and asks how delays such as at De Kooy and Woensdrecht will be prevented, including whether recalculations are reflected in the MER.
Since the government has had to extend the period twice, these members view this with some scepticism.
Aangezien de regering tot twee maal toe de termijn heeft moeten verlengen, vernemen genoemde leden dit met enige scepsis.

Objects to the extension and asks about noise complaints, residents' options to object and enforce limits while no airport decision exists, and whether flight numbers will be fixed in future decisions to allow enforcement.
What are currently the options for residents to object to the experienced nuisance?
Wat zijn op dit moment de mogelijkheden voor de omwonenden om bezwaar te maken tegen de ervaren overlast?

34950-IIA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for fiscal year 2017 by adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles, as shown in the attached schedule. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2017.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2017.

35058.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2017/828 on shareholder long-term engagement by amending the Dutch Civil Code, the Financial Supervision Act and the Securities Giro Act. It introduces shareholder votes on remuneration policy and reports, disclosure and approval rules for related-party transactions, engagement and transparency duties for institutional investors, asset managers and proxy advisers, and identification and information-passing duties along the custody chain.
35058.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary deviation from remuneration policy by the need to serve long-term interests or viability in exceptional circumstances, limited to what the directive allows.
q: The company may, in exceptional circumstances, temporarily and at the latest until a new remuneration policy is adopted, deviate from the remuneration policy.
De vennootschap kan onder uitzonderlijke omstandigheden tijdelijk en uiterlijk totdat een nieuw bezoldigingsbeleid is vastgesteld, afwijken van het bezoldigingsbeleid.
d: company remuneration of directors under existing policy if new policy not adopted
temporary deviation from remuneration policy in exceptional circumstances
p: Companies may temporarily depart from an approved remuneration policy in exceptional circumstances, subject to procedural conditions stated in the policy and disclosure in the remuneration report.

Material related-party transactions outside ordinary business are approved by the supervisory board rather than the general meeting, with conflicted directors excluded and public announcement required.

parties: Asks whether the exceptional-deviation option from remuneration policy is used and how it relates to shareholder powers, and questions the estimated implementation costs.
Do the members understand correctly that the government has used the option in the underlying directive to, in exceptional cases, deviate from the remuneration policy?

Begrijpen de aan het woord zijnde leden het goed dat de regering in het implementatiewetsvoorstel gebruik heeft gemaakt van de mogelijkheid die de onderliggende richtlijn biedt in uitzonderlijke gevallen af te kunnen wijken van het bezoldigingsbeleid.
Supports greater shareholder oversight but asks whether the advisory vote on the remuneration report is optional or mandatory and how the directive fragments rules across member states.
Can the government indicate whether this concerns an optional right of the general meeting or whether it becomes a mandatory part of the meeting?
Kan de regering aangeven of het hier gaat om een optioneel recht van de algemene vergadering of wordt dit een verplicht onderdeel van de vergadering?

Welcomes stronger shareholder control over listed companies to protect stakeholder interests and asks which changes to remuneration policy must be put to shareholders and how exceptions are supervised.
Exercising the control rights attached to shares in a responsible and efficient manner strengthens the controlling relationships within listed companies, these members assume.

Het op verantwoorde en efficiënte wijze uitoefenen van de aan aandelen verbonden zeggenschapsrechten versterkt de controlerende verhoudingen binnen beursvennootschappen, zo veronderstellen deze leden.

Criticises the government for adopting only cost-reducing member-state options, questions the remuneration deviation option and the uncertain grip on executive pay, and asks how employees' influence can be increased.
These members ask the government why it chose only cost reduction and not other starting points.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom alleen is gekozen voor lastenverlichting en niet voor andere uitgangspunten.

35148.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by adding a one-off supplementary appropriation of €1,000 million on article 03 (public-private sector financing) to enable the purchase of an equity stake in Air France-KLM. It takes effect on 15 February 2019 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears on or after 1 February.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for 2019, in connection with enabling the purchase of an equity stake in Air France-KLM.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2019, samenhangend met het mogelijk maken van de aankoop van een aandelenbelang in Air France-KLM.

35175.s: The bill ends mandatory electronic procedure at the Gelderland and Midden-Nederland district courts and, with transitional rules, applies the Code of Civil Procedure's expanded oral-hearing and stronger judicial case-management provisions (articles 87-90 Rv) to all courts. It also makes several technical amendments to civil procedure, including on the Supreme Court, default judgments and electronic signatures.
35175.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the urgency of ending the pilots and by the need to make the stronger judicial case management and expanded oral-hearing rules available to all courts quickly.
q: The bill therefore provides that, at the same time as mandatory digital procedure is stopped in Gelderland and Midden-Nederland, the same Rv procedural law will apply in all first-instance and appeal courts.

Het wetsvoorstel regelt daarom dat tegelijk met het stopzetten van verplicht digitaal procederen in Gelderland en Midden-Nederland, in alle gerechten in eerste aanleg en hoger beroep hetzelfde procesrecht van Rv gaat gelden
p: Expands the judge's discretion to order and conduct oral hearings, question parties and give procedural directions, while requiring the judge to respect a good procedural order and offering parties a chance to be heard if no hearing is held.

parties: Asks whether this is the only bill arising from the reset of judicial digitisation and requests the total costs and results of the KEI project, including what is salvageable.
Is this the only bill arising from that reset, or do more laws need to be amended?
Is dit het enige wetsvoorstel dat voortkomt uit die reset, of moeten er meer wetten worden gewijzigd?
Asks how the relationship, investments and knowledge built with chain partners can be preserved in the new digitisation plan and whether the BIT can weigh them.
What options does the government see to keep this relationship, these investments and this knowledge from being lost in the new digitisation basic plan?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om deze relatie, investeringen en kennis niet verloren te laten gaan in het nieuwe basisplan digitalisering?

Asks why the Dutch Bar's advice on errors in the 2016 legislation was not adopted, questions drafting and the transitional consequences of three law versions, and raises the extra workload for courts and clerks.

These members find the widening of options for oral hearings and the strengthening of judicial case management desirable, but they also want to draw explicit attention to the additional workload for civil clerks' offices, teams and judges that this brings.

Deze leden vinden de verruiming van de mogelijkheden voor de mondelinge behandeling en de versterking van de regie van de rechter wenselijk, maar zij willen ook nadrukkelijk aandacht vragen voor de extra werkbelasting voor de civiele griffies, teams en de rechters dat dit met zich mee brengt.

35238.s: The bill creates a centralised automated bank-data referral portal, run by the Minister of Justice and Security, through which banks and payment providers must supply identifying data, beneficial owner and account open/close dates to designated authorities on the basis of existing powers in criminal procedure, tax, and welfare law. It also obliges DNB to supervise compliance and allows DNB to share confidential non-personal information with the Minister, implementing the EU anti-money-laundering directive 2018/843.
35238.j: The memorandum justifies the portal by the EU directive, the policy wish to act faster against crime, and efficiency, and states the bill does not widen or narrow existing powers.
d: Artikel I, C / Artikel 3:267i, lid 4 Wft
rules on portal management, authorities using it, data, and technical requirements
p: Artikel I, D / Artikel 3:267i, lid 1 and 3

Designated investigative and tax authorities can obtain client identifying bank data through an automated portal, reducing the manual control previously applied to each request, while being limited to powers already in statute.
DNB may share confidential supervisory information, excluding personal data, with the Minister of Justice and Security, subject to a secrecy duty.

parties: Asks whether the portal's IT security is fully under control, whether the six-month delay suffices to meet the BIT advice, and why an extra FTE is needed for a system meant to make queries more efficient.
They attach great value to the advice of the Bureau ICT-toetsing (BIT) and wonder whether a six-month delay is sufficient to meet the BIT advice.

BIT advies De leden van de VVD-fractie hechten grote waarde aan het advies van het Bureau ICT-toetsing (BIT) en vragen zich af of een uitstel van een half jaar voldoende is om te voldoen aan de adviezen van het BIT.
Asks whether authorities may combine information from different powers into an overview, and whether this is permitted under the GDPR, given the need for clear purpose limitation.

These members ask the government whether account has been taken of circumstances in which an authority can, on the basis of different powers, request different information and combine it itself into an overview.

Deze leden vragen de regering of er rekening is gehouden met omstandigheden dat een overheidsinstantie op basis van verschillende bevoegdheden verschillende informatie kan opvragen en deze zelf kan combineren tot een overzicht.

Questions the proportionality of the measure in light of privacy and anonymity, the government's rejection of integrated fiat (prior authorisation) despite the Raad van State advice, and whether checks on proper use are carried out for every case.
These members ask the government to further substantiate the proportionality of the proposed measure, also in light of the right to anonymity and protection of private life.
Deze leden vragen de regering om de proportionaliteit van voorgestelde maatregel nader te onderbouwen, mede in het licht van het recht op anonimiteit en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.

Asks whether a prior-authorisation (fiattering) system inside the portal was tested, whether all Raad van State and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens remarks were met, and what the worst-case hacking risk is.
The members of the GroenLinks group ask the government which remarks/suggestions of the Raad van State have not (fully) been complied with and why not.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen de regering aan welke opmerkingen/suggesties van de Raad van State niet (volledig) is voldaan en waarom niet.

Questions whether citizens can obtain redress through criminal procedure if they disagree with data collection, given the purely administrative enforcement framework, and asks how citizens are informed and can have data destroyed.

First, regarding the persons whose data are collected: does the administrative enforcement framework mean that an individual cannot obtain redress through a criminal procedure if they disagree with the data collection?

Allereerst betreffende de personen van wie de gegevens worden verzameld: betekent het bestuursrechtelijk handhavingskader dat een individu geen recht kan halen via een strafrechtprocedure, mocht diegene het oneens zijn met de gegevensverzameling?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill creating a central digital reference portal for bank identification data, raising concerns about safeguards against unnecessary data disclosure, security risks, incomplete implementation of the EU disclosure obligation, and costs borne by banks. The government's reply accepted several points by adding safeguards, security measures, an extra disclosure basis for beneficial owners, and further justification on costs.
concerns: The Afdeling advised additional safeguards against unnecessary disclosure of identifying data, such as fiattering, and clarification of data subjects' rights, especially regarding the Tax Authority; the government added safeguards and rights explanation but did not adopt fiattering.

The Afdeling advised explaining the security risks to bank customer administrations and government data files from the connection to the portal, and the government added a description of the security measures taken.
The Afdeling noted the bill does not fully match the EU disclosure obligation, and the government added a disclosure basis for beneficial owners and opening and closing dates in a separate article.
The Afdeling advised further justification of why banks alone must bear the connection costs, and the government added an explanation in the explanatory memorandum.

35247.s: The bill creates a procedure under which citizens and organisations can petition for sustainability rules, which the Minister may then turn into general administrative orders (AMvB) or ministerial regulations covering listed subjects such as emissions, renewable energy and animal welfare. The rules are subject to a parliamentary pre-submission (voorhang) procedure, a five-year sunset and evaluation, and enforcement including administrative fines.
35247.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegation by the need for an accessible route for societal sustainability initiatives, with parliamentary pre-submission and temporary character as safeguards.
q: Firstly, because this bill provides a broad delegation basis for setting rules in the interest of sustainable development following a request to that effect; parliament is thereby given insight and the chance to comment.
Ten eerste omdat dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in een ruime delegatiegrondslag voor het stellen van regels in het belang van een duurzame ontwikkeling na een daartoe strekkend verzoek.
d: sustainability rules on petition, listed subjects
rules on how petitions are submitted
fine levels for violations of the rules
p: Broad delegation lets the executive turn petitioned initiatives into binding rules, with parliament limited to a pre-submission hearing and no bypass of statute permitted.
The Minister may grant exemptions or dispensations from the rules on application, weighing benefits against harms with a five-year review.
Enforcement powers include orders under administrative coercion and administrative fines up to fifth-category levels.

parties: Worries the bill delegates far-reaching rule-making to ministers and organisations, leaving parliament only a pre-consultation (voorhang) role and too little oversight of competition-restricting rules.

In the view of these members, this bill does not remove these obstacles in current legislation; rather it regulates the procedure for making far-reaching additional regulation at the request of all kinds of organisations.

Naar de mening van deze leden haalt dit wetsvoorstel deze belemmeringen in de huidige wetgeving niet weg, maar regelt dit wetsvoorstel juist de procedure voor het maken van vergaande extra regelgeving op voordracht van allerlei organisaties
Asks how parliament can see the minister's reasons for refusing requests and questions the vague notion of broad support and the alternatives to the bill.
How can parliament gain insight into the minister's consideration for rejecting requests to make rules?
Hoe kan het parlement inzicht krijgen in de afweging van de Minister om verzoeken tot het stellen van regels af te wijzen
Broadly positive about enabling government to endorse societal initiatives; asks clarifying questions on comparable procedures and timing.
These members have a positive basic attitude towards the bill.
Deze leden hebben een positieve grondhouding ten aanzien van het wetsvoorstel.
Supports more room for sustainability initiatives but asks about the careful weighing of exemptions and the risk of unfair competitive advantage without advice.
The bill provides that the minister decides on exemptions without obtaining advice on them.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt dat de desbetreffende Minister beslist over vrijstellingen, zonder hierover advies in te winnen.
Questions the narrow scope and whether the right to challenge could undermine sustainability goals and consumer protection.
These members ask the government for examples in which a right to challenge, in effect a deviation from sustainability standards, will lead to benefits for the public interest.
Deze leden vragen de regering om voorbeelden waarin een «right to challenge», de facto een afwijking van standaarden voor duurzaamheid, zal leiden tot voordelen voor het maatschappelijk belang
Supports the procedure while acknowledging it lacks the full safeguards usual in lawmaking.
Although the procedure does not have all the safeguards usually present when legislation is made, these members can nonetheless support this procedure.
Hoewel de procedure daartoe weliswaar niet de volledige waarborgen kent die bij het tot stand komen van wetgeving wel gebruikelijk zijn, kunnen deze leden toch deze procedure steunen.
Sees a meaningful step forward but takes seriously the Council of State's criticism, including that initiatives are not anchored in statute.
These members ask the government to explain why anchoring by statute is not considered opportune.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven waarom een verankering per wet niet als opportuun wordt beschouwd.
Asks why the parliament is not given a stronger preliminary-review power allowing the chambers to require enactment by statute, and about limiting who may submit requests.
These members ask why the government did not choose a strong preliminary-review provision under which the chambers could decide that the proposed rules must be introduced by statute.
Deze leden vragen daarbij waarom de regering niet gekozen heeft voor een zware voorhangbepaling, waarbij de Kamers kunnen besluiten dat de voorgestelde regels bij wet ingevoerd moeten worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the Wet ruimte voor duurzaamheidsinitiatieven, citing undue limitation of the legislator's discretion, weakening of parliament's primacy, risk of juridisering, and doubts about effectiveness given competition law and EU law. The government's nader rapport accepts many points, adds clarifications, a sunset/evaluation clause and a narrower delegation, but maintains the bill and disputes the most serious objections.
concerns: Broad delegation to the minister via ministerial regulation undermines the primacy of the legislator; government narrowed scope into the Act and limited delegation to AMvB, but did not accept the parliamentary-approval concern fully.
Open-ended delegation of regulatory power for sustainability rules is too weakly bounded; government added clauses and restricted the scope of matters but retained a delegation structure.
Doubt that many requests can be granted given competition law and EU law constraints, so the bill may not effectively solve the problem; government disagrees and maintains the bill is useful.
Risk of juridisering: refusals and content of rules could lead to court challenges; government clarified no administrative appeal lies against decisions on requests.

Risk that the procedure conflicts with the Union's loyal cooperation and free movement rules; government added subsidiarity/proportionality to the analysis but the EU compatibility remains to be shown in practice.
Advice to pursue EU-level clarification of competition rules for sustainability initiatives; government notes such talks are already taking place.
Advice to use the regular legislative process with specific delegation grounds where needed; government does not exclude this route but keeps the bill as a supplement.

35256.s: The bill amends the Algemene wet bestuursrecht to create a new general coordination regime for interrelated administrative decisions, including a coordinating authority, joint procedures and a single appeal route, and adds a power of substitution (indeplaatstreding) for provincial and national authorities in Omgevingswet project decisions. It also extends the Awb medewerkingsplicht with enforcement by administrative coercion and adjusts many sector statutes and special compensation schemes to match.
35256.j: The memorandum justifies indeplaatstreding as a last-resort tool to prevent delay in complex infrastructure projects that need many interdependent decisions.
q: Use of the substitution power is a last resort against delay by decentralised authorities in taking interrelated decisions.
Inzet van de indeplaatstredingsbevoegdheid vormt een ultimum remedium tegen vertraging door decentrale bestuursorganen bij het nemen van samenhangende besluiten
d: coordinating authority may decide not to apply coordination
coordinating authority sets decision deadline for coordinated decisions
national or provincial authority substitutes for original competent body
p: Allows national ministers or provincial executives to substitute their own decision for that of a lower authority that fails to decide or blocks a project decision.
Allows administrative enforcement by coercion against non-cooperation with inspectors under the general duty to assist supervision.
Makes a coordinated decision package appealable in a single instance where any one decision allows that, reducing appeal levels for affected parties.

parties: Welcomes the bill's aim of aligning the Awb with the Omgevingswet and asks for a clearer explanation of the new coordination scheme, without raising a check concern.

The VVD members have taken note of the bill with interest and a positive basic attitude, amending the General Administrative Law Act and other laws in connection with the new environmental law and compensation law.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling en een positieve grondhouding kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb) en enkele andere wetten in verband met het nieuwe omgevingsrecht en nadeelcompensatierecht (hierna: het wetsvoorstel).

Asks how the flexible coordination power to adjust decision deadlines is safeguarded against misuse by administrative bodies, and whether exceptions to the duty to consult before substitution are possible.
These members ask how it is ensured that this is not misused by administrative bodies by postponing all decisions until the final decision deadline of one decision.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt geborgd dat dit niet misbruikt wordt door bestuursorganen door alle besluiten uit te stellen tot de uiterste beslistermijn van één besluit.

Questions whether the expanded coordination regime will complicate coordination of procedures, and raises the lack of a remedy for provinces against coordinating-body decisions and the non-enforceable position of municipalities against provinces.
The D66 members note that decentralised authorities have no possibility to appeal a decision taken by the coordinating administrative body after the original administrative body fails to act.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat voor decentrale overheden geen mogelijkheden bestaan tot beroep tegen een door het coördinerend bestuursorgaan genomen besluit nadat het oorspronkelijk bestuursorgaan in gebreke blijft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised (9 April 2019) on a bill amending the Awb for the new Omgevingswet and the coordination of related decisions, raising concerns about two-tier appeal being displaced beyond environmental law and about administrative enforcement against non-cooperation with supervisors, which may conflict with the privilege against self-incrimination. The government's reply of 2 July 2019 adds a section on social-domain applications with a table of affected decisions, expands the explanatory note on self-incrimination and the restriction on use of material, and makes several technical changes.
concerns: Advice to explain in the explanatory note the consequences of limiting appeal to one instance beyond environmental law, which the government addressed with a new section 3.2 and a table.

The statutory duty to cooperate with supervisors may infringe the prohibition of self-incrimination; the advice asks for fuller treatment of the restriction on use of compelled material and its consequences for enforcement and evidence, which was expanded in the explanatory note.
Redactional comments of the Afdeling were incorporated into the bill and explanatory note.

35283.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 and the Gas Act to align them with several EU energy instruments (Directive 2019/692 and Regulations 2019/942, 2019/941, 2019/943 and 2017/1938), mainly by replacing references to repealed regulations and extending gas interconnector rules to third-country interconnectors. It also lets the Minister act as competent authority in some cases and gives the energy regulator ACM and the Minister roles in cooperation and approval procedures.
35283.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement EU regulations and to ensure enforceability and compliance through ACM supervision.
q: With the bill, the necessary provisions are included in the Gas Act to give effect to what the directive requires of Member States.
Met het wetsvoorstel worden de noodzakelijke bepalingen in de Gaswet opgenomen om invulling te geven aan hetgeen met richtlijn 2009/692 wordt verlangd van lidstaten.
d: designation of the competent authority for risk preparedness
ARTIKEL I, L and M (arts. 27, 31 Elektriciteitswet)
network codes and tariff conditions under Regulation 2019/943
ARTIKEL II, K (art. 18h Gaswet, sixth paragraph)
Minister may decide on exemption request if third-country authority does not respond within three months
Minister may assign tasks to the transmission system operator
p: ARTIKEL II, K (art. 18h Gaswet, sixth paragraph)
If a third-country regulator does not respond within three months, the Minister may decide on an exemption for an interconnector without waiting for its reply.
The Minister stays the competent authority for gas supply security measures and may take them directly rather than via other bodies, with the option of not using this power left open.

parties: Asks whether parliament will control the extra powers granted to Acer and how the Minister's oversight of the electricity crisis rules is made objective and independent.
Is there parliamentary control over granting additional powers to Acer?
Vindt er parlementaire controle plaats op het toekennen van extra bevoegdheden aan Acer?
Opposes shifting powers to the European Commission and Acer, and wants an independent competent authority instead of the Minister, given the Minister's record of prioritising economic interests.
They would prefer to appoint an independent competent authority.
Zij zouden liever een onafhankelijke bevoegde instantie benoemen.
Asks how the rules on gas solidarity and compensation to neighbouring states will work in practice and who decides the conditions, given it is left to individual neighbouring states.
These members ask why setting the conditions, including for supplying gas in a serious disruption, is left to individual neighbouring countries.
Deze leden vragen wel waarom het vaststellen van condities, waaronder in het geval van een ernstige verstoring gas wordt geleverd, wordt overgelaten aan individuele buurlanden.
Asks for an explanation of the action plan the Minister must draw up for structural congestion and whether other member states have experience with it.
These members ask the government for an explanation of such an action plan.
Deze leden vragen van de regering om een toelichting op een dergelijk actieplan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Electricity Act 1998 and Gas Act to implement the amended Gas Directive and related regulations, and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's covering letter confirms the advice was received and the bill will be submitted without changes.

35292.s: The bill amends the Energy Efficiency Implementation Act and the Heat Act to implement EU Directive 2018/2002, extending remote-readable individual metering and cost-allocation rules to heat and cold networks. It delegates detailed meter requirements, pricing rules, technical feasibility criteria and cost-efficiency methods to general administrative orders (AMvB).
35292.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to give concrete content to technical requirements (meter accuracy, metrology rules, feasibility and cost-efficiency conditions) set by the EU directive.
q: Article 6a, third paragraph, subsection a, provides a delegation provision allowing implementing regulations to specify the requirements the meter must meet.
Artikel 6a, derde lid, onderdeel a, voorziet in een delegatiebepaling die de mogelijkheid biedt om in uitvoeringsregelgeving concreet aan te geven aan welke eisen de meter zal moeten voldoen.
d: ARTIKEL I, B.3 (art. 2, zesde lid, Wet implementatie EU-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie)
requirements for remotely readable meters and data security
criteria for technical feasibility and cost-efficiency of individual cold meters
meter requirements and rates for purchase or use of heat meters
requirements for remotely readable heat meters and data security
criteria for technical feasibility and cost-efficiency of individual heat meters
ARTIKEL II, B (art. 8, veertiende lid, Warmtewet)
criteria for technical feasibility and cost-efficiency of individual heat meters

parties: Asks how reasonable costs are determined, which body decides on cost-efficiency exemptions from remote-readable meters, and who oversees and sanctions non-replacement.
Which body determines what reasonable costs are and how is this supervised?
Door welke instantie wordt bepaald wat redelijke kosten zijn en hoe wordt hierop toegezien?
Asks about the Autoriteit Consument en Markt's powers to set lower maximum heat tariffs and about the energy-saving achieved and expected under the directive.

These members ask to what extent the Authority for Consumers and Markets has the power under article 5 of the Heat Act to set lower maximum tariffs for the small number of large heat suppliers in 2020 than the gas reference.

Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de Autoriteit Consument en Markt de mogelijkheid heeft op basis van artikel 5 van de Warmtewet om voor dit kleine aantal grote warmteleveranciers lagere maximumtarieven in 2020 vast te stellen dan de gasreferentie.
Asks whether sustainability and circularity criteria can be imposed on meters and why an obligation scheme was not chosen for energy efficiency.
They also ask to what extent the pace of rolling out smart meters as regulated in this proposal fits the climate and energy targets to be met.
Zij vragen tevens in hoeverre het tempo van het uitrollen van slimme meters zoals die nu wordt geregeld in dit voorstel aansluit bij de te halen klimaat- en energiedoelen.
Criticises smart meters for inaccurate billing and asks how consumer complaints will be addressed, what control mechanisms users have, and whether data may be shared with third parties.
What are the current tariffs charged?
Wat zijn de huidige tarieven die in rekening worden gebracht?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a draft bill amending the Wet implementatie EU-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie and the Warmtewet to implement Directive 2018/2002/EU on energy efficiency. The Afdeling had no remarks on the proposal and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer.

35319.s: This omnibus bill amends a large number of transport, water, aviation, environmental and road-traffic statutes with mostly technical corrections, renumbering, ministry renaming and updated references. Notable substantive changes include new delegation powers for the minister to designate an examining body for tachograph installers, a general ministerial/AMvB basis for drinking-water rules to implement international obligations, and a requirement that goods carriers hold a consignment note that can be shown on first demand.
35319.j: The memorandum justifies the new drinking-water delegation as a needed fallback because existing delegation bases may not fully cover the pending revision of the EU Drinking Water Directive.
q: The proposed Article 54a provides an additional basis in these cases, which cannot be missed.
Het voorgestelde artikel 54a biedt in deze gevallen een aanvullende grondslag, die niet kan worden gemist.
d: ARTIKEL II, G (art. 9:3 Arbeidstijdenwet/ art. 9:3 Wegenverkeerswet context)
rules on examination and diploma for tachograph installers
further rules implementing international obligations on drinking water (AMvB or ministerial regulation if technical)
ARTIKEL XIII, A (art. 2.13(2) Wet wegvervoer goederen)
detailed rules on consignment note and liability split between sender and carrier
p: Creates a general power to set further rules by AMvB or ministerial regulation on all drinking-water matters to implement international obligations, without specific limits or parliamentary approval.
ARTIKEL XIII, B (art. 3.3 Wet wegvervoer goederen)
Changes the NIWO from being required to refuse a CEMT permit to having discretion to refuse it.

parties: No further comments or questions on the bill.
The PVV members have noted the bill and have no further comments or questions.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere opmerkingen of vragen.
Has no further questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen nadere vragen.
No contribution to the written consultation on the bill.
The D66 members have no contribution to the written discussion of the omnibus Infrastructure and Water Management Act 2019.
De leden van de fractie van D66 hebben geen inbreng op de schriftelijke bespreking van de verzamelwet Infrastructuur en Waterstaat 2019.

Worries that dropping mandatory MER for low-impact projects weakens environmental review and alternatives assessment, and that permit granters may not critically check the need for an MER, potentially approving projects unreviewed and conflicting with European requirements.
Can the government guarantee that now very many projects will not be wrongly granted permits without being assessed?
Kan de regering garanderen dat nu niet heel veel projecten alsnog onterecht ongetoetst worden vergund?
No questions or comments on the bill.
The SP members have no questions or comments on the Omnibus Infrastructure and Water Management Act 2019.
De leden van de fractie van de SP hebben geen vragen en opmerking bij de Verzamelwet Infrastructuur en Waterstaat 2019.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised deleting two data-processing provisions of the Verzamelwet IenW 2019 (one already assessed by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, one not submitted to it) and reflecting further on the bill before submission. The minister's nader rapport accepts both points by deleting the provisions and also adds several technical amendments, including delegation grounds and annex changes to the Waterwet and Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
concerns: Article III, creating a specific legal basis for processing personal data under the Scheepvaartverkeerswet, should be deleted because the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found the GDPR was already met without it.
Article VI, part B, on municipal automatic number plate recognition was not submitted to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and should either be deleted or submitted for advice.
Several remaining remarks were addressed through wording corrections and reordering of articles in the revised bill.

35328.s: The bill bans the largest gas consumers from drawing low-calorific gas from the grid after 1 October 2022 and caps low-calorific gas withdrawals at 100 million m3 per gas year until 2030. It also obliges the grid operator to convert affected connections to high-calorific gas under a plan, with ministerial power to impose binding conduct and grant exemptions and compensation.
35328.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for the fastest safe phase-out of Groningen gas extraction and security of supply, and limits exemptions to very exceptional use.
q: The cabinet therefore foresees a very limited and exceptional use of the possible exemption ground.
Het kabinet voorziet dus een zeer beperkt en uitzonderlijk gebruik van de mogelijke ontheffingsgrond.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 10l, eerste lid)
exemptions from the consumption ban on low-calorific gas
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 10l, derde lid)
exemption from the 100 million m3 cap for security of supply
compensation for disproportionate harm from the ban, via policy rule
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 10k, derde lid)
binding conduct instructions to the grid operator on conversion planning
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 10k, derde lid)

The minister may impose binding conduct on the grid operator's conversion planning when in the interest of phasing out Groningen gas or the economic interest of a consumer, with only a reporting obligation attached.
The minister receives broad discretion to grant or withdraw exemptions from the consumption ban, subject to grounds stated in the article.
Compensation for affected consumers is discretionary on request and to be elaborated in a policy rule, with decisions open to objection and appeal.

parties: Asks whether supply security is guaranteed if large users cannot convert in time, and asks for criteria for exemptions to give clarity to users and parliament.
These members ask the government whether criteria can be drawn up as a basis for granting the exemption, to provide more clarity to users and the House.

Deze leden vragen de regering of er criteria opgesteld kunnen worden die als basis gelden voor het verlenen van de ontheffing om op deze manier meer duidelijkheid naar de afnemers en de Kamer mogelijk te maken.
Asks for clarity on necessity and legal feasibility, questions the assumed reduction in foreign demand, and asks why the validity of the 100 million m3 cap is unlimited in time.

These members ask why the government did not choose to shape article 10f so that its validity is limited to the period in which the consumption cap is necessary to achieve the gas reduction from the Groningen field.

Deze leden vragen waarom de regering er niet voor gekozen heeft artikel 10f zo vorm te geven dat de geldigheidsduur beperkt is tot de periode dat het verbruiksplafond noodzakelijk is voor de realisatie van de gasreductie uit het Groningenveld.
Questions the fairness of treating nine large users differently from the other 161 and whether the 75 million euro compensation scheme is adequate.
Is it fair to treat nine users differently from 161 other large consumers?
Is het rechtvaardig om negen afnemers anders te behandelen dan 161 andere grootverbruikers?
Questions the justification given criticism from the Council of State's advisory division and asks for a fuller weighing of costs and benefits and the compensation rules.
They place serious question marks over the justification, in part given the criticism from the Council of State's advisory division.
Zij zetten grote vraagtekens bij de onderbouwing, mede gelet op de kritiek van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Welcomes the reduction in demand for low-calorific gas but asks about the status of the nitrogen plant and whether energy transition can be combined with the gas phase-out.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill restricting low-calorific gas use by the nine largest industrial consumers and imposing a consumption ceiling should be justified in light of the reduced effect of the wider measures package, the financial impact on large consumers, the equal-treatment and Gas Directive compliance of the distinction made, electricity supply security, and the indefinite duration of the ceiling. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the suggestion to limit the ceiling's duration and added supplementary explanations, while rejecting the request to extend the transmission operator's switching duty and the compensation scheme to consumers affected by the ceiling.
concerns: The advisory division asked for a reasoned justification of the added value of the bill given that the expected effect of other measures has greatly reduced its contribution to ending Groningen gas extraction; the government supplemented the explanation but maintained the bill's value as part of a package.

The advisory division asked for clarification of financial consequences for affected consumers and of the compensation scheme in light of property protection under Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR; the government added a chapter on financial effects while the compensation rules remain to be specified.

The advisory division asked for a reasoned justification that the distinction by consumption threshold complies with the equal-treatment and non-discrimination principles under the Gas Directive; the government argued the criterion is objective and non-discriminatory and did not add further justification beyond its explanation.

The advisory division asked for attention to the possible effects of the consumption ceiling on electricity supply security, including for mothballed gas power plants; the government added discussion of this in the explanatory memorandum.

The advisory division asked that the switching duty of the transmission operator and the compensation right be extended to consumers affected by the ceiling; the government declined, arguing those consumers are not materially affected in their operations.

The advisory division asked that the ceiling's validity be limited to the period needed for the gas reduction, since an indefinite duration was not acceptable; the government added a third paragraph to article 10f providing for the ceiling to lapse.
The advisory division made redactional comments; the government adopted them, sharpening the preamble, the considerans and a notification provision in article 10g.

35337.s: The bill amends the Drank- en Horecawet (renamed Alcoholwet) to curb problematic alcohol use by banning deep discounts for drinks taken off-premises, tightening rules on online alcohol sales including age verification, and giving the Landelijke commissie sociale hygiëne a statutory footing with a public register of certified staff. It also gives municipal inspectors and the NVWA new enforcement powers, including use of fictitious identities for test purchases and minor test buyers aged 16-17, and allows delegation of detailed rules by AMvB and ministerial regulation.
35337.j: The memorandum justifies the new inspection powers and fictitious identities by the impossibility of effective supervision of online sales otherwise and the ethical unacceptability of using minors as test buyers.
q: It is therefore proposed that the supervisor may provide incorrect or incomplete data about his name, address and age when purchasing online or by telephone.
Er wordt daarom voorgesteld dat de toezichthouder onjuiste of onvolledige gegevens mag verstrekken met betrekking tot zijn naam, adres en leeftijd op het moment van online of telefonische aankopen.
d: definition of social hygiene and conditions for recognising diplomas
minimum connecting space between slijtlokaliteit and neringruimte
requirements for online sales of alcohol incl. age verification and guaranteed working method
fees for recognising diplomas and register entries
municipal ordinances on floor area of drinking premises and banning happy-hour discounts on-premises
p: Inspectors may use fictitious identities and give false information when test-purchasing alcohol online, with a written report required afterwards and the legitimation-showing duty switched off during the act.
Artikel I, E (art. 11a-11e) and Artikel I, F
A new independent commission is given statutory powers to recognise diplomas and keep a public register, with detailed content left to lower regulation.
The Minister may bar businesses from online alcohol sales for one to twelve weeks after three violations, enforceable by bestuursdwang.
Municipalities lose their own enforcement of online sales and discount pricing, which move to the national NVWA.

parties: Asks whether discount limits and online sales rules are effective and enforceable, and requests analysis and an enforcement plan from the NVWA.
These members also consider it important that measures are effective and workable and that they do not lead to unnecessary problems in implementation and enforcement.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het ook belangrijk dat maatregelen doelmatig en werkbaar zijn en dat de maatregelen niet tot onnodige problemen leiden in uitvoering en handhaving.
Doubts the effectiveness of the discount limit and fears cross-border purchasing; questions whether the measures are proven effective as the coalition agreement requires.
These members want to know what evidence shows the effectiveness of limiting promotional prices on alcoholic products.
Deze leden willen weten waaruit de effectiviteit blijkt van het begrenzen van de prijsacties van alcoholhoudende producten.
Supports the aim but asks how effectiveness will be monitored, how the age-verification rules will be set and enforced, and how municipalities and the NVWA will supervise.
The CDA members ask how the effectiveness of the measures in this bill will be monitored in the coming years.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op welke wijze de effectiviteit van de maatregelen uit dit wetsvoorstel de komende jaren gemonitord wordt.
Questions the effectiveness of online rules because foreign providers fall outside them, creating an uneven playing field, and doubts that the wederverstrekking offence can be enforced in practice.
Parties delivering from abroad fall outside the new rules: they may give discounts above 25% and may sell strong liquor from a website that also offers other products.
Partijen die leveren vanuit het buitenland vallen buiten de nieuwe regels: zij mogen meer korting geven dan 25% en zij mogen sterke drank leveren vanaf een website die ook andere producten aanbiedt.
Supports most measures but asks about the effectiveness of age verification, the reliance on municipalities for enforcement, and the lack of restrictions on sales in slijterijen to minors.
The SP members note that enforcement of alcohol sales to minors is still not in good shape.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat het met de handhaving van de verkoop van alcohol aan minderjarigen nog niet goed gesteld is.
Welcomes the measures but worries that removing the floor-area rule will increase alcohol access points, and asks whether municipalities can effectively supervise.
The ChristenUnie members fear that by dropping the floor-area requirement it becomes very easy for retailers to set up a small café next to or within their shop.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vrezen dat door het laten vervallen van de vloeroppervlakte-eis het voor retailers heel eenvoudig wordt om naast/in hun zaak een klein café te maken.
Supports the bill but questions how the criminal offence of passing alcohol to minors can be enforced, and asks why the floor-area requirement is being dropped and why advertising is not restricted.
