These members do wonder how this statutory provision will be checked and enforced.
Genoemde leden vragen zich wel af hoe deze wetsbepaling gaat worden gecontroleerd en gehandhaafd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Drank- en Horecawet linked to the prevention agreement and evaluation of the act, raising no substantive objections and only drafting remarks. The government's reply reports that the drafting remarks were followed and that one administrative-burden measure (dropping the requirement to list immediate supervisors on the licence) was removed, along with minor changes.
concerns: The Afdeling offered redactional remarks on article I, parts F and L, which the government followed.

35350-X.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (second supplementary budget), raising commitments and expenditure appropriations across several policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X)

35355.s: The bill adds Article 35a to the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens, allowing the Minister to refuse a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for designated high-integrity functions when police data show links between the applicant and criminal offences that pose a risk to the job. It also replaces 'data from police registers' with 'police data' in Article 36 and requires a report to Parliament within five years on the law's effectiveness.
35355.j: The memorandum justifies the new refusal ground by the high risks of misuse of powers or information in designated functions, which existing screening instruments cannot adequately address.
q: Existing screening instruments are not suitable or sufficient for this, so extending the sources is desirable.
Bestaande screeningsinstrumenten zijn hiervoor niet passend of toereikend, waardoor bronuitbreiding gewenst is.
d: designation of functions requiring high integrity for VOG screening
p: Allows the Minister to refuse a VOG based on police data, including cases without judicial data, widening executive screening power over applicants, with functions and criteria set in a ministerial regulation and a report to Parliament within five years.

parties: Asks whether refusing a VOG on police data places a disproportionate burden on applicants through reversal of the burden of proof and how erroneous or subjective police data would be interpreted.
Does this not place a disproportionate burden on the applicant given the reversal of the burden of proof?
Wordt hiermee niet een onevenredige last op de aanvrager gelet door omkering van bewijslast?
Raises concerns about use of unverified police data, privacy intrusion and proportionality, and asks how the administrative judge could assess whether a police record underlying a refusal is correct.
These members share these concerns and ask the government to explain how it can address them.
Voornoemde leden delen deze zorgen en vragen de regering uiteen te zetten hoe zij deze zorgen kan wegnemen.

Questions why verified police data is not used, the presumption of innocence, and whether a ministerial regulation rather than statute should set the assessment framework, given the speed of changes versus legal certainty.
Police data after all contains more noise than judicial data.
Politiegegevens bevatten immers meer ruis dan justitiële gegevens.

Supports strong integrity checks for sensitive functions but asks for justification for using policy rules instead of legislation and for involving the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens in drafting them, and asks about proportionality and victims' data.
They would appreciate further justification for not elaborating the rules in legislation.
Graag ontvangen zij een nadere onderbouwing om niet te komen tot een nadere uitwerking in wetgeving.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in October 2019 that the bill allowing refusal of a VOG based on police data should not proceed unless revised, because the criteria for 'soft' police data and 'niet-onbesproken gedrag' are insufficiently clear and should be fixed in an AMvB rather than policy rules. The Minister's reply of November 2019 states the explanatory memorandum was expanded on relevance, nature, frequency and timeliness of data, and the criteria were anchored in the statutory text, with the BOA relationship also clarified.
concerns: The Afdeling finds it insufficiently foreseeable what police data may ground a VOG refusal given their soft nature, and the government added factors and examples in the explanatory memorandum and statutory text.

The Afdeling advises that necessary elaboration of the data assessment and the 'niet-onbesproken gedrag' criterion be set by AMvB rather than only policy rules; the government moved the test criterion and factors into the law but kept the detailed framework in Justis policy rules.

Concern that refusal of a VOG on unverified, soft police data is far-reaching for the applicant and weakens citizens' legal protection, addressed by requiring objective, verifiable grounds and attention to source and frequency.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the relationship between the bill and article 4:3(5)(c) of the Besluit politiegegevens for BOA reliability assessments, which the government did.

35382.s: The bill amends the Extradition Act, the Dutch Caribbean Criminal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to implement the 2015 Riga Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism, adding new terrorism-related offences as extraditable and as grounds for jurisdiction and investigative powers. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no new discretionary powers for it.
q: It is desirable to amend the Extradition Act, the Criminal Code BES and the Code of Criminal Procedure to implement the Additional Protocol concluded at Riga on 22 October 2015.
Wenselijk is de Uitleveringswet, het Wetboek van Strafrecht BES en het Wetboek van Strafvordering te wijzigen ter uitvoering van het op 22 oktober 2015 te Riga tot stand gekomen Aanvullend Protocol

parties: Asks how often the omission in the Besluit internationale verplichtingen extraterritoriale rechtsmacht prevented the Netherlands from exercising jurisdiction over Dutch nationals committing offences abroad.
They have a few remarks and a question about the bill.
Zij hebben nog een enkele opmerking en een vraag bij het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued its advice on the bill amending the Extradition Act, the Dutch Caribbean Criminal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to implement the Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism. The Afdeling has no remarks on the bill and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives; no separate government reply (nader rapport) is included in the text beyond the transmittal letter.

35409.s: The bill amends the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 to add article 1.6a, which apportions rental housing jointly owned, possessed or held under a limited right by two or more persons among them pro rata to their share for the rental housing levy. It repeals article 1.3 and applies retroactively from 1 January 2020 to fix a taxation gap that generated objections on equality grounds.
35409.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a repair of the levy's equal-treatment defect, given expected objections and litigation over the 2019 levy, rather than as a new grant of executive power.
q: This ensures that (co-)owners are subject to the rental housing levy from levy year 2020 in proportion to their ownership share.
Hiermee wordt bewerkstelligd dat (mede-)eigenaren vanaf het heffingsjaar 2020 naar rato van de mate van hun eigendom worden betrokken in de verhuurderheffing.

parties: Asks whether the defect should have been known earlier and whether the legislation was flawed, and whether the complexity of the levy becomes too great.
These members would like to know whether this defect should not have been known earlier and whether there was faulty legislation.
Graag vernemen deze leden of dit gebrek niet eerder bekend had moeten zijn en of sprake was van gebrekkige wetgeving.
Asks whether comparable cases exist where retroactive legislation was used and whether alternatives to the chosen repair were examined.
These members ask whether there are comparable situations in which this method was used to introduce legislation.
Deze leden vragen of er vergelijkbare situaties zijn waarbij deze methode is toegepast om wetgeving in te voeren.
Asks the minister to respond to the Council of State's criticism of retroactivity and to Aedes' point that tax reductions are not apportioned pro rata.
Finally, the GroenLinks members would like a further explanation from the Minister of the Council of State's criticism regarding retroactive effect.
Tot slot ontvangen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks graag een nadere toelichting van de Minister op de kritiek van de Raad van State op het punt van de terugwerkende kracht.
Asks the government to reflect on the use of retroactivity in light of the Council of State's criticism and whether other options were considered.
These members ask the government to reflect on the use of retroactivity in the law in light of the Council of State's criticism.
Deze leden vragen de regering om te reflecteren op het gebruik van de terugwerkende kracht in de wet in het licht van de kritiek van de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised (30 January 2020) against retroactive effect back to 1 January 2020 for a bill that repairs the rental housing levy for jointly held rental dwellings, and asked for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented on the limited scope of the change. The minister's reply (21 February 2020) keeps the retroactive effect, justified by the budgetary risk to the 2020 levy, drops one of the stated reasons, and supplements the explanatory memorandum on the other points.
concerns: Retroactive effect to 1 January 2020 for a burdensome measure is not justified by special circumstances such as abuse or announcement effects, and should be dropped.

The explanatory memorandum should justify the limited scope of the change to taxable persons and the tax base, and explain how other provisions such as the energy investment reduction apply to jointly held dwellings.

35418.s: The bill amends Article 55 of the Constitution to create an electoral college for the Eerste Kamer (Senate) elected by Dutch nationals living abroad who meet the requirements for Tweede Kamer voting. It also provides that the amended Article 55 enters into force only once the Kieswet has been adapted, with an additional article governing the timing.
35418.j: The memorandum justifies the new electoral college by equal treatment of voters with provincial voters and by aligning with Tweede Kamer voting rights, leaving the detailed rules to the Kieswet.
q: In order to treat the voters of the electoral college as far as possible in the same way as voters for provincial councils, the new second paragraph of Article 55 aligns with the provisions of Article 129 of the Constitution.

Teneinde de kiezers van het kiescollege zoveel mogelijk op dezelfde wijze te behandelen als de kiezers van provinciale staten, wordt in het nieuwe tweede lid van artikel 55 aangesloten bij de in artikel 129 van de Grondwet opgenomen bepalingen
d: details of electoral college for Dutch citizens abroad

parties: Asks whether restoring Senate voting rights for Dutch citizens abroad by 2023 is realistic and requests the government explain the full Kieswet regulation before the second reading.
They express the hope that, in the context of the second reading of this bill, insight can be given into that further regulation.
Zij spreken de hoop uit dat in het kader van de tweede lezing van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel inzicht kan worden gegeven in die nadere regeling.
Supports the proposal in principle but questions the inconsistency of using two different vote-weight calculation methods and asks for figures and details of the Kieswet before the second reading.
By using two fundamentally different calculation methods in one and the same election, one is hopping between two ideas.
Door bij een en dezelfde verkiezing uit te gaan van twee principieel van elkaar verschillende berekeningswijzen, hinkt men op twee gedachten.
Welcomes the bill as addressing a democratic deficit but asks why the vote-weight rule appears only in the explanatory notes and whether the register of non-residents can be fixed in the meantime.
Is the government anticipating a discussion that still has to take place at a later stage?
Neemt de regering hier al een voorschot op een discussie die in een later stadium nog moet plaatsvinden?

Questions the differing basis for vote weight between non-residents and residents and asks whether Dutch citizens in other Kingdom countries should also be able to vote, invoking Article 4 of the Constitution.
Would it not be more logical and fairer, these members ask, to use the same basis for determining vote weight for all groups?
Zou het, zo vragen deze leden, niet logischer en rechtvaardiger zijn om voor alle groepen uit te gaan van dezelfde basis voor het bepalen van de stemwaarde?
Questions why non-residents should gain influence over the Senate, which is constitutionally a body chosen by the provinces, and whether this undermines the Senate's rationale.
Why is a departure made from the constitutional system for electing the Senate for this specific group?
Waarom wordt voor deze specifieke groep afstand genomen van de grondwettelijke systematiek voor de verkiezing van de Eerste Kamer?
Supports extending influence to citizens abroad via an electoral college but asks how vote weight works, how it changes with turnout, and what turnout is expected.
Do the members speaking understand correctly that as more votes are cast by Dutch citizens abroad, the influence of that electoral college on the composition of the Senate will grow?

Begrijpen de aan het woord zijnde leden het dan goed dat naarmate er meer stemmen door Nederlanders in het buitenland worden uitgebracht dat daarmee ook de invloed van het desbetreffende kiescollege op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer zal groeien?
Argues the legal distinction in vote weight between residents and non-residents needs justification, notes the Council of State's advice, and asks about dual nationals and former nationals.

In the interest of carefully drafting (constitutional) legislation, the ChristenUnie members ask for further argument on why a legal distinction between non-residents and residents is considered justified here.

Vanuit het belang van een zorgvuldige totstandkoming van (grond)wetgeving, vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie nader te beargumenteren waarom een juridisch onderscheid tussen niet-ingezetenen en ingezetenen hier gerechtvaardigd wordt geacht.
Sees value in involving non-residents but asks for more clarity on implementation and the size of the electoral college before amending the Constitution, given the proportionality requirement.
But they do wonder whether there should not be more clarity on the precise implementation options before the Constitution is amended.
Maar zij vragen zich wel af of er niet meer duidelijkheid moet zijn over de precieze mogelijkheden voor uitvoering, voordat er tot wijziging van de Grondwet kan worden overgegaan.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised that the proposed constitutional amendment extending Eerste Kamer voting rights to non-resident Dutch citizens lacks adequate justification, given the long-standing imbalance and absence of international obligations, and that the stemwaarde calculation method and transitional safeguards needed clarification. The government's reply accepted the additional article on entry into force and expanded the memorie van toelichting on history and vote-weight calculation, but rejected using the RNI register for vote weight.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of why the constitutional change is needed now, given that the imbalance has existed since 1983 and no international obligation requires it; the government expanded the history but did not substantively change its rationale.

The Afdeling proposed basing the stemwaarde on the RNI register to stay closer to the population-based method and allow pre-election publication; the government rejected this as the register is incomplete and may contain deceased or non-Dutch persons.
The Afdeling advised adding an article so the constitutional change enters into force only once the Kieswet has been adapted; the government added this article.

35427.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to implement EU vehicle type-approval and market-surveillance regulations, designating the RDW as approval authority and the ILT as market-surveillance authority. It adds new enforcement tools including administrative fines, orders under administrative coercion and bans on marketing non-approved vehicles.
35427.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new enforcement powers as necessary to operationalise EU regulations that require designated authorities and effective sanctions.
q: This amendment only aims to operationalise the regulations to the extent they were not yet, so that they can be applied in the Netherlands in the manner intended by the European legislator.
Deze wetswijziging beoogt alleen de verordeningen te operationaliseren voor zover zij dat nog niet waren, zodat zij op de door de Europese wetgever beoogde wijze in Nederland kunnen worden toegepast.
d: costs of designation applications set by the minister
further rules on reporting dangerous vehicles
rules on assessment and monitoring of technical services
rules for national type-approval and individual approval
conditions for national approval and exemptions
further rules on recall and withdrawal of products
designation of EU regulation articles whose breach is prohibited
designation of parts exempt from approval for installation
designation of parts subject to spot-check inspection
market-surveillance scope set by reference to EU regulations
designation of vehicles by the minister as special mopeds
Besluit voertuigen gains additional statutory basis in art. 33
p: Extends ILT market-surveillance powers over vehicles and applies general administrative law provisions to the surveillance task.
Gives the RDW and ILT wider powers to suspend, withdraw or refuse approvals and to issue bans on marketing, with administrative fines of up to fifth-category amounts.
Introduces administrative fines and orders under administrative coercion as enforcement tools, enabling sanctions without criminal procedure.
Allows the minister to suspend a designation pending review where it appears wrongly granted.
Allows the RDW to refuse registration of approved vehicles on infrastructure-related grounds without specified criteria.

parties: The VVD has no further questions or remarks on the bill.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions or comments on it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
The PVV asks about the costs for citizens and businesses from extra fines and the workload of the RDW and ILT, and what happens if the EU rules are not implemented.
That therefore means extra work for agencies that are already under heavy workload pressure.
Dat betekent dus extra werk voor instanties die al onder zware werkdruk staan.

The CDA asks how the ILT will enforce non-designated vehicles, whether oversight is watertight, and whether the RDW and ILT have adequate resources, and asks the government to reconsider the sanctions regime.
The bill will have financial consequences for the RDW, since this agency is being given more tasks.
Het wetsvoorstel zal financiële gevolgen hebben voor de RDW, aangezien deze instantie met meer taken wordt belast.

GroenLinks supports stronger supervision and enforcement against manipulation of vehicle approval, hopes the gaps exposed by the diesel scandal are closed, and asks how administrative fines relate to criminal prosecution and whether the agencies receive more staff and budget.
One of the lessons of the diesel scandal was the lack of supervision and enforcement, the lack of investigative powers and the difficult provability under existing regulations.
Eén van de lessen van het dieselschandaal was het gebrek aan toezicht en handhaving, het gebrek aan opsporingsmogelijkheden en de lastige bewijsbaarheid onder de bestaande regelgeving.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Uitvoeringswet for EU Regulation 2018/858 must specify concretely which EU regulation provisions the RDW and ILT enforce and which provisions are punishable, rather than using open-ended definitions and copying norms, because these raise lex certa, delegation and EU-law concerns. The minister's nader rapport accepts most points, narrowing the definitions and redrafting articles 29, 20g, 30 and 174a-c, while rejecting the proposal to place the detailed list in the law or an AMvB, instead keeping it in a ministerial regulation.
concerns: The open category of 'other EU regulations' is too vague to serve as a basis for assigning tasks and powers to the RDW and ILT, so the Afdeling advised specifying the regulations in the law itself or by AMvB.
Punishing violations of provisions referenced by a collective definition, to be set later, conflicts with lex certa because the prohibited conduct is not sufficiently knowable in advance.
Copying norms from EU regulations into national law endangers their direct effect and uniform application, contrary to EU law.
The level of punitive sanction must be proportionate to the nature and gravity of the violation, which can only be determined by reference to the concrete provision.
Transposition tables in the annexes should include articles containing member-state options, with explanation where options are not used.
Articles 20e(2) and 26(2) should be amended so that the withdrawal possibility does not cover the situations in subparagraphs c.

35436.s: This bill makes a batch of technical corrections and repairs to the Code of Criminal Procedure, the Criminal Code and related statutes, following the Wet herziening tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke beslissingen. Most changes fix cross-references, mis-numbered provisions and drafting errors, and restore powers or appeal rights that were inadvertently dropped.
35436.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as corrections restoring the original intent of the legislator and fixing errors, with urgent safety reasons given for the temporary crisis admission power.
q: With this textual amendment the statutory text is brought back in line with the original intent of the legislator.
Met onderhavige tekstuele wijziging wordt de wettekst weer in lijn gebracht met de oorspronkelijke bedoeling van de wetgever.
p: Allows the investigating judge, on a prosecutor's request, to order temporary admission of a person under a terbeschikkingstelling for up to seven weeks, extendable, without the person's consent, with the decision immediately enforceable.
Artikel I, onderdelen U, Z, AA, BB
Restores or clarifies appeal routes for the prosecution and the convicted person against decisions on enforcement of conditional sentences and measures, partly strengthening judicial review.

parties: Asks whether tbs patients were conditionally terminated without the required judicial review, and whether courts can afterwards review those terminations.
Have tbs patients become eligible for conditional termination of their tbs without the statutory judicial review having taken place?
Zijn er tbs’ers in aanmerking gekomen voor voorwaardelijke beëindiging van de tbs zonder dat de wettelijke rechterlijke toet sing heeft plaatsgevonden?
Welcomes the government's clarification that appeal is possible against the decision to enforce a conditional sentence, which preserves a check on enforcement.
It is good that the government provides clarity on the possibility to appeal against the decision to enforce a conditional sentence.
Het is goed dat de regering duidelijkheid geeft over de mogelijkheid hoger beroep in te stellen tegen de beslissing tot tenuitvoerlegging van een voorwaardelijke straf.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Reparatiewet herziening tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke beslissingen and made no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that technical corrections and phased entry into force were added to the bill.

35445.s: The bill approves the 2017 Munich Partnership and Development Agreement between the EU and its member states and Afghanistan for the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: is approved for the European part of the Netherlands.
wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks whether provisions are directly binding (eenieder verbindend) in Dutch law and how urgent measures for breaches would work, seeking clarity on the agreement's legal effect and sanctions.
Do obligations on military cooperation arise from the agreement?
Vloeien er verplichten over militaire samenwerking uit het verdrag voort?
Supports the agreement but asks the government to press on religious freedom and protection of vulnerable minorities, including whether conversion to Christianity is banned by law.

Is the government willing to press explicitly for attention to vulnerable religious minorities in Afghanistan, such as Hazara and Christians, bilaterally and within the EU-Afghanistan human rights dialogue?

Is de regering bereid nadrukkelijk aandacht te vragen voor kwetsbare religieuze minderheden in Afghanistan, zoals Hazara en christenen, bilateraal en in het kader van de EU-Afghanistan mensenrechtendialoog?
Asks how the government intends to address root causes of irregular migration such as poverty, bad governance and corruption, and who would take part in the migration dialogue.
Can the government further explain what it precisely understands by conducting a comprehensive dialogue on all relevant migration issues?
Kan de regering nader toelichten wat zij precies verstaat onder het «voeren van een omvattende dialoog met betrekking tot alle relevantie migratiekwesties»?

Questions the late submission to parliament, whether human rights respect is conditional (less for less/more for more), the Western military approach to terrorism, returns to a war zone, and risk of EU complicity in abuses by Afghan security forces including torture.
Can the Minister respond to that, in particular because the PSO covers a period (2014–2024) that has largely already elapsed."
Kan de Minister daarop ingaan, in het bijzonder omdat de PSO betrekking heeft op een periode (2014–2024), deze periode is grotendeels al verlopen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no comments on the draft bill approving the EU-Afghanistan partnership and development cooperation agreement and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs forwarded the advice and the bill without a further reply, as none was needed.

35454.s: The bill implements the EU Copyright Directive in the digital single market by amending the Copyright Act, the Neighbouring Rights Act and the Databases Act. It creates exceptions for text and data mining, cultural heritage preservation and education, introduces press publisher rights, platform liability rules for online content-sharing services, and extended collective licensing for works out of commerce.
35454.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the directive's dialogue, guidance and proportionality requirements, and to ensure parliamentary control through the nahang procedure.
q: The bill implementing the directive creates the possibility to set further rules by general administrative order.
Het wetsvoorstel dat strekt tot omzetting van de richtlijn schept de mogelijkheid bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te geven.
d: Artikel I, D (Artikel 16n / 29c, zevende lid Auteurswet)
rules on platform liability and complaint procedures
Artikel I, H/O (Artikel 44b / 45 Auteurswet, extended licensing)
scope of extended collective licences and out-of-commerce definition
rules on when works are deemed out of commerce
application of platform liability rules to neighbouring rights
p: Removes the word 'serious' from the disproportionality clause, easing authors' claims against exploiters.
Gives platform providers duties to filter and remove content, with complaint and appeal procedures available to users.

parties: Asks what safeguards prevent platform filtering from causing overblocking and a chilling effect on freedom of expression, and how effectiveness and transparency of dispute settlement are monitored.
What safeguards does the bill contain to prevent platforms from filtering too much and thereby creating a chilling effect on freedom of expression?
Welke waarborgen bevat het wetsvoorstel om te voorkomen dat platforms teveel filteren en daarmee een chilling effect kan ontstaan ten opzichte van de vrijheid van meningsuiting?

Asks how the Article 17 filtering obligations square with likely Court of Justice scrutiny, whether consequences apply to platforms that overblock, and what rights recourse makers have across member states.
How can Article 17 and its practical implementation be reconciled with the expected position of the Court of Justice?
Hoe is dan artikel 17 en de praktische uitwerking daarvan te verenigen met het te verwachten standpunt van het Hof van Justitie?
Questions whether legal protection of individuals whose speech is blocked by upload filters is adequately secured, and whether a ban on general monitoring obligations should be written into law.
Does the government consider that the legal protection of that individual is now adequately secured by this bill?
Vindt de regering dat de rechtsbescherming van dat individu nu met dit wetsvoorstel voldoende geborgd is?

Argues the draft does not use the policy freedom the directive allows to protect user rights, and that serious restrictions on free expression should be assessed by an independent judge rather than platforms, and questions the use of a general AMvB for matters touching fundamental rights.
Should such a far-reaching infringement on freedom of expression not ultimately be assessed by the independent judge, rather than by a platform?
Hoort een dergelijke vergaande inbreuk in de uitingsvrijheid niet uiteindelijk te worden beoordeeld door de onafhankelijke rechter, in plaats van door een platform?

Asks that the AMvB on extended collective licensing and the filtering rules be subject to a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure, warns of overblocking of user-generated content, and asks how repeated abuse of filters and complaint procedures will be addressed.
Is the government willing to include this in the law after all?
Is de regering bereid dit alsnog in de wet op te nemen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the implementation bill for Directive (EU) 2019/790 on copyright in the digital single market, raising concerns about filtering measures and freedom of expression, and about delegating binding force to non-binding Commission guidelines via an AMvB. The government's nader rapport accepts both points by clarifying the explanatory memorandum and adding a parliamentary control procedure, while not transposing the guidelines integrally.
concerns: Filtering measures by online sharing platforms may conflict with freedom of expression and the prohibition of censorship, requiring clearer explanation of safeguards and balancing; government clarified the memorandum and retains complaint and appeal mechanisms.

Converting non-binding Commission guidelines directly into binding rules via an AMvB raises democratic legitimacy concerns; government made the provision discretionary, added the nahang procedure for parliamentary control, and clarified that guidelines will not be transposed integrally.

35463.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2017/352 on port services and port financial transparency in Dutch seaports within the trans-European transport network, giving the Minister and the Autoriteit Consument en Markt implementing and supervisory roles. It lets the Minister set rules by ministerial regulation on publication of selection criteria, port charges consultation and complaint procedures, and makes the ACM the complaints and supervisory body with fines up to €900,000 or 10% of turnover.
35463.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation powers as suited to detailed procedural and technical rules that are better placed in lower regulation than in the statute.
q: To the extent such rules are desirable, they lend themselves better to inclusion in lower regulation.
Voor zover dergelijke voorschriften wenselijk zijn, lenen deze zich meer voor opname in lagere regelgeving.
d: publication of minimum requirements and limiting number of port service providers
consultation of port users and stakeholders
division of complaint-handling tasks between ministers and procedural rules for complaints
p: The ACM may impose administrative fines up to €900,000 or 10% of turnover and penalty orders on violators of the regulation.
Complaints about decisions under the Loodsenwet pricing rules are excluded, leaving only objection and appeal against those decisions.

parties: Asks whether the bill addresses earlier objections of excessive supervision of port operators and whether enforcement has been active since the regulation applied.

The VVD members read that the regulation has applied unchanged in the Netherlands since 24 March 2019 and ask whether enforcement has been active since then, or only will be after this bill takes effect.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat de verordening sinds 24 maart 2019 onverkort van toepassing is in Nederland en vragen of er sindsdien actief gehandhaafd wordt, of dat dit pas zal gebeuren, nadat dit wetsvoorstel in werking is getreden.
Questions why a Brussels dictate must be implemented and whether Dutch rules could be made without EU input.

The PVV members ask the government why yet another Brussels dictate will be implemented and whether the government agrees that we do not need Brussels to achieve good regulation on this subject in the Netherlands.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen aan de regering waarom voor de zoveelste keer een Brussels dictaat zal worden geïmplementeerd en of de regering het met deze leden eens is dat we Brussel niet nodig hebben om in Nederland tot een goede regelgeving omtrent dit onderwerp te komen.
Asks whether public ownership of a port affects who is the competent authority, requests the advice of the Adviescommissie Toetsing en Regeldruk and the government's response.
Has read the bill with great interest and sees no reason for further questions.
These members see no reason for further questions on this.
Deze leden zien hiertoe geen aanleiding voor verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the draft Dutch implementing act for the EU port services regulation be revised: it objected to excluding labour-law provisions (Articles 9 and 14) from the complaints procedure and enforcement, to a complaints route against ACM tariff decisions, to a special regime for Article 4(4)(b), and to the four-month decision period. The government's reply accepts most points, extends the complaints scheme to Articles 9 and 14, excludes ACM tariff decisions, deletes the special regime, shortens the period in the explanatory memorandum, and adds procedural clarifications.
concerns: Excluding labour-law provisions (Articles 9 and 14) from the complaints procedure and enforcement was not convincingly justified, so these were brought under the complaints regime.
Allowing complaints to the ACM about tariffs it sets itself is incompatible with an impartial procedure, so ACM decisions were excluded from the complaints scheme.
The special regime for Article 4(4)(b) of the regulation misreads its purpose and should be deleted.
The four-month decision period differs from the two-month period in the Electricity and Gas Acts without justification; the government justified it and shortened it in the memorandum.
Procedural rules are thin; the government agreed to provide for a ministerial regulation on the complaints procedure and clarified the relation to enforcement requests and binding decisions.

35472.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through a fourth supplementary budget for an emergency jobs and economy package, adding about 1.15 billion euro in expenditure. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 26 May 2020, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2020

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2020

35481.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, as a third incidental supplementary budget to support local information provision in response to Covid-19. It adjusts appropriations and expenditure lines across policy articles and takes effect from 29 May 2020, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35490.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Infrastructure Fund, adding a first incidental supplementary budget for public transport availability payments (beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV). It is a purely budgetary adjustment with an effective date set retroactively to 1 March 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2020

35517.s: The bill amends the Dutch Housing Act (Woningwet) to increase workability and future-proofing and to reduce administrative burdens, following the evaluation of the 2015 revision. It loosens procedures for mergers and affiliations, makes fit-and-proper tests and incompatibility rules more principle-based and risk-oriented, and adds a new experimentation clause allowing deviation from parts of the Act by general administrative order.
35517.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and wider discretion as allowing local customisation, risk-based supervision, and reduced administrative burden while retaining safeguards.
q: The government wants to offer more scope for local customisation, room for more risk-based supervision, and to reduce administrative burdens.
De regering wil meer mogelijkheden bieden om lokaal maatwerk toe te passen, ruimte geven voor meer risicogericht toezicht en de administratieve lasten beperken.
d: ARTIKEL I, Q/Art. 41 and others (experimentation clause, Art. 61u)
experiments deviating from Housing Act chapters IIIa and IV
rules on implementing experiments deviating from chapters IIIa and IV
ARTIKEL I, Art. 25(6) and 30 (amvb on incompatibility)
further rules on exceptions to incompatibility and board composition
ARTIKEL I, Art. 26 / 48 (ministerial regulation on income verification and data)
income determination and data requirements for rental allocation
further rules on guarantee fund risk and financial frameworks
p: The minister may issue binding instructions to the guarantee fund and dismiss its entire supervisory board, with limited procedural constraints.
Experiments allow departure from statutory chapters by general administrative order for up to five years, with evaluation report to parliament.
The supervisor may take the public interest in housing into account in its decisions, widening its discretion beyond explicit rules.
Housing association mergers may proceed without tenant organisations' consent in specified circumstances, and some merger approvals are dropped.

parties: Asks whether tenant organisations effectively hold a veto on mergers and whether the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties can proceed without tenant approval when consent is withheld on non-housing grounds; also asks how municipalities can enforce local housing agreements.
The VVD members read that tenant organisations are given a de facto veto over mergers.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat huurdersorganisaties een feitelijk vetorecht krijgen op fusies.

Asks whether local flexibility could slow housebuilding, whether the Minister should be able to override housing agreements not aligned with national ambitions, and why municipalities are not obliged to have a housing vision.
The CDA members ask the government what it thinks of the idea of the Minister overruling performance agreements that are not in line with national housing and building ambitions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering wat zij ziet in het idee van het «overrulen» van prestatieafspraken door de Minister indien deze niet in lijn met nationale woon- en bouwambities.

Asks whether the replacement of the list of incompatible functions with generic principles safeguards against conflicts of interest and who checks compliance; asks how the general members' meeting's dual safeguard works in practice.
These members ask to what extent this guarantees that no conflict of interest arises.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre hiermee is gewaarborgd dat er geen belangenverstrengeling plaatsvindt?

Asks for clarity on merger conditions, what happens after a negative evaluation of an exemption for a Woningwet region, and whether a threshold should exempt small holdings from the requirement of a municipal opinion.

Objects that tenants' consent (instemmingsrecht) and information rights are being removed or narrowed in mergers, governance and sales under the guise of administrative burden, and asks the government to reconsider.
The SP members are not happy that tenants' control is being restricted in a merger.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn er niet over te spreken dat de zeggenschap van huurders wordt ingeperkt bij een fusie.
Asks how tenant participation and consultation with tenant organisations is safeguarded in the bill and whether the changes were discussed with tenant organisations.
Asks whether the government sees further room to amend the Housing Act so corporations can address housing problems and whether EU rules constrain corporations.
Does the cabinet still see possibilities to further amend the Housing Act so that maximum use can be made of the strength of housing corporations?

Ziet het kabinet nog mogelijkheden om de Woningwet verder aan te passen zodat maximaal gebruik kan worden gemaakt van de kracht van woningcorporaties om problemen op het gebied van volkshuisvesting te lijf te gaan?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Woningwet to give housing corporations more room for local tailoring and reduce administrative burdens, raising a state aid concern that changes to DAEB tasks may fall outside the EC 2009 approval and advising consultation with the European Commission before submission. The government's nader rapport states it has supplemented the explanatory memorandum, argues the changes stay within the approved framework, and makes several textual adjustments.
concerns: Changes to DAEB tasks may take the financing outside the European Commission's state aid approval, so consultation with the Commission before submission is advised; the government added explanation but argues most changes do not touch the approval.
The explanatory memorandum should specify how each change relates to the 2009 EC decision, which the government has done in chapter 4.

The Afdeling doubts the bill will substantially solve the fundamental problems of the housing market, against the explanatory memorandum's suggestion; the government rebuts by pointing to combined measures for the rental market.

35526.s: The bill creates a temporary chapter in the Public Health Act (Wet publieke gezondheid) giving the government and mayors powers to impose safe-distance rules and other behavioural measures during the COVID-19 epidemic, largely through ministerial regulations and a general administrative order. It includes parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang), a six-month sunset with possible extension by royal decree, monthly reporting to parliament, and a fallback allowing emergency ordinances if regulations cannot be made in time.
35526.j: The memorandum justifies broad delegation to ministerial regulation by the need for speed, flexibility and frequent amendment during the epidemic, and adds parliamentary voorhang and a sunset to offset democratic deficits.
q: Therefore a system is proposed that relies on delegation to the level of ministerial regulation, with room for differentiation
Daarom wordt een stelsel voorgesteld dat uitgaat van delegatie naar het niveau van ministeriële regeling, met ruimte voor differentiatie
d: procedure for adopting ministerial regulations under the chapter
differentiation between areas, age groups, activities and places
setting the safe-distance rule and exemptions
places where group gatherings are prohibited and group size limits
public places that may be closed or subject to conditions
events that may be prohibited or conditioned
hygiene rules, protective equipment, contact professions, public facilities, occupancy of paid accommodation
bans on certain passenger transport and rules on transport facilities
prohibition or conditions on educational activities
closure or conditions for childcare, exceptions and municipal location designation
residual catch-all measures and instruction to mayors to issue emergency ordinances
rules on information provision by mayors
minister may transfer mayoral powers to the safety region chair
mayor may grant exemptions in special circumstances
mayor's orders to secure compliance on public places
mayor's orders to stop activities and remove persons from private places
p: Allows ministers to adopt binding measures by ministerial regulation outside the normal statutory framework, which must then be converted into a bill within two weeks, with parliament deciding finally.

Safe-distance obligation set by general administrative order, with exemptions by ministerial regulation, restricting citizens' freedom of movement and assembly subject to voorhang and proportionality.
Mayors may issue written directions or emergency orders to operators of public places, with reasons required but without prior parliamentary involvement.
Minister or mayor may issue binding directions and emergency orders to operators of private places, including workplaces, with reasons required.
Mayor may issue any orders necessary to ensure compliance on public places when crowding threatens distancing rules, with no specified limits on content.
Mayor may order cessation of activities and removal of persons from private non-residential places where there is serious fear of virus spread.
Minister may transfer mayoral powers exclusively to the safety region chair in cases with effects beyond local significance.
Enforcement by administrative coercion and penalty payments available to the minister and mayors.

parties: Asks about the necessity of the law for legal practice and clear government communication, and about procedure if parliament cannot respond within one week.
Can the government outline the procedure if the situation arises where both chambers are unable or unwilling to respond within one week?
Kan de regering de behandelprocedure schetsen wanneer de situatie zich voordoet dat beide Kamers niet in staat willen of kunnen zijn binnen één week te reageren?
Supports a legal basis and stronger democratic control but finds the one-week pre-consultation short and asks what powers chambers have to amend or block draft ministerial regulations.
These members ask what options the chambers have if they want a draft ministerial regulation amended, or want it not to take effect at all.
Deze leden vragen welke mogelijkheden de Kamers hebben wanneer zij een ontwerp voor een ministeriële regeling aangepast zouden willen zien, of wensen dat het ontwerp geheel niet in werking treedt?
Argues that open-ended norms and ministerial regulations give too little rights guarantees, and that courts should be able to review restrictions fully rather than only marginally.

These members therefore find that the representative body must be able to review restrictive measures and that a court, when asked, must be able to review a proposal to restrict fundamental rights fully, not merely marginally.

Deze leden vinden daarom dat de volksvertegenwoordiging beperkende maatregelen moet kunnen toetsen en dat een rechter desgevraagd een voorstel tot beperking van uitoefening van grond- en mensenrechten niet slechts marginaal, maar volledig moet kunnen toetsen.
Strongly objects to delegation to ministerial regulations because parliament cannot amend them, and asks why genuine decision-making power was not given to the House.
Why did the government not choose genuine decision-making power for at least the House of Representatives?
Waarom heeft de regering niet gekozen voor daadwerkelijke zeggenschap van in ieder geval de Tweede Kamer?

Welcomes a statutory basis but questions whether a one-week pre-consultation gives solid democratic legitimacy and whether voorhang offers real parliamentary involvement; floats a binding approval right.
To what extent is it realistic to expect the representative body to form a sound judgment within a week on a proposed measure that may even affect fundamental rights?

In hoeverre is het reëel te verwachten dat de volksvertegenwoordiging zich binnen een week een goed oordeel kan vormen over een voorgestelde maatregel waarmee zelfs grondrechten in het geding kunnen zijn?

Welcomes a statutory framework protecting legal certainty, proportionality and temporariness, but asks why a standalone temporary law was not chosen and why emergency decrees and direct ministerial powers remain as fallbacks.
Was this not precisely the reason it was important for this law to come into being?
Was dit niet juist de reden dat het van belang was dat deze wet er moest komen?
Opposes the bill because it sidelines parliament and gives the Minister open-ended powers, and calls for withdrawal and a separate law balancing health against civil liberties.
The bill before us violates that constitutional principle and gives the Minister of Health full scope to impose far-reaching restrictions on citizens' behaviour through his own regulations.
Het wetsvoorstel dat voorligt schendt dat constitutionele beginsel en geeft de Minister van VWS de volledige ruimte met eigen regelingen vergaande beperkingen aan het gedrag van burgers op te leggen.
Supports ending emergency decrees but argues the bill is too broad and vague on rights, asks for stronger parliamentary involvement, minimal restrictions, and local democratic control.
They attach importance to parliamentary involvement being further strengthened and to the text of the bill showing that restrictions are as minimal as possible.
Zij hechten eraan dat de parlementaire betrokkenheid verder versterkt wordt en dat ook uit de tekst van het wetsvoorstel blijkt dat de beperkingen zo minimaal mogelijk zijn.
Very concerned that the bill sidelines parliament and allows indefinite, rights-infringing measures that they consider neither necessary nor proportionate.
The proposed measures are in these members' view not necessary (and therefore unlawful), because the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity are not met.
De voorgestelde maatregelen zijn naar het oordeel van deze leden niet noodzakelijk (en derhalve onrechtmatig), omdat niet voldaan is aan de vereisten van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises, on 27 July 2021, that most provisions of the COVID-19 temporary act (Twm) may be extended to 1 December 2021, but asks for clearer criteria, justification for dropping the curfew and information-provision powers, and a hearing on the approval bill. The government's reply of 26 August 2021 accepts the extension, explains its criteria, drops the curfew and information powers, and declines to request advice on the approval bill.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clearer criteria linking the OMT risk-level benchmarks to the necessity and proportionality test for extending the Twm; the government explains the legal weighing framework but says precise medical criteria cannot be set in advance.

The Afdeling asks that the curfew power not be dropped without substantive justification; the government explains it is no longer necessary given the epidemiological situation and would seek a new statutory basis via expedited legislation if needed.
The Afdeling notes the basis for the curfew should not return to article 8 Wbbbg if reinstated; the government agrees that a new legislative route would be preferred if the measure were needed again.

The Afdeling asks for timely insight into how gradual phasing-out, to preserve credibility and effectiveness of measures, will feature in government deliberations; the government explains its approach but notes that some relaxations proved too early.

The Afdeling asks to be heard on the bill approving the extension decree given fundamental constitutional rights at stake; the government declines, invoking article 73(1) Constitution's last clause, arguing the bill merely approves the decree.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 3 February 2021 that the emergency measures under the Temporary COVID-19 Act remain necessary and that extension for three months is justified, without objections to lapsing parts of the Act at this time. The Minister replied in a nader rapport of 9 February 2021, agreeing with the advice and forwarding the extension decision to parliament.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the COVID-19 measures still necessary given the high infection numbers and uncertainty about new variants, so extension for three months is justified.
Because the measures are far-reaching, they should remain in force no longer than necessary, which is why the Act has a three-month duration with possible extension.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the extension to 1 June 2021 of the temporary COVID-19 measures under Chapter Va of the Wet publieke gezondheid, concluding that the Twm cannot yet be dispensed with because it provides the basis for phased scaling down, but noted that new provisions are still being added without an overview of their timing. The minister's reply accepts the need to extend and adds to the explanatory memorandum an overview of announced amendments and their planned timeline.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that, given current circumstances, repealing parts of the Twm is not yet appropriate because the law is needed for phased scaling down of measures, and extension by three months is reasonable.
The Afdeling asks for an overview of announced Twm amendments and their intended timeline, which the minister added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling stresses that consistent policy and clear communication are needed to avoid raising expectations about scaling down measures that may prove unfeasible.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19, supporting the need for a temporary statutory basis but raising major objections to the division of powers between ministers and tiers of government, the one-year duration, criminal record registration of violations, and inclusion of the corona-app rules. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the advice, including shortening the duration to six months, adding parliamentary information and pre-hanging procedures, and removing the app provision.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the minister of VWS held too central a role, encroaching on other ministers' portfolios, and the government adopted joint vaststelling by the VWS, JenV and BZK ministers.
Afdeling asked for an explicit general necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity clause, which the government added as article 58b.
Restrictions on visits to care locations may infringe the right to the home; the Afdeling asked for specific conditions distinguishing long-term residence, which were added in article 58o.

Afdeling accepted delegation to ministerial regulations for speed but demanded stronger parliamentary information and prior-review rights; government added an information duty and a pre-hanging procedure.

Afdeling objected to the overtakeover power of veiligheidsregio chairs and to keeping the Wpg emergency ordinance route; the overtake power was replaced by a recommendation power and the second fallback provision was merged.
Afdeling requested clearer criteria for mayoral exemptions and advice from the GGD, which were included.

Afdeling objected to registering violations in the criminal record (strafblad) given the broad impact on citizens; the government tightened its policy on VOG screening rather than fully excluding registration.
Afdeling advised deleting the corona-app/digital means provision as premature and unnecessarily complicating the urgent bill; government removed article 58v.
Afdeling requested clarification of the veilige afstand norm, the group-formation prohibition and its exceptions, and a narrower exemption wording, all adopted in the revised text.
Afdeling considered a one-year duration too long and proposed six months with parliamentary-approved extension; government adopted six months with three-month extensions.

35535.s: The bill amends the Dutch Surrender Act (Overleveringswet) and Extradition Act to align them with recent EU Court of Justice case law on the European Arrest Warrant, including allowing the issuing state to issue an arrest warrant before extradition of its nationals and adding grounds to postpone surrender where fundamental rights risks exist. It also extends time limits for court decisions in certain circumstances, such as pending preliminary references to the EU Court and suspected rights violations.
35535.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to comply with recent Court of Justice rulings on surrender procedures and fundamental rights, not as a grant of new executive discretion.
q: This amendment will be included in an amendment note.
Deze wijziging wordt opgenomen in een nota van wijziging.
p: Rechtbank must refuse surrender where serious, fact-based grounds show a real risk of fundamental rights violation, with postponement and review mechanisms attached.

Court may extend decision deadlines in exceptional circumstances by up to 60 or 30 days repeatedly, lengthening detention pending surrender, with notification duties to Eurojust and the issuing authority.
Minister may refuse extradition in favour of surrender under a European arrest warrant from the state of nationality, giving priority to the EAB route.
Artikel I J (art. 31) and I K (art. 36)
Minister may set aside statutory extradition provisions and give priority to court surrender decisions, and may attach conditions to temporary return of persons for trial.

parties: Asks how mutual trust and recognition of judicial decisions are maintained with countries where judicial independence is under pressure, and about delays from prejudicial procedures.
How does the government intend to ensure that a limitation of the principle of mutual trust will not lead to even less trust between member states?
Hoe wil de regering bewerkstelligen dat een inperking van het beginsel van wederzijds vertrouwen geen aanleiding zal zijn voor nog minder vertrouwen tussen lidstaten?
Asks whether an additional rule-of-law test should be built into the Surrender Act to avoid surrendering people where European rule-of-law principles are breached.
Is the government willing to build an additional test into the Surrender Act, respecting mutual trust, so that people are not surrendered where European rule-of-law principles are violated?

Is de regering bereid een extra toets in de overleveringswet in te bouwen, met inachtneming van het beginsel van wederzijds vertrouwen, om geen mensen over te leveren indien er strijd is met de Europese Rule of Law beginselen?
Questions the public prosecutor's role after the CJEU ruling requiring judicial supervision independent of the executive, and favours removing the special instruction power.
These members have long held that abolishing the special instruction power would be good.
Deze leden zijn al langer van mening dat het schrappen van de bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid goed zou zijn.
Stresses human rights, long pre-trial detention, detention conditions, defence rights and the lack of attention to rights protection in the bill.
Why is there no attention to humane treatment and safeguarding of human rights?
Waarom is er geen aandacht voor de menswaardige behandeling en het waarborgen van mensenrechten?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing parts of the EU European Arrest Warrant framework decision should explain why Article 6 of the Overleveringswet was not amended despite conflicting Court of Justice case law, and clarify the explanatory memorandum, plus several drafting remarks. The Minister replied that Article 6 will be substantially revised via a future nota van wijziging after consultation, and that the bill was supplemented to remove a provision in the Wet wederzijdse erkenning following the SF judgment.
concerns: Article 6 of the Overleveringswet conflicts with CJEU rulings Poplawski and Wolzenburg, and the explanatory memorandum should explain why it was not amended; the government now plans a broader revision of Article 6 via a future amendment.

Article 6(5) imposes an administrative requirement (permanent residence permit) on long-term residents that the CJEU considers incompatible with EU law, which the explanatory memorandum should address.
Several redactional remarks on wording, cross-references and the explanatory memorandum were adopted in the amended bill.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a government amendment note to the bill implementing the EU framework decision on the European arrest warrant, following a CJEU ruling of 24 November 2020 that a Dutch public prosecutor cannot act as the executing judicial authority. The Minister of Justice and Security accepted the main advice, adding clarifications, moving additional powers to the investigating judge, and explaining why no further changes to the Surrender Act were made.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to explain how it chose which powers of the public prosecutor to change in the Surrender Act in line with the CJEU ruling, and the explanatory notes were supplemented accordingly.

The Afdeling advised anchoring in the Surrender Act the role of the investigating judge or court in continued detention and the time limit for review, but the government argued the existing judicial review system already complies and deferred structural change to a WODC study.
The explanatory notes were to address the consequences for pending requests for supplementary consent and pending shortened procedures, and this was added.

35544.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment amounts for general and additional grants to €26.7 billion and setting integration and decentralisation grant commitments, to compensate municipalities for COVID-19 related losses and costs. It takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2020 and is accompanied by the budget table and explanatory memorandum.
35544.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments by the COVID-19 crisis and refers to a separate letter on the compensation package for local governments.
q: Because of the corona measures there were no terraces set up and no markets or events from 1 March to 1 June.
Door de corona-maatregelen waren er in de periode van 1 maart tot 1 juni geen terrassen opgesteld en zijn er geen markten- en evenementen geweest.

35553.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, the third incidental supplementary budget on corona measures, mainly reallocating funds to democratic elections (a recruitment campaign for polling staff and voter information) and to municipalities running central vote counting. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum concerns budget reallocations rather than executive powers.
q: A nationwide recruitment campaign will therefore be launched in autumn 2020 to find a new group of polling station members and counters.
Er zal daarom in het najaar van 2020 een landelijke wervingscampagne worden gestart om een nieuwe lichting stembureauleden en tellers te vinden.

35562.s: The bill amends the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg to create legal bases for processing pseudonymised health data for addiction care monitoring and for trauma-care registration by trauma centres, with implementing rules left to an AMvB. It also amends the Wet langdurige zorg so the CIZ must supply aggregated forecasts to the Minister of VWS on shifts of clients into the Wlz, including processing of personal and health data for that purpose.
35562.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to improve quality of care, meet EU obligations, and provide a legal basis required under the GDPR, arguing that anonymisation and consent are not feasible alternatives.
q: Therefore, anchoring in law, with all safeguards, is the only option under the GDPR to maintain the existing quality registration.
Daarom is verankering in de wet, met alle waarborgen, de enige optie op grond van de AVG om de bestaande kwaliteitsregistratie te behouden.
d: data categories, transfer method, security, retention for addiction care monitoring
data categories, transfer, security, retention for acute and trauma care registration
p: The Minister may process health and citizen-service-number data from addiction care providers and disclose it to third parties for statistical and policy purposes, limited to pseudonymised data.
Trauma centres are empowered to process pseudonymised patient data for regional and national monitoring and benchmarking.
The CIZ may process personal and health data to generate aggregated forecasts for the Minister on Wlz client shifts.

parties: Wants personal privacy and the security of sensitive health data guaranteed as an essential condition, and asks how that security is organised.
On the other hand, it is also essential for the VVD members that individuals' private lives remain as well guaranteed and protected as possible.
Aan de andere kant is het voor de leden van de VVD-fractie ook essentieel dat de persoonlijke levenssfeer van individuen zo goed mogelijk gewaarborgd en beveiligd blijft.
Questions GDPR compliance and the medical confidentiality implications, and asks for the underlying AMvB (data set, access, security, retention) to be sent to the Chamber before plenary debate.

The CDA members also ask whether the government can ensure that, before plenary treatment of this bill, the underlying general administrative order (AMvB), specifying which precise data are recorded, who has access, how they are secured and how long they are kept, is sent to the Chamber.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen daarnaast of de regering er zorg voor kan dragen dat voordat de plenaire behandeling van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel plaatsvindt, de onderliggende algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) ... naar de Kamer wordt gestuurd.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill creating legal bases for processing pseudonymised patient data for addiction-care (LADIS) and trauma-care registries, plus CIZ aggregate data, should define addiction care in the law and clarify how data subjects' GDPR rights are guaranteed. The government reply adopted a statutory definition of addiction care with a non-exhaustive list, and clarified in the explanatory memorandum that GDPR data-subject rights do not apply to the double-pseudonymised registry processing.
concerns: The bill lacks a definition of addiction care, leaving unclear which providers must supply data; the government added a non-exhaustive statutory definition.

The explanation of data-subject rights under the GDPR is contradictory and unclear for pseudonymised data supplied by providers; the government fixed the inconsistency but justified non-application of GDPR rights via Article 11 rather than Article 89 derogations.

35570-IIB.s: This bill fixes the 2021 budget statement for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, in thousands of euros. It sets the appropriations and receipts per article for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij, the three Governors' cabinets and the Kiesraad.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2021 is established.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft 2021 budget law for the other High Colleges of State, Cabinets of the Governors and the Electoral Council (IIB) and raised no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the House of Representatives. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that the Afdeling has no remarks on the proposals, except for one non-blank advice concerning the Ministry of Finance, and that some budgets require amendments.

35580.s: The bill makes the school diploma for practical education (praktijkonderwijs) and for the special secondary education (vso) work-oriented and day-activity profiles a statutory diploma issued by the school director, with a portfolio forming part of it. It also renames the former certificates to diploma or verklaring across several education and compulsory schooling laws.
35580.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the minister for a diploma model by aligning with the existing system for other school types and consulting sector councils, while the school board drafts the portfolio itself.
q: The Minister does not establish a model for that.
De Minister stelt daarvoor geen model vast.
d: Artikel I A (art. 14d lid 1, Wet op de expertisecentra)
criteria for awarding vso work-oriented diploma set in school regulation
Artikel I B (art. 14g lid 1, Wet op de expertisecentra)
criteria for awarding vso day-activity diploma set in school regulation
Artikel I A/B (art. 14d lid 3 and 14g lid 3)
model of the vso school diploma
Artikel II B (art. 29a lid 1, Wet voortgezet onderwijs)
criteria for awarding praktijkonderwijs diploma set in school regulation
model of the praktijkonderwijs school diploma
Artikel III (art. 73 lid 1, Wet voortgezet onderwijs BES)
criteria for awarding BES praktijkonderwijs diploma set in school regulation
model of the BES praktijkonderwijs school diploma

parties: No questions or concerns raised; the fractie has no questions on the bill.
The members of the VVD fractie have read the bill with interest and have no questions about it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel Schooldiploma praktijkonderwijs en voortgezet speciaal onderwijs en hebben daarover geen vragen.
Welcomes the diploma but asks how the Inspectorate will check schools' compliance with the new legal duty and how non-compliant schools will be addressed.

They also ask to what extent the Inspectorate of Education will check whether schools issue a school diploma once this has become a legal obligation.](The fractie also asks how schools will be held to account if they fail to meet this legal duty.)
Tevens vragen zij in hoeverre de Inspectie van het Onderwijs scholen gaat controleren of zij een schooldiploma uitreiken zodra dit een wettelijke verplichting is geworden
Welcomes the bill as giving every pupil the same recognition; no further questions.
These members have no further questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Supports the diploma but asks why it is not on DUO's diploma register and why it carries no civil effect, and raises transport-card inequality.
Why is there no civil effect attached to the diploma by default?
Waarom er standaard geen civiel effect vastzit aan het diploma?
Asks how school regulations will be kept from diverging too much, and who decides and is involved in awarding the diploma, including pupils and teachers.
How will it be prevented that these regulations diverge too much from one another, they ask.
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat deze reglementen te veel van elkaar gaan verschillen, zo vragen zij.

Supports the diploma and school autonomy in deciding eligibility, asks why the diploma is excluded from DUO's register, and asks whether the government recognises that praktijkonderwijs should be funded outside the passend onderwijs system.
They ask whether the government can explain the considerations behind the school diploma not being entered in DUO's diploma register.
Zij vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten welke overwegingen eraan ten grondslag liggen dat het schooldiploma niet in het diplomaregister van DUO wordt opgenomen.
Asks whether the government agrees the bill is a fine recognition of a special group of pupils that should not pass unnoticed.
The members of the ChristenUnie fractie ask whether the government agrees that this is such a fine bill.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen of de regering het met hen eens is dat dit zo’n mooi wetsvoorstel is
Asks how the diploma's social recognition fits with not setting national norms, and how the discretion of the competent authority over regulations relates to the prescribed model.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill allowing school diplomas for practical education and special secondary education, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer with only redactional remarks. The minister's reply confirms that the redactional comments were incorporated and sends the amended bill and explanatory memorandum to parliament.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum state whether and how Caribbean Netherlands school boards were consulted on the draft decree.
The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum address legal protection regarding practical education and special secondary education diplomas.
The Afdeling advised adding a substantive conflict-of-laws provision in relation to article VII of the WVO 20xx given possible overlap.

35625.s: The bill strengthens the legal position and legal protection of students in senior vocational education (mbo) by replacing the onderwijsovereenkomst with a registration-based relationship, requiring a studentenstatuut and an internal complaints and objection procedure with an independent advisory committee. It moves disputes between mbo/ho institutions and students to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak of the Raad van State as single first-instance appeal body, abolishing the CBHO, and adds rules on suspension, expulsion and support for students with disabilities.
35625.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the need for detailed and changeable rules on suspension, expulsion and support, and it presents the new appeal route as strengthening students' legal protection.
q: The bill aims to give students in senior vocational education (mbo) a better legal position and legal protection.
Inleiding Dit wetsvoorstel heeft tot doel om studenten in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) een betere rechtspositie en rechtsbescherming te geven.
d: Artikel I, J (art. 7.4.8 lid 4 WEB) and Artikel I, FF (art. 8.1.7c lid 3)
conditions for financial support of student board members
institution may establish a college van beroep bijzonder onderwijs by regulation
p: Artikel I, Q and Artikel I, R (art. 7.5.9 WEB)

Student disputes move from the civil courts to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak of the Raad van State as single first-instance body, and abolition of the CBHO changes the forum for higher-education disputes.
Artikel I, X (art. 8.1.1 lid 1c WEB) and Artikel I, FF (art. 8.1.7d)
Institutions gain power to suspend and expel students, subject to written motivation, parental notice for minors and a hearing before expulsion.
Denominational institutions may create their own appeal college whose decisions cannot be appealed to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak, subject to a ministerial veto power.

parties: Asks whether students bear primary responsibility for knowing their rights and whether the onderwijsovereenkomst gave real negotiating room, and how selection instruments and suspension grounds will work.
Is it not primarily the responsibility of the adult student to be well informed about their rights and obligations, the members ask.
Is het niet primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de volwassen student om goed geïnformeerd te zijn over hun rechten en plichten, zo vragen de leden.
Supports abolishing the onderwijsovereenkomst and equalising rights, but asks which grounds for suspension and expulsion apply and how student carers are protected, and questions regulatory burden.
These members support abolishing the onderwijsovereenkomst and taking measures to make the legal position of mbo students more equal to that in higher, secondary and primary education.

Deze leden steunen het afschaffen van de onderwijsovereenkomst en om maatregelen te treffen om de rechtspositie van studenten in het mbo meer gelijk te schakelen aan het hoger, voortgezet en primair onderwijs.

Welcomes the bill's accessible complaints facility, independent advisory committee and external appeal body, and asks why suspension is limited to two weeks and why students with disabilities should be safeguarded.
These members therefore endorse the importance of this law and are pleased that it provides for setting up an accessible facility where students can go with all their questions.

Deze leden onderschrijven daarom het belang van deze wet, en zijn blij dat hiermee wordt geregeld dat het oprichten van een toegankelijke faciliteit waar studenten met al hun vragen naartoe kunnen mogelijk wordt.
