Regrets that the negative binding study advice remains the instrument for expulsion, and asks whether COVID-19 disruption should excuse students from the BSA norm and whether students are actively informed of their new rights.
These members consider it a missed opportunity that the position of mbo students has not been improved on this point.
Voornoemde leden vinden het een gemiste kans dat de positie van de mbo-studenten op dit punt niet is verbeterd.

Welcomes the abolition of the onderwijsovereenkomst and the accessible route for wrongful refusal of admission, but opposes the bindend studieadvies as it sends students away and asks about a student statute.
These members have always opposed the binding study advice, because it does not work and unnecessarily sends students away from the course.
Deze leden hebben zich altijd tegen het bindend studieadvies gekeerd, omdat het niet werkt en onnodig studenten van de opleiding wegstuurt.

Asks whether expulsion after a BSA should be conditional on being justified so students know when schools may deregister them, and whether the central desk will genuinely inform students and cover parents' rights.
Does the government acknowledge that expulsion after a BSA must then be a condition that is well-founded, so that students also know when a school has the right to deregister them?
Erkent de regering dat dan wel als voorwaarde moet gelden dat verwijdering na een BSA gegrond plaatsvindt, zodat studenten ook weten wanneer een school het recht heeft om hen uit te schrijven?

Asks why the suspension period differs from secondary education, why the Onderwijsinspectie cannot order specific remedial action for individual students, and what the status of the support agreements is.
These members ask whether the government recognises that a strict separation between supervision of quality assurance and handling of individual cases is unsatisfactory for situations like this.
Deze leden vragen of de regering onderkent dat een strikte scheiding tussen het toezicht op de kwaliteitszorg en de uitwerking in individuele casus» voor situaties als deze onbevredigend is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division broadly welcomes the bill strengthening legal protection of mbo students (replacing written education agreements with internal complaint procedures and administrative appeal to the ABRvS), but raises objections on implementability, the constitutional basis under article 112 of the Constitution, exclusivity of administrative remedies, and the transition timeline. The government's reply accepts most points, postpones the entry-into-force date to 1 August 2022, clarifies the legal status of decisions, and adds monitoring and evaluation, while declining to extend appeal rights to examination bodies and rejecting a statutory basis for a central registration system.
concerns: The Council warns of a significant cultural shift and administrative burden for mbo institutions and asks for a realistic transition period and support, which the government adopts by postponing entry into force to 2022.

The Council asks for an explanation of how shifting student disputes from private to administrative law fits article 112 of the Constitution, and the government adds a clarification in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asks for clarity on the relationship between the college of appeal for special education, the ABRvS and the civil courts, and the government adds explanation on this.

The Council doubts whether the ABRvS will keep the short processing times of the CBHO and suggests a statutory deadline; the government agrees on the importance but relies on an agreed average of 94 days and expedited procedures instead of a legal deadline.

The Council considers a one-week maximum suspension unrealistic and asks for a longer period and for suspensions to last longer within removal procedures; the government raises the maximum to two weeks and adopts the second point.
The Council suggests extending appeal rights to examination committees and examiners; the government declines for now and defers this to the evaluation.
The Council advises a statutory basis for a central mbo enrolment register; the government declines, arguing the mbo enrolment process is institution-based and participation is voluntary.

The Council's drafting remarks, including replacing the term deelnemer with student and aligning the test standard and competence of the examination appeals committee with higher education, are incorporated.

35634.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to reflect fourth supplementary budget mutations for COVID-19 measures, with figures in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 16 November 2020. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and only fixed budget adjustments and entry-into-force provisions.
35634.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the current developments around the coronavirus, with no delegation or new powers argued for.
q: Just as We approve and resolve by this: Article 1 The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2020 is amended
Gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35643.s: This omnibus bill makes technical and corrective amendments across several agriculture, nature and food-quality laws, mainly fixing wrong cross-references and gaps. It also adds a payment-deadline mechanism to the Plant Health Act that lets the competent authority refuse further inspections until overdue fees are paid, and repeals an expired structure scheme.
35643.j: The memorandum justifies the new payment-deadline power as a continuation of existing powers under the former Plant Diseases Act that were accidentally omitted from the new law.
q: Through an error, this delegation basis and provision were not included in Article 21 of the Plant Health Act.
Abusievelijk waren deze delegatiegrondslag en bepaling niet opgenomen in artikel 21 van de Plantgezondheidswet.
d: ARTIKEL III, punt 1 (Plantgezondheidswet artikel 21, vierde lid)
fee rates and payment deadlines for plant health inspections
p: ARTIKEL III, punt 2 (Plantgezondheidswet artikel 21, achtste lid)
Allows the competent authority to refuse certain work for a market operator who has not paid overdue fees, a discretionary sanction without a stated procedural safeguard.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the Verzamelwet LNV 20.. bill, which repairs technical defects and outdated cross-references in several agriculture, nature and food quality laws, and only made a drafting remark on the Plantgezondheidswet retribution provision. The minister's reply states that the redactional remark was followed and that some minor additional amendments were made.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that article 21(8) of the Plantgezondheidswet be aligned with the explanatory memorandum so the power arises only after non-payment within the deadline, and that it clarify whether work may be conditioned on advance payment of retributions.

35661.s: The bill amends the Dutch Animal Act to align it with EU Regulations 2019/6 (veterinary medicines) and 2019/4 (medicated feed), mainly by deleting national rules now covered by the EU regulations and renaming terms. It also reshapes some national grounds for delegated rules on transport, sale and use of veterinary medicines, and removes the article allowing exemptions from marketing authorisation.
35661.j: The memorandum justifies the retained delegation to set rules on transport and retail of veterinary medicines by the need to safeguard quality and efficacy where existing national rules are continued.
q: To guarantee the quality and efficacy of veterinary medicines, it may however be useful to continue existing national rules on the transport of veterinary medicines.
Om de kwaliteit en de werkzaamheid van diergeneesmiddelen te waarborgen kan het echter nuttig zijn om bestaande nationale regels over het vervoer van diergeneesmiddelen te continueren.
d: rules on transport, retail, restricted prescribing and clinical trials of veterinary medicines
I, G (art. 2.20, eerste en derde lid)

parties: Asks for the budgetary impact, for the lower-level rules that are not visible, and for a broader account of the transposition choices, without clearly pushing for more or less executive leeway.
Can the government provide insight into the budgetary consequences of the present amendment?
Kan de regering inzicht geven in de budgettaire gevolgen van voorliggende wetswijziging?
Asks that the independence of members of the EMA committee be ensured and asks how existing antimicrobial controls by the NVWA will be guaranteed under the new law.
Can the government commit to ensuring that these members are independent?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat erop toegezien wordt dat deze leden onafhankelijk zijn?
Asks when the detailed implementation rules for retail and medicated feed will be expected and how practicability for veterinarians will be taken into account.
When is this detailed elaboration expected?
Wanneer wordt deze nadere uitwerking verwacht?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no remarks on the draft bill amending the Animals Act to implement revised EU rules on veterinary medicines and medicated feed, and advised submitting it to parliament. The government's reply notes no substantive points arose and only adds technical alignments, including updating references in the Economic Offences Act and clarifying transposition tables.

35670.s: The bill writes into the Kieswet the rules for postal and electronic ballots for voters abroad and for registering party logos on ballots, which until now rested on a temporary experiment law expiring 1 January 2022. It makes email delivery of the ballot the default, sets logo registration and ballot-marking rules, and adds transitional provisions aligning with two other pending bills.
35670.j: The memorandum justifies the email-ballot default by the time gained over unreliable postal delivery abroad, and says the model is needed to keep the experiment's advantages after the temporary law lapses.
d: models for ballot paper and candidate list overview
manner of sending voting documents abroad (Kiesbesluit amendment)

parties: Asks whether MijnOverheid was considered as a delivery channel and why the ballot rule changed from the experiment, and asks for a commitment to evaluate the change and inform voters.
However, they ask the government whether it has also considered using MijnOverheid and offering the option to retrieve the documents there, instead of email.
Wel vragen zij de regering of ook overwogen is om gebruik te maken van MijnOverheid en de mogelijkheid te bieden daar de bescheiden op te halen, in plaats van e-mail.

Supports the email model but asks about spam-filter failures in the first experiment, why postal voters must opt in explicitly, how many postal votes were cast, and what a 'more structured' counting method means for trust in the process.
These members ask why the government considers it necessary to lay this down only in lower regulations.](Note: see evidence_en mapping below)
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering meent dat het vastleggen hiervan pas in lagere regelgeving nodig zou zijn.
Has no need to ask further questions at this stage.
At this moment they have no need to ask further questions.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen behoefte aan het stellen van nadere vragen.

Regrets that many parties lack a logo on the ballot, supports the Kiesraad's active approach, and asks why a obligation for polling stations to offer logo inclusion is not required rather than leaving it to a passive request system.

Why, in line with the Kiesraad's approach, is the passive approach, under which a political grouping can request in writing that a logo be added, not supplemented with an obligation for the polling station to offer that option?

Waarom wordt, in lijn met de benadering van de Kiesraad, de passieve benadering, dat een politieke groepering schriftelijk kan verzoeken om het bijschrijven van een logo, niet aangevuld met de verplichting dat het stembureau die mogelijkheid aanbiedt?
Asks why an article 92 Woningwet change is bundled into an electoral bill and how the related amendments are coordinated, which bears on transparency of the legislative process.
The VVD members want to know why it was chosen to re-establish article 92 of the Woningwet.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen weten waarom er wordt gekozen om artikel 92 van de Woningwet opnieuw vast te stellen.
Asks the government for the likelihood of the scenario in which voters abroad temporarily lose replacement ballots and for an overview of what remains in each bill after the transfer of provisions.
These members also would like an overview of the elements that remain in this bill and in proposal TK 35 489 after the transfer.
Deze leden ontvangen voorts graag een overzicht van de elementen die in dit wetsvoorstel en in het voorstel TK 35 489 overblijven na de overheveling.
Questions the inclusion of an unrelated Woningwet provision, calls it undesirable for transparency, and asks why the opening of postal ballot envelopes is anticipated before the evaluation.

Moreover, these members believe that an amendment to the Woningwet does not belong in a proposal amending the Kieswet and that, for the sake of transparency of the legislative process and legislative history, it is undesirable to expand a proposal in this way.

Overigens zijn deze leden van mening dat een wijziging van de Woningwet niet thuishoort in een voorstel tot wijziging van de Kieswet en dat het met het oog op de transparantie van het wetgevingsproces en de wetsgeschiedenis ongewenst is dat een voorstel op deze wijze wordt uitgebreid.
Worries that e-mailed ballot forms are more fraud-prone, asks what safeguards exist, and questions the unequal treatment of voters in the Netherlands who cannot receive ballot documents by e-mail.
The SP members fear that ballot forms sent by e-mail are more susceptible to fraud and ask what measures are being taken to counter this.
De leden van de SP-fractie vrezen dat stemformulieren per e-mail fraudegevoeliger zijn en vragen naar de maatregelen die worden ondernomen om dit tegen te gaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Kieswet to permanently introduce a new ballot paper for voters abroad, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes a small technical amendment to article J 20 of the Kieswet that had been omitted from the bill.

35715.s: The bill introduces a uniform licensing regime for sex work in the Netherlands, requiring personal permits for prostitutes and operating permits for sex businesses, administered by municipal mayors with a national register. It also establishes enforcement, sanctions, and a prohibition on facilitating unlicensed prostitution.
35715.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for uniform regulation, oversight of the unlicensed sector, and protection against trafficking and coercion.
q: Clear uniform rules for the entire sector contribute to this.
Heldere uniforme regels voor de gehele branche dragen hieraan bij.
d: designation of municipalities for permit applications
application procedure and required documents for prostitute permit
rules governing the national prostitution permit register
additional moral conduct requirements for operators and managers
measures to be included in business plans of prostitution businesses
municipal ordinance capping number of sex establishments
municipal ordinance banning prostitution businesses (zero option)
policy rules on applying administrative fine power
p: Mayors' officials assess applicants' self-reliance and may refer suspected coercion, widening administrative discretion over who may work in prostitution.
Permit may be refused on the mayor's judgment of insufficient self-reliance, with criteria set by ministerial regulation rather than statute.
Establishes a national register of prostitutes linked to BSN and phone numbers, with data processing exemptions from the GDPR special-category prohibition.
Supervisory officials may enter a home where a licensed sex establishment is located, even without the occupant's consent.
Every mayor may impose administrative fines on prostitutes for violations of the licensing and advertising rules.
Refusal grounds for operators may be extended by general administrative order based on moral conduct.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against submitting the Wet regulering sekswerk (mandatory prostitute licensing, criminalising facilitation of illegal prostitution and the client) unless substantially revised, doubting its effectiveness and warning it could drive prostitution underground. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely maintains the licensing system and criminal provisions while accepting some points, such as moving self-sufficiency criteria to an AMvB, adding local enforcement rationale, and clarifying Caribbean non-applicability, but it rejects the central recommendation to drop the licence.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the licensing system will reduce misstanden and may increase illegal prostitution, advising deletion of the licence scheme; the government maintains it is necessary for oversight.
Registration and licensing interfere with privacy and processing of special personal data and stigmatise prostitutes, requiring justification that the government disputes.
The one-meeting licence interview is unlikely to detect coercion or lack of self-sufficiency; the government answers that trained staff and guidance will help.
The self-sufficiency criteria are too vague and should be set in an AMvB rather than a ministerial regulation; the government accepts moving them to an AMvB.

The criminal offence of facilitating illegal prostitution is too broad, insufficiently motivated and may not be effective; the Afdeling advises justifying or deleting it, and the government largely maintains it.

The criminalisation of clients relying on a licence-number check is ineffective because the client cannot verify identity and could invoke avas; the Afdeling advises deleting it, which the government does not follow.
Criteria for self-sufficiency should be regulated in an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than a ministeriële regeling.
Inconsistent local enforcement could create regional displacement; the government explains local enforcement and adds rationale to the memorie van toelichting.
The Dienstenrichtlijn justification for municipal caps and the nuloptie is underexplained; the government supplements the explanatory memorandum.
Drafting corrections and cross-references are adopted, and the Wrs is clarified to apply only to the European part of the Netherlands.

35733.s: The bill creates a mandatory registration regime in a public register for private out-of-court debt collection services aimed at natural persons, with quality requirements, supervision by existing bodies (BFT, deken, Inspectie), administrative fines and orders under penalty, and a cap on cumulative collection costs for instalment payments. It also amends the Advocatenwet, Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet, Wft and Civil Code accordingly.
35733.j: The memorandum justifies the registration requirement and broad discretionary standards by consumer protection, public order concerns and the need for a gatekeeping function before market entry, with ex-post supervision judged insufficient.
q: Ex-post supervision alone is in this situation insufficient, because the harm has already been done to the debtor or creditor by the time the debt collector is sanctioned.
Ex-posttoezicht alleen is in deze situatie onvoldoende toereikend, omdat de schade de schuldenaar of schuldeiser al is toegedaan wanneer de incassodienstverlener een sanctie wordt opgelegd.
d: rules on how applications are submitted
further quality requirements for debt collectors
tariff and levy rules for registration costs
rules on cumulated instalment collection fees
p: The Minister may impose orders under penalty and administrative fines on collection agencies, with fine ceilings set by category and suspension pending appeal for the larger fines.
The Minister assesses applicants' reliability and may refuse or cancel registration on broadly worded grounds such as conduct not expected of a good collector.
The Minister may strike a registration off the register for serious non-compliance or conduct judged seriously contrary to societal expectations, a broad standard with appeal available under the Awb.
The AFM may share confidential information with the registry and other named bodies, which overrides the usual confidentiality rule for that purpose.

parties: Asks how enforcement is divided among several supervisors and whether the lawyers' and bailiffs' professional bodies can enforce consistently, and questions the civil-law consequences of unregistered collectors.
How is it guaranteed that the playing field will not become fragmented as a result of this bill?
Op welke wijze is geborgd dat het speelveld als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel niet versnipperd raakt?
Asks how the register test and the split of supervision among organisations will work, and how public and private collection rules compare.
Questions the choice of the Inspectie J&V over the BFT as supervisor, citing the Raad van State's warning that supervision becomes more complex.

Argues that the register alone will not fix unjustified pressure and costs, and asks for better information for vulnerable debtors and for collection costs on resold claims to be borne by the creditor.
Does the government think the registration obligation (and the quality requirements attached to it) will solve all problems around unacceptable pressure from collection companies?
Denkt de regering dat de registerplicht (en de daarbij behorende kwaliteitseisen) alle problemen rondom ontoelaatbare druk vanuit incassobedrijven zal oplossen?
Finds the quality requirements too broad and leaves them to lower regulation, warns of false legitimacy, and prefers uniform supervision by the BFT.
If the requirements are not clearly and firmly formulated, false legitimacy can arise.
Als de eisen niet helder en stevig geformuleerd zijn, kan schijnlegitimatie ontstaan.
Doubts that a three-yearly audit and a Dienst Justis supervisor provide effective control, and questions the split supervision and the choice against the Raad van State's advice.
These members question the choice of Dienst Justis as supervisor of debt collection services.
De leden van de SGP-fractie plaatsen vraagtekens bij de keuze voor de Dienst Justis als toezichthouder op de incassodienstverlening.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill regulating private out-of-court debt collection lacks substantive quality norms in the statute itself, that the supervisory design should be reconsidered (suggesting the BFT), and raised points on scope and enforcement of the BIK. The minister's nader rapport accepts the substantive-norms point by adding quality requirements to article 13, retains the Inspectie JenV as supervisor with reasoning, and clarifies scope and the effect of registration deregistration.
concerns: The statute should contain the main elements of the regime, including conduct rules and a complaints scheme, rather than leaving them to delegated regulation; the government added quality requirements to article 13.
The delegation clause was framed as a discretionary 'kan' provision, which should be made mandatory if substantive norms are left out of the statute.
Supervision is split across several bodies, reducing effectiveness; the Afdeling suggested designating the BFT, and the government reconsidered but kept the Inspectie JenV with reasons.

The scope is limited to natural persons, and the Afdeling asked whether vulnerable small legal persons such as associations should also be covered; the government kept the objective criterion and clarified the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the BIK and the enforcement gap; the government explained civil-law enforcement and the link to article 13 quality requirements.
The civil-law effects of deregistration for incorrect information were unclear; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
Redactional comments were accepted and further wording changes were made.

35805.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) to fund FieldLabs, the mobility cluster support scheme administration costs, and interest on the voucher credit facility, with amounts in thousands of euros. It also sets entry into force from 13 April 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2021
De Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2021

35814.s: The bill sets rules for guarantees of origin for other gas from renewable sources, implementing EU Directive 2018/2001, including issuance, transfer, and recognition via an electronic system managed by the Minister. It also empowers the Minister to set tariffs and detailed rules by ministerial regulation and gives the ACM supervisory and fining powers.
35814.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation by stating that the directive makes no distinction in rules for the different types of guarantees of origin, so a single underlying regulation keeps the overview.
q: For this, the rules for the already existing guarantees of origin for electricity, gas and heat from renewable energy sources and HR-CHP electricity in the Regulation on guarantees of origin and certificates of origin are followed.

Hiervoor wordt aangesloten bij de regels voor de reeds bestaande garanties van oorsprong voor elektriciteit, gas en warmte uit hernieuwbare energiebronnen en HR-WKK-elektriciteit in de Regeling garanties van oorsprong en certificaten van oorsprong.
d: tariffs and detailed rules on guarantees of origin
mandating system tasks to an independent non-subordinate body
ACM binding conduct orders, measurements and penalties
p: The ACM may perform or order measurements at producers, suppliers and end users, who must tolerate them, and may impose administrative fines and penalty payments.
Tariffs and rules on information provision and use of guarantees of origin are set by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute itself.

parties: The VVD worries the ACM lacks the capacity to exercise the proposed inspection power and asks how measurements and fraud prevention will be guaranteed.
They further read that the ACM indicates it is not equipped to exercise such an inspection power.
Teven lezen deze leden dat de ACM aangeeft dat zij niet geëquipeerd is om een dergelijke inspectiebevoegdheid uit te oefenen.
The CDA asks the government to clarify hydrogen import strategy, certification timelines, and treatment of Danish statistical transfers.
These members ask the government when and in what manner the demonstration of this additional renewable energy production will be given substance.
Deze leden vragen de regering wanneer en op welke wijze er wel invulling zal worden gegeven aan het aantonen van de productie van deze extra hernieuwbare energie.
The SP fears greenwashing through certificates and questions whether the target and statistical transfers truly serve the climate.
These members believe such agreements reflect weakness in national policy if millions of public money are spent on statistical transfers.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat dergelijke afspraken getuigen van zwakte van nationaal beleid als miljoenen publiek geld wordt uitgegeven aan de statistische overdracht.
The PvdA asks about temporal matching of renewable production and consumption and about transparency for end consumers.
These members ask how the implementation of this directive could be used for more transparency for the consumer on the purchasing side of the electricity market.
Deze leden vragen hoe de implementatie van deze richtlijn benut zou kunnen worden voor meer transparantie voor de afnemer in de inkoopzijde van de stroommarkt.
The ChristenUnie asks how problems in the ACM's role arising from the bill will be identified and addressed despite the ACM's reservations.
These members ask how possible bottlenecks in the ACM's role resulting from the bill will be identified and addressed.
Deze leden vragen hoe eventuele knelpunten in de rol van de ACM als gevolg van het wetsvoorstel gesignaleerd worden en worden ondervangen.
The SGP asks about guarantees of origin for liquid hydrogen products, subsidy eligibility for trucked biogas, and consumer transparency on grey versus green electricity.
How does the government ensure more transparency toward consumers about the purchase of grey or green electricity by energy suppliers, these members ask.
Hoe zorgt de regering voor meer transparantie richting de consument over de inkoop van grijze dan wel groene stroom door energieaanbieders, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued an advisory opinion on the draft Act implementing the EU renewable energy directive and guarantees of origin, raising no substantive remarks and advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister's nader rapport states that only minor, non-substantive textual changes were made in response to the opinion.

35823.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by adding EUR 12 million, as a second supplementary budget for testing of necessary cross-border traffic to Germany. The explanatory memorandum says the ministry will award a contract to a market party using the urgency exception of the procurement law, bypassing normal tendering rules.
35823.j: The memorandum justifies the procurement deviation by pointing to the urgency exception (dwingende spoed) in the procurement law, art. 2.32c.
q: This is done here through a reasoned appeal to the urgency exception (dwingende spoed) in the procurement law, art. 2.32c.
Dat gebeurt in dit geval middels een gemotiveerd beroep op de uitzonderingsgrond dwingende spoed in de aanbestedingswet, art. 2.32c.
p: The ministry bypasses normal procurement rules under the urgency exception, a limited departure from standard competitive tendering with no parliamentary involvement described.

35832.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the amending agreement of 27 January 2021 on the transfer and mutualisation of contributions to the Single Resolution Fund among the participating EU member states. It also sets entry into force on the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Agreement amending the Agreement on the transfer and mutualisation of contributions to the Single Resolution Fund
Overeenkomst tot wijziging van de Overeenkomst betreffende de overdracht en mutualisatie van de bijdragen aan het gemeenschappelijk afwikkelingsfonds

parties: The VVD has no further questions on the bill.
They have no further questions on this.
Zij hebben hierbij geen nadere vragen.
The PVV questions how risk reduction was demonstrated, whether COVID-19 raised bank risks, and whether taxpayers may still bear the costs of failing banks.
In what way has it been demonstrated that banks have cleaned up their balance sheets and made provisions to reduce the risk of bankruptcies?
Op welke wijze is aangetoond dat banken hun balans hebben opgeschoond en voorzieningen hebben getroffen om risico’s op faillissementen te verminderen?
The CDA supports the changes for euro-area stability but asks how periodic risk reduction and debt sustainability are monitored and how external financing options work.
They ask the government how the degree of risk reduction and debt sustainability is periodically monitored.
Zij vragen de regering op welke manier periodiek de mate van risicoreductie en schuldenbeheersbaarheid wordt gecontroleerd
The SP questions the proportionality of the amendment and asks what role national parliaments have in judging whether an emergency procedure applies.
What is the influence of national parliaments on this?
Wat is de invloed van nationale parlementen hierop?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill approving the amended Agreement on the transfer and mutualisation of contributions to the Single Resolution Fund, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer with one drafting remark on explaining why the Agreement does not apply to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the explanatory memorandum was amended accordingly, clarifying that the Agreement applies only to participating member states and thus only to the European part of the Netherlands, and that some other points were clarified and edited.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum state the reasons why the Agreement does not extend to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and the government added this clarification.

35841.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, implementing the seventh supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures, with effect from 25 May 2021 and retroactive to 18 May 2021. It changes spending and revenue figures across policy articles without delegating rule-making or altering oversight.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2021.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2021.

35850-IIA.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal) through a first supplementary budget, adding about 3.9 million euro in commitments and 18.4 million euro in expenditure across Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint articles. The increases fund the Eerste Kamer administration, Tweede Kamer building renovation delays, parliamentary inquiries, and wage and price adjustments, and the law takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: Following that, a parliament-wide development programme was launched to strengthen clerical support.
Naar aanleiding daarvan is een griffiebreed ontwikkeltraject ingezet om ambtelijke ondersteuning te versterken.

35904.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet strategische diensten to implement the recast EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821, updating references to the old regulation 428/2009 and the Minister of Foreign Affairs' competences as competent authority for licensing, supervision and enforcement. It also withdraws the temporary implementing decree and sets transitional rules for pending licence applications.
35904.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary timely implementation of the directly applicable EU regulation, with the Minister remaining the designated competent authority.
q: Timely implementation of the revised regulation, which takes effect on 9 September 2021 and becomes directly applicable in the Netherlands, ensures that the references in the WSD are updated so that the Minister of Foreign Affairs remains designated as competent authority.

Tijdige implementatie van de herziene verordening die op 9 september 2021 in werking treedt en rechtstreeks van toepassing wordt in Nederland, zorgt dat de verwijzingen in de WSD worden aangepast waardoor de Minister van Buitenlandse zaken als bevoegde autoriteit blijft aangewezen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 2, derde lid WSD)
competent authority decisions on dual-use software and technology transfers
licensing of brokering services for dual-use goods

parties: Asks for plain-language explanation of low-risk goods, the basis for longer licence validity and the link to the Toulouse declaration.
Can the government explain in simple terms what kind of goods are involved and why they have been classified as low risk?
Kan de regering in simpele taal uitleggen om wat voor goederen het hier gaat en waarom er besloten is deze goederen als laagrisico aan te merken?
Asks how enforcement via the WSD and customs law works in practice, which body acts, and what sanctions exist for violations.

The CDA members ask the government to explain in more detail how control over implementation of the regulation through the WSD and the General Customs Act works in practice, by which body, and what the method is when the regulation is violated.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de controle op de uitvoering van de verordening via de Wet strategische diensten (WSD) en de Algemene douanewet praktisch wordt uitgevoerd, door welke instantie en wat de methode is wanneer er in strijd met de verordening wordt gehandeld.
Objects that the revision lowers controls on ad hoc matters, low-risk transactions and licence duration without interim checks, and questions the legal basis for acting before the bill.
Overall, the SP members see that these relaxations may result in less control and transparency.
Al met al zien de leden van de SP-fractie daarom dat deze versoepelingen ervoor kunnen zorgen dat er juist sprake kan zijn van minder controle en transparantie.
Worries that longer licence validity weakens strict human-rights review and asks who is ultimately responsible; asks for stronger human-rights conditions on cyber-surveillance.
Supports the regulation but asks for guarantees against arbitrary or economic use of the dual-use label and against human-rights abuse by exported surveillance tech.
However, the Volt members wonder whether there are sufficient guarantees that the dual-use regulation is only applied to industries where this is seriously relevant.
De leden van de Volt-fractie vragen zich echter wel af of er voldoende garanties zijn dat de dual-use verordening alleen wordt ingezet voor industrieën waar dit serieus op van toepassing is.
Asks how businesses will be informed of the new law and how outdated handbooks will be updated.
According to the VVD members, it is important that this legal amendment is properly incorporated and explained in all handbooks.
Het is volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie belangrijk dat deze wetswijziging goed verwerkt en uitgelegd wordt in alle handboeken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the revised EU dual-use regulation (Regulation (EU) 2021/821) via amendments to the Wet strategische diensten, and found no remarks. The Minister of Foreign Affairs transmitted the advice with a nader rapport, but no substantive points were raised requiring a reply.

35922.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security, mainly by adding 200 million euros to the contraterrorism and national security article for the compensation scheme (Regeling tegemoetkoming schade 2021). It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 9 September 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2021

35931.s: The bill amends the income tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, withholding tax and general tax acts to counter reverse hybrid mismatches under EU Directive 2017/952 by treating certain partnerships as Dutch taxpayers and denying deductions in mismatch cases. It extends existing anti-avoidance rules to individuals linked to the taxpayer and sets effective dates for 2022.
35931.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as implementation of the EU directive (ATAD2) and does not justify any delegation or new executive powers.
q: This measure is, in line with ATAD2, not applicable to collective investment undertakings with a diversified securities portfolio that are subject to financial supervision.
Deze maatregel is, conform ATAD2, niet van toepassing op collectieve beleggingsinstellingen met een gediversifieerde effectenportefeuille die onder financieel toezicht staan.

parties: Argues the documentation duty in article 12ag Wet Vpb lets the inspector reverse and aggravate the burden of proof without immediate legal protection, unlike an information decision under the AWR, and asks whether the provision should be dropped.
Can the government explain the main differences between the inspector's powers under article 12ag of the Wet Vpb and chapter 7, section 2 of the General Tax Act (AWR)?

Kan de regering aangeven wat de belangrijkste verschillen zijn tussen de bevoegdheden van de inspecteur op basis van artikel 12ag van de Wet Vpb en hoofdstuk 7, afdeling 2 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR)?
Asks about expected frequency of application, how other EU and non-EU countries implemented the measure, and how transparent entities can opt for full taxability.
The members of the D66 faction ask how often the government expects the tax liability measure to be applied.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe vaak de regering verwacht dat de belastingplichtmaatregel wordt toegepast.
Has taken note of the documents without raising specific questions or concerns.
The members of the PVV faction have taken note of the documents.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de stukken.

Asks why a deduction is introduced for reverse hybrid entities, why collective investment institutions are exempt, whether new avoidance routes exist, and what practical difficulties the NOB identifies that could lead to litigation.

The members of the SP faction ask the government to explain why under certain conditions a deduction option is introduced when the profit of the reverse hybrid entity goes directly to participants in a state that treats the entity as transparent.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering uit te leggen waarom onder bepaalde voorwaarden een aftrekmogelijkheid wordt ingevoerd, wanneer de winst van het omgekeerde hybride lichaam rechtstreeks toekomt aan participanten in een staat die dat lichaam als transparant aanmerkt.
Asks how many corporate structures have actually been adjusted despite the postponed entry into force, whether the tax base is rising, and whether treatment of trust-like companies changes.
Given the postponement of entry into force, how many corporate structures have actually been adjusted?
Gegeven het uitstel van inwerkingtreding, hoeveel bedrijfsstructuren zijn daadwerkelijk aangepast?
Welcomes ending the untaxed cv/bv structure but questions the step-up valuation of assets at the 2022 opening balance and the minimal budgetary effect, and asks about BEPS pillar effects.
Asks how many structures have been dissolved since 2020, the basis for expecting only a few dozen remaining, the complexity red flag in the implementation test, and transitional rules for open cvs.
The members of the CDA faction ask the government whether it is correct that only participants with an interest of more than 50 percent qualify for the tax liability measure.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of het klopt dat alleen participanten met een belang van meer dan 50 procent kwalificeren voor de belastingplichtmaatregel.
Supports the aim of countering misuse of qualification differences but criticises the thin justification of administrative burdens, echoing the Raad van State.
These members underline the commitment to countering the misuse of qualification differences between tax systems in order to combat tax avoidance.
Deze leden onderstrepen de inzet om het misbruiken van kwalificatieverschillen tussen belastingstelsels tegen te gaan om zo belastingontwijking te bestrijden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill implementing the reverse hybrid entity tax liability measure of the second EU anti-tax avoidance directive, raising points on implementation clarity, transitional law for open limited partnerships, and administrative burden. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely accepted these points by clarifying the explanatory memorandum and adding transitional arrangements to be considered, while maintaining that the administrative burden is very limited.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clearly explain how the reverse hybrid tax liability measure relates to the existing provisions in the second anti-tax avoidance directive implementation act; the government supplemented the memorandum.

Transitional law for open limited partnerships that could become reverse hybrid entities after abolition of their corporate tax liability should be explained; the government clarified it will be considered in a future bill without fully settling it now.

The claim of negligible administrative burden for businesses is doubted and should be better motivated; the government maintained the burden is very limited, citing reduced attractiveness of such structures and advisory body findings.
Redactional remarks from the advisory division were adopted in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35940.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/2161 on consumer protection modernisation by amending Book 6 of the Civil Code, the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act and the Prices Act. It adds rules on online marketplaces, search ranking transparency, fake reviews, ticket resale, digital services and personal-data-based contracts, and raises maximum administrative fines for coordinated enforcement actions.
35940.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the Prices Act decree by the need to implement the directive's optional derogations in practice, and the higher fines by the directive's required sanction criteria.
q: It is proposed to include these criteria in the Whc.
Voorgesteld wordt deze criteria in de Whc op te nemen.
d: Artikel III (Prijzenwet art. 2b lid 1, onderdeel e)
rules on announcing price reductions in the Prices Act decree
p: Requires the consumer enforcer to consider listed factors such as nature, gravity and duration of the infringement when imposing fines.
Raises maximum administrative fines for coordinated enforcement actions to 4% or up to 10% of turnover, expanding the regulator's sanctioning discretion over businesses.

parties: Asks why personal-data rules are placed in the implementing bill and flags a likely cross-reference error in the penalty provision for the regulator's fines.

The VVD members read in the proposed new article 2.15, third paragraph, sub a, of the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act that the ACM or AFM may double the maximum fine not only for recidivism but also for coordinated action.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen in het voorgestelde nieuwe artikel 2.15, derde lid, sub a, van de Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming de mogelijkheid voor de ACM of de AFM om het boetemaximum niet alleen te verdubbelen in het geval van recidive maar ook in het geval van een gecoördineerde actie.
Has no further questions on the bill.
The D66 members have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions about it.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben hier nu geen verdere vragen over.

Supports the EU-level approach but presses the government on enforcement capacity, the Data Protection Authority's warnings, SME impact, missing mkb-test, and why colportage is not addressed now despite regulator complaints.
Why, despite these signals from the ACM, does the government nonetheless not choose to address a better approach to door-to-door sales immediately with the introduction of this law?
Waarom kiest de regering er ondanks deze signalen van de ACM toch niet voor om een betere aanpak van colportage meteen bij de invoering van deze wet te regelen?
Has no further questions on the bill.
The SP members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions about it.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben daarover geen nadere vragen.
Asks about enforceability, whether legal duties should be imposed on traders holding personal data, and how compliance can be shown, following the regulator's concerns.
Is a legal obligation not a proper means to ensure that consumers can be sure their data are safely returned?
Is een wettelijke verplichting niet een juist middel om te waarborgen dat consumenten er zeker van zijn dat hun gegevens veilig teruggeven worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Implementation Act for the EU Directive modernising consumer protection, asking the government to justify more fully its choice not to use the optional colportage provision and to correct a drafting point on social media recommendations. The government's reply accepted the request to add justification to the explanatory memorandum, adding that it keeps monitoring colportage problems with the ACM and may still legislate if needed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to better motivate not using the Member State option on colportage, given ACM's reported enforcement problems, and the government added this justification to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that proposed article 6:193g(aa) BW be aligned with the explanatory memorandum so that 'sociale media' refers only to 'aanbevelingen', and the government included a redactional correction.

35975-K.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (second supplementary budget), reducing expenditure by about 131.8 million euros relative to the first supplementary budget and adjusting commitments across materiel and infrastructure items. It sets the amendment in thousands of euros and makes it effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
35975-K.j: The memorandum explains that differences between commitments and expenditure arise from commitments that do not lead to expenditure changes this year, and that the supplementary budget gives an overview of financial deviations.
q: With this bill it is proposed to reduce the 2021 revenue and expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) relative to the first supplementary budget by an amount of 131.8 million euros.

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld de ontvangsten- en uitgavenbegroting 2021 van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) ten opzichte van de 1e suppletoire begroting met een bedrag van € 131,8 miljoen te verlagen.

36048.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) to add an incidental supplementary appropriation of EUR 100 million for a contribution to Ukraine via the World Bank, effective 1 March 2022. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no power shift to the executive.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), all for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), alle voor het jaar 2022

36057.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet to let municipalities grant a one-off energy allowance under categorical special assistance in 2022 to low-income households, without a means test or proof of higher energy bills. It also allows the allowance to be set ex officio, departing from the normal application requirement, and makes the allowance non-counted income for benefit purposes.
36057.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by the need for fast, low-cost implementation and by reducing the administrative burden on municipalities compared with individual special assistance.
q: The proposed fifth paragraph provides a departure from Article 43(1) of the Participatiewet, which provides that the college determines the right to assistance upon written application
Het voorgestelde vijfde lid voorziet in een afwijking van artikel 43, eerste lid, van de Participatiewet, waarin is geregeld dat het college het recht op bijstand vaststelt op schriftelijke aanvraag
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 35, vierde lid, Participatiewet)
municipal discretion to grant one-off energy allowance and define low-income threshold
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 35, vierde en vijfde lid)
Municipal colleges gain discretion to grant the energy allowance without checking actual energy cost increases and to set it ex officio, with the standard written-application requirement set aside.

parties: Objects that the bill was processed after municipalities already started implementing without legal basis, calling for reflection to prevent democratic oversight being bypassed in future.
It is undesirable that the House of Representatives lags behind implementation on such important legislative changes and that implementation must start on a scheme that has no statutory basis yet.
Het is onwenselijk dat de Tweede Kamer bij dit soort belangrijke wetswijzigingen achter de uitvoering aanloopt en dat uitvoering aan de slag moet met een regeling die nog geen wettelijke basis heeft.
Asks whether the budget is sufficient and how to ensure uniform municipal application, pressing for clarity on funding and the target group.

However, these members have various questions about the proposed scheme, particularly about applying and reaching the same groups of people as uniformly as possible by municipalities, and about the adequacy of the funds made available or promised to municipalities.

Wel hebben deze leden diverse vragen over de voorgestelde regeling met name over het zo uniform mogelijk toepassen en bereiken van dezelfde groepen mensen door gemeenten en over de toereikendheid van de aan gemeenten beschikbaar gestelde of toegezegde middelen.
Asks how the government will ensure municipalities reach the right target group and avoid large regional differences in compensation.
Can the government not make binding agreements with municipalities so that large differences in compensation cannot occur and every Dutch person with a low income is compensated?
Kan de regering hier geen sluitende afspraken over maken met gemeenten zodat grote verschillen in compensatie niet voor kunnen komen en elke Nederlander met een laag inkomen wordt gecompenseerd?

Questions the budget sufficiency, the 800,000-household cap versus a larger target group, the feasibility of the scheme, and the principle of budget rights as the bill was implemented before enactment.
At the same time, they do have question marks about this chosen solution route from that package of measures and the feasibility of the plan to provide a one-off categorical energy allowance.
Tegelijkertijd hebben zij wel vraagtekens bij deze gekozen oplossingsroute uit dat maatregelenpakket en de uitvoerbaarheid van het plan om eenmalig categoriaal een energietoeslag te verstrekken.

Raises legal vulnerabilities including the hard income cut-off without hardship clause, constitutional equality concerns (Article 1 Grondwet), missing uitvoeringstoets, and EU coordination law questions.
Does the government find that acceptable, and does it consider the present bill to be in accordance with the Constitution and in particular Article 1?
Acht de regering dat acceptabel en acht de regering het voorliggende wetsvoorstel in overeenstemming met de Grondwet en dan met name artikel 1?
Asks whether municipalities have received sufficient funds and whether they will apply stricter criteria, and questions why middle incomes and pensioners are excluded.
Is it correct that not all municipalities have received the necessary financial resources to provide the one-off energy allowance?
Klopt het dat niet alle gemeenten de noodzakelijke financiële middelen hebben ontvangen om de eenmalige energietoeslag te kunnen verstrekken?
Worries that broad municipal discretion will delay payments and asks for national guidelines allowing only positive deviations.
Is the government therefore willing to draw up national guidelines under which municipalities could only deviate in a positive direction?
Is de regering daarom bereid om landelijke richtlijnen op te stellen, waarbij gemeenten alleen in positieve zin zouden mogen afwijken?
Seeks confirmation of the allowance amount, budget and municipal compensation, and clarity on target group threshold and student exclusion.
Can the government guarantee municipalities that they will be compensated for all costs?
Kan de regering de garantie geven aan gemeenten dat zij voor alle kosten worden gecompenseerd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the one-off energy allowance bill under the Participatiewet leaves too much discretion to municipalities, risking non-uniform application, unclear eligibility and financial risks, and recommended fixing eligibility and amount by law. The government replied that it is not the intention to fully compensate low-income households, that municipalities will bear risks but ministry expects no undue restraint, and that the bill was otherwise largely kept, with clarifications added to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Eligibility and allowance amount should be fixed by or under the law rather than left to municipalities to ensure uniform application; the government kept municipal discretion with non-binding guidelines.

Application procedures, non-ex-officio cases, and expected rise in individual bijzondere bijstand need fuller treatment in the explanatory memorandum; the government addressed this partly by explaining the procedure and possible additional claims.

Unclear whether the measure, together with other measures, adequately removes the main hardships so that other schemes are used less; government states the target and the intention to monitor, without full compensation.
Financial risk for municipalities may cause reluctance to apply the scheme; government disagrees but commits to monitoring and adjusting amounts.

36084.s: The bill extends the National Cyber Security Centre's power, on behalf of the Minister of Justice and Security, to share threat and incident information with non-vital private providers and with organisations that inform others about cyber threats, including on a residual-data basis where no intermediary exists. It also moves designation of such information-sharing organisations from individual ministerial decisions to ministerial regulation.
36084.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded sharing powers by the need to protect non-vital providers' digital resilience, since many such organisations depend on information-sharing organisations that would otherwise lack data on vulnerable systems.
q: Without that information they do not know they are vulnerable and cannot take measures against it.
Zonder die informatie weten zij niet dat ze kwetsbaar zijn en kunnen zij hier geen maatregelen tegen treffen.
d: Artikel I A 1 (art. 3, lid 2, onder a Wbni)
designation of computer crisis teams and information organisations
Artikel I B (art. 20, lid 2, onder a Wbni)
designation of organisations informing others on threats and incidents
p: Artikel I A 2 (art. 3, lid 2, onder e Wbni)

Allows the NCSC to share threat and incident data, including personal data, with non-vital private providers where significant consequences exist and no intermediary organisation is available, without consent of the provider concerned.
Extends the circle of recipients of provider-identifiable confidential data without consent to designated information-sharing organisations.

parties: Asks how responsibilities are divided between the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers and whether the NCSC and DTC could cooperate better, without taking a firm position.
Can the government explain how tasks and responsibilities are divided between the ministers and whether any bottlenecks are experienced?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe de verdeling van taken en verantwoordelijkheden ligt bij de ministers en of er knelpunten worden ervaren?
Notes the Council of State's concern that security and privacy safeguards for linking organisations are not legally guaranteed and asks why the government departed from that advice.

These members ask why the government has departed from this advice and how it can now be guaranteed that the linking organisations (continue to) meet the required level of security and privacy protection.

Deze leden vragen waarom de regering van dit advies is afgeweken en hoe nu kan worden gegarandeerd dat de schakelorganisaties aan het vereiste niveau van beveiliging en privacybescherming (blijven) voldoen.
Welcomes the bill and has no questions.
These members have no questions arising from this.
Deze leden hebben naar aanleiding hiervan geen vragen.
Questions why the government urgently wants this now and warns of duplicated work and fragmented responsibility, asking why a single responsible organisation was not chosen.
Why has this amendment then taken so long?
Waarom heeft deze wijziging dan zo lang op zich laten wachten?
Argues that new powers need proper oversight and accountability, questions the vagueness of 'other providers' and data minimisation under the GDPR, and asks about lack of supervision of OKTTs.
But with more responsibilities comes appropriate oversight and appropriate accountability mechanisms.
Maar bij meer verantwoordelijkheden, hoort ook gepast toezicht en gepaste verantwoordingsmechanismen.

Warns the definition of 'other providers' is too broad and insufficiently foreseeable under European case law, creating a large legal basis for processing personal data including criminal data, and asks for safeguards.
The provision is insufficiently specified and therefore insufficiently knowable and foreseeable, as intended in case law of the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR).
De bepaling is onvoldoende gespecificeerd en daarmee onvoldoende kenbaar en voorzienbaar, zoals wordt bedoeld in rechtspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM).

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill extending the Minister of Justice and Security's power to share threat and incident information with non-vital providers and public-informing organisations, but raises concerns about overlap with the Digital Trust Center and insufficient legal safeguards for security and privacy at intermediary organisations. The government's reply explains the clear task division with the DTC, adds a new chapter on the NCSC-DTC relationship, and argues that statutory security obligations for intermediaries are unnecessary, while supplementing the explanatory memorandum on vetting and oversight.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clarification of the task division between the NCSC and the Digital Trust Center to avoid confusion and duplication, and the government responds with clarified task descriptions and a new chapter in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling notes that statute insufficiently guarantees that intermediary organisations meet security and privacy requirements at designation and afterwards; the government points to existing vetting, reporting, suspension and withdrawal mechanisms and supplements the memorandum but does not add statutory obligations.
The Afdeling notes that intermediaries may disclose confidential information traceable to specific organisations, and that protection of such data and personal data must be adequately safeguarded.

36093.s: The bill implements EU Market Surveillance Regulation 2019/1020 and Regulation 2020/740 on tyre labelling by amending the Meststoffenwet, Metrologiewet, Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, Telecommunicatiewet, Warenwet, Wegenverkeerswet 1994, Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht and Wet explosieven voor civiel gebruik. It grants market supervisors new powers to enter homes without the occupant's consent, to acquire products under a false identity, and to impose standalone orders requiring online intermediaries to restrict access, with prior authorisation from the rechter-commissaris and appeal to the court.
36093.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the EU market surveillance regulation, which mandates minimum enforcement powers for national authorities.
q: This bill is necessary because the market surveillance regulation requires the bodies responsible for market supervision to have certain powers they currently do not have.

Dit wetsvoorstel is nodig omdat de markttoezichtverordening vereist dat de instanties die zijn belast met het houden van markttoezicht over enkele bevoegdheden beschikken waarover zij op dit moment niet beschikken.
d: tyre and vehicle fuel-efficiency and CO2 consumer information requirements
p: Artikel 47a / 28a / 13a / 32d / 158b Warenwet, Metrologiewet, Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, Telecommunicatiewet, Meststoffenwet, Wegenverkeerswet (home entry)
Supervisors may enter homes without the occupant's consent, subject to prior authorisation by the rechter-commissaris and reviewable appeal to the court.
Artikel 47b / 28b / 13b / 32e / 158c Warenwet, Metrologiewet, Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, Telecommunicatiewet, Meststoffenwet, Wegenverkeerswet (false identity)
Supervisors may acquire products under false identity and are exempted from the duty to show their official identification during such operations, with a written report required.
Artikel 49a / 28c / 13d / 32g / 158d Meststoffenwet, Metrologiewet, Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, Telecommunicatiewet, Warenwet, Wegenverkeerswet (standalone orders to online intermediaries)

Minister may order removal of online content or restriction of access by intermediaries, excluding internet blocking or filtering, subject to prior rechter-commissaris authorisation and appeal to the court.

parties: Asks whether a general regulation in the Awb for the new supervisory powers will be introduced, and why prior review is not used for obtaining product samples under false identity, given the Council of State's advice.
These members ask the government what considerations led it to disregard the Council of State's advice on providing for prior review before obtaining product samples under a false identity.

4.2 Advisering De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering wat de overweging geweest is om het advies van de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State inzake het voorzien in voorafgaande toetsing voor het verkrijgen van productmonsters onder valse identiteit in de wind te slaan.
Notes that extending entry into homes may affect privacy and asks how control over market surveillance authorities will be guaranteed in practice.
This may undermine privacy.  ... How is control over the market surveillance authorities guaranteed?

Questions the necessity of expanding the supervisor's power to enter homes without consent, asks for case numbers, and asks why the rechter-commissaris rather than the mayor is authorized and whether the Council of State's suggested weighing framework will be adopted.
The SGP members ask the government to address the necessity and usefulness of this change, as it appears to be a far-reaching measure.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op nut en noodzaak van deze wijziging, aangezien dit een vergaande maatregel lijkt.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a bill implementing the EU market surveillance regulation, raising objections on powers to enter homes without consent, use of fictitious identities without prior review, cross-border mutual assistance and the need for a general rule in the Algemene wet bestuursrecht. The government's reply accepted most points, adding judicial authorisation for home entry, prior assessment for fictitious identities, and clarified rights protection in cross-border assistance, while declining to immediately create a general AWB rule.
concerns: Advice that home entry without consent should require judicial rather than mayoral authorisation was followed, with a rechter-commissaris authorisation now required.
Use of fictitious identities should be subject to prior review; government did not adopt prior review but introduced an assessment framework and relied on ex post judicial review.
Clarification of the relationship between the new home-entry powers and article 5:15 Awb was requested and the wording was adjusted accordingly.
Cross-border mutual assistance powers should be clarified, including legal basis for enforcement under article 23 and the allocation of legal protection, and the memorie was supplemented.

Advice to create a general statutory regime for these new powers in the Algemene wet bestuursrecht within a foreseeable period was only partly accepted; the government will explore it separately without a firm timetable.
Scope of samenwerkingsplicht prohibitions was narrowed to match the regulation and the Meststoffenwet provision was revised.

36138.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2021/784 on combating the dissemination of terrorist online content by establishing a new independent administrative authority (Autoriteit Online Terroristisch en Kinderpornografisch Materiaal) with powers to identify terrorist content, impose removal and specific measures, and issue fines and periodic penalties. It also sets rules on the authority's structure, limited ministerial oversight, data processing, and amends the Criminal Code and other laws.
36138.j: The memorandum justifies the new authority by the regulation's requirements, the need for independent decision-making, and the preference to keep prosecutorial capacity free, while noting administrative appeal remains open.
q: Fully excluding any possibility for the minister to shape this responsibility in case of shortcomings in implementing the regulation could conflict with that responsibility.

Het volledig uitsluiten van iedere mogelijkheid om bij een tekortkoming in de nakoming van de uitvoering van de verordening deze verantwoordelijkheid vorm te geven kan op gespannen voet komen te staan met deze verantwoordelijkheid.
d: rules on electronic message traffic with the authority
entry into force by royal decree, possibly different per part
p: Several Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen provisions are disapplied, limiting ministerial instruction power over the authority to financial management and administration only.
The authority may restrict data subjects' GDPR rights where necessary and proportionate, and may withhold notice where it would frustrate the restriction's purpose.
An administrative authority takes over removal-order powers that would otherwise lie with the prosecutor under Article 125p Sv, with ex post rather than ex ante judicial review.

parties: Asks how the regulation relates to the DSA and CSA proposal, how the authority's tasks and enforcement align, and whether the monitor and know-your-client obligations are adequately addressed.
Can the government explain how the TOI regulation relates to the DSA?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe de TOI-verordening zich verhoudt tot de DSA?
Worries that placing the authority outside ministerial responsibility removes parliamentary control over far-reaching powers and asks for stronger justification, including for policy rules.
A situation must be prevented in which the House criticises, for example, overly broad powers of the Authority without a debate with the government being possible.
De situatie moet voorkomen worden waarin de Tweede Kamer kritiek heeft op bijvoorbeeld te brede bevoegdheden voor de Autoriteit, zonder dat daar een debat over gevoerd kan worden met de regering.
Asks whether creating a new zbo complicates ministerial steering in light of Court of Audit recommendations and how the interim authority will reach independent judgements.
How does the government ensure that an interim Authority can reach independent judgements as far as possible?
Hoe zorgt de regering ervoor dat een tijdelijke Autoriteit zoveel mogelijk tot onafhankelijke oordelen kan komen?

Fears automated detection and removal without judicial intervention threatens fundamental rights and freedom of expression, and questions legal protection against removal orders from other member states.
Can the government explain again why this far-reaching infringement of human rights is permissible without the intervention of a judge and whether sufficient safeguards will apply?
Kan de regering kortom nog eens uitleggen waarom deze vergaande inbreuk op de mensenrechten geoorloofd is zonder tussenkomst van een rechter en of er voldoende waarborgen gaan gelden?
Asks why the powers could not be assigned to an existing zbo rather than creating a new one, requiring a fuller motivation.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Uitvoeringswet for the EU regulation on terrorist online content, mainly objecting to the creation of a new independent zbo without adequate justification, the exclusion of ministerial policy-rule powers, unclear digital investigation powers, insufficient data-protection safeguards, and the relationship between the preventive duty of care and the constitutional ban on censorship. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the data-protection and digital-powers points by amending the bill and explanatory memorandum, but kept the new zbo and the exclusion of ministerial policy rules, offering reasoned justification.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a thorough, reasoned justification of the need for a new zbo and consideration of alternatives, which the government provided in part but without accepting a different institutional design.
The Afdeling advised reconsidering the exclusion of the minister's power to set policy rules for the new authority, which the government rejected, retaining the exclusion.

The Afdeling asked for clearer rules on the authority's digital investigation powers and their limits, which the government addressed by clarifying the scope limited to the open internet and adding a data-processing basis.
The Afdeling required specific and suitable safeguards for processing special and criminal personal data, including a concrete maximum retention period, which the government added to the bill.

The Afdeling asked that safeguards such as human intervention be added where automated decisions on removal orders are possible, and the explanatory memorandum clarified human verification without changing the bill text.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of how the preventive duty of care relates to the constitutional ban on prior restraint based on content, and the government clarified the scope of specific measures in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling noted that the EVRM and Grondwet do not themselves require a zbo, and the government accepted this while maintaining its view that a zbo is justified.
Redactional comments of the Afdeling were adopted in the revised bill and explanatory memorandum.

36156.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a seventh supplementary budget, changing appropriations across policy articles and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes spending adjustments for client position and transparency, training and labour market, and information policy, including funding for a programme to improve service and data use.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for 2022 (7th incidental supplementary budget)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2022 (7e incidentele suppletoire begroting)

36165.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (the seventh supplementary budget, covering the Work on Implementation, Ukraine and the Slavery Past commemoration year) and sets its amounts in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 7 July 2022 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36174.s: The bill amends the Wft to implement the MiFID II recovery package directive for investment firms, adding information duties toward professional investors, cost-benefit disclosure for switching financial instruments, and revised position limits and position management controls for commodity derivatives. It also temporarily suspends the periodic best-execution publication duty and grants the AFM and the government new rule-making and enforcement powers in those areas.
36174.j: The memorandum justifies the new AFM position-limit powers and the general administrative order delegation by the need to avoid hindering new commodity contracts and by uncertainty about future changes to the reporting obligations.
q: Because it is not clear whether, and if so how, one or both obligations in article 4:90b, seventh paragraph, will be amended at a later date, the current text of that article is replaced by a more abstract text offering more flexibility.

Omdat niet duidelijk is of, en zo ja, op welke wijze een of beide in artikel 4:90b, zevende lid, opgenomen verplichtingen op enig later tijdstip zullen worden gewijzigd, wordt de huidige tekst van dat artikel vervangen door een abstractere tekst die meer flexibiliteit biedt
d: ARTIKEL I, E, 2 (art. 4:90b, twaalfde lid Wft)
information on order execution policy and periodic publication of execution quality
p: The AFM sets position limits for agricultural and critical commodity derivatives, may modify them after market change, and may grant exemptions on application.
The statutory duty to publish execution quality information is replaced by a more abstract provision allowing future change via general administrative order, with no parliamentary involvement stated.

parties: Supports removing unnecessary burdensome obligations and asks how the government evaluates whether reporting obligations are redundant.
These members support removing unnecessarily burdensome obligations and have some further questions and comments.
Deze leden ondersteunen het wegnemen van onnodig belastende verplichtingen en hebben daar nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen bij.
Questions the late implementation of the directive, the missing ESMA list of significant commodity derivatives and possible consequences such as fines and infringement procedure.
Does this late handling have consequences such as for fines?
Heeft deze te late behandeling consequenties zoals voor boetes?
Asks the government for the reason for the recovery package and why burdensome obligations were imposed on investment firms in the first place.
These members further ask the government why (unnecessary) burdensome obligations were ever imposed on investment firms.
Deze leden vragen de regering voorts waarom er ooit (onnodig) belastende verplichtingen zijn ingesteld voor beleggingsondernemingen.
