Strongly critical of the position limits: questions the narrowing of their scope, the lack of an impact assessment, wide bandwidths and speculation in food and energy markets, and calls for stronger government intervention.

Asks about the government's efforts to meet the implementation deadline, how Netherlands compares with other EU countries, and the impact of removing the notification requirement for the ancillary activities exemption.
The BBB member further asks what the government will do to comply with the implementation deadline in the future.
Het lid van de fractie BBB vraagt voorts wat de regering gaat doen om in de toekomst zich wel te conformeren aan de implementatietermijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the draft bill implementing the EU covid-19 recovery package for investment firms, and only offered drafting remarks. The Minister of Finance's reply notes that the drafting remarks on article 5:68(4) Wft will be handled through an amendment to the Besluit marktmisbruik Wft.
concerns: The Afdeling recommends rewording article 5:68(4) Wft so that it better reflects the requirement for internal reporting procedures for potential or actual breaches, and the government intends to address this via a change to the Besluit marktmisbruik Wft.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to discuss the consequences of the late implementation of the directive, which should have been in force by 28 February 2022.

36183.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations by adding a third supplementary budget for a housing package to address the migration crisis, mainly increasing spending under the housing market article (€193 million for overflow locations and an emergency reception organisation). The bill sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 30 August 2022, with retroactive effect where publication occurs later.

36219.s: The bill abolishes the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) from 2023 by repealing the 2014 housing market measures law and related provisions, while keeping transitional rules for earlier tax years and starter loans. It also removes the rent-cap chapter and the landlord contribution to the Rental Commission, with the rent-cap change dropped after consultation.
36219.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal by noting the levy's link to the Rental Commission contribution and the expected workload effects on RVO, without invoking new executive powers.
q: With the repeal of the rental levy, the arrangement for the landlord contribution to the Rental Commission also lapses.
Met het intrekken van de verhuurderheffing vervalt ook de regeling voor de verhuurderbijdrage voor de Huurcommissie.

parties: The VVD has no further questions or comments on the bill.

The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the documents accompanying the withdrawal of the Housing Market Measures 2014 II Act (abolition of the rental tax) and have no further questions or comments on it.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de stukken behorend bij de Intrekking van de Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II (afschaffing verhuurderheffing) en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen en/of opmerkingen.

The SP asks many detailed questions about the financial effects of abolishing the tax on profits and the ATAD rule for approved institutions, and how resources will be balanced for affordability, sustainability and new construction.
Can the government ensure that through the abolition of the rental tax the tasks and resources at sector level of the approved institutions are brought into balance?
Kan de regering verzekeren dat middels de afschaffing van de verhuurderheffing de opgaven en middelen op sectorniveau van de toegelaten instellingen in balans gebracht worden?
GroenLinks welcomes the abolition of the rental tax, which it had long opposed, and asks why it was kept in place after it was no longer financially needed and how the government reflects on that.
The members of the GroenLinks faction have taken note with interest of the present bill to finally abolish the rental tax.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel om de verhuurderheffing eindelijk af te schaffen.

Omtzigt welcomes the abolition and the rent cap, but asks whether the government will repeat the earlier mistake of abandoning performance agreements, whether they will reach their goals amid changed economic conditions, and asks for a vision on balancing rent caps and for a rent discount for poorly insulated homes.
Member Omtzigt notes that there has been broad societal opposition to the rental tax for years, also called the fine on affordable rent.
Het lid Omtzigt constateert dat er jarenlang breed maatschappelijk verzet is geweest tegen de verhuurderheffing – ook wel de boete op betaalbare huur genoemd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 17 August 2022 that the bill abolishing the landlord levy and changing the rent-increase cap for liberalised leases should be reconsidered, citing unjustified justification for reintroducing project subsidies funded by levies, insufficient safeguards and improper delegation of the rent cap to a ministerial regulation, and advised splitting the bill. The minister's reply of 4 October 2022 states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, the rent cap calculation is now fixed in the law, and the bill was split into two separate bills.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for justification of reintroducing solidarity-based project subsidies funded by levies, which the government addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum while noting the mechanism is still being elaborated.
The Afdeling found insufficient safeguards for necessity and proportionality of the rent-increase cap, and the government fixed the calculation method in the law with clarification in the memorandum.
The Afdeling considered delegating the maximum rent increase to a ministerial regulation unjustified, and the government moved the calculation method into the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte.

The Afdeling stressed the need for a fair balance between tenant and landlord interests and property protection under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR, which the government addressed by adjusting the cap formula and memorandum.
The Afdeling advised splitting the bill because the two measures lack connection and would deny Parliament separate debate, and the government split it into two bills.

36228.s: The bill prohibits businesses trading in goods from accepting or making cash payments of EUR 3,000 or more and adds a duty for institutions to check with other institutions about previously identified money laundering or terrorist financing risks, with a legal basis for banks to share transaction data in a joint monitoring facility. It also strengthens data-processing rules for sensitive personal data and sets evaluation and audit duties.
36228.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying technical and administrative measures may change often and need adjusting to technical developments such as data security.
q: It is neither necessary nor desirable to regulate these subjects fully at statutory level, since they concern technical and administrative measures that may change regularly and must be adjustable to technical developments.

Het is niet noodzakelijk en ook niet wenselijk deze onderwerpen geheel te regelen op wetsniveau, aangezien het hier gaat om maatregelen van technische en administratieve aard die mogelijk met enige regelmaat zullen wijzigen
d: scope of institutions to be checked for risk information
conditions for outsourcing customer due diligence
safeguards for processing sensitive personal data
data categories shared in joint monitoring facility
p: Institutions may share risk information on customers with other institutions, reducing client control over personal data flows, bounded by a risk-based trigger and a duty to inform clients.
Banks may combine customer transaction data in a joint monitoring facility, with data categories set by decree and audit and evaluation duties attached.

parties: Asks the government about the effectiveness of the cash ban and how circumvention would be countered.
The members of the VVD fractie have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Raises fundamental questions about legal soundness, EU-law conflict, the risk of wrongful suspicion and the 100-euro joint monitoring threshold.
Furthermore these members have fundamental questions about the legal sustainability of parts of the bill and the risk that people wrongly end up in the suspect's dock and cannot get out.

Voorts hebben deze leden fundamentele vragen over de juridische houdbaarheid van delen van het wetsvoorstel en het risico dat mensen onterecht in het verdachtenbankje terechtkomen en daar niet meer uit kunnen geraken.
Asks whether the cash-ban evidence is recent and how the Belastingdienst would enforce it, and questions the Raad van State's concern about mass monitoring.
Furthermore the PVV members note that currently nineteen member states apply a limit on cash payments.
Verder merken de leden van de PVV-fractie op dat er op dit moment negentien lidstaten zijn die een grens hanteren op contante betalingen.
Supports the anti-laundering aim but insists on neutral bank gatekeeping, supervision of banks and adequate legal protection for citizens and firms.
In addition it is important that there is good legal protection for citizens and businesses so that they can defend themselves against wrongful outcomes.
Daarbij is het van belang dat er een goede rechtsbescherming voor burgers en bedrijven is, zodat zij zich kunnen verweren bij onterechte uitkomsten.
Doubts the proportionality and necessity of the bill and the privacy intrusion, and asks whether a more targeted approach was considered.
These members ask the government for a comprehensive explanation of the proportionality and necessity of the bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering om een uitgebreide toelichting op de proportionaliteit en de noodzakelijkheid van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Weighs privacy and access to banking services and asks about the effectiveness and cost of measures for consumers.
The balance between these two interests, in which privacy plays a central role, must in the view of these members be carefully weighed against each other.
De balans tussen deze twee belangen, waarin privacy een centrale rol speelt, moeten zorgvuldig tegen elkaar worden afgewogen in de ogen van deze leden.
Expresses fundamental criticism of several aspects of the bill and doubts it can be supported in its current form, questioning effectiveness of the cash ban scope.
These members have fundamental criticism of a number of aspects of the bill and doubts about whether they can support the bill in its current form.

Deze leden hebben fundamentele kritiek ten aanzien van een aantal aspecten van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en hebben twijfels over de vraag of zij het wetsvoorstel in de huidige vorm kunnen steunen.
Accepts the need to act but raises critical questions, including the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' view that monitoring risks are disproportionate, and insists normal cash payments remain possible.
These members ask whether the government agrees with them and whether the government also shares their view that cash payments must always remain possible, insofar as this depends on the legislator.

Deze leden vragen of de regering dit met deze leden eens is en of de regering tevens met deze leden van mening is dat contante betalingen altijd mogelijk moeten blijven, voor zover dat van de wetgever afhangt.
Very critical of the substantial curtailment of freedoms including privacy and asks how the government weighs this against the aim.
The present bill comes on top of earlier anti-money-laundering legislation and leads to a substantial restriction of freedoms, including privacy.
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel komt boven op eerdere witwaswetgeving en leidt tot een forse inperking van vrijheden, waaronder privacy.
Argues central monitoring of nearly all payments conflicts with proportionality and the EU Charter and asks for a fundamental-rights test.
Rightly the AP notes that only a small percentage of total payment traffic is directly or indirectly linked to money laundering, while under this proposal (virtually) every payment is monitored.

Terecht merkt de AP op dat slechts een klein percentage van het totale betalingsverkeer direct of indirect gelieerd is aan witwassen, terwijl met dit voorstel (nagenoeg) elke betaling wordt gemonitord.
Worries about small citizens and SMEs becoming unbankable and asks what legal remedies and independent ombudsman oversight exist.
How will the government improve legal protection for consumers and SMEs? What appeal options are there for citizens?
Hoe gaat de regering de rechtsbescherming voor consumenten en MKB verbeteren? Wat voor beroepsmogelijkheden zijn er voor burgers?
Shares Council of State and AP criticism on fundamental rights, asks whether a supplementary advice was sought and how citizens can contest bank decisions.
Member Omtzigt notes that both the advice of the Council of State and of the Dutch Data Protection Authority were very critical.
Het lid Omtzigt constateert dat zowel de adviezen van de Raad van State (RvS) als van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) heel kritisch waren.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against the proposed joint transaction monitoring by banks and the client-due-diligence data sharing, finding their necessity and proportionality insufficiently shown and fundamental-rights safeguards lacking, and advised rejecting the joint monitoring basis. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the main objection on necessity, but accepts several conditions: narrower data sets, pseudonymisation, a four-year evaluation, explicit bans on solely automated decisions and on sub-delegation, clearer responsibilities, and narrower risk-sharing criteria.
concerns: The Council found joint transaction monitoring of nearly all Dutch citizens' data disproportionate and its necessity unproven; the government kept the measure, narrowing the data processed and adding an evaluation.

Privacy and data-protection rights are seriously affected by mass data sharing; the government added pseudonymisation, encryption and evaluation but refused extra cybersecurity requirements beyond existing rules.

The government left the necessity assessment of joint monitoring to banks rather than making its own; the Council considered this an improper delegation of fundamental-rights safeguards to private parties, which the government partly addressed.
The open-ended norm for when a client poses a higher risk and the unspecified data to be shared were criticised; the government specified triggers and data categories.

Lack of safeguards against automated decision-making, exclusion and discrimination, and of effective legal protection for affected clients; the government excluded solely automated decisions and sub-delegation.
Processing of criminal-law data and possible blacklists required concrete safeguards; the government added some data-protection rules and deferred others to a general administrative order.
Professional secrecy of lawyers and notaries should not be breachable by ministerial order; the government removed the extension for these professions.
Redactional point on the EU directive basis for outsourcing rules was raised and addressed in the reply.

36250-X.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and expenditure by article in thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 December 2022. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes mainly to the 2021-2023 collective labour agreement, external hiring, and a transfer of EUR 732.9 million to the Defence Materiel Budget Fund.
36250-X.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the collective labour agreement, higher than expected external hiring costs, and the transfer to the Defence Materiel Budget Fund.
q: The change of EUR 732.9 million concerns the contribution from the Defence chapter budget to the Defence Materiel Budget Fund chapter for expenditure recorded on the fund.

De mutatie van € 732,9 miljoen betreft de bijdrage vanuit de begroting Hoofdstuk X Defensie aan hoofdstuk K Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds ten behoeve van uitgaven die op het fonds worden verantwoord.

36264.s: The bill amends the Dutch GDPR implementation act (UAVG) and several sector laws to clarify rules on processing personal data, including criminal-law data, health records transfers, accountants' mandatory audits, biometric access, identification numbers and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens. It mainly tightens or clarifies processing exceptions and adds a delegation to ministerial regulation for AP appointment rules and for health record transfers.
36264.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement GDPR rules flexibly and to clarify practice, relying on consultation with the AP and the Council of State.
q: The prohibition on processing special categories of personal data no longer applies where processing is necessary for an engagement prescribed by law to be carried out by an accountant.

Het verbod om bijzondere categorieën van persoonsgegevens te verwerken is niet langer van toepassing indien de verwerking noodzakelijk is voor een door een accountant te verrichten bij wettelijk voorschrift voorgeschreven opdracht.
d: I, onderdeel C (art. 3 lid 3 onderdeel a UAVG)
armed forces data processing rules for missions
qualifications and procedure for appointing AP members
further rules on health record transfer by care providers
processing of personal data by temporary commissions set up by ministerial or royal decision
rules on safeguards for automated blocking of payment transactions
p: Allows temporary commissions and advisory bodies set up by ministerial or royal decision to process sensitive and criminal data, subject to statutory safeguards and a report on dissolution.
Permits banks and payment institutions to automatically block or suspend transactions, with human review and a right of the client to state a view, with detailed rules to follow by decree.

parties: Asks about cross-sectoral data sharing for fraud prevention and the government's handling of advisory bodies' comments, with no clear check-related demand.
Can the government outline the latest state of affairs regarding cross-sectoral data sharing?
Kan de regering ten aanzien van het onderwerp cross-sectorale gegevensdeling de laatste stand van zaken schetsen?
Questions why safeguards in Article 41 are not set in sectoral legislation as the AP proposed, and whether the AP's advice on rights of data subjects should be reconsidered.
These members would like to know the reasons for not regulating the safeguards in sectoral legislation, as the AP proposes.
Deze leden willen graag weten wat de redenen zijn om de waarborgen niet in sectorale wetgeving te regelen, zoals de AP voorstelt.
Asks about proportionality and subsidiarity of the bill, bureaucracy, and whether a minor's consent can conflict with a legal representative's rights.
The CDA members ask to what extent the government has weighed the purpose of the law against the interests it serves.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen in hoeverre de regering de afweging heeft gemaakt tussen het doel van de wet en de belangen die hiermee gediend worden.
Argues the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens needs stronger effectiveness and public accountability, and asks about collective complaint rights and publication of decisions.
These members are somewhat puzzled that this omnibus bill makes no proposals to improve the effectiveness and capacity of the AP.
Het bevreemdt deze leden dan ook enigszins dat in deze verzamelwet geen voorstellen worden gedaan om de effectiviteit en slagkracht van de AP te verbeteren.
Regrets that the debate on Article 41 is not held, noting that people are denied essential information by agencies invoking it.
They see that in practice this means people are still denied essential information by agencies invoking this article.
Zij zien dat in de praktijk dit betekent dat mensen nog steeds essentiële informatie wordt onthouden door instanties die een beroep doen op dit artikel.
Worries that the GDPR and UAVG are applied too strictly, blocking data sharing in care, security and investigation, and asks how to prevent this.
These members fear that the GDPR and UAVG are interpreted too strictly and that this serves not to protect citizens' privacy but rather obstructs implementation.
De leden van deze fractie vrezen dat de AVG en UAVG té stringent worden uitgelegd en dat dit niet dient ter bescherming van de privacy van burgers, maar eerder een belemmering in de uitvoering vormt.
Sees the bill as a step forward for protecting EU citizens and asks how the government will define 'zwaarwegend algemeen belang' via indicators and a weighing framework.
To sharpen the protection of Dutch EU citizens, they see this bill as a step in the right direction.
Om de bescherming van Nederlandse EU-burgers scherper te krijgen, zien zij dit voorstel als een stap in de goede richting.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Verzamelwet gegevensbescherming amending the Dutch GDPR implementation act, raising concerns about open GDPR norms, purpose limitation and the scope of the bailiff/curator data-processing grounds, transaction monitoring, rights restrictions and the delegation for committees. The government reply accepts most points, revising the wording, adding safeguards and deferring the rights-restriction amendment for further study.
concerns: Unclear which legal ground applies to curators and (Wsnp-)bewindvoerders' data processing and how the general task description squares with purpose limitation; government narrowed the task wording and added a list of specific acts.
Open GDPR notions such as 'zwaarwegend algemeen belang' and 'passende en specifieke waarborgen' need clearer substance; government clarified the notion and added safeguards for committees.

Automated transaction blocking requires clear appropriate safeguards in place when the provision enters into force; government specified the measures in the Wft and an AMvB with aligned entry into force.
Scope of the restriction of data subject rights was unclear; government deferred the amendment for further study instead of adopting it now, though the text was adjusted.

Delegation for committees and advisory bodies needed clearer scope and identification of the controller; government broadened it to all temporary bodies and requires designation of the controller in the instellingsregeling.
Placement of the accountants' processing exception in the UAVG rather than sectoral law was questioned; government explained the choice but kept it in the UAVG.
Several redactional corrections were proposed; most were incorporated, except the request to specify the statutory basis in the Wet op de rechtsbijstand.

36291.s: The bill adds mpox to the list of infectious diseases in article 1 of the Public Health Act (Wet publieke gezondheid), so that its designation as a group B1 disease, first made by ministerial regulation, is incorporated into the statute. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36291.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the legal requirement in article 20(4) Wpg that a ministerial designation be submitted as a bill within eight weeks to keep it in force.
q: To keep the designation as a B1 infectious disease in force, article 20(4) Wpg requires that within eight weeks of the ministerial regulation being made, a bill incorporating it be sent to the House of Representatives.

Voor voortduring van de aanwijzing als B1-infectieziekte vereist artikel 20, vierde lid, Wpg dat binnen acht weken na het tot stand komen van de betreffende ministeriële regeling een voorstel van wet tot incorporatie van die regeling aan de Tweede Kamer wordt gezonden.

parties: Asks about vaccination numbers, communication roles and whether a tecovirimat stockpile will be built, without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members support the proposal to designate mpox as a B1 infectious disease but have some questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn voor het voorgenomen voorstel om mpox aan te wijzen als B1-infectieziekte, maar hebben hierbij nog wel enkele vragen.
Positive about downgrading the disease category but asks for a measurable trigger for reverting to type A, which would constrain executive discretion.
These members ask the Minister whether there is a measurable point at which, if needed, the infectious disease would again be classified as type A.
Genoemde leden vragen de Minister of er een meetbaar moment is wanneer, mocht het nodig zijn, de infectieziekte wel aangemerkt wordt als type A.
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
They currently have no questions or comments on this.
Zij hebben hier op dit moment geen vragen en/of opmerkingen over.
Agrees with the decision but asks for action plans on pre-exposure vaccination and tecovirimat stock and how to reach patients, without raising checks.
The GroenLinks members consider it important to try to prevent a new resurgence or outbreak of mpox and note that moving mpox from group A to B1 does not cause the advice of this council to lapse.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie achten het van belang dat wordt geprobeerd een nieuwe opleving/uitbraak van mpox te voorkomen en constateren dat de verplaatsing van mpox als infectieziekte van groep A naar B1 er niet toe leidt dat de adviezen van dit beraad komen te vervallen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet publieke gezondheid to incorporate the Regeling mpox B1 and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The text contains no separate government reply to substantive points because the Afdeling raised none, and the minister simply forwards the bill.

36309.s: The bill abolishes the power of the SVB to declare persons negligent (schuldig nalatig) for unpaid AOW premiums, thereby removing the pension reduction that followed such a declaration. Existing reductions lapse, no new declarations may be made after the entry-into-force date, and unpaid premiums remain collectable via the Belastingdienst.
36309.j: The memorandum justifies abolition by citing disproportionate effects on citizens, Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and simplification of implementation for the SVB and Belastingdienst.
q: in order to prevent disproportionate effects for citizens and to simplify the implementation of the AOW for the SVB and the Belastingdienst
om zo disproportionele effecten voor burgers te voorkomen en de uitvoering van de AOW voor de SVB en de Belastingdienst te vereenvoudigen
d: rules on rounding partial calendar years and partial annual premiums
p: Artikel II, A (vervallen Wfsv hoofdstuk 4 paragraaf 3, art. 61-62)

Removes the SVB's administrative power to declare persons negligent and the associated appeal provision, reducing both executive sanction power and the procedural remedy against it, which is a shift toward the executive in the sense of reduced citizen protection against an administrative sanction.

parties: Asks how enforcement of premium debts will be maintained so that collection remains a real risk, and how the transition and budget effects are arranged.
To maintain support for the accrual character of the AOW, these members consider it necessary that collection is experienced as a real risk by premium payers.
Om het draagvlak onder het opbouwkarakter van de AOW te behouden is het volgens deze leden noodzakelijk dat deze invordering als reëel risico wordt ervaren door premieplichtigen.
Asks what steps prevent policy from only being corrected after a court ruling and whether unintended effects are checked in other social security schemes.
Specifically, these members ask about the steps the government takes to prevent action being taken only after a court ruling shows that legislation leads to undesirable effects.
Concreet vragen deze leden naar de stappen die de regering zet om te voorkomen dat pas actie wordt ondernomen na een rechterlijke uitspraak als wetgeving tot onwenselijke effecten blijkt te leiden.
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
The CDA members have no questions or comments on the present bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben geen vragen en/of opmerkingen bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Supports the bill's added room for correction but asks for case-by-case treatment and a personal contact point for citizens in difficult situations.

In addition, these members would like to see the possibility of tailored treatment and clear communication about a counter with real people, reachable both in person and by phone, to present personal situations.

Daarnaast zouden deze leden graag de mogelijkheid tot maatwerk zien en heldere communicatie over een loket met echte personen waar zowel fysiek als via de telefoon mee gesproken kan worden om persoonlijke situaties voor te leggen.
Asks how likely it is that people reduced since 2020 would win a legal challenge for unequal treatment and whether retroactive non-reduction was considered.

The PvdA members ask how large the government considers the chance that pensioners reduced on their AOW between 2020 and 2023 following an SN decision would be right if legal proceedings are started over unequal treatment?

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen hoe groot de regering de kans acht dat gepensioneerden die tussen 2020 en 2023 gekort zijn op hun AOW naar aanleiding van een SN-besluit gelijk krijgen indien er een juridische procedure wordt gestart wegens ongelijke behandeling?
Asks for confirmation that existing reductions will lapse and how premium evasion by people working abroad will be addressed by the Belastingdienst.
Will the Belastingdienst get more powers to counter this form of AOW premium evasion?
Krijgt de Belastingdienst meer mogelijkheden om deze vorm van ontduiking van de AOW-premie tegen te gaan?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill abolishing the possibility of declaring someone guilty of negligence for not or not fully paying social insurance premiums (volksverzekeringen) raises no remarks and may proceed to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport, dated 16 February 2023, notes only an adjustment to the budgetary series in the explanatory memorandum to give a more precise estimate of extra expenditure in 2023.

36318.s: The bill creates a legal framework for policy to increase the independence of the Dutch energy supply, requiring the minister for Climate and Energy to adopt an energy strategy every five years, an annual energy note, and an advisory Energy Council. It also provides for consultation with provinces, water boards, municipalities and other parties to implement the policy.
36318.j: The explanatory memorandum excerpt provided does not contain a substantive justification for the delegation beyond the general aim of energy independence.
q: The Minister for Climate and Energy may amend the energy strategy two years after its adoption if, in his judgment, progress in implementation makes this necessary.
Onze Minister voor Klimaat en Energie kan de energiestrategie twee jaar na de vaststelling wijzigen indien dit gelet op de voortgang van de uitvoering naar zijn oordeel noodzakelijk is.
d: amendment of the energy strategy two years after adoption
p: The minister may amend the energy strategy on his own judgment if he deems it necessary, without a further parliamentary step specified in the bill.

36327.s: The bill enacts a new Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure (Wetboek van Strafvordering) to modernise the existing code, restructuring the general provisions, the trial process, investigation powers and remedies. The explanatory memorandum says it aims to reflect current practice, codify case law, strengthen rights of defendants and victims, and provide a clearer framework for digital investigation powers.
36327.j: The memorandum justifies the new and expanded investigative powers by the need to adapt criminal procedure to digital technology and changed crime patterns, with rights safeguards codified.
q: An important systematic and substantive improvement in the new code is achieved, for example, by no longer linking the suspect's legal protection to the start of prosecution.

Een belangrijke systematische en inhoudelijke verbetering wordt in het nieuwe wetboek bijvoorbeeld bereikt door de rechtsbescherming van de verdachte niet meer te koppelen aan het begin van de vervolging
d: designation of electronic facilities for transmitting messages and filing documents
designation of categories of auxiliary investigating officers and their investigative domains
victim support rules, individual needs assessment and protection measures
p: The public prosecutor may order that a suspect's lawyer has no access to or may not communicate confidentially with the suspect for up to six days, subject to later court review.

parties: Asks whether the sanction of inadmissibility for breaching instruction norms on the landelijke bevoegdheid is proportionate and whether suspects' contact with counsel may be supervised.
These members ask why the sanction of inadmissibility of the prosecution service for breach of instruction norms regarding the national competence was chosen.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom gekozen is voor de sanctie van niet-ontvankelijkheid van het OM op schending van instructienormen ter zake de landelijke bevoegdheid.
Asks whether the rechter-commissaris should supervise the investigation more broadly and whether the raadkamer's test should be in the statute rather than the explanatory memorandum.
They ask whether consideration has been given to letting the rechter-commissaris oversee the criminal investigation more broadly than only in cases where the rechter-commissaris is involved.

Zij vragen of is overwogen om het «meekijken» van de rechter-commissaris bij het opsporingsonderzoek breder te laten plaatsvinden dan alleen maar in gevallen waarbij de rechter-commissaris wordt betrokken.

Questions whether the victim-interest clause 'te allen tijde' conflicts with the presumption of innocence and whether the proportionality and subsidiarity principles should apply to the whole procedure.
Is 'at all times' not far too broad, given that the Netherlands has a two-party system (the suspect and the prosecution service) and the victim does not fall under it?
Is «te allen tijde» niet veel te ruim, gezien het feit dat Nederland een tweepartijenstelsel kent (de verdachte en het OM) en het slachtoffer hier niet onder valt?
Asks why proportionality and subsidiarity are not in Boek 1 and why the broader use of algemene maatregel van bestuur in criminal procedure was chosen given legality concerns.
These members ask what the government's arguments are for not including these principles in Boek 1.
Deze leden vragen wat de argumenten zijn van de regering om deze beginselen niet op te nemen in Boek 1.

Notes that only two suspect rights are named in the introductory provisions and that the principles of proportionality and subsidiarity appear only in Boek 2, creating an impression they do not apply generally.
The SP members note that only two of the suspect's rights are mentioned in the introductory provisions.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat er in de inleidende bepalingen slechts twee van de rechten van de verdachte worden genoemd.

Worries that the balancing of interests in the introductory provisions reduces the criminal process to suspect and victim, dropping the societal perspective, and asks whether the defence right should be a guiding principle.
Can the government indicate why, for example, the right of defence should not be a guiding principle?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom bijvoorbeeld het recht op verdediging niet een leidend beginsel behoort te zijn?
Asks when funding will be available and whether the many AMvB's to be elaborated and the workload on police, prosecution and judiciary are accounted for.
These members also point to the number of algemene maatregelen van bestuur (AMvB's) that must be elaborated.
Deze leden wijzen tevens op het aantal algemene maatregelen van bestuur (AMvB's) dat uitgewerkt dient te worden.
Asks whether the 'beweging naar voren' might restrict the defence later and how suspects without counsel can have a good position, given it must not come at the cost of suspects' rights.
However, these members believe that this aim may not come at the expense of the rights of the suspect.
Echter, zo menen deze leden, mag dat streven niet ten koste gaan van de rechten van de verdachte.

Asks about the scope of communication-service providers, the status of the College of procureurs-generaal rule as non-formal, and whether pre-authorisation by the rechter-commissaris will be required for some powers.
To what extent does the government consider it wise to leave open for which powers the public prosecutor will likely be required to request an authorisation?
In hoeverre acht de regering het verstandig om nu in het midden te laten voor welke bevoegdheden de officier van justitie naar verwachting verplicht zal zijn een machtiging te vragen?
Questions whether internal checks like the College's approval count as formal requirements, and whether oral orders undermine verifiability of lawful investigation by the defence.
They ask whether, in this way, the defence can properly verify that justice has acted in accordance with statutory requirements.
Zij vragen of het op deze manier voor de verdediging goed te controleren is of door justitie conform de wettelijke voorschriften is gehandeld.

Asks why detailed, non-technology-neutral powers are codified, whether consent requirements of voluntariness and unambiguity should be stated, and about the scope of pre-trial detention and surety rules.
These members therefore ask the government to examine other choices in finding a balance between legal certainty and future-proofing.
Voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering daarom andere keuzes te onderzoeken bij het vinden van een evenwicht tussen rechtszekerheid en toekomstbestendigheid.

Argue that the rechter-commissaris should be involved more often in the investigation, that non-suspects' data must be protected, and that pre-trial detention should be subject to proportionality and alternatives.
In addition, these members believe that an independent judicial assessment of the lawfulness and justice of criminal intervention should be built into the investigation as soon as possible.

Daarnaast vinden deze leden dat in het opsporingsonderzoek zo snel mogelijk een onafhankelijk rechterlijk oordeel moet worden ingebouwd over de rechtmatigheid en rechtvaardigheid van strafrechtelijk ingrijpen.
Asks about the workload impact flagged by the judiciary, and whether the OM should be more explicitly obliged to pursue alternatives to pre-trial detention.
Would it not also be necessary, to achieve a practice in which alternatives to pre-trial detention are applied more widely, to more explicitly oblige the OM in the law to make efforts to that end?

Zou het, om daadwerkelijk tot een praktijk te komen waarin alternatieven voor voorlopige hechtenis breder worden toegepast, niet ook nodig zijn het OM in de wet nadrukkelijker op te dragen zich daartoe in te spannen?
Argues that the powers should be stated in the statute itself rather than only the memorie van toelichting, to satisfy legality, and that detailed descriptions may increase administrative burden.
If the government really wants these powers to be limited, why is this not included in the statute itself?
Als de regering daadwerkelijk wil dat de betreffende bevoegdheden begrensd dienen te worden, waarom is dit dan niet in de wet zelf opgenomen?
Asks how victims' rights and procedural fairness are protected, the motivation of sepot decisions, and inconsistent handling of complaints across appeal courts.
Can the government indicate which steps Book 3 takes to increase procedural fairness for interested parties?
Kan de regering aangeven welke stappen er met Boek 3 worden gezet om de procedurele rechtvaardigheid van belanghebbenden te vergroten?
Questions the marginal judicial review of prosecution decisions, supervision of delegated decisions by prosecutorial staff, and the lack of notification to non-interrogated suspects.
Can the government explain why it kept a marginal review by the judge?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom is gebleven bij een marginale toets door de rechter?
Asks for the government's reasons for a non-exhaustive list of procedural principles and why the equality principle is omitted, and why the objection procedure against prosecution is rarely used.
These members specifically ask why the equality principle is not included in this article.
Deze leden vragen concreet waarom het gelijkheidsbeginsel niet in dit artikel is opgenomen.
Raises concerns from Fonds Slachtofferhulp about victims' rights throughout proceedings and whether victims are actively involved in agreements and out-of-court settlements.
How can the government guarantee that victims have rights throughout the entire legal process, not only at the hearing?
Hoe kan de regering garanderen dat slachtoffers rechten hebben tijdens de gehele rechtsgang, en niet alleen op zitting?
Ask how often complaints about non-investigation are filed, whether the two-step complaint route is a barrier, and whether serious offences should be investigated.
These members ask how often such a complaint possibility is used each year.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen hoe vaak er jaarlijks gebruik wordt gemaakt van een dergelijke klachtmogelijkheid.
Asks why the prosecutor's gatekeeper role and out-of-court disposal are not regulated in Book 3, arguing transparency toward police and partners is needed.
In that context it is all the more important that it is clear how the Public Prosecution Service fulfils its gatekeeping function and that this is transparent to the chain partners involved.
In dat kader is het nog meer van belang dat inzichtelijk is op welke wijze het OM de poortwachtersfunctie invult en dat dit transparant is voor de betrokken ketenpartners.

Asks about implementation costs for expert institutes and about how witness-request criteria actually encourage timely filing, and about standardising compensation for trial delay to avoid arbitrariness between judges.
Can the government reflect on this?

Asks whether the new rules will actually shorten case durations, whether the presiding judge rather than the investigating judge should be the only one deciding readiness, and why the Keskin exception is not codified.
The D66 members ask, regarding case durations in criminal proceedings, whether the proposed rules will actually lead to improvement.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen, met betrekking tot de doorlooptijden in strafrechtelijke procedures, of de voorgestelde regelingen wel daadwerkelijk tot verbetering gaan leiden.
Worries that the forward-moving trial model and stricter witness-request assessment disadvantage unrepresented defendants, and asks about victims' notification and privacy when hearings are recorded.
To what extent is the envisaged funnel model, in which the assessment of requests to summon witnesses and experts becomes increasingly strict to the detriment of the suspect?
In hoeverre is het voorziene trechtermodel waarin de beoordeling van verzoeken tot oproeping van getuigen en deskundigen steeds strenger wordt in het nadeel van de verdachte?
Asks how victims and injured parties are informed about the written round and whether they can object to recording of hearings, and how their privacy is safeguarded.
These members ask whether the government can address how the victim/injured party is informed about the written round.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan ingaan op de vraag op welke wijze het slachtoffer/de benadeelde partij wordt geïnformeerd over de schriftelijke ronde.
Questions whether injured parties' civil claims should be handled inside criminal procedure, and presses on victims' speaking rights, notification of written rounds, and recording of hearings.
Asks whether the extensive speaking right of victims directed at the suspect, who is presumed innocent, was considered, and suggests the verdict should address victim statements.
Has the government considered this and, if so, why is nothing of this found in the statutory regulation or the explanatory memorandum?
Heeft de regering hierover nagedacht en zo ja, waarom is daar niets van terug te vinden in de wettelijke regeling, dan wel de memorie van toelichting?
Asks how the new appeal system affects prosecution appeal rights, victims' interests, and whether the single-judge chamber limit should be raised to reduce long appeal durations.
Can the government provide an overview of the decisions against which the OM can currently still appeal (higher appeal) but no longer under the new Code?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van de beslissingen waartegen het OM thans nog wel (hoger) beroep in kan stellen en in het nieuwe Wetboek niet meer?
Asks who bears the risk of electronic filing failures, how defendants are informed of withdrawals, and whether defendants in appeal should be required to have a lawyer.
Does the government agree that non-professional procedural parties should be informed, besides electronically, also by a non-electronic route such as a letter?
Deelt de regering de mening dat niet-professionele procespartijen behalve via de elektronische weg ook via een niet-elektronische weg zoals een brief op de hoogte moeten worden gesteld?

Worries that penal orders and objections are handled with excessive delay, that waiver of the right to object should be scrutinised, and that the one-week withdrawal period and lack of safeguards disadvantage defendants.

These members therefore consider it unacceptable that citizens who reject a penal order by lodging an objection must do so within a short 14-day period and then often have to wait far too long for their case to be heard by the district court.

Deze leden vinden het daarom onaanvaardbaar dat burgers die een strafbeschikking afwijzen door verzet in te stellen, dat binnen een korte termijn van 14 dagen dienen te doen en vervolgens vaak veel te lang moeten wachten op een behandeling van de zaak bij de rechtbank.
Welcomes the expanded appeal options for defendants and abolition of the leave system, but asks whether the appeal court's reduced active role leaves unrepresented defendants exposed.
These members note that these are positive proposals for the position of the defendant.
Deze leden merken op dat dit positieve voorstellen zijn voor de positie van de verdachte.
Shares the Council of State's concern that unrepresented defendants may not be able to exercise their rights and asks whether mandatory legal representation in appeal should be considered.
They ask the government to reflect on this point.
Zij vragen de regering op een reflectie op dit punt.
Asks whether pre-trial detention of minors is truly a last resort, why detention time limits are not shorter for juveniles, and why the judge's powers to impose longer sentences are expanded.
Why is it not expressly stated in the statutory text itself that depriving minors of liberty in the pre-trial phase may only be applied as a last resort and for the shortest possible duration?

Waarom is niet uitdrukkelijk in de wetstekst zelf opgenomen dat het benemen van de vrijheid van minderjarigen in de voorfase van het strafproces slechts als uiterste maatregel en voor de kortst mogelijke duur mag worden toegepast?
Questions whether the discretion left to individual judges to summon parents risks unequal treatment, and asks why no mandatory appearance rule was chosen.
These members believe this creates a significant risk of legal inequality..'Deze leden menen dat hierdoor het risico op rechtsongelijkheid groot is.
Deze leden menen dat hierdoor het risico op rechtsongelijkheid groot is.
Asks the government to reconsider writing the last-resort principle for juvenile detention explicitly into law and to justify the expanded sentencing power of the single-judge children's judge.
Is the government willing to reconsider explicitly including this principle in the law?
Is de regering bereid te (her)overwegen om dit uitgangspunt expliciet in de wet op te nemen?
Asks how the expanded sanction powers of the single-judge children's judge have been used and what the principled basis for the expansion is.
What is the principled basis for the decision to add this expansion of powers?
Wat is de principiële basis voor het besluit om deze verruiming van mogelijkheden toe te voegen?
Asks why the duty for judges to examine suspension of pre-trial detention for juveniles was dropped and whether shorter detention limits for juveniles are warranted.
These members ask the government why this choice was made, since extra restraint should be applied to pre-trial detention of juvenile suspects.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom deze keuze is gemaakt, aangezien bij jeugdige verdachten extra terughoudend moet worden omgegaan met de toepassing van voorlopige hechtenis.
Asks the criteria for applying adolescent criminal law and how parents are involved, and whether minor suspects have all the rights of adult suspects.
These members ask whether minor suspects therefore also hold all the rights that apply to adult suspects under the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Deze leden vragen of minderjarige verdachten dan ook beschikken over alle rechten die toekomen aan een meerderjarige verdachte zoals bepaald in het Wetboek van Strafvordering.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the new Wetboek van Strafvordering, welcoming its modernisation but raising major concerns about implementability, personnel capacity, digitalisation, citizens' capacity to navigate the process, and the balance between prosecution, police, victims and the defendant. The government's nader rapport accepts many points, clarifies intended goals and adds implementation and financial detail, while noting its limits.
concerns: The Afdeling says the bill's implementability is insufficiently addressed, especially personnel capacity, digital systems and citizens' capacity to act, and the government adds implementation and cost detail but leaves capacity risks open.

The Afdeling finds the explanatory memorandum does not clearly state the bill's goals or answer key questions, which the government addresses by adding a goals section and more detail on implementation.
The Afdeling asks for stronger safeguards for suspects, especially those without counsel, including legal aid, access to files and information, which the government only partly takes up.

The Afdeling warns that shifting roles among prosecution, police, judge and victim may unbalance the criminal process and asks the legislature to set clearer guidance on the judge's role, which the government addresses in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that investigative powers be subject to safeguards matching their intrusiveness and questions dropping ernstige bezwaren and judicial authorisation requirements for some powers, which the government largely defers.

36336.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by a second incidental supplementary budget for support to Ukraine, changing spending and commitment appropriations across several policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 3 April 2023, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36345.s: The bill inserts eight new articles into the General Customs Act (Algemene douanewet) giving customs inspectors an explicit statutory basis to process personal data through cameras, including fixed and mobile (drone) cameras, for risk analysis, customs control and enforcement support. It sets purposes, location limits, a four-week deletion rule, an annual privacy audit by the Minister of Finance, a yearly camera plan, and a delegation to an AMvB for further rules.
36345.j: The memorandum justifies the new camera powers by the sheer volume of goods movements, the need for innovative tools such as drones, and the fact that cameras are less intrusive than large numbers of inspectors physically checking more people.
q: To carry out customs supervision over those goods movements, a very large customs service would be necessary.
Om het douanetoezicht uit te voeren op die goederenbewegingen zou een zeer omvangrijke douanedienst noodzakelijk zijn.
d: designation of officials to authorise cameras at other locations in urgent cases
further rules ensuring correct application of camera provisions, including camera plan content
annual camera plan set by the Minister of Finance and published
p: Gives customs inspectors a broad statutory power to process personal data via cameras for risk management and control support, limited by stated purposes, location rules and a four-week deletion period.
Allows cameras processing health data of travellers to select persons for customs control, including possible body searches, a sensitive category of personal data.
Requires an annual audit of privacy and integrity aspects by the Minister of Finance's own internal audit team rather than an independent body.

parties: Wants camera surveillance to be effective against organised crime, while asking whether privacy rules and the balance with citizens' privacy are properly struck, and whether the camera plan could be misused by criminals.

Notes the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' earlier serious concerns, asks which special personal data will be processed, and is very sceptical of automatic facial recognition, asking under what conditions it could be used.
These members are in general very sceptical about the use of automatic facial recognition.
Deze leden zijn in algemene zin zeer sceptisch over de inzet van automatische gezichtsherkenning.

Accepts that personal data processing is unavoidable but insists it be done carefully with enforceable rules, and asks how deletion after four weeks is guaranteed, including for data shared with partners.
However, they find that this must be done carefully and that the rules must be well enforceable.
Wel vinden zij dat dit zorgvuldig moet gebeuren en dat de regels goed handhaafbaar zijn.
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
These members currently have no questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben nu geen vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks what safeguards surround the use of facial recognition, why they are considered adequate, and which conditions must be met before using facial recognition cameras in a given case.
These members still have a number of questions regarding the use of cameras.
Deze leden hebben nog een aantal vragen ten aanzien van het gebruik van camera’s.

Asks which situations justify processing personal data for the personal safety of officials and why identifying natural persons is necessary, and asks for the meaning of the delegation for urgent cases.
This member asks the government which situations it has in mind and why identification of natural persons is then necessary.
Dit lid vraagt de regering aan welke situaties zij dan denkt en waarom identificatie van natuurlijke personen dan noodzakelijk is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet cameratoezicht douane, which regulates personal data processing from fixed and mobile cameras used by customs, recommending a statutory guarantee that individuals are identified only when necessary, addressing data sharing with cooperation bodies, and re-consulting the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens. The government's reply (nader rapport) reports that a new paragraph was added limiting identification to what is necessary, that the memorie van toelichting was supplemented on data sharing and the AP advice, and that the bill was adjusted for sea-directed cameras.
concerns: Individuals should be identified only to the extent necessary for customs tasks, a safeguard absent from the draft and now added as a new paragraph in article 1:23a.
The explanatory memorandum should address sharing of personal data with cooperation bodies, which was added in paragraph 3.6 AVG.

The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens should be re-consulted on the substantially changed bill; the bill was submitted to the AP, which asked for a fuller memorie van toelichting on drone risks, addressed by expanding the explanation rather than changing the bill.

36360-V.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2022, setting out changes to commitments, expenditure and receipts per policy article. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36372.s: The bill amends the Penitentiary Principles Act to let the Minister for Legal Protection order, for detainees held in extra-secure units or intensive supervision wings, broader restrictions on communication with the outside world (mail, visits, phone, media) for up to three to twelve months, renewable. It also introduces mandatory visual supervision of detainee-lawyer meetings, locates phone calls to designated places, limits the number of lawyers with privileged access to two, and adds a restricted appeal procedure allowing evidence to be withheld from the complainant.
36372.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to prevent organised crime and threats to officials and third parties from within detention, and argues the measures are necessary and proportionate and compatible with ECHR Articles 3, 6 and 8.
q: If there are indications that life-threatening or seriously intimidating activities are being undertaken from detention, it must be possible to intervene more quickly and more firmly.
Als er aanwijzingen bestaan dat levensbedreigende of ernstig intimiderende activiteiten vanuit detentie worden ondernomen, moet er sneller en steviger kunnen worden ingegrepen.
d: rules on visual supervision of visits
designation of places from which detainees may be phoned
detailed rules on lawyer access in extra-secure units
detailed rules on implementation of detention provisions
p: The Minister may order broad communication restrictions on detainees, including on contact with third parties outside the prison, for up to twelve months with renewal, based on intelligence or the nature of the offence rather than individual proof.
Parties may withhold information or documents from the complainant in appeals against ministerial orders, with only the appeals body seeing the material, limiting adversarial review.
Visual supervision of lawyer visits in extra-secure units and intensive supervision wings becomes automatic, without individual decision.
Detainees' access to lawyers is limited to two designated lawyers, with the Minister deciding on additional ones, restricting choice of counsel.

parties: Asks whether a ministerial order and separate appeal procedure before the RSJ create legal uncertainty and whether a uniform regime would be clearer.
The bill now creates an additional legal procedure, and especially in the first period after entry into force a small group of detainees may often appeal.

Het wetsvoorstel creëert daarbovenop nu een extra juridische procedure, waarbij zeker in de eerste periode na inwerkingtreding niet is uitgesloten dat een kleine groep gedetineerden vaak in bezwaar en beroep zal gaan.
Same concerns on legal certainty and appeal procedures before the RSJ, alongside questions on recording audio of lawyer contact.
These members ask the government to respond to this.
Voornoemde leden vragen een reactie van de regering hierop.
Worries generic measures such as limiting lawyers to two and visual supervision of lawyer contact are too sweeping for detainees' fundamental rights and lack individual tailoring.
However these members consider this specific measure very far-reaching and at odds with fundamental rights as set out in Article 6 ECHR and Article 17 of the Constitution.

Echter achten deze leden deze specifieke maatregel zeer vergaand, en op gespannen voet met de grondrechten zoals omschreven in artikel 6 Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) en artikel 17 Grondwet.
Asks how the Minister and prison governors avoid overlapping powers, what complaint procedure applies to ministerial measures, and whether orders can be renewed after twelve months.
These members ask how it will be prevented that the Minister and the governor of the institution encroach on each other's domain.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat de Minister en vestigingsdirecteur in elkaars vaarwater gaan opereren.
Criticises the growing ministerial role at the expense of prison governors, the lack of factual evidence for the measures, and the lack of graduated easing for the most serious category of detainees.
In particular the possibility created for the Minister to take over the decision-making power of the prison governor on a measure is in these members' view a big step.

Met name de mogelijkheid die wordt geschapen waarbij de Minister de beslissingsbevoegdheid van de directeur van de penitentiaire inrichting over een te nemen maatregel over kan nemen is volgens deze leden een grote stap.

Stresses proportionality, subsidiarity and the need for individual assessment and review of measures, questioning the generic nature of visual supervision and lawyer limits and the political risk of ministerial orders.
These measures interfere with the free and confidential contact between lawyer and client and should therefore, in these members' view, be carefully and tailor-made.
Deze maatregelen grijpen in op het vrij en vertrouwelijk verkeer tussen advocaat en cliënt en zouden daarom naar het oordeel van deze leden zorgvuldig en op maat gesneden moeten worden.

Asks about the size of the affected group, the tension with reintegration and recidivism prevention, the interests of minor children in contact restrictions, and whether criteria should be set in law.
These members do ask whether the government has sufficiently taken into account situations in which a detainee needs legal assistance outside criminal law.

Wel vragen deze leden of de regering voldoende rekening heeft gehouden met de omstandigheid dat er situaties kunnen zijn waarin een gedetineerde buiten het strafrecht, bijstand van een advocaat nodig heeft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Penitentiary Principles Act to tighten control over detainees posing serious threats from prison, including ministerial power to restrict contact, supervision of lawyer contact, and house rules, recommending reconsideration. The Minister's reply accepted several points, narrowed the scope of general measures, added safeguards and an evaluation clause, but kept the ministerial order power and rejected some advice on geprivilegieerde contacts and house rules.
concerns: The Afdeling said the bill's restrictions on contact with the outside world, camera surveillance and lawyer contact affect multiple fundamental rights (ECHR, Constitution, EU Charter, Children's Rights Convention) that the explanatory memorandum did not fully assess; the government added analysis but did not change the measures' substance.

The Afdeling advised that restrictions must rest on individual proportionality assessments with adequate safeguards, and that the maximum duration of isolation and 24-hour camera surveillance be limited to three months; the government added individual assessment requirements and written, reasoned orders with specified duration.

The Afdeling advised narrowing the scope to the EBI while AIT placement criteria are unknown and justifying the necessity of generic measures on lawyer contact; the government clarified AIT placement criteria but kept AIT covered and justified the generic measures in the memorandum.

The Afdeling advised that restricting contact with privileged bodies such as the Ombudsman and inspectorates must be justified or excluded absent concrete indications of misuse; the government clarified the order cannot restrict lawyer contact but did not clearly exempt privileged bodies.

The Afdeling questioned the shift of responsibility for individual measures and house rules from the institution director to the Minister and asked for justification; the government clarified the director's powers are unchanged and dropped the house-rules transfer.
The Afdeling asked for attention to feasibility and personnel capacity at DJI and other bodies; the government added a section on administrative and financial consequences.
The Afdeling asked for an evaluation of the measures, preferably after three years; the government inserted an evaluation clause with a three-year report.

36390.s: The bill creates a statutory framework for surrogacy in the Netherlands, under which a court may grant parenthood to intended parents from birth, subject to prior counseling, consent and conditions. It also sets a recognition regime for foreign surrogacy rulings, a surrogacy register, criminal penalties for paying for parental transfer or exceeding compensation caps, and related leave and tax provisions.
36390.j: The memorandum justifies the compensation and register delegations by the need to prevent abuses and by the complexity of the technical rules, while keeping key safeguards in the court's hands.
q: Dutch private international law has no specific regime for recognising family-law relationships established abroad after surrogacy.
Het Nederlandse Internationaal Privaatrecht heeft geen specifieke regeling voor de erkenning van in het buitenland tot stand gekomen familierechtelijke betrekkingen na draagmoederschap.
d: rules on content of counseling and reports, and conditions on surrogacy mediation
nature and maximum amount of compensation to surrogate
detailed rules on the surrogacy register, data and access
designation of the register holder by general administrative order
designation of a legal person exempt from the mediation ban
p: Artikel I, onderdeel H (art. 215, lid 3) and Artikel III

Compensation caps are set by general administrative order rather than statute, with a four-week waiting period after the draft is submitted to parliament, while courts assess compliance in individual cases.
Recognition of foreign surrogacy rulings requires a court declaration under defined conditions, which reinforces judicial review rather than reducing it.

parties: Asks how the interests of children are weighed and how judges can verify the accuracy and completeness of foreign documents submitted for recognition of parenthood.
What options do judges have, when recognising parentage of children obtained through foreign surrogacy, to assess whether the documents submitted by intended parents are correct and complete?

Welke mogelijkheden hebben rechters om bij de erkenning van afstammingsrelaties van via buitenlands draagmoederschap verkregen kinderen te beoordelen of de documenten die wensouders aanleveren juist en volledig zijn?
Warns that under the proposal a Dutch court no longer examines foreign surrogacy procedures, making exploitation harder to control and procedures harder to verify.
Where previously a Dutch judge examined the procedure, this proposal no longer requires that, provided a judge abroad has examined the case.
Waar voorheen een Nederlandse rechter naar de procedure keek, is dat in dit voorstel niet meer nodig, mits een rechter in het buitenland naar de zaak heeft gekeken.
Argues the bill facilitates trafficking and commercial surrogacy, questions the government's inability to prevent abuses abroad, and asks why it is not better to ban surrogacy than to regulate it.
These members believe the bill fosters human trafficking situations and does not contribute to combating commercial surrogacy worldwide.
Deze leden menen dat het wetsvoorstel situaties van mensenhandel in de hand werkt en niet bijdraagt aan de bestrijding van commercieel draagmoederschap wereldwijd.

Worries about the difficulty of enforcing rules and investigating abroad, the lack of an objective check on voluntariness when intended parents decide, and unclear limits between paid surrogacy and child purchase.
These members share the concern whether this can in all cases truly be an objective test.
Deze leden delen de zorg of dit in alle gevallen wel echt een objectieve toets kan zijn.
Questions whether the bill protects children and surrogates, doubts its effectiveness, and asks whether the government can justify facilitating international surrogacy after the Joustra report.
Beyond principled objections to this legislative change, the ChristenUnie members have strong doubts about the effectiveness of the legislation.
Naast principiële bezwaren op deze wetswijziging hebben de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie sterke twijfels bij de effectiviteit van de wetgeving.
Supports a statutory regime but insists lessons from the Joustra commission on interstate adoption abuses be applied, and finds the government's assurance on preventing abuses abroad insufficient.

These members note that the government recognises the risks identified by the Joustra commission, but also that Dutch government influence does not reach far enough to rule out abuses abroad entirely.

Deze leden lezen dat de regering de door de Commissie Joustra benoemde risico's onderkent, maar dat de regering tegelijkertijd ook onderkent dat de invloed van de Nederlandse overheid niet zo ver reikt dat het risico op misstanden ook in het buitenland geheel kan worden uitgesloten.
Supports a legal regime but asks how judges' wide discretion on the child's interest affects legal certainty and whether costs and waiting times deter the legal route.
However, the greater judicial discretion, the smaller legal certainty and possibly legal uniformity.
Wel is het zo dat hoe groter de rechterlijke vrijheid is, hoe kleiner de rechtszekerheid en mogelijk de rechtseenheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in June 2021 that the surrogacy and parentage bill needed further consideration, recommending splitting off unrelated parts, fuller analysis of risks and fundamental rights, and clarifications on the national register and paid surrogacy. The minister's 2023 reply accepted the split, added safeguards, and revised the register, surrogacy agreement and criminal provisions, while not fully addressing all points.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller analysis of the fundamental rights of child, surrogate and intended parents and of conflicts between them; the government added separate fundamental-rights sections and a dilemmas paragraph.
The register lacked essential elements required by Article 10 of the Constitution; the government added the main features of the register to the statute itself.
Essential matters were left to lower regulation, raising primacy-of-legislature concerns; the government moved the register's core elements into the law.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of the relation to freedom to provide services and the residence requirement; the government added a paragraph on EU law justification.

The relation between the court's discretion and the statutory conditions, and the remedies for non-performance of surrogacy agreements, were unclear; the government clarified the text but not all points.
The Afdeling asked for a fuller picture of the social problem and side-effects such as attraction of surrogacy tourism; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum.
Overlap and unexplained differences in penalties for payment versus excessive expense reimbursement were pointed out; the government revised the penalty maxima and explanation.

36426.s: The bill introduces a new CO2 levy on greenhouse horticulture from 2025, phases out the reduced energy tax rate for greenhouse gas use by 2030, and narrows the energy tax exemption for gas-fired electricity generation. It also repeals the existing CO2 cost-equalisation scheme for greenhouse horticulture and related excise provisions.
36426.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulations as needed to provide legal certainty to sectors outside greenhouse horticulture and to combat tax avoidance through technical constructions.
q: Criteria may be set by ministerial regulation for assessing whether there is a tie with a greenhouse horticulture company.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen criteria worden vastgesteld ter beoordeling van het hebben van binding met een glastuinbouwbedrijf
d: Artikel I, onderdeel H / Artikel 71t, lid 2 Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag
minimum size of greenhouse horticulture and energy companies subject to the CO2 levy
Artikel I, Chapter VIC / Artikel 71t, lid 3
criteria for ties between energy companies and greenhouse horticulture, anti-avoidance
Artikel I, Chapter VIC / Artikel 71w, lid 3
rules for monitoring and registering gas consumption
p: Designates the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality as the authority administering the new levy, with the Minister of Finance designating officials under the general tax act.

parties: Asks about budgetary assumptions, uncertainty margins, possible automatic clawback of extra revenue, and whether the measure distorts competition between coal and gas power generation.
What if the yield is much higher? Would the government then be willing to soften the measure to prevent the sector from leaving the Netherlands?
Wat als de opbrengst fors hoger is? Is de regering dan bereid de maatvoering van deze maatregel te verzachten om te voorkomen dat de sector vertrekt uit Nederland?
Asks about negative consequences if the bill cannot proceed and about administrative treatment of smaller WKK installations.
The D66 members ask the government to address the negative consequences if the Fiscal Climate Measures Greenhouse Horticulture Act cannot proceed.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op de negatieve gevolgen indien de Wet fiscale klimaatmaatregelen glastuinbouw geen doorgang kan vinden.

Asks the government to explain the urgency of handling the bill before elections given its demissionary status, and criticises the memorie van toelichting for barely addressing sector-level and firm-level effects.
The PVV members ask the government, given the cabinet's demissionary status, to state what the urgency is, other than meeting climate targets, for handling this bill before the House elections.

De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering, gezien de demissionaire status van het kabinet, om aan te geven wat de urgentie, anders dan het behalen van klimaatdoelen, is om dit wetsvoorstel nog vóór de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen te behandelen.
Questions whether the price incentive is proportionate to the agreed CO2 targets and whether the impact analysis on leakage, heat tariffs and security of supply has been adequately addressed.
These members ask the government to respond substantively to this analysis and to make clear the exact CO2 effects of this measure both within the Netherlands and within Europe.
Deze leden vragen de regering inhoudelijk te reageren op deze analyse en inzichtelijk te maken wat de exacte CO 2 -effecten van deze maatregel zijn zowel binnen Nederland als binnen Europa.
No additional questions at this stage.
The SP members have taken note of the present bill and currently have no additional questions about it.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Supports abolishing the reduced rates but asks why a gradual phase-out was chosen rather than abolition in 2024, whether an EU exemption is needed, and why coal input exemptions are not restricted.
Does this mean an exemption must be requested to maintain them after 2024, and that this would not be necessary if the government chose to fully abolish the reduced rates from 2024?
Betekent dit dat ontheffing moet worden aangevraagd voor behoud na 2024, en dat dit niet nodig zou zijn als de regering zou kiezen voor het volledig afschaffen van de verlaagde tarieven per 2024?
Worried about the sector's burden without adequate handelingsperspectief, and questions why belichte WKK installations below 20 MW get no phase-in while larger ones do.
Does the government agree with the members that this kind of tightening is not tolerable without a perspective for action?
Is de regering het met de leden eens dat dit soort aanscherpingen zónder handelingsperspectief niet te verteren zijn?

Has serious doubts about the bill's basis and proportionality, asks whether it should be withdrawn from the Belastingplan 2024, and questions the lack of thorough assessment of negative effects flagged by Trinomics and Berenschot.

These members ask whether the government is willing to remove the proposal from the Belastingplan 2024 and take time for consultation with sector organisations, possible reconsideration and adjustment, and careful treatment.

Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is het voorstel uit het Belastingplan 2024 te halen, en tijd te nemen voor overleg met sectororganisaties, eventuele heroverweging en bijstelling en een zorgvuldige behandeling.
Asks about financial feasibility, sector support, the correlation with the convenant, and whether the European Commission will allow reduced rates from 2025.
The BBB members want the government to elaborate on the financial feasibility and the support for and within the greenhouse horticulture sector.
De leden van de BBB-fractie willen graag dat de regering nader ingaat op de financiële haalbaarheid en het draagvlak voor en onder de glastuinbouwsector.
Asks detailed questions on the convenant's agreements versus the bill, cost increases per firm, pass-through to consumer prices, and administrative burdens.
What are the differences between the agreements and their reflection in the law?
Wat zijn de verschillen tussen de afspraken en de weerslag in de wet?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on the draft Wet fiscale klimaatmaatregelen glastuinbouw 2024, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris's reply forwards the opinion, makes minor technical and wording changes, and renames the citation title.

36435-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal) by adjusting appropriations for the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer, mainly reducing Tweede Kamer personnel costs by about 4 million euro. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 19 September 2023.
