q: The budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement accompanying this law.
De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36444.s: The bill clarifies and expands the Inspectorate's (IGJ) right of access to patient and client files so it can inspect records under the Awb powers, lets it process personal and health data when investigating other complaints, and tidies up data-processing grounds for Veilig Thuis, CIZ, subsidies and fraud-related data exchange across health and social care laws. It also adds a delegation so that rules on processing personal data, including sensitive data, can be set for the Caribbean Netherlands regarding domestic violence.
36444.j: The memorandum justifies the inspectorate access and data powers by the need to perform effective supervision and protect public health and patient safety, and clarifies that the powers mirror existing Awb powers.
q: In order to exercise its supervision, it is necessary for the IGJ to be able to inspect patient files, and it is therefore important that practitioners or care providers cannot invoke their medical professional secrecy.

Om haar toezicht te kunnen uitoefenen is het voor de IGJ echter noodzakelijk om patiëntendossiers in te kunnen zien en is het dus van belang dat beroepsbeoefenaren of zorgverleners zich niet op hun medisch beroepsgeheim kunnen beroepen.
d: Artikel XI.A (Invoeringswet BES art. 18.4.5 lid 1 onderdeel e)
rules on processing personal and sensitive data for domestic violence and shelter in the Caribbean Netherlands
p: Artikel I.D / II.A / III.C / IV.A / VI (inzagerecht IGJ)

Expands inspectors' access powers to patient and client files and removes professional secrecy as a defence against inspectors, reducing citizens' and professionals' confidentiality protection relative to the executive's supervisory agencies.
Artikel II.A en II.B (andere meldingen, Wkkgz)
Makes it mandatory for care providers and professionals to hand over medical and criminal-law data to the IGJ for other complaints, overriding medical confidentiality.
Artikel XI.A (Invoeringswet BES 18.4.5 lid 1 onderdeel e)
Creates a delegation allowing executive rules to govern processing of sensitive personal data in domestic violence matters in the Caribbean Netherlands, subject to proportionality safeguards.
Artikel XII (Wet elektronische gegevensuitwisseling) en XIII (WMO)
Extends inspector access to health data and replaces contractual with statutory basis for data obligations.
Allows the minister to process personal and health data of subsidy applicants when assessing applications.

parties: Supports the bill and urges the government to proceed quickly; raises no further questions.
These members support this bill and urge the government to get started on it quickly.
Deze leden steunen dit wetsvoorstel en sporen de regering aan hier spoedig mee aan de slag te gaan.
Asks whether vulnerable users, children and experts were consulted on consent, and whether data registration could deter people from seeking care.
To what extent could this wish to register their data increase this distrust and get in the way of providing care?
In hoeverre kan deze wens tot het registeren van hun gegevens dit wantrouwen vergroten en het verlenen van de zorg in de weg staan?
Warns of privacy, bias and wrongful-decision risks from big data in youth care, citing the childcare benefits scandal, and demands a solid risk analysis.

The NSC members therefore really miss a solid justification with analyses, a future outlook and a balanced risk/benefit/problem analysis regarding the consideration of enabling data collection on this scale.

De leden van de NSC-fractie missen dan ook echt een gedegen onderbouwing voorzien van analyses, toekomstbeeld en een afgewogen risico/baten/probleem analyse ten aanzien van de overweging om data verzameling op deze schaal mogelijk te maken.
Asks about the DPIA outcomes, purpose limitation safeguards, staff access and data-breach risks from broad data sharing.
This amendment creates a basis for many different parties to share personal data on suspicion of fraud, these members note.
Deze wetswijziging creëert een grondslag voor veel verschillende partijen om persoonsgegevens te delen bij een vermoeden van fraude, zo constateren genoemde leden.
Asks how privacy concerns of people with disabilities or help needs are addressed and whether people can choose which bodies receive their information.

These members are especially curious about the response to the remark about greater privacy intrusion for people with a disability or help need, and whether people can themselves choose which bodies they share information with.

Genoemde leden zijn vooral benieuwd naar het antwoord op de opmerking over een grotere inbreuk op de privacy van mensen met een beperking of een hulpvraag, en of personen zelf kunnen kiezen met welke instanties ze informatie delen.
Doubts that users can understand data processing without anonymity notice, questions proportionality of sharing staff data, and doubts the Dutch DPA objection is resolved.
How is the privacy of, for example, these staff members who are not themselves suspected of fraud sufficiently safeguarded in this amendment?
Hoe worden de privacy van bijvoorbeeld deze personeelsleden die zelf niet verdacht zijn van fraude voldoende gewaarborgd in deze wetswijziging?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division had no remarks on the draft Verzamelwet gegevensverwerking VWS I, which strengthens legal bases for data processing in health-related laws, and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's reply (nader rapport) describes only technical and clarifying amendments made to the bill and explanatory memorandum, including alignment of IGJ inspection powers with the Awb and clearer rights of data subjects in fraud investigations.

36453.s: The bill introduces a temporary levy on market revenues from electricity generated from infra-marginal sources, including coal, implementing EU Regulation 2022/1854 on high energy prices, at 90% of surplus revenues for the period 1 December 2022 to 1 July 2023. It sets the calculation methods, a market revenue report that producers must file, supervision and enforcement by the Dutch Emissions Authority (NEa) on behalf of the Minister, and collection by the tax authority.
36453.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules and the new enforcement powers by the need to implement the EU regulation's revenue cap uniformly and to ensure that the levy is effectively applied to producers, including those in groups.
q: The bill provides the power to impose an administrative fine or a penalty order when a producer fails to file a (new) market revenue report or to follow the directions given.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in de bevoegdheid een bestuurlijke boete of een last onder dwangsom op te leggen wanneer een producent nalaat om (opnieuw) een marktinkomstenverslag in te dienen of daarbij de gegeven aanwijzingen in acht te nemen.
d: rules on measuring hourly quantities of electricity from hybrid installations
rules on hourly quantities, imbalance discount and day-ahead prices
rules on measurement, imbalance and allocation of revenues under the booking method
manner of filing, content and accountant verification of the market revenue report
p: The Minister may order a producer to file a new market revenue report within a reasonable period, following the Minister's directions.
The Minister may unilaterally set a producer's taxable market revenue on the basis of an estimate when reports are missing or insufficient.
The Minister may impose penalty orders and administrative fines up to the sixth category or 10% of turnover for non-compliance.
The General Tax Act is largely disapplied to the levy, with the disputes on taxable revenues channelled into the supervisory procedure.
Tax assessments following a new report or ex officio determination are issued by the tax inspector within twelve weeks.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the solidarity contribution on fossil energy, how feasible reapplication of retroactive measures is in future crises, and whether energy cooperatives can be excluded.
How feasible does the government consider the possibility that this law will apply again in the future due to high energy prices?
Hoe kansrijk acht de regering de mogelijkheid dat deze wet in de toekomst weer van toepassing is door hoge energieprijzen?
Asks what lessons are drawn for future crises and what fraud risk the reduced accountant control poses, and how it is limited.
What risk of fraud does this entail? How is this risk limited as much as possible?
Welk risico op fraude brengt dit met zich mee? Hoe wordt dit risico zoveel mogelijk beperkt?
Asks whether comparable measures were already taken in neighbouring European countries since 2022 and what their consequences were.
These members ask the government whether similar measures as now proposed have already been taken in European countries around us since 2022, and what the consequences and reactions have been.

Deze leden vragen aan de regering of er sinds 2022 in Europese landen om ons heen al eerder soortgelijke maatregelen zijn getroffen zoals nu hier voorligt en wat de gevolgen en reacties daarvan zijn geweest.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Tijdelijke wet inframarginale elektriciteitsheffing, raising concerns about retroactive effect, the Dutch-EU law relationship, the division of tasks between NEa and Belastingdienst, the choice of a self-assessment tax, the confidentiality duty, and delegated rules, and advising revision before submission. The minister's nader rapport accepts most points, adapting the bill and explanatory memorandum on retroactivity, EU law, classification as a rijksbelasting, the confidentiality clause, and accountant verification, while maintaining the self-assessment design and the division of tasks.
concerns: Retroactive effect of a burdensome tax for an already expired tax period raises legality concerns, which the government addresses by exempting chapter 4 obligations from retroactivity and justifying the exceptional retroactivity.

The explanatory memorandum should address the relationship with EU law, including property rights under Article 17 of the EU Charter and state aid rules for the coal-fired electricity plafond; the government supplemented the memorandum.
The levy is described as a rijksbelasting without the bill saying so; the government changed the wording to belasting and adjusted terminology.
The division of tasks between the NEa and the Belastingdienst does not match the intended practice, causing overlap; the government declined to further refine the statute.
Choosing a self-assessment levy reduces taxpayer safeguards compared with an assessed tax; the government defends the choice but did not substantively change the design.
The proposed confidentiality duty overlaps with and does not fit the existing confidentiality provisions of the Awb and Awr and the Woo; the provision was deleted and the relation explained.

Ministerial regulations could require accountant verification with significant cost impact on levy payers without clarity; the bill was amended so that accountant control is required in statute and a definition is added.
The government additionally dropped the proposed belastingrente on specific naheffingsaanslagen after reconsideration.

36462.s: The bill adds Article 14a to the Dutch Opiumwet 1960 BES, giving the island governors (gezaghebbers) of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba power to impose an order under administrative coercion (bestuursdwang) or a penalty order to close homes, rooms or plots where drugs are sold, supplied, kept or where preparatory items are present. It also allows the governor to collect the resulting debt by dwangbevel and amends the Wet politiegegevens so governors can receive police data for public order purposes.
36462.j: The memorandum justifies the new closure power by the rise in drug trade from homes and the inadequacy of existing powers under Article 177 WolBES, and states that proportionality and fundamental-rights limits are respected.
q: The island governors need a power under Article 13b of the Opiumwet to close drug premises.
De gezaghebbers hebben behoefte aan een bevoegdheid overeenkomstig artikel 13b van de Opiumwet (hierna ook: Opw), waarmee zij drugspanden kunnen sluiten.
p: Governors gain a discretionary power to close dwellings and premises for drug-related conduct or preparatory items, subject to general administrative law safeguards and appeal to the Caribbean courts.
Exemption for pharmacies, doctors, dentists and vets; Awb provisions applied mutatis mutandis, with governors empowered to issue debt collection orders (dwangbevel).
Artikel II (Wpg art. 36d lid 1 onder b)
Governors may receive police personal data for public order enforcement, widening executive access to police records.

parties: Supports giving local authorities all necessary powers to close drug premises, and asks clarifying questions about follow-up steps such as termination of leases and expropriation.
These members consider it important that the local government have all necessary powers available regarding the closure of drug premises.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat de lokale overheid alle noodzakelijke bevoegdheden ter beschikking dient te hebben ten aanzien van het sluiten van drugspanden.

Supports the bill but asks why the proportionality principle is not codified in the law, stressing the severity of closing homes and the interests of family members and children, and asks about the legal basis for the closure term and the reliance on case law.
Closing premises, in particular homes, is by its nature a far-reaching power.
Het sluiten van panden, in het bijzonder van woningen, is naar zijn aard een ingrijpende bevoegdheid.

Asks why basic principles of good administration are not codified in the Caribbean Netherlands, requests explicit proportionality, protection of children living in the premises, and an evaluation clause, and warns of a waterbed effect.

Does the government share the view that for such a far-reaching power, where the interests of vulnerable persons such as children may play a role, it is nevertheless advisable to explicitly include the proportionality principle in the statutory provision?

Deelt de regering het standpunt van deze leden dat het bij een dergelijke ingrijpende bevoegdheid, waar ook belangen van kwetsbaren zoals kinderen een rol kunnen spelen, toch aangewezen is om in ieder geval het evenredigheidsbeginsel expliciet in de wettelijke bepaling op te nemen?
Has taken note of the bill and has no questions.
There are no questions about this.
Supports the regulation but asks whether the stepwise approach with warnings is sufficient and whether the measure may displace drug trade to street sales.
These members ask what the reason is for choosing a stepwise system.
Deze leden vragen wat de reden is dat voor een getrapt systeem is gekozen.
Worries about disproportionate intrusion into private life, the non-codified proportionality principle, the discretion leading to uneven application, and the effects on children.
Does the government share the view that the discretionary power will cause differences in how strictly this legislation is applied in practice?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de discretionaire bevoegdheid zal zorgen voor verschillen in hoe hard deze wetgeving in de praktijk zal worden toegepast?
Supports the necessity of the bill and asks one question about how an earlier omission in the BES legislation occurred.
These members endorse the necessity of the bill, which enables mayors or island governors in the BES islands to impose an order under administrative coercion on drug premises.

Deze leden onderschrijven de noodzaak van het wetsvoorstel waarmee het mogelijk wordt gemaakt dat burgemeesters of gezaghebbers op de BES-eilanden een last onder bestuursdwang kunnen opleggen ten aanzien van drugspanden.
Finds the government's justification convincing and asks questions about the scale of the drug problem, prevention, and why the power to terminate leases and expropriate is not created.
These members find the government's justification convincing and see that it is based on practice on the islands.
Deze leden vinden de onderbouwing van de regering overtuigend en zien dat die is gestoeld op de praktijk op de eilanden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the purpose of a bill letting island governors close drug premises under administrative enforcement in the Caribbean Netherlands, but asks for a fuller proportionality assessment in the explanatory memorandum and statutory anchoring of the proportionality principle. The government's reply accepts the explanatory-memorandum additions and the proportionality point in substance but declines to write the principle into the statute, arguing it already applies under unwritten administrative law and that codifying one general principle would be undesirable.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must explicitly assess the proportionality of the new closure power under Article 10 of the Constitution, Article 8 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 1, and the government has expanded it accordingly.

The Afdeling asks the statute to bind the governor explicitly to the proportionality principle; the government declines codification, relying on unwritten administrative law and case law, but expands the explanatory memorandum.
The bill is refocused on the governor's power and technical adjustments are made to the provisions referring to Dutch Awb and Criminal Code articles that do not apply in the Caribbean Netherlands.

36470-IIB.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2023 budget statement for the other high state bodies, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adding a net amount of 2.906 thousand euro in commitments and 6.603 thousand euro in expenditure, with the increase concentrated in the Raad van State and the Nationale ombudsman. The law takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively from 1 December 2023.
q: This concerns a transfer of budget from the Administrative Jurisdiction division to the Council of State shared services for information provision and ICT expenditure.
Dit betreft een overheveling van het budget van de afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak naar Raad van State gemeenschappelijke diensten voor de uitgaven voor informatievoorziening en ICT.

36516.s: The bill amends the Dutch body-material legislation (Wvkl and Wod) to align it with current practice: it adds licensing and erkenning requirements for tissue institutions and procurement organisations, a national reporting point for organ-transplant travel, and new enforcement powers for the Minister including written instructions and orders. It also shifts allocation and monitoring tasks for tissue and organs to the orgaancentrum and delegates detailed data and quality rules to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
36516.j: The memorandum justifies the new enforcement powers by arguing that the Minister and inspectorate need more options to secure compliance where health and safety risks exist, and that the orgaancentrum's expertise makes it better placed to interpret reports.
q: In practice it has become clear that supervision, enforcement and thus compliance with the law would benefit if the Minister had more enforcement options.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat toezicht, handhaving en daarmee naleving van de wet er gebaat bij zou zijn als de Minister beschikt over meer handhavingsopties.
d: designation of EU directives on organ transplantation and tissues/cells
personal and health data processed in the organ register
personal data reported by healthcare providers to the national reporting point
requirements for recognition of tissue institutions under EU tissue directive
personal data in the register of tissue institutions and procurement organisations
health data institutions must supply to the orgaancentrum
further rules on allocation of body material
policy rule by orgaancentrum on redistributing postmortem tissue between tissue banks
exemption from the procurement-organisation licensing requirement for supply continuity
p: Gives the Minister written instructions and the inspector emergency orders against institutions, with penalty-payment enforcement, with motivation required but no prior parliamentary or judicial check.
Extends the Minister's power to impose administrative fines and penalty payments to additional provisions and to non-compliance with instructions and orders.

Creates a national reporting point collecting health data on Dutch patients' transplant travel and breaks medical confidentiality, with data use limited to policy purposes and to be specified by general administrative order.
Artikel I K (art. 8f–8i Wvkl) and Artikel II Y (art. 24 Wod)
Gives the orgaancentrum power to reallocate postmortem tissue between banks and to require storage of tissue for emergencies, subject to a Minister-approved policy rule.
Allows the Minister to exempt organisations from the licensing requirement in the interest of supply continuity, with no stated time limit or review.

parties: Asks how donors' privacy and health data are protected and whether they must consent to processing, and how long personal data are kept.
The meldpunt is not aimed at processing personal data, yet personal data are processed and full anonymity cannot be guaranteed.
Het meldpunt is niet gericht op persoonsgegevensverwerking gericht, toch worden de persoonsgegevens verwerkt en kan volledige anonimiteit niet worden gegarandeerd.
Questions the safety of the reporting clinician and whether reporting breaches medical confidentiality; asks who can access the meldpunt data and who supervises data sharing.
Is it legally truly safe for the healthcare provider to make this report, and does it really not breach professional confidentiality?
Is het juridisch echt veilig voor de zorgverlener om deze melding te maken, betreft dit echt het niet schenden van het beroepsgeheim.
Asks whether meldpunt data will be enriched with other data sources and when the legal basis will be ready.
Although the meldpunt is not aimed at personal data processing, personal data about the person concerned will be processed as part of information gathering.

Ondanks dat het meldpunt niet gericht is op persoonsgegevensverwerking, zullen in het kader van informatieverzameling persoonsgegevens worden verwerkt over de persoon op wie de melding betrekking heeft.
Questions whether reporting all international transplant donations is proportionate and suggests a narrower meldpunt; also asks about penalties after the criminal provision was dropped.
Would it not be better to focus the meldpunt on anonymous reports of suspicious cases?
Is het niet beter het meldpunt toe te spitsen op anonieme meldingen van verdachte gevallen?
Asks how proportionality and subsidiarity of newly added necessary data are checked, whether parliament is involved, and about retention limits, patient information and consent.
The D66 members ask how the proportionality and subsidiarity of any new 'necessary data' are assessed.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke wijze de proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit van eventuele nieuwe «noodzakelijke gegevens» worden getoetst.
Accepts removal of the criminal provision on using illegally obtained organs on the Raad van State's advice but asks how it will be shaped later and asks to be kept informed.
The CDA members ask whether the government will further inform and keep the House updated on the follow-up.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering de Kamer over het vervolg nader wil informeren en op de hoogte houden.
Asks which personally identifiable data must be supplied to the meldpunt and why each is necessary, and questions the profit exemptions.
The SP members ask the government which (potentially traceable) personal data must be supplied to the meldpunt and why these specific data are necessary.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering welke (mogelijk herleidbare) persoonsgegevens precies moeten worden aangeleverd bij het meldpunt en om welke reden deze precieze gegevens noodzakelijk zijn.
Questions why the meldpunt should move to NTS from TRIP, which would avoid traceability, and asks about how other countries structure such reporting.
It is still not sufficiently clear to the ChristenUnie members why the meldpunt must be moved to the Dutch Transplantation Foundation (NTS) when it is currently housed at TRIP.

Het wordt de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie nog niet voldoende duidelijk waarom het meldpunt bij d Nederlandse Transplantatie Stichting (NTS) moet worden ondergebracht terwijl het nu is ondergebracht bij TRIP.
Asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens still supports proceeding after amendments, when the ratification-linked criminal provision will be settled, and how privacy is guaranteed.
The BBB members note that the AP gave several recommendations that were incorporated into the bill and its explanatory memorandum.
De leden van de BBB-fractie lezen dat de AP enkele adviezen heeft gegeven die zijn overgenomen in het wetsvoorstel en de toelichting daarvan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division, in its opinion of 24 January 2024 on the draft Wet actualisering lichaamsmateriaalwetgeving, found the bill largely acceptable but raised objections on the organ-trade reporting point (necessity and safeguards for processing personal and medical data, and placement at the NTS) and advised removing the new criminal offence, which had not been consulted with the legal profession. In its nader rapport of 7 March 2024 the Minister explained the reporting-point choices, added safeguards and clarifications, and withdrew the criminal provision from the bill.
concerns: Processing of personal and medical data by the organ-trade reporting point was not convincingly shown to be necessary; the government kept the full questionnaire and added justification and safeguards.
Safeguards for personal data (retention, patient position, risk of linkage at the NTS, transfer to EDQM) were required; the memorie added retention, access and AVG-rights clarifications.
The new criminal offence should be removed given unclear relation to existing criminal and disciplinary law, mensenhandel modernisation and the Council of Europe treaty; the government withdrew it.
The draft offence wording (opzet, wederrechtelijk, other purposes, placement outside the WED) was unclear; this point is deferred with the offence.
Consultation of the legal practice (judiciary, prosecution, bar, police, national rapporteur) had not occurred; the government did not consult them and deferred this to any future offence.

36525.s: The bill raises the amounts in the Wet verlaging eigen bijdrage huurtoeslag by €3.05 to improve purchasing power for rent allowance recipients, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2024. It is a short, fixed-amount adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power.
36525.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by the cabinet's decision to raise the maximum rent allowance for 2024 to support lower incomes, without any delegation or new powers.
q: The cabinet decided to raise the (maximum) rent allowance for 2024 by just over 400 euros to support the purchasing power of lower incomes.
Het kabinet heeft namelijk besloten om de (maximale) huurtoeslag voor 2024 te verhogen met ruim 400 euro, om zo de koopkracht van lagere inkomens te ondersteunen.

parties: Asks for detailed overview of purchasing-power effects per example household, the size of the estimation error, and whether an amendment will be submitted if the planned minimum wage increase does not proceed.
They ask that for each example household it be made clear what purchasing-power development was presented on Budget Day and how large the estimation error was.
Zij vragen om daarbij per voorbeeldhuishouden inzichtelijk maken wat voor koopkrachtontwikkeling er gepresenteerd is bij Prinsjesdag, hoe hoog de inschattingsfout was.
Asks why the calculation error occurred, what the government is doing to prevent recurrence, and what the cumulative effect is alongside the simplification bill.
What is the reason an error was made in this purchasing-power calculation? What is the government doing to prevent a repetition?
Wat is de reden dat bij deze koopkrachtberekening een fout is gemaakt? Wat doet de regering om herhaling te voorkomen?

Questions the choice for partial rather than full repair, the mid-year adjustment and its precedent effect, the risk of more repayments, and the overlap with the simplification bill; also criticises exclusion of low-income private-sector renters.
These members are critical of this choice. They ask the government whether it shares the view that this choice will create a precedent.
Deze leden zijn kritisch over deze keuze. Zij vragen de regering of zij de mening deelt dat deze keuze voor precedentwerking gaat zorgen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 20 March 2024 that it has no remarks on a bill amending the Wet verlaging eigen bijdrage huurtoeslag (purchasing-power repair) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations forwarded the advice to the King, with a nader rapport dated 22 March 2024 that adds no substantive reply because no objections were raised.

36552.s: The bill gives the Kiesraad (Electoral Council) a new quality-promotion role in the election process, including advisory, instructional and supervisory-type powers over municipal and water-board election bodies, and a broader general advisory mandate on elections. It also lets the Kiesraad issue process directions to polling boards, adopt its own models and rules, and report irregularities to the Minister of Interior, while retaining the Minister's ultimate interbestuurlijk toezicht.
36552.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to improve election quality, the limits of Minister-level monitoring, and the Kiesraad's supporting role, while noting that Article 59 of the Constitution restricts broad delegation.
q: Fully splitting the Kiesraad's tasks was considered in the context of this bill, but was not chosen.
Het volledig opsplitsen van de taken van de Kiesraad is in het kader van dit wetsvoorstel overwogen, maar er is niet voor gekozen.
d: fees for persons assisting the Kiesraad
rules on how Kiesraad involves municipal and joint bodies
emergency rules for polling boards, approved by the Minister
Kiesraad sets election forms and models by regulation
p: The Kiesraad may issue binding process directions to polling boards and set emergency rules, reducing municipal and polling-board autonomy over election administration.
The Kiesraad gains a formal supervisory-like role and must publish findings on irregularities in polling-station conduct.

parties: Asks how functional separation within the Kiesraad is secured, the role of its chair, and whether observation powers should be written into law to clarify the Kiesraad's competences.
Safeguards are therefore provided to prevent undesirable mixing of functions within the Kiesraad.
Er wordt daarom voorzien in de waarborgen om onwenselijke functievermenging binnen de Kiesraad te voorkomen.

Stresses the need for an independent Kiesraad with clear powers and adequate resources, asks whether intervention powers should shift from the minister to the Kiesraad, and questions the financial and staffing basis.
These members also attach great importance to an independent Kiesraad with clear powers and tasks and sufficient resources to carry them out properly.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie hechten ook bijzonder veel belang aan een onafhankelijke Kiesraad met heldere bevoegdheden en taken en met voldoende middelen om haar taken goed uit te voeren.
Asks for clearer delimitation of the broad delegation basis for 'nadere regels' that could affect Kiesraad independence, and for a risk analysis of overlapping governance functions.
These members note, however, that 'nadere regels' may also influence the independence of the Kiesraad.
Deze leden constateren echter dat ook «nadere regels» invloed kunnen uitoefenen op de onafhankelijkheid van de Kiesraad.
Supports assigning responsibilities and tasks to the Kiesraad and asks what margin of error the Kiesraad may tolerate when calculating results.
These members support the proposal to assign a number of responsibilities and tasks to the Kiesraad.
Deze leden ondersteunen het voorstel een aantal verantwoordelijkheden en taken bij de kiesraad te beleggen.
Supports the bill, welcomes that municipalities' role stays unchanged, and asks whether a planned electoral system reform (districts) should lead to pausing the bill.
Specifically, these members are very satisfied that the role of municipalities in the electoral process remains unchanged.
Specifiek zijn deze leden erg tevreden over het feit dat de rol van gemeenten in het verkiezingsproces ongewijzigd blijft.
Asks whether instructions and standards should be limited to technical matters rather than policy choices, and how observation by the Kiesraad is organised and limited without a statutory basis.
These members ask whether the government can confirm that it is undesirable for these instructions and standards to concern policy choices on which the legislature should decide.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan bevestigen dat het niet wenselijk is dat deze instructies en standaarden beleidsmatige keuzes betreffen waarover de wetgever zich dient uit te spreken.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions at this stage.
These members currently have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben daarbij op dit moment geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Wet kwaliteitsbevordering uitvoering verkiezingsproces, which expands the Electoral Council's (Kiesraad) instructive, supervisory and advisory roles, raising concerns about explanation, delegation to the Kiesraad under Article 59 of the Constitution, interim instructions for unforeseen circumstances, and election observers. The Minister's reply accepts most points, adds explanatory text and narrows or clarifies delegation and observer provisions, while disputing that instructions and quality standards are generally binding.
concerns: Broad, unbounded delegation to the Kiesraad for instructions and quality standards must be made concrete and precise, and the Minister's reply disputes the binding nature while only adding clarifications and an amended amvb delegation.

Interim instructions on unforeseen circumstances must be limited in duration and scope, which the government addressed by adding a validity period and changing the instrument to regulations requiring ministerial approval.
The explanatory memorandum should better explain the background and need for the expanded Kiesraad role and which shortcomings evaluations revealed, which was followed by adding text.
The text should clarify that Kiesraad members and staff may not act as observers, which was followed by amending Article A 9 and its explanation.

36560-IIB.s: This bill is a closing budget act (Slotwet) amending the 2023 departmental budget of the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, bringing total appropriations and realised figures into line. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the other High Colleges of State, Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for the year 2023
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2023

36561.s: The bill inserts into the Zorgverzekeringswet a codified 'hinderpaal' criterion requiring insurers' reimbursement for non-contracted care not to deter an average insured person from using that care, and allows rules on how the reimbursement is calculated. It also lets the government, by general administrative order, designate care sectors and set reimbursement levels directly for non-contracted care there.
36561.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to act quickly and flexibly when access, quality or affordability of care is at stake, since a statutory amendment would take too long.
q: Delegation of rule-making is needed to act swiftly where the transition to appropriate care, or the quality, accessibility or affordability of care, is at stake.

Delegatie van regelgeving is nodig om slagvaardig op te kunnen treden indien geconstateerd wordt dat (de transitie naar) passende zorg of de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid of betaalbaarheid van de zorg in het geding zijn.
d: rules on how insurers calculate reimbursement for non-contracted care
designating care sectors and setting reimbursement levels via ministerial regulation
p: Allows the government to set reimbursement levels for whole care sectors by general administrative order and ministerial regulation, outside the statute, with only a voorhang to parliament.

parties: Worried the bill restricts free choice of doctor and asks the government to pause the bill until a new government decides on it.
The PVV members have noted with disappointment the amendment of the Health Insurance Act to promote care contracting.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben met teleurstelling kennisgenomen van de wijziging van de Zorgverzekeringswet in verband met het bevorderen van zorgcontractering.
Asks how the bill relates to free choice of doctor, whether insurers exploit contract dependence, and whether vulnerable patients with complex needs will be excluded.
Can the government explain how this bill relates to free choice of doctor?
Kan de regering ingaan hoe voorliggend wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt ten opzichte van de vrije artsenkeuze?
Asks about the rationale for alternatives, whether the amvb will go through a voorhang procedure, and how smaller providers can contract.
Can the government indicate per amvb whether there will be a voorhang procedure and, if so, what form?
Kan de regering per amvb aangeven of daar sprake zal zijn van een voorhangprocedure en zo ja, welke vorm van voorhang dan is voorzien?
Asks how a lower reimbursement fits the EU Müller-Fauré ruling and how patients are transparently informed.
These members ask how a lower reimbursement relates to the European Court of Justice ruling in Müller-Fauré.
Deze leden vragen hoe een lagere vergoeding zich verhoudt tot het arrest van het Europese Hof van Justitie in de zaak Müller-Fauré.
Supports promoting contracting as part of the Integraal Zorgakkoord and asks how contracting and steering contribute to adequate care.
consider it a good thing to work on promoting care contracting as part of the Integrated Care Agreement (IZA).
vinden het een goede zaak in te zetten op het bevorderen van de zorgcontractering, als onderdeel van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA).
Worries the bill limits patients' choice of care and that small non-contracted providers may be pressured into unfavourable contracts.
In what way does this bill affect small non-contracted care providers?
Op welke manier heeft dit wetsvoorstel gevolgen voor kleine niet-gecon tracteerde zorgaanbieders?
Asks why the bill is needed now given the Council of State's doubts about effectiveness and whether measures under the IZA have been tried.
Can the government explain why it considers it opportune to send this bill to the House now?
Kan de regering eens toelichten waarom zij het nu opportuun vindt dit wetsvoorstel naar de Kamer te sturen?
Supports contracting but warns that the hinderpaal criterion protecting free choice could be hollowed out, and asks for the Council of State's alternatives to be explained.
At the same time they attach importance to freedom of choice for insured persons and the hinderpaal criterion that protects it.
Tegelijkertijd hechten zij aan de keuzevrijheid voor verzekerden en het hinderpaalcriterium dat dit beschermt.
Sees the importance of contracting but worries about small providers, insurers' dominant position, and whether the package of IZA measures is realised before this bill takes effect.
nevertheless have concerns, for example about the position of small care providers and the powerful position of health insurers.
hebben evenwel zorgen, bijvoorbeeld over de positie van kleine zorgaanbieders en de machtige positie van zorgverzekeraars.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises that the bill codifying the hinderpaal criterion in the Zorgverzekeringswet is a useful clarification, but questions whether it will actually promote contracting and asks the explanatory memorandum to address effectiveness and alternatives. The government's reply (nader rapport) responds by pointing to the wider Integraal Zorgakkoord package, the planned lower reimbursement for non-contracted care, and the exception for insurer fault, and makes minor amendments to the bill and memorandum.
concerns: The Council questions how codifying and clarifying the hinderpaal criterion will achieve more contracting, and asks for explanation of effectiveness and alternatives; the government points to the wider IZA package and explanatory memorandum additions but largely maintains its position.

The Council notes the exception for insurer fault may apply in times of scarcity and waiting lists and may limit the insurer's regulatory role; the government responds that this codifies existing practice and the IZA addresses scarcity.

The Council points out that payment in wijkverpleging and parts of GGZ rewards hours rather than performance and that insurers struggle to verify efficiency; the government refers to ongoing reforms and the extrapolation mechanism in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council notes that the pgb route for wijkverpleging is not addressed in the bill, which may undermine its effectiveness; the government replies that insurers can proportionally lower pgb reimbursement.
Technical drafting points, such as changing 'overige dienst' to 'andere dienst' and specifying the amended paragraph of article 124, were adopted as ex officio amendments.

36606.s: The bill raises the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) amounts and phase-out percentages in 2025, 2026 and onward, redistributing benefits within the scheme to support household purchasing power. It sets the new amounts directly in the statute instead of through a general administrative order, and it fixes the 2026–2028 indexation steps in the law.
36606.j: The memorandum explains that the amount increase could normally be made by general administrative order but is instead included in the bill because the phase-out percentage is also changing.
q: But because this bill also raises the WKB phase-out percentage, it is proposed not to apply Article 3(2) of the Act and to include the amendment of the amounts in this bill.

Maar omdat met dit wetsvoorstel ook het afbouwpercentage van de WKB wordt verhoogd, wordt voorgesteld om artikel 3, tweede lid, van de wet niet toe te passen en de wijziging van de bedragen mee te nemen in dit wetsvoorstel.
d: Artikel I, B.7 (art. 3, zevende lid WKB)
publication of revised benefit amounts in Staatscourant

parties: Asks whether a child benefit increase financed by higher income tax would reduce dependence on income-tested benefits and the risk of reclaims.
How does the government assess this proposal in light of reducing dependence on income-related allowances (where there is a risk of reclaims)?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering dit voorstel in het kader van het terugdringen van de afhankelijkheid van inkomensafhankelijke toeslagen (waarbij het risico op terugvorderingen bestaat)?
Worries that the steeper phase-out raises marginal pressure on middle incomes, making work less rewarding, and asks for quantification and the Dienst Toeslagen implementation assessment.
The VVD members ask the government how it will prevent middle incomes from experiencing excessively high marginal pressure from this measure, making work less rewarding.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering hoe wordt voorkomen dat middeninkomens door deze maatregel een te hoge marginale druk ervaren, waardoor werken minder lonend wordt.
Supports reducing child poverty but asks how the government weighs rising dependence on allowances, reclaim risk and marginal pressure, and whether parents' own preferences were considered.

Although these members support the goal of reducing child poverty, they ask how the government weighs that this increases households' dependence on allowances, raises the risk of reclaims and increases marginal pressure due to a steeper phase-out.

Hoewel deze leden de doelstelling van het verminderen van kinderarmoede steunen, vragen deze leden hoe de regering weegt dat hiermee de afhankelijkheid van huishoudens van toeslagen stijgt, het risico op terugvorderingen hoger wordt en de marginale druk stijgt als gevolg van een steilere afbouw.
Supports financial support for families with children but asks how the increase fits the goal of phasing out allowances and why marginal pressure rises.
Can the government explain why it chooses to let marginal pressure rise through this measure?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom de regering ervoor kiest om de marginale druk door deze maatregel te laten oplopen?
Criticises that middle incomes bear part of the intensification and that the steeper phase-out raises marginal pressure; asks for a higher income threshold instead.
At the same time, these members note that part of the intensification is paid for by middle incomes.
Tegelijk constateren deze leden dat een deel van de intensivering wordt betaald door middeninkomens.
Welcomes the bill as a contribution to financial security and child poverty reduction, while asking about the unaddressed issue of non-cohabiting partners and the remaining funds.
These members support the bill because it swiftly implements the Hoofdlijnenakkoord of 15 May 2025.
Deze leden steunen het wetsvoorstel omdat hiermee voortvarend invulling gegeven wordt aan het Hoofdlijnenakkoord van 15 mei 2025.
Expresses concern about marginal pressure on parents and asks the government to explain the effect.
The D66 members are concerned about marginal pressure on parents.
De leden van de D66-fractie maken zich zorgen over marginale druk voor ouders.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Wet op het kindgebonden budget for income support, and advises submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport notes a correction to the amounts in article I, part B, under 5, replacing an erroneous cumulative increase with the annual increase only.

36705.s: The bill raises statutory maximum prison sentences under the Opium Act for possessing, trading, producing, importing and exporting hard drugs, with a new tier of eight years for large quantities defined by general administrative order. It also adjusts cross-references for organised participation and aligns amendments with two other pending Opium Act laws.
36705.j: The memorandum justifies the higher maxima by the growing scale of hard drug production and trade and the need for a sentencing response aligned with the serious social harm.
q: Money laundering through investment of illegal money in, for example, real estate can be considered.
Gedacht kan worden aan witwassen in de vorm van investeringen van illegaal geld in bijvoorbeeld vastgoed
d: defining the large quantity threshold for hard drugs
p: Raising maximum sentences widens the range within which prosecutors frame charges and sentence demands, while judges keep their sentencing discretion as stated in the memorandum.

parties: Asks how the government arrived at the twelve-year maximum and whether it could be raised further, without raising check-related concerns.
The PVV members ask how the government concluded that raising the maximum from eight to twelve years for intentional trade and production of hard drugs would be sufficient.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen hoe de regering gekomen is tot het oordeel dat een verhoging van het strafmaximum van acht naar twaalf jaar voor de opzettelijke handelen in en productie van harddrugs afdoende zou zijn.
Welcomes the bill and asks for consistency in sentencing and whether related offences should also be raised; no check-related concerns raised.
These members think it is good that a number of statutory maximum sentences are being brought up to date.
Deze leden vinden het goed dat een aantal strafmaxima bij de tijd wordt gebracht.
Asks how often maximum sentences have been imposed and about prison capacity effects; no explicit check concern.
These members ask whether the government has taken into account the overcrowded prisons that the Netherlands is currently facing.
Deze leden vragen de regering of hierbij ook rekening is gehouden met de overvolle gevangenissen waar Nederland momenteel mee te maken heeft.

Questions the effectiveness of harsher penalties compared with enforcement, and worries that the large-quantity aggravating ground could catch lighter offences, raising proportionality concerns for judicial sentencing.
These members therefore want to prevent minor offences from being punished disproportionately severely.
Deze leden willen dan ook voorkomen dat lichte overtredingen onevenredig zwaar worden gestraft.

Broadly supportive but asks whether Public Prosecution Service and court sentencing guidelines will change, since higher maxima have no effect if guidelines stay the same, and asks about recovery of state costs.
Raising the statutory maximum has no practical effect if the guidelines for the sentences to be demanded or imposed do not change.
Het verhogen van het strafmaximum heeft in de praktijk geen enkel effect als de richtlijn voor de te eisen, danwel, op te leggen straffen, niet veranderen.

Asks about the threshold of 500 grams as a large quantity, the timing of the implementing decree, and how it relates to the Public Prosecution Service's use of strafbeschikking; touches on administrative practice.
Why has the government not chosen a lower threshold than 500 grams of hard drugs as a 'large quantity'?
Waarom heeft de regering niet gekozen voor een lagere grens dan 500 gram harddrugs als «grote hoeveelheid»?

Questions proportionality and effectiveness of higher penalties, the lack of attention to recidivism, and whether the bill widens the gap with neighbouring countries; asks the government to reflect on the NVvR's caution.
Higher sentences do not always and automatically lead to improved behaviour and reduced recidivism.
Hogere straffen leiden niet altijd en vanzelfsprekend tot verbeterd gedrag en verminderde recidive.
Asks for justification of the specific numbers and the meaning of 'intentional' and 'large quantity', plus prevention measures; no explicit check concern.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division accepted the rationale for raising maximum penalties for hard-drug trafficking and production but advised that the explanatory memorandum address the effectiveness of tougher sentences and the accompanying policy measures. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was expanded to link the bill to other anti-crime measures and to describe prevention, disruption and protection measures, and a technical amendment was made.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller discussion of whether raising penalties for hard-drug offences is effective, given that perceived detection risk may matter more than sentence length.
The Afdeling noted that the explanatory memorandum offered little insight into the accompanying policy measures meant to improve effectiveness.

36740-IIB.s: This budget bill (Slotwet) amends the 2024 departmental budget for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, setting realised spending against the revised figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to executive powers or checks.
q: We have decided and resolved ... The departmental budget statement ... is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat ... wordt gewijzigd

36813.s: The bill makes a series of technical amendments to Dutch tax laws for 2026, including extending a horizon clause for reduced company-car tax on zero-emission cars, adjusting pension rules for 18-20 year olds, restoring Eurovignet rates, and modernising electronic correspondence rules under the General Customs Act. It also extends transitional rules for funds for joint account and makes minor numbering and reference corrections.
36813.j: The memorandum justifies the electronic-correspondence delegation by saying the modern digital channel must be applicable to all message streams and that the Belastingdienst needs time to complete the modernisation by 2030.
d: designating messages and circumstances for exclusively electronic or non-electronic correspondence
determining manner of electronic correspondence with tax authorities
p: Artikel XIV and XV (Awb Chapter 2.3 exclusions)

Exempts customs and tax correspondence from several general administrative law provisions and lets ministerial regulation fix whether communication must be electronic, reducing citizens' choice of channel.
Excludes title 5.2 of the General Administrative Law Act, which contains the general rules on administrative appeal, from customs law.

parties: Asks whether the government considered countering group-structure abuse in the energy investment deduction and asks for an overview of evaluation and horizon clauses in tax schemes as required by the Maatoug motion.
These members ask the government to provide an overview of all tax schemes that have since received an evaluation and horizon clause following the adoption of that motion.
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van alle fiscale regelingen die sinds het aannemen van de genoemde motie al een evaluatie- en horizonbepaling hebben gekregen?

Accepts the postponement for the Tax Administration but stresses that the postal delay problem affects taxpayers' legal protection and asks for full electronic correspondence and higher priority for the objection phase.
The VVD members note that full opening of electronic message traffic would prevent these disputes and directly benefit the legal protection of the taxpayer.}

De leden van de VVD-fractie stellen vast dat volledige openstelling van berichtenverkeer langs elektronische weg deze geschillen voorkomt en de rechtsbescherming van de belastingplichtige direct ten goede komt.
Asks the government to clarify how the new transitional rules for funds for joint account relate to the 2024 transitional rules and to confirm applicability.
These members ask the government to clarify how both arrangements relate to each other.{
Deze leden vragen de regering om te verduidelijken hoe beide regelingen zich tot elkaar verhouden.
Supports incentives for energy investment but stresses that the exception for the Tax Administration must not undermine citizens' legal position and should be strictly temporary.
These members understand that the pressure on the Tax Administration's ICT systems is considerable, but want to stress that the legal position of the citizen must remain leading.}
Deze leden begrijpen dat de druk op de ICT-systemen van de Belastingdienst aanzienlijk is, maar willen benadrukken dat de rechtspositie van de burger leidend moet blijven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division gave its advice on the draft bill Overige fiscale maatregelen 2026 and found no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes only some editorial amendments to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36822.s: The bill amends the Wft, Faillissementswet and Bankwet to implement BRRD I and II and clarify the resolution powers of DNB as resolution authority, including early intervention, temporary administrators, special administrators, bail-in, write-down and conversion, and a stichting administratiekantoor afwikkeling. It also extends DNB's powers over banks and investment firms outside the SRM and adjusts contractual recognition and creditor-protection rules.
36822.j: The memorandum justifies the new and clarified powers by the need to make DNB's resolution tasks practically executable and to implement BRRD and SRMR obligations, citing the ATB Bank failure.
q: During this practical elaboration, DNB identified several ambiguities in the legislation that could prevent effective exercise of its resolution powers.
Tijdens deze praktische uitwerking heeft DNB een aantal onduidelijkheden in de wetgeving geconstateerd die een effectieve uitvoering van haar afwikkelingsbevoegdheden kunnen verhinderen.
d: Artikel I, E (1:75a lid 1 en 3A:14 lid 2)
early intervention measures and MREL setting by DNB
rules on establishment, tasks, financing and governance of the resolution foundation (SAA)
DNB may apply resolution instruments individually or combined, and repeat transfers
p: DNB may impose wide early intervention measures, including dismissal of management, on banks and investment firms without a fixed trigger beyond a significant deterioration in financial position.
DNB may appoint a temporary administrator who replaces or co-manages the board of an institution, with administrative appeal as the main safeguard.
DNB may appoint a special administrator who takes over the powers of the governing bodies, with personal liability of board members and supervision by DNB.
DNB may write down or convert capital instruments and creditor claims, and set the terms and conditions of conversion itself.
DNB may suspend payment and delivery obligations, including deposit payments, subject to only a daily amount that depositors can access.
DNB may ask the court to stay all legal actions or proceedings against a bank in resolution for as long as needed.
Bail-in applied to creditors and shareholders is structured under DNB control with limited judicial or parliamentary oversight specified.

parties: Supports the improvements on bank failures for financial stability and has no further questions at this stage.
These members support the improvement regarding possible bank failures given its importance for financial stability.
Deze leden steunen de verbetering omtrent eventuele faillissementen van banken gezien het belang hiervan voor de financiële stabiliteit.
Asks why national changes are made while EU rules may change soon, how the SAA will be staffed and kept at arm's length from DNB, its costs, and what happens if an institution fails to report.
These members ask the government when clarity is expected on the outcome of these negotiations and why legislative change is chosen while European frameworks may change in the short term.

Deze leden vragen de regering wanneer duidelijkheid wordt verwacht over de uitkomsten van deze onderhandelingen en waarom wordt gekozen voor wetswijziging, terwijl Europese kaders mogelijk op korte termijn zullen veranderen.

Probes whether DNB decides on the 'necessity' of retaining management, how that decision is made and where the criterion is in law, the realism of immediate conversion, the timing of share allocation, and the consequences of joint liability for directors.
Does DNB judge the 'necessity'? If not, who does?
Oordeelt DNB hier over de «noodzakelijkheid»? Zo nee, wie dan?
Asks how the government responded to the Council of State's advice on delimiting the special administrator's powers and whether the revised text departs from that advice.
Following the Council of State's advice on delimiting the powers of the special administrator, the ChristenUnie members ask the government to specify what it has done to meet that advice.

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State over de afbakening van bevoegdheden van de bijzonder bestuurder vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie de regering om precies aan te geven wat de regering heeft gedaan om tegemoet te komen aan het advies van de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wft, Faillissementswet and Bankwet 1998 to refine the bank resolution framework, raising a major point on the allocation of responsibilities between a special administrator and remaining management board members in a bank under resolution. The Minister's reply accepted the point by clarifying the competence split in article 3A:49 Wft and the explanatory memorandum, and also corrected the implementation of optional deposit access provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling advised making explicit in the statutory text how responsibilities are divided between the special administrator and remaining board members, and the Minister amended article 3A:49(5) Wft accordingly.
The Afdeling's concern about the scope of liability of remaining management under the BRRD framework was addressed by clarifying the wording of article 3A:49(6)(c) Wft on voidable legal acts.
Implementation of BRRD article 33a(3) and 69(5) was corrected so that access to a portion of deposits is mandatory rather than discretionary when the member state option is used.

36831.s: The bill amends the Huisvestingswet 2014 to prohibit municipalities from giving priority to housing seekers solely because they hold a residence permit (vergunninghouders), to prevent displacement of other applicants. It allows municipal councils a temporary exception for priority to permit holders for non-independent housing, which lapses one year after entry into force, and requires an annual report on urgency categories.
36831.j: The memorandum justifies the ban as preventing undue waiting times for other applicants and notes the restriction of local autonomy, with a temporary exception for single permit holders during the implementation phase.
q: The fact that someone is a permit holder is not, in the government's view, a suitable ground for determining eligibility for urgency, because other housing seekers would otherwise have to wait disproportionately long.

Het feit dat men vergunninghouder is, acht de regering geen passende grond voor het bepalen of men in aanmerking komt voor urgentie, omdat daardoor andere woningzoekenden onevenredig lang moeten wachten.
d: municipal council may grant priority to permit holders for non-independent housing
form for annual overview of urgency categories
p: Removes municipalities' discretion to give priority to permit holders as an urgency category, restricting local autonomy in housing allocation, while provincial supervision is extended to enforce the ban.

parties: Expresses strong concern about constitutionality and legal soundness and asks the government to respond to the Council of State's advice.
They note that there are serious concerns about the constitutionality, legal soundness and feasibility of the law.
Zij merken op dat er grote zorgen bestaan over de grondwettelijkheid, juridische houdbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid van de wet.
Asks factual questions about recent waiting-time data, public opinion, and the link with other measures.
These members ask the government whether the Ministry of Housing has much more recent figures and whether it wants to share them with the House.
Deze leden vragen de regering of het Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening veel recentere cijfers heeft en met de Kamer wil delen.
Argues the bill is ineffective symbolic legislation that will push vergunninghouders into homelessness and undermines rights to housing, and asks the government to justify it.
This law will not shorten waiting times for homes, will not reduce but increase the problems in asylum reception, and will make the asylum chain not cheaper but more expensive.
Deze wet gaat de wachttijd voor woningen niet verkorten, gaat de problemen in de asielopvang niet verkleinen maar vergroten en gaat de asielketen niet goedkoper maar duurder maken.
Objects that the ban infringes municipalities' policy freedom and local discretion while their statutory task remains, and questions the necessity and proportionality.
With this bill the government intervenes deeply in the policy freedom of municipalities.
Met dit wetsvoorstel grijpt de regering diep in in de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten.
Accepts the principle against structural priority by residence status but asks about feasibility, administrative coherence and workarounds for municipalities.
At the same time they have questions about feasibility, administrative coherence and the consequences of the proposal for municipalities, provinces and permit holders.
Tegelijkertijd hebben zij vragen over de uitvoerbaarheid, de bestuurlijke samenhang en de gevolgen van het voorstel voor gemeenten, provincies en vergunninghouders.
Supports priority for Dutch nationals and asks whether municipalities can be given explicit power to favour Dutch nationality in allocation.

These members ask the government whether it is possible within the current bill to amend the Huisvestingswet 2014 so that municipalities are explicitly empowered to give priority to housing seekers with Dutch nationality.

Deze leden vragen de regering of het binnen het huidige wetsvoorstel mogelijk is de Huisvestingswet 2014 aan te passen op een wijze die gemeenten expliciet de bevoegdheid biedt om bij de woonruimteverdeling voorrang te verlenen aan woningzoekenden met de Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Supports equal treatment of all housing seekers and the bill, while asking questions about guarantees for alternative housing capacity.
The BBB members therefore endorse the principle of equal treatment and equal opportunities for everyone who relies on the social rental sector.
De leden van de BBB-fractie onderschrijven daarom het uitgangspunt van gelijke behandeling en gelijke kansen voor iedereen die een beroep doet op de sociale huursector.
Cites the Council of State and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens that the ban violates equality and the right to housing, and asks why the advice was not followed.
These members ask whether the government acknowledges that the advice of the Council of State's Advisory Division is an essential part of the constitutional safeguards in the legislative process.
Deze leden vragen of de regering erkent dat het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State een essentieel onderdeel vormt van de constitutionele waarborgen binnen het wetgevingsproces.
Asks why the law is not made conditional on flanking measures being effective and questions the coherence of the municipal obligation with the priority ban.
Asks about linkage with related asylum bills and the abolition of the municipal task, and about readiness of alternative housing.
Will municipalities not get into serious trouble if the task obligation remains for now but the possibility of giving priority to permit holders is abolished?
Komen gemeenten niet in grote problemen als de taakstelling, vooralsnog, blijft bestaan, maar de mogelijkheid tot voorrangverlening voor vergunninghouders wordt afgeschaft?
Asks the government to commit to heavily weighing negative advice from the Council of State, the Dutch Bar and the Human Rights Institute, and questions equal treatment of vulnerable permit holders.
These members ask the government to clearly confirm that it will not proceed unchanged with a new ban on priority for permit holders in case of negative advice from the Council of State.
Deze leden vragen de regering om helder te bevestigen dat zij een nieuw verbod op voorrang voor vergunninghouders niet onveranderd zal doorzetten bij negatieve advisering door de Raad van State.
Has no questions given the current political developments surrounding the bill.
have no questions given the current political developments regarding the proposal.
hebben geen vragen gezien de huidige politieke ontwikkelingen omtrent het voorstel.
Supports ending priority for permit holders and argues the Council of State's equal-treatment objection overlooks Dutch citizens on waiting lists.
These members note that this is a remarkable line of reasoning: ending a preferential position would be unequal, while long favouring one group apparently was not.
Deze leden merken op dat dit een opmerkelijke redenering is: het beëindigen van een voorkeurspositie zou ongelijk zijn, terwijl het jarenlang bevoordelen van één groep dat blijkbaar niet was.
Objects to the minister abandoning the ban on priority, calling it unacceptable and unfair to waiting home seekers, and asks critical questions about the reversal.
At the same time, these members have taken note with great concern of the report that this Minister is abandoning the ban on priority for permit holders in social rental housing.
Tegelijkertijd hebben deze leden met grote zorgen kennisgenomen van het bericht dat deze Minister afziet van het verbod op voorrang voor vergunninghouders in de sociale huur.
Regrets the withdrawal of the bill, sees sufficient basis for a balanced proposal, and considers further questions pointless.
These members note that they regret this withdrawal.
Deze leden merken daarbij op dat zij deze intrekking betreuren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises against submitting the bill banning priority housing for residence-permit holders (vergunninghouders), arguing it violates the constitutional right to equal treatment because the promised measures will not equalise their housing position in time, and it places municipalities in a very difficult position given the statutory quota. The minister's reply rejects the equal-treatment objection, argues the ban is objectively justified and that measures will normalise the position by mid-2027, and keeps the bill largely unchanged while adjusting the transitional provision and the memorandum.
concerns: The bill removes the compensating priority instrument while the disadvantage of residence-permit holders persists, which the Afdeling says breaches the constitutional right to equal treatment; the government replies the ban is objectively justified and that equal treatment does not require equal outcomes.

The Afdeling considers it unrealistic that the announced measures will achieve the required equal starting position by 1 July 2027; the government expresses confidence they will work within the envisaged timeframe.

The bill strips municipalities of the policy freedom to designate residence-permit holders as an urgency category and makes it very hard to meet the statutory quota, a justification the Afdeling finds insufficient; the government says it has adjusted the amendment and plans to abolish the quota.

Required consultation and an implementability test for decentralised governments were not carried out, indicating a deficient legislative process; the government acknowledges a short consultation period and defends it by urgency.

The savings clause in the bill was inconsistent with the Mooiman amendment to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting, and the Afdeling notes the clause has since been adjusted to assume that amendment is removed.

36903.s: The bill creates a statutory basis for a national school safety monitor (landelijke veiligheidsmonitor) in primary, special and secondary education, under which the Minister processes pupil and staff data with safeguards. It also allows the Minister to provide staff data to sector councils (PO-Raad, VO-raad) via ministerial decisions, and extends NWO access to the student register for research.
36903.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed, standardised rules on monitoring content and process that are better suited to ministerial regulation than to statute, and says the regulation will be consulted with sector organisations and the inspectorate.
q: These concern rules on the topics and background characteristics needed to gain insight into the safety focus areas at school.
Het gaat daarbij om regels voor de uit te vragen onderwerpen en achtergrondkenmerken die noodzakelijk zijn om inzicht te verkrijgen in de aandachtsgebieden van de veiligheid op school.
d: content of safety monitor: background characteristics, topics, process, reporting
Art. I C (art. 167a, lid 6 and 11 WPO)
ministerial decision on staff data transfer to PO-Raad; ministerial regulation on request procedure
content of safety monitor for expertise centres
Art. II C (art. 143a, lid 6 and 11 WEC)
ministerial decision on staff data transfer to PO-Raad and VO-raad; regulation on request procedure
content of safety monitor for secondary education
Art. III C (art. 2.112, lid 6 and 11 WVO)
ministerial decision on staff data transfer to VO-raad; regulation on request procedure
p: Art. I B (art. 4e WPO); Art. III B (art. 3.41a WVO)

Minister may collect sensitive personal data (ethnicity, religion, health, sexual orientation) of pupils and staff for the safety monitor, subject to necessity, retention limits, restricted access and voluntary participation.
Art. I C (art. 167a WPO); Art. II C (art. 143a WEC); Art. III C (art. 2.112 WVO)
Minister may disclose identifiable-by-aggregation staff data to sector councils by decision, with conditions, withdrawal power and Staatscourant publication.

parties: Asks how sensitive personal data of pupils and staff will be protected, how data breaches are prevented and reported, and where data is stored.
These members ask how this bill ensures that data breaches are detected, reported and handled adequately in time.
De leden vragen hoe binnen dit wetsvoorstel wordt geborgd dat datalekken tijdig worden gesignaleerd, gemeld en adequaat afgehandeld.
Supports evidence-informed policy but insists on careful, proportionate use of personal data, especially of minors, and asks about avoiding extra administrative burden.

Questions the necessity and proportionality of the LVM, the sensitivity of processing special personal data of minors, re-identification risks, and the role of the Minister's access rights and mission creep.
Asks what changes for the Staatssecretaris's responsibilities and which monitoring focus areas are involved, and how representativeness risk from non-participation can be mitigated.
These members ask what changes compared with the current situation in the responsibility of the Staatssecretaris.
Deze leden vragen wat er ten opzichte van de huidige situatie verandert in de verantwoordelijkheid van de Staatssecretaris.

Questions the proportionality of the bill against rising administrative burden, the low participation rate, and the overlap with the Vrij en veilig onderwijs bill; asks about the legal basis for processing data that may reveal criminal offences.
Has no questions for the government.
The members have no questions for the government.
De leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.

Asks why no evaluation clause was included, asks why a general administrative order was not chosen instead of a ministerial regulation despite Council of State advice, and questions the voluntary nature and representativeness of the monitor.
Given that special personal data are processed and the concerns in the field, is it not desirable to choose a general administrative order instead of a ministerial regulation?

Is het, gezien het feit dat bijzondere persoonsgegevens worden verwerkt en de zorgen die er in het veld leven, niet wenselijk om alsnog te kiezen voor een algemene regel van bestuur in plaats van voor een ministeriële regeling?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill regulating personal data processing in primary and secondary education (national safety monitor, staff data to PO/VO-Raad, pupil data to NWO), recommending that key safeguards for sensitive and criminal-law data be set in statute, that nadere regels not be left to ministerial regulation, and that a delegation basis be narrowed. The government's reply accepts most points: it adds a statutory access restriction, narrows the delegation basis, and moves protective rules into law.
concerns: Sensitive and criminal-law personal data processing in the safety monitor requires key safeguards in statute, which the government adopted by adding access restrictions and protective provisions in the law.
Ministerial regulation should not set rules on sensitive data processing and specific protective measures; the government removed those delegations and moved protections into the law.
The delegation basis for transferring staff data to the PO/VO-Raad must be concretely and precisely bounded; the government narrowed it to procedural rules on submitting requests.

36912.s: The bill introduces a mandatory basic public insurance for self-employed persons against income loss from incapacity for work, administered by the UWV, with a waiting period of 104 weeks and benefits set by a formula on profit from business. It also allows self-employed persons to opt out in favour of a private disability insurance under a statutory framework, with a stability contribution to protect the system.
36912.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail and flexibility in implementing the scheme, and by the aim of a level playing field and a stable system for self-employed persons.
d: further and possibly deviating rules on incapacity assessment
extending or restricting the circle of insured persons
rules on duties of insured persons; exemptions by ministerial regulation
rules on determining the benefit basis, possibly deviating
definition of income deducted from benefit
rules on opt-out eligibility and calculation of life expectancy indicator
p: Rules that may depart from the statute on incapacity assessment are delegated to an AMvB, with a four-week waiting period after the draft is sent to both chambers.
UWV may suspend or stop benefit payments on the basis of clear indications or a reasonable suspicion of non-compliance, with limited procedural safeguards stated in the text.
UWV may suspend benefit payments where a beneficiary has moved to an unknown destination.

parties: Asks whether policy choices are driven by feasibility rather than political choice, and whether the opt-out and waiting period are realistic.
However, it must be prevented that political, policy discussions become impossible because implementation problems allow only one policy choice.
Voorkomen moet echter worden dat politieke, beleidsmatige discussies onmogelijk worden gemaakt omdat problemen in de uitvoering slechts één beleidsmatige keuze mogelijk maken.
Warns that the Council of State judges the scheme hardly implementable and that UWV is already overburdened, and questions why the government proceeds.
Why does the government nevertheless proceed with a proposal that the Council of State warns is barely implementable?
Waarom zet de regering desondanks door met een voorstel waarvan de Raad van State waarschuwt dat het nauwelijks uitvoerbaar is?
Asks which implementation indicators must be in order before entry into force, given UWV and Tax Authority capacity.
These members ask which concrete implementation indicators the government considers must minimally be in order before the Baz can actually enter into force.

Deze leden vragen welke concrete uitvoeringsindicatoren volgens de regering minimaal op orde moeten zijn voordat de Basisverzekering arbeidsongeschiktheid zelfstandigen (Baz) daadwerkelijk in werking kan treden.
