Questions the legitimacy of the scheme given low self-employed support and lack of direct consultation, and asks whether the bill should be suspended.
Is the government willing, during this consultation, to place the fundamental question of whether the basic insurance in its current form is the right route at the center?
Is de regering bereid om tijdens dit overleg de fundamentele vraag centraal te stellen of de basisverzekering in de huidige vorm wel de juiste route is?
Argues the mandatory insurance disproportionately burdens well-paid self-employed and asks for proportionality justification and guarantees premiums are cost-covering.
How does the government justify this deterioration for this group, particularly given that they often want to take risks and deliberately do not insure (or insure differently)?
Hoe rechtvaardigt de regering deze achteruitgang voor deze groep, met name gezien het feit dat zij vaak wel risico's willen nemen en zich bewust niet (of anders) verzekeren?
Demands an agricultural exemption, arguing the government has not carried out an adopted Kamer motion and needs weighty reasons to set it aside.
Is the government willing to still include an opt-out for this sector in the bill, in implementation of the said motion?
Is de regering bereid alsnog een opt-out voor deze sector op te nemen in het wetsvoorstel, ter uitvoering van genoemde motie?
Opposes compulsory participation in a public scheme for self-employed who choose freedom and private arrangements, and asks for justification and cost data.
These members ask the government to extensively justify why self-employed persons must be forced to participate in a public scheme.
Deze leden vragen de regering uitgebreid te motiveren waarom zelfstandigen gedwongen moeten worden deel te nemen aan een publiek stelsel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that the bill introducing a basic disability insurance for self-employed (BAZ) is hardly implementable, given UWV and Belastingdienst capacity problems and the added complexity to the WIA system, and recommends first simplifying the WIA and reconsidering the bill. The government's reply (nader rapport) acknowledges the complexity and implementation concerns, but decides to continue the legislative process while monitoring the implementation capacity and maintaining the proposed design.
concerns: The Afdeling concludes the BAZ is hardly or not implementable at UWV and Belastingdienst while WIA backlogs persist; the government accepts that capacity must be created first but proceeds with the bill, adding conditions on entry into force.

The Afdeling finds the BAZ provides only partial adequate income protection and limited level playing field due to low benefit cap, 104-week waiting period and opt-out; the government defends these design choices as balancing affordability and implementability.

The Afdeling notes the bill adds substantial complexity (samenloop with WIA and other schemes, anticumulation, profit-based premium, opt-out complications) and many elements are deferred to lower regulation; the government acknowledges the complexity and clarifies parts of the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling raises questions on free movement of services, state aid, competition, and Regulation 883/2004 coordination; the government responds with clarifications and states further arrangements will be made in the implementing act.

36921.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2025 treaty establishing an international claims commission for Ukraine, housed within the Council of Europe framework. It provides that the treaty takes effect the day after the Staatsblad publication.
36921.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by Article 90 of the Constitution obliging promotion of the international legal order and by the Hague's role as city of peace and law, and notes that claims decisions are final, not appealable and not enforceable in national courts.
q: A decision of the claims commission also cannot be enforced through procedures before national courts and other national quasi-judicial bodies of treaty parties, unless a member of the claims commission has expressly consented.

Een beslissing van de schadevergoedingscommissie kan evenmin worden afgedwongen middels procedures voor nationale rechtbanken en andere nationale quasi-judiciële instanties van partijen bij het Verdrag, tenzij een lid van de schadevergoedingscommissie daarmee uitdrukkelijk heeft ingestemd.
d: treaty approval and ratification of an international commission

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the bill approving the treaty establishing an international claims commission for Ukraine and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs forwards the bill to the Crown, with no substantive reply needed since no remarks were made.
